tgt: Khabinete yi tshikelela xirhambo xa Phuresidente Zuma eka mfumo wa Israele ku yima nyimpi ya le hansi ni ya le moyeni leyi yi yaka emahlweni yi vanga ku lahlekeriwa hi vutomi na nkayakayo wo vava wa vanhu.

src: Cabinet is opposed to the veiled attempts by the Israeli Government to use its onslaught on Gaza to undermine the Unity Government in Palestine.
tgt: Nakambe yi lava ku yimisa ku copa tirhokete hi Hamas eka vaakatiko va Israele.

src: There will never be a military solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
tgt: Khabinete yi kanetana na matshalatshala ya xitumbelelani ya mfumo wa Israele ku hlasela Gaza ku tsan’wa Ntwanano wa Mfumo wa Palestina.

src: The only solution lies in serious and genuine negotiations involving all parties.
tgt: Xinchunxo xa kona xi le ka ku kanerisana ka ntiyiso loku katsaka mintlawa hinkwayo.

src: South Africa joins the UN Secretary General, Mr Ban Ki-moon, in calling for an immediate ceasefire by all sides, and a resumption of the flow of humanitarian aid to the suffering people of Gaza.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga ri tihlanganisa na Matsalanankulu wa Nhlangano wa Misava, Tatana Ban Ki-moon, u kombela ku yimisa nyimpi hi matlhelo hinkwawo ni ku pfumelela mfuno wa ximunhu ku ya eka vanhu va Gaza lava xanisekaka.

src: The humanitarian situation is of great concern to Cabinet.
tgt: Xiyimo xa ximunhu i mhaka leyi khumbaka Khabinete swinene.

src: Government appeals to the Egyptian authorities to open their doors to the injured and affected people of Gaza.5 On behalf of the people of the Republic of South Africa, Cabinet conveys its condolences to the families and friends of all the victims of the Malaysia Airlines plane that crashed in Ukraine on 17 July 20.6 Cabinet conveys its condolences to the family and friends of the Nobel Prize-winning author Nadine Gordimer who passed away recently.
tgt: Mfumo wu kombela varhangeri va Egipta ku pfula timbati ta vona eka vanhu lava vavisekeke ni ku khumbeka eGaza.

src: South Africa will always remember Ms Gordimer as a brave activist who used her pen and courageous voice to speak out against the injustices of the apartheid regime.
tgt: Hi ku yimela vanhu va Riphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga, Khabinete yi hundzisela ku chavelela ka yona eka mindyangu ni vanghana vo xanisiwa va xihahampfhuka xa Malexiya lexi fayekeke eYukireyini hi siku ra 17 Mawuwani 2014.

src: Her fiction, which played an important role in the struggle against apartheid, documented the effect that institutionalised racism had on the lives of ordinary South Africans.7 Cabinet sends it condolences to the parents of the 4 year old Taegrin Morris who was killed in a high jacking incidence in Reiger Park South of Johannesburg.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzisela ku chavelela ka yona eka ndyangu na vanghana va Mutsari wa Risiva ra Ndzhangelo Nadime Gordimer loyi a ha ku hundzaka emisaveni ku nga ri khale.

src: Cabinet further joins in condemning such brutality especially on children.
tgt: Afrika Dzonga ri ta tshama ri ri karhi ri tsundzuka Manana Gordimer tani hi nhenha ya migingiriko eka swa tipolitiki loyi a a tirhisa pene ya yena na rito ra yena ra vurhena ku vulavula mayelana na ku pfumaleka ku vululami ka mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu.

src: Cabinet further thanked the police and the members of the public that assisted in the safe return of Mongezi Phike who was recently kidnaped after they hijack his father.8 Cabinet reminds South Africans that the Chancery of Orders is inviting nominations from members of the public, non-governmental organisations, civic- and faith-based organisations for individuals deemed worthy recipients of National Orders.
tgt: Manana Gordimer a a ri xirho lexi tumbuluxeke Khongirese ya Vatsari va Afrika-Dzonga (COSAW) naswona tani hi xirho xa African National Congress, hi 1989, u ve fakazi yo yimelela 11 wa varhangeri va United Democratic Front (UDF) na vagingiriki va swa tipolitiki va Vaal Civil Association.

src: National Orders are the highest form of recognition that a country bestows on deserving citizens.
tgt: Matsalwa ya yena, lama tirheke ntirho lowukulu eka ku lwela nchunxeko eka mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu, ya paluxile mbuyelo lowu nawu wa xihlawula-mbala wu veke na wona eka vutomi bya vanhu ntsena va .maAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Members of the public are requested to submit names of an outstanding individual in their community using a form available from WEBTOKEThis must be accompanied by a separate motivation covering the following areas:an introductory paragraph with summary of the nominee’s achievementsa list of exceptional milestones reached by the nominee in his/her career and/or international arena anda description of the exceptional, outstanding, dedicated service or act of bravery rendered by the nominee.
tgt: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa maAfrika-Dzonga mayelana na “Chancery Orders” yi rhamba vaakatiko, mintlawa leyi nga riki ya mfumo, vanhu ntsena, mintlawa ya vupfumeri ku hlawula vanhu lava faneleke ku xiximiwa ka National Orders.“National Orders” i xiyimo xa le henhla lexi tlhandlekiwaka eka vaakatiko lava faneleke.

src: The nominations will close on 31 July Key Cabinet decisions Cabinet was briefed on the implementation of Section 100 (1)
tgt: Phuresidente tani hi Patironi leyikulu ya “National Orders” hi yena a havaxerisaka mfungho lowu.

src: intervention in Limpopo province and approved the transition of the intervention from section 100 (1)
tgt: Vaakatiko va komberiwa ku yisa mavito ya vanhu lava tihlawulekiseke etikweni hi ku tirhisa fomo leyi kumekaka eka WEBTOKEN Fomo leyi fanele ku va na mbhumambumelo eka tindzawu leti:pharagirafu ya manghenelo na nkomiso wa leswi endliweke hi muhlawuriwanxaxameto wa timhakankulu leti fikeleriweke hi muhlawuriwa eka ntirho wakwe na/kumbe eka arena ya misavanhlamuselo ya vukorhokeri byo hlawuleka byo tlangandla erivaleni bya vutiyimiseri.

src: to section 100 (1)
tgt: Khabinete yi vikeriwile ta ku tirhisiwa ka xiyenga xa 100 (1)

src: with clear conditions given to the Provincial Executive to fulfil as a pre-requisite, for determining full withdrawal.
tgt: xo lamulela xifundzankulu xa Limpopo na ku pfumelela ku nghenelela ka nkarhinyana ku suka eka xiyenga xa 100 (1)

src: A separate briefing that will spell out what was achieved and the process going forward will be held early next week.
tgt: Nhlengelketano yinw’ana ya xiviko lexi andlalaka leswi fikeleriweke na magoza yo ya emahlweni yi ta khomiwa vhiki leri landzelaka.

src: Cabinet approved the 2014-2019 Medium-Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) which will serve as the first 5-year building block towards the 2030 vision in the National Development Plan (NDP).
tgt: Khabinete yi pfumelerile Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi wa Rimba ra Maqhingha (MTSF) wa 2014 – 2019 leri nga ta tirha tani hi ntlhanu wa malembe yo sungula ku kongoma eka xivono xa 2030 xa Pulana ya Rixaka ya Nhluvuko (NDP).

src: The MTSF contains detailed five year implementation plans for the NDP, with targets, indicators, roles and responsibilities and timeframes for the implementation of key actions - to enable systematic and evidence-based monitoring of the implementation of the NDP.
tgt: MTSF yi na vuxokoxoko bya ntlhanu wa malembe byo tirhisa tipulana ta NDP, ku ri na swikongomiwa, swikoweto, mintirho, vutihlamuleri na minkarhi yo tirha migingiriko leyikulu – ku pfumelela vulandzelerisi bya vumbhoni byo khomeka bya ku tirha ka NDP.

src: The MTSF builds on government’s experience and learning during the 2009- 2014 administration, when outcomes-based planning, monitoring and evaluation were introduced for the first time.
tgt: MTSF yi aka ehenhla ka ntokoto wa mfumo na ku dyondza ka vufambisi bya 2009 – 2014, loko ku pulana ka mimbuyelo, ku landzelerisa na ku kambisisa loko ku tivisiwile ro sungula.

src: During that period delivery agreements were developed, monitored and evaluated for the 12 priority outcomes of government which included quality basic education, a long life for all South Africans, safety and security, inclusive growth and decent employment and rural development and land reform.
tgt: Enkarhini wolowo mintwanano ya vukorhokeri a yi hluvukisiwile, landzelerisiwile ni ku kamberiwa eka swirhangana swa 12 swa mimbuyelo ya mfumo leyi a yi katsa nkoka wa dyondzo ya masungulo, vutomi byo leha bya maAfrika Dzonga, vuhlayiseki na nsirhelelo ku katsa ku kula na mintriho leyinene na nhluvukiso wa matikoxikaya na antswiso wa misava.

src: During the 2014-2019 administration the number of outcomes has been increased to 14, with the addition of two new outcomes - social protection and social cohesion and nation building.
tgt: Enkarhini wa vufambisi bya 2014 – 2019 nhlayo ya mimbuyelo yi engeteriwile yi fika eka 14, ku engeteriwile mimbuyelo yimbirhi yintshwa ku hlayiseka ka vanhu na ku hanyisana kun’we ka vanhu na ku aka rixaka.

src: All in all, these 14 outcomes cover all the chapters of the NDThe Ministry of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation will hold a media briefing on the MTSF shortly.3 Cabinet approved that South Africa hosts the Global Smart Partnership Dialogue in October 2014 under the theme: “Leveraging Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) for Socio-economic.
tgt: Hinkwayo mimbuyelo leyi ya 14 yi katsakanya tindzima hinkwato ta NDOfisi ya Holobye wo Pulana, ku Kambisisa Matirhele no Hlela u ta va na bulu na vahaxi va mahungu mayelana na MTSF ku nga ri khale.

src: Transformation through Smart Partnership Principles”.The dialogue provides a platform for Heads of States, business leaders, scientists, academics and student leaders to exchange ideas and experiences related to science, technology and innovation.
tgt: Khabinete yi pfumelerile leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ri amukela vuyeni Nkanerisano wa Vutirhisano lebyinene Bya Misava hi nhweti ya Nhlangula 2014 ehenhla ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Ku Tlakusa Sayense, Thekinoloji na Masungulo Mantshwa (STI) leswaku ku va na ku Hundzuluka ka Ikhonomi ya Vanhu hi Matirhelo ya Vutirhisano Lebyinene.”Nkanerisano wu nyika ndzawu eka Varhangeri va Matiko, varhangeri va mabindzu, van’watisayense, swidyondzeki na varhangeri va machudeni ku cincisana miehleketo na mintokoto leyi fambelanaka na STI na vutumbuluxi byintshwa.

src: Furthermore the dialogue seeks to boosting socio-economic transformation, development and growth in Africa.
tgt: Nakambe nkanerisano wu lava ku tlakusa ku hundzuluka ka ikhonomi ya nhluvuko wa vanhu na ku kula ka Afrika.

src: The hosting will also address the aims and objectives of the National Development Plan on improving science and technology for socio-economic transformation in South Africa and on improving our innovative edge in the region, the continent and globally.
tgt: Ku amukela vuyeni ku ta fikelela makungu na swikongomelo swa NDP hi ku antswisa sayense na thekinoloji ku hundzuluxa ikhonomi ya vanhu eAfrika-Dzonga ni ku antswisa masungulo lamantshwa exifundzeni, tikonkulu ni misava hinkwayo.

src: Upcoming events President Jacob Zuma will launch Women’s Month at the Union Buildings on 31 July 2014 under the theme: “60th anniversary of the Women’s charter as part of the 20 years of Freedom, Moving Women’s Agenda Forward!” The launch will be joined by the Pan African Parliament which will also pay tribute to the Pan African Women’s Organisation and its role in liberating South African women.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u ta simeka Nhweti ya Vamanana eUnion Buildings hi siku ra 31 Mawuwani 2014 ehenhla ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Malembe ya 60 ya Chata ya Vamanana tani hi xiphemu xa 20 wa malembe ya Nchunxeko ku yisa emahlweni Ajenda ya Vamanana.” Ku simekiwa loku ku ta joyiniwa hi Palamende ya Afrika hinkwayo leyi nga ta tsundzuka Nhlangano wa Vamanana va Pan African hinkwavo na ntriho lowu va wu tirheke ku chunxa Vamanana va Afrika Dzonga.

src: A number of activities are planned for the month of August to celebrate the gains made by South Africa in changing the lives of South African women.
tgt: Ku lulamusiwile migingiriko yo tala ya nhweti ya Mhawuri ku tlangela ku vuyeriwa loku endliweke hi Afrika-Dzonga ku cinca vutomi bya Vamanana va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The main event on 9 August will take place in Durban.
tgt: Mugingiriko lowukulu wu ta va hi siku ra 09 Mhawuri eThekwini.

src: The Department of Arts and Culture, as the lead department of Women’s Month, will l also launch the 20 Best Moments for Women during August.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Vutshila na Mfuwo, tani hi ndzawulo ya vurhangeri eka Nhweti ya Vamanana, na yona yi ta simeka 20 wa Migingiriko Leyikulu ya Vamanana hi nhweti ya Mhawuri.

src: These key events mark achievements by exceptional local women and the gains made by all South African women.
tgt: Migingiriko xidzi yi fungha vuswikoti byo hlawuleka bya Vamanana va ndzawu na ku vuyeriwa loku endliweke hi Vamanana hinkwavo va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The details of these events will be announced in due course.2 President Jacob Zuma is scheduled to lead a delegation to participate in the United States-Africa Leaders’ Summit, under the theme: “Investing in the Next Generation”, from 5 to 6 August 2014.
tgt: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u ta rhangela vurhumiwa lebyi nga ta va na xiave eka Samiti ya Varhangeri va United States Africa ehanhla ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Ku Vekisela eka Rixaka Lera Ha Taka” ku suka hi siku ra 5 ku fika 6 Mhawuri 2014, Samiti yi ehleketela ku hlanganisa Valawuri va mabindzu ya Amerika na ya Afrika ku kanela vuvekisi na ku sungula mabindzu eAfrika.

src: The summit is expected to bring US and African business executives together to discuss investment and business opportunities in Africa.
tgt: Nakambe ku ta va na tinhlengeletano ta tiofisiri letikulu ta Vufambisi bya Amerika na Afrika(CEO) na nhlengeletano ya Vaholobye ku languta ku kula ka Afrika (AGOA).

src: There will also be side meetings for American and African Chief Executive Officers (CEOs) and an African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) Ministerial Meeting.
tgt: Tinhlengeletano leti ti kongoma ku tiyisisa vuxaka exikarhi ka Amerika na Afrika ngopfu-ngopfu eka mabindzu na vuvekisi.

src: These meetings are aimed at strengthening relations between United States and Africa particularly on trade and investment.
tgt: Mimbuyelo leyi languteriweke hi leyi: ku khutaza ku hlangana ka swifundza eka tikonkulu ku seketela tiphurogireme to hambana ta nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi wa Nhangano wa Afrika ku rhula na vuhlayiseki ku katsa na ku engetela AGOA ku cinca ka maxele na timhaka to hlayisa mbangu na ku pfuna Afrika ku fikelela xikongomelo xa xivono xa 2063.

src: The envisaged outcomes are: the encouragement of regional integration on the continent support for various African Union economic development programmes, peace and security, including the extension of AGOA climate change and environment protection issues and assistance to meet the Africa 2063 vision goals.3 The Department of Science and Technology will launch the National Science Week (NSW) on 2 August 2014 under the theme: “Today’s science, tomorrow’s world”.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Thekinoloji yi ta simeka Vhiki ra Rixaka ra Sayense (NSW) hi siku ra 2 Mhawuri ehenhla ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Sayense ya Namuntlha, Misava ya Mundzuku”.

src: The NSW 2014 will continue until 9 August 2014 across the country.
tgt: NSW 2014 yi ta ya emahlweni ku fika 9 Mhawuri 2014 eka tiko hinkwaro.

src: During that week there will be a number of science activities throughout the country.
tgt: Eka vhiki leri ku ta va na migingiriko yo tala etikweni hinkwaro.

src: These will entail exhibitions, science shows, workshops and lectures.
tgt: Leyi yi ta katsa minkombiso, minkombiso ya sayense, ndzetelo-vutivi na tidyondzo.

src: Details of the activities will be announced in due course.
tgt: Vuxokoxoko bya migingiriko leyi byi ta tivisiwa hi ku famba ka nkarhi.

src: Women’s Month/ National Women’s Day celebrations.
tgt: N’hweti ya Vamanana/Ku Tlangela ka Rixaka ka Siku ra Vamanana Khabinete yi amukela tipulana ta ku tlangela ka rixaka ka Siku ra Vamanana na migingiriko hinkwayo leyi pulaniweke eka n’hweti hinkwayo ya Mhawuri.

src: Cabinet welcomes plans for the national Women's Day celebrations and all activities planned throughout the month of August.
tgt: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u ta rhangela mugingiriko wa rixaka lowu nga ta khomeriwa eka Xitediyamu xa King Zwelithini, e-Umlazi, eKwazulu Natal, hi siku ra 9 Mhawuri 2014 ehenhla ka nhlokomhaka leyi: “Ku Tlangela 60 wa Malembe ya Chata ya Vamanana na 20 wa Malembe ya Nchunxeko: swin’we hi yisa emahlweni Afrika-Dzonga ro pfumala xihlawuhlawu xa mbala na rimbewu.”Tani hi xiphemu xo tlangela n’hweti ya vamanana, mfumo wu ta va na migingiriko yo tala ku ndzhundzuzela vamanana eka swiyenge swo hambana hambana na ku kombisa leswi hi swi endleke tani hi tiko.

src: President Jacob Zuma will lead the national event to be held at King Zwelithini Stadium, in Umlazi, KwaZulu-Natal, on 9 August 2014 under the theme: “Celebrating the 60th Anniversary of the Women’s Charter and 20 Years of Freedom: together moving non-racial and non-sexist South Africa forward”.As part of the celebrations of women’s month, government will host several events to profile women in different sectors and showcase the achievements we have made as a country.
tgt: Yin’wana ya migingiriko leyi kunguhatiweke yi katsa Masagwati ya Vamanana eka Vuaki (14 Mhawuri), Masagwati ya Vamanana eka Sayense (15 Mhawuri), Masagwati ya Lembe ya Murimi wa Xisati (22 Mhawuri) Masagwati ya Vamanana eka swa Mati (29 Mhawuri).Tani hi xiphemu xo tlangela, Holobye wa Ndzawulo ya Vutshamo bya Vanhu swin’we na Xirho xa Huvonkulu xa Xifundzankulu eka nhlengeletano ya xipecele ya MINIMEKE leyi a yi khomiwile hi siku ra 04 Mawuwani, yi amukerile phurogireme yo phakela 1 956 wa tindlu eka xin’wana ni xin’wana xa swifundzankulu leswa kaye.

src: Some of the events planned include the Women Awards in Construction, 14 August, Women in Science Awards, 15 August, Female Farmer of the Year Awards, 22 August and Women in Water Awards, 29 WEBTOKEN part of the celebrations, the Minister of Human Settlements together with the provincial MEC’s in the special meeting (MINMEC) held on 4 July 2014, approved a programme to deliver 1 956 houses in each of the nine provinces.
tgt: Phurogireme leyi yi hoyozela vamanana lava nga macha va ya e-Union Buildings ku kanetana na milawu ya tipasi hi 1956.Ku simekiwa ko sungula ka phurogireme leyi ku ve kona eka doroba ra Ratanda, eka Masipala ya Muganga ya Lesedi eGauteng hi siku ra 04 Mhawuri 2014.

src: A total of 17 604 houses will be built by women and the beneficiaries will be women, the elderly and child headed households as stipulated by Human Settlements Minister Lindiwe Sisulu during her recent budget speech.
tgt: Ntsengo wo ringana 17 604 wa tindlu wu ta akiwa hi vamanana nakona lava nga ta vuyeriwa i vamanana, lavakulu na miti leyi fambisiwaka hi vana tani hi leswi swi lerisisiweke xiswona hi Holobye wa Vutshamo bya Vanhu Lindiwe Sisulu eka xipichi xa yena xa mpimanyeto wa timali.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to support and participate in the Women’s Month programmes and activities throughout the month to ensure that women achievements are celebrated.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba maAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku seketela no va eka tiphurogireme na migingiriko eka N’hweti ya Vamanana n’hweti hinkwayo ku endla leswaku vuswikoti bya vamanana byi tlangeriwa.

src: The National Women’s Month Programme is attached.
tgt: Phurogireme ya Rixaka ya Nhweti ya Vamanana yi namarhetiwile ehansi.

src: Key programme implementationCabinet welcomes and appreciates the progress on implementation of key government programmes which reflect our commitment to moving South Africa forward.
tgt: Mafambisele Xidzi ya Phurogireme Khabinete yi amukela ni ku hoyozela nhluvuko wo tirha tiphurogireme leta nkoka ta mfumo leswi swi kombaka ku tiyimisela ka hina ku yisa Afrika-Dzonga emahlweni.1 ku pfuriwa ka R30 wa mamiliyoni yo lulamisa Matorokisi ya Rhaliweyi eDe Aar, eKapa N’walungu ku tlakusa ikhonomi ya ndhawu ni ku antswisa mahanyele ya vaakatiko.

src: More than 100 direct jobs have already been created and a further 300 jobs are expected.
tgt: Ku fika sweswi ku se ku tumbuluxiwile mintirho ya 100 na mintirho ya 300 ya ha ehleketeleriwa.

src: The Wagons Refurbishing Facility is part of Transnet’s R300 billion infrastructure plan to revamp and modernise the country’s rail, pipeline and ports network which will create 588 000 new jobs.
tgt: Xitirhisiwa xo Lulamisa Matorokisi i xiphemu xa Rhaliweyi xa R300 wa mabiliyoni ya pulana ya switirhisiwa ku tlhiva no endla rhaliweyi yi va ya ximanguva lawa, netiweke ya tiphayiphi na tiphoto leswi nga ta tumbuluxa mintirho yintshwa ya 588 000.

src: Young people in the area will also benefit from the development of a Youth Multi-Purpose Precinct.
tgt: Lavantshwa endhawini yoleyo va ta vuyeriwa hi ku hluvukisa hi Ndhawu ya Swikongomelonyingi swa Lavantshwa.

src: This project forms part of a number of government infrastructure projects coordinated through the Presidential Infrastructure Coordinating Committee.
tgt: Phurojeke leyi i xiphemu xa tiphurojeke ta mfumu ta swimakiwa leti hlanganisiwaka hi Khomixini yo Kondleta Mafambiselo ya Switirhisiwa ya le hofisini ya Phuresidente.2 Tani hi nsusumeto wa mfumo ku ndlandlamukisa vuswikoti bya vumaki bya Afrika-Dzonga, ku andzisa vumaki bya tiko ni ku tumbuluxa mintirho leyi lavekaka ngopfu , xitirhisiwa xa R80 wa mamiliyoni xi simekiwile e-Epping eka Dorobankulu ra Kapa.

src: As part of government’s drive to expand the capabilities of the South African manufacturing industry, to increase the country’s industrial base and create the much needed jobs, an R80 million facility was launched in Epping Cape Town.
tgt: Xitirhisiwa xa 120 Megawatts xa dyambu xa PV xi simekiwile ximfumo hi siku ra 06 Mhawuri 2014 hi Jinko Solar, khampani ya tinxakanyingi ya Machayina.

src: This is part of the roll-out of the South African Renewable Energy Independent Power Producers Programme (REIPPP).
tgt: Leri i pfhumba ro tumbuluxa Phurogireme ya Vaendli vo tiyimela voxe va Gezi ra Eneji yo Pfuxetiwa-pfuxetiwa ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The facility is expected to produce 1 300 solar panels per day, with an expected R600 million turnover per year.
tgt: Xitirhisiwa lexi xi ehleketeleriwa ku humesa 1 300 wa tiphanele ta dyambu hi siku ku ri karhi ku ehleketeleriwa mbuyelo wa R600 wa mamiliyoni hi lembe.

src: Since the inception of this programme, Jinko Solar has deployed over 300MW of solar PV panels, reaching approximately 30% market share.
tgt: Hi mpfhuka ku tumbuluxiwa phurogireme leyi, Jinko Solar yi rhumerile ku tlula 300 Megawatts ya tiphanele ya PV ta dyambu, ku fikelela kwalomu ka 30% ya xiave xa makete.

src: The plant, which is the newest and most modern of its type on the continent, is expected to produce 120 Megawatts by the end of the year.
tgt: Xitichi lexi nga xintshwa no va xa masiku lawa eka tikonkulu, xi ehleketeleriwa ku humesa 120 Megawatts hi ku hela ka lembe leri.

src: This is part of government’s drive to expand the capabilities of the South African manufacturing industry, to increase the country’s industrial base and create the much needed jobs in Epping.
tgt: Lexi i xiphemu xa mfumo xo andzisa vuswikoti bya vumaki bya Afrika Dzonga, ku kurisa vumaki bya tiko na ku tumbuluxa mintirho leyi lavekaka ngopfu e-Epping.

src: The Green Economy has been identified as a key focus area in the Industrial Policy Action Plan and provides significant opportunities for job creation, localisation and economic growth.
tgt: Ikhonomi ya Rihlaza yi lemukiwile tani hi ndhawu ya nkoka eka Pulana ya Pholisi ya Matirhele ya Vumaki.3 Khabinete yi tsakile hi ku simekiwa ka Sentara ya Manyunyu ya Eneji yo Pfuxetiwa-pfuxetiwa e-Upington, eKapa N’walungu leyi yimelaka mugingiriko wun’wana ku yisa Afrika-Dzonga emahlweni.

src: Cabinet is pleased with the launch of the Renewable Energy Centre of Excellence in Upington, Northern Cape which represents another initiative to move South Africa forward.
tgt: Sentara leyi i mbuyelo lowukulu wa ntirhisano exikarhi ka swidyondzeki, mabindzu ya phurayivhete,na mfumo eka ndhawu ya eneji yo pfuxetiwa-pfuxetiwa.

src: The centre is the result of strong collaboration among academia, the private sector, and government in the area of renewable energy.
tgt: Sentara leyi yi ta seketela ndzavisiso, ku hluvukisa ni ku tumbuluxa eka xiyenge xa eneji, ku tivisa ni ku kucetela swiboho swa pholisi na ku seketela nhluvukiso wa vatirhi.

src: The centre will support research, development and innovation in the energy sector, informing and influencing policy decisions and supporting human capital development.
tgt: Leyi yi ta va na xiave lexikulu eka ku ndlandlamukisa ka Ikhonomi ya Rihlaza, na ku hundzuluxa vutshila bya xifundzankulu na ndhawu.

src: This will contribute significantly towards expanding the Green Economy, and transforming the skills profile of the province and region.
tgt: Eneji yo pfuxetiwa-pfuxetiwa yi na swivekisi swo tala swo tsakisa, ku katsa na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mintirho yinyingi.4 Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Phorojeke ya Thekinoloji ya Gezi ya Tisele ta Fuwele ya Hayidirogene (HFC) hi siku ra 05 Mhawuri 2014 leyi ku nga ku fikelela mbuyelo wa mbhurisano exikarhi ka mfumo na ntirhisano wa Anglo-Ballard.

src: This project to derive power from fuel cell technology is the world's first fuel cell mini-grid electrification field trial.
tgt: Phurojeke leyi yi kuma matimba eka thekinoloji ya sele ya fuwele leyi nga yo sungula emisaveni ku ringeta sele ya fuwele yo sungula ku lumeka gezi.

src: Of particular interest is the pivotal role of the development and deployment of this technology in localisation of the energy value chain specifically the use of fuel cell technology as an alternative generation technology.
tgt: Lexi tsakisaka ngopfu i ntirho wa nhluvukiso na ku tirhisiwa ka thekinoloji etindzawini ngopfu-ngopfu ku tirhisa thekinoloji ya sele ya fuwele tani hi ndlela yin’wana yo jenereta gezi.

src: This project will deepen industrialisation of South Africa’s economy and enable us to reduce the carbon intensity of its economy and contribute significantly to employment creation.
tgt: Phurojeke leyi yi ta entisa vumaki bya ikhonomi bya Afrika-Dzonga na ku hunguta khaboni na ku tumbuluxa mintirho hi ndlela yo hlamarisa.

src: Cabinet approved South Africa’s initial transport sector offer under the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Trade in Services Negotiations.
tgt: Swiboho swa Nkoka swa Khabinete.1 Khabinete yi amukerile Mbulavurisano hi Vukorhokeri bya Vutleketli lowu susumetiweke hi xiyenge xa vutleketli xa Afrika-Dzonga ehansi ka Vaakatiko va Nhluvukiso wa Afrika wa Dzonga (SADC).

src: This sector is critical to South Africa’s growth and job creation prospects, both as an intermediate input to merchandise trade and as a tradable service in its own right.
tgt: Xiyenge lexi i xa nkoka eka nhluvuko na ku tumbuluxa ka mintirho eAfrika-Dzonga, eka swa nkarhinyana wa swixavaxani na vukorhokeri bya mabindzu hi byoxe.

src: Intra-regional integration of transport services can generate commercially valuable market opportunities for South African service suppliers as well as investment across the transport sectors in the region.
tgt: Ku hlanganisa ka vutleketli bya swifundza ku nga va na nkoka lowukulu wa ku tumbuluxa makete ya swixavisiwa ni vuhlayiselo eka xiyenge xa vutleketli eka xifundza lexi.

src: As income is generated by exporting services within value chains, South African companies could obtain commercial benefits and simultaneously contribute to the development of the regional transport sector.
tgt: Leswi mali yi nghenisiwaka hi ku rhumela swixavisiwa, tikhampani ta Afrika-Dzonga ti nga vuyeriwa nakambe ti hluvukisa xiyenge xa vutleketli bya xifundza.2 Khabinete yi tivisiwile hi mbuyelo wa 2013 wo hlaya timhelembe eKruger National Park na ku amukela maqhingha yo nghenelela yo ponisa ntlhambi wa timhelembe.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the outcomes of the 2013 rhino census conducted in the Kruger National Park and approved the recommended strategic interventions to secure the rhino population.
tgt: Ku nga ri khale, Holobye wa Timhaka ta Mbangu u ta tivisa va mahungu hi mhaka leyi.3 Khabinete yi amukerile Matirhele lamantshwa ya Zimbabwe.

src: Cabinet approved that a full review be undertaken of Provincial Development Finance Institutions (PDFIs) based on the findings and recommendations from a desktop review, by National Treasury to assess current financial status and development effectiveness.
tgt: Nkambisiso lowu heleleke wa PDFIs wu ta pfuna ku vona leswaku swiletelo swa yona swi hlanganisiwa na leswaku nseketelo wa Mfumo wa vanhu na swikongomelo swa pholisi ya ikhonomi swa landzeleriwa na maavelele lamanene na matirhisele ya switirhisiwa swa Mfumo.5 Khabinete yi amukerile hi mandla mambirhi nhluvuko wa Maqhingha yo aka hi vuntshwa Ndzawulo ya Mintirho ya Mfumo na Xiviko xo Pfala xa Xiyimo xa Ntshamiseko.

src: Cabinet is satisfied with progress recorded in turning around the department.
tgt: Khabinete yi korwisiwile hi nhluvuko lowu endliweke ku hundzuluxa ndzawulo.

src: The Minister of Public Works will conduct a separate media briefing to explain the details of this report.
tgt: Holobye wa Mintirho ya Mfumo u ta va na va mahungu ku hlamusela vuxokoxoko bya xiviko lexi.

src: Cabinet’s position on current issues.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhaka ta Sweswi Khabinete yi amukela antswiso wa Nawu wa Ndzingano wa Vutholi lowu sunguleke ku tirha hi 1 Mhawuri 2014.

src: The amended Act promotes transformation, fairer labour practices and protects against unfair discrimination.
tgt: Nawu lowu antswisiweke ku khutaza cinco, matirhele lamanene ya ringanelo, na ku sirhelela xihlawuhlawu xo ka xi nga fanelangi.

src: It further strengthens implementation and enforcement mechanisms by, for example increasing fines for non-compliance.
tgt: Wu ya emahlweni wu tiyisisa ku tirhisiwa ni swikoxo, xikombiso ku engetelela tifayini to tlula milawu.

src: Cabinet calls on employers to comply with the provisions of the Act and work with government to transform the workplace.
tgt: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa vatholi ku landzelela swiletelo swa Nawu na ku tirha na Mfumo ku cinca ndhawu yo tirhela kona.

src: Furthermore, the Department of Labour is conducting public road shows to educate the public about employment equity and its impact.
tgt: Tlhandlakambirhi, Ndzawulo ya Mintirho yi le ka tixowu ta le magondzweni ku dyondzisa vanhu mayelana na ndzingano wa vutholi na mihandzu ya kona.2 Khabinete yi ndzhundzuzela Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga eka matlangelo ya le henhla hi nkarhi wa Mintlangu ya Commonwealth eGlasgow, Scotland leri wineke 13 wa golidi, 10 wa silivhere na 17 wa koporo wa timendlele.

src: Cabinet congratulates Team South Africa on its outstanding performance during the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, Scotland which won them 13 gold, 10 silver and 17 bronze medals.
tgt: Afrika- Dzonga yi kume xiyimo xa vunkombo hi ku landzelela timendlele na kona a ri ri leri tirheke swinene eka tiko ra Afrika.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to honour and celebrate the achievements of our South African athletes on Friday, 8 August 2014, when open buses will be carrying the athletes from Olympic House in Johannesburg at 11h.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba maAfrika-Dzonga ku xixima na ku tlangela vunghwazi bya switsutsumi swa Afrika-Dzonga hi Ravuntlhanu ra siku ra ti 8 Mhawuri 2014, loko mabazi yo pfuleka ya ta va ya rhwarile switsutsumi leswi ku suka Olympic House eJoni hi nkarhi wa 11h.3 Khabinete yi ndzhundzuzela xipano xa khirikhete ya rixaka (Proteas) ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Kapiteni wa Mitlangu yo Ringetela Hashim Amla ku va va winile tiserisi to ringetela eSri Lanka na ku va va kumile xiyimo xo sungula eka International Cricket Council World Test ranking.4 Khabinete yi ndzhundzuzela Zolani “Last Born” Tete ku va a winile eka International Boxing Federation (IBF) junior bantamweight title eJapani.5 Khabinete yi rhumela ku chavelela eka ndyangu na vanghana va wanuna loyi a lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya yena hikokwalaho ka ku ninginika ka misava hi Ravumbirhi na ku navelela lava vavisekeke ku hatla va hola.

src: Cabinet also congratulates the national cricket team (Proteas) under the leadership of Test Captain Hashim Amla for winning the Test series in Sri Lanka and regaining the number one International Cricket Council World Test ranking.
tgt: Hi ku pfuniwa hi xiyenge xa Mafambisele ya Mhangu ya Rixaka, mfumo wu le ku langutaneni na vaakatiko lava khumbekeke.

src: Cabinet congratulates Zolani "Last Born" Tete for winning the International Boxing Federation (IBF) junior bantamweight title in Japan.
tgt: Migingiriko leyi ya ha taka.1 Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u ta va eka Samiti ya Ntolovelo ya vu-34 ya Tinhloko ta Matiko ni Mimfumo ya Vaakatiko va Nhluvukiso wa Afrika wa Dzonga (SADC) hi ti 17 na ti 18 Mhawuri 2014 eVictoria Falls, eZimbabwe.

src: SADC continues to be the primary vehicle for South Africa’s foreign policy on regional development and integration.
tgt: SADC yi ya emahlweni yi va muhaxi wo sungula wa pholisi ya matiko ya le handle ya Afrika-Dzonga mayelana na nhluvukiso na nhlanganiso wa xifundza.

src: Pertinent issues to be discussed at the Summit include the Review of the Regional Indicative Strategic Development Plan, the SADC Vision 2050, SADC Tribunal and the Food and Nutrition Strategy and Regional Agricultural Policy.2 The inaugural Mining Lekgotla will be held on 13 and 14 August 2014 at Gallagher Estate, Johannesburg under the theme: “Building on the contribution of mining since the advent of democracy: The past we acknowledge and the future we build.” The Lekgotla allows for strategic interaction between stakeholders in the South African mining industry and other role players.
tgt: Timhaka ta nkoka leti nga ta kaneriwa eka Samiti ti katsa Nkambisiso wa Xifundza lowu kombaka Maqhingha ya Pulana ya Nhluvukiso, Xivono xa 2050 xa SADC, Huvo ya SADC na Maqhingha ya Swakudya na Swinonisi na Pholisi ya Vurimi bya Xifundza.2 Huvo yo sungula ya Lekgotla ya swa Migodi yi ta va hi ti 13 na ti 14 Mhawuri 2014 eGallagher Estate, eJoni ehenhla ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Ku aka ehenhla ka leswi endliweke emigodini hi mpfhuka ka dimokirasi: Swa khale ha swi amukela na vumundzuku ha byi aka.” Huvo yi pfumelela ku hlangana exikarhi ka vakhumbeki va Afrika-Dzonga eka swa migodi na van’wana.

src: Cabinet urges all partners to work towards the implementation of the Framework Agreement for a Sustainable Mining Industry and reaffirms that Government will monitor compliance with the Mining Charter.3 The Centre for Public Service innovation will hold its 8th Public Sector Innovation Conference on 19 and 20 August 2014 in Cape Town under the theme “Building an Innovative State Machinery for Maximised Service Delivery Impact”.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba vatirhisani hinkwavo ku tirhela ku fikelela Rimba ra Ntwanano ra Migodi ya Nkarhi wo Leha na ku tiyisisa leswaku Mfumo wu ta xiyisisa loko swilaveko swa Chata ya Migodi swi ri karhi swi fikeleriwa.3 Sentara ya Vukorhokeri bya Mfumo bya maendlelo lamantshwa yi ta va na Khonferense ya vunhungu ya Xiyenge xa Vukorhokeri bya Mfumo bya Maendlelo Lamantshwa hi ti 19 na ti 20 Mhawuri 2014 eka Dorobankulu ra Kapa ehenhla ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Ku aka Muchini wa Mfumo wa Maendlelo Lamantshwa ku va na Vukorhokeri lebyi antswisaka vutomi bya Vanhu” .

src: Cabinet wishes delegates fruitful deliberations as innovation in the public sector is vital to help us achieve Vision 2030 as outlined in the National Development Plan.
tgt: Khabinete yi navelela varhumiwa mbhurisano lowunene tani hi leswi matirhele lamantshwa ya nga ya nkoka eka xiyenge xa mfumo ku hi pfuna ku fikelela Xivono xa hina xa 2030 tani hileswi xi nga xiswona eka Pulana ya Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka.

src: Cabinet also commends all nominees for the Public Sector Innovation Awards which recognises and rewards innovation that improves the lives of all South Africans.6 Appointments.1 Cabinet noted the appointment of the following Non-Executive Directors to serve on the Board of the Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi khutaza vahlawuriwa hinkwavo va Masagwati ya Xiyenge xa Mfumo xa Matirhele Lamantshwa lexi hlawulaka no khensa matirhele lamantshwa lama antswisaka vutomi bya maAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo.

src: Implementation of key government programmesCabinet commends the launch of another Sexual Offences Court in Bethlehem, Free State by Minister Michael Masutha.
tgt: Ku Tirhisiwa ka Tiphurogiremenkulu ta MfumoKhabinete yi hoyozela ku simekiwa ka khotso yin’wana ya Vugevenga bya Timhaka ta Masangu eBethlehema eFree State hi Holobye Michael Masutha.

src: This forms part of government’s intervention programme in the fight against sexual violence against women, children and the vulnerable groups.
tgt: Leswi i xiphemu xa phurogireme ya mfumo yo lwa ni vugevenga bya timhaka ta masangu eka vavasati, vana ni mintlawa yo nyenyela.

src: These dedicated courts are equipped to provide specialised victim-support services which in turn help to improve conviction rates.
tgt: Tikhotso leto tirhana ni mhaka yo karhi tilulamiseriwile ku tisa vukorhokerhi bya xiyimo ni nseketelo eka vatwisiwakuvava leswi hi hala tlhelo swi pfunaka ku tlakusa xiyimo xa khotsa vaendli va milandzu.

src: Government remains resolute to strengthen the criminal justice system so as to deal decisively with the violation of the rights of women and children.
tgt: Mfumo wu tiyimiserile ku tiyisa xiyenge xa timhaka ta vugevenga ni vululami leswaku ku ta tirhaniwa hi ku hetiseka ku kandziyeriwa ka timfanelo ta vavasati ni vana.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch by Minister Lindiwe Zulu of the Enterprise Development Academy based at the Gordon Institute of Business Science.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Akhademi ya Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu hi Holobye Lindiwe Zulu eka Gordon Institute of Business Science.

src: The Academy focuses on scholarship-based education and support to micro and small business owners by helping them grow sustainably to create further employment in the long term.
tgt: Akhademi yi kongomisiwile eka dyondzo ya swikolaxipi no tlhela yi seketela vinyi va mabindzu lamantsongo hi ku va pfuna ku kurisa mabindzu ya vona hi ndlela leyi nga heriki no tumbuluxa mintirho.

src: The Academy is part of the solution to address youth unemployment and build a nation of entrepreneurs.
tgt: Akhademi i xiphemu xa xintshuxo xo lwa ni ku kavivela ka mintirho eka vantshwa no aka rixaka ra vanhu lava rhandzaka ku tisungulela mabindzu ya vona.

src: It aims to provide practical and relevant business education and leadership training to entrepreneurs, followed by a comprehensive structure of support services.
tgt: Xikongomelonkulu i ku nyika dyondzo leyi nga fanela ya vufambisi bya mabindzu hi ndlela leyi vanhu lava rhandzaka ku tisungulela mabindzu ya vona va nga ta tiendlela hi voxe, ni ku letela vurhangeri eka vanhu lava nga tinyiketa ku sungula mabindzu ya vona, swi landzela hi vukorhokerhi bya nseketelo lebyi twisisekaka.

src: This ensures that academic learning is applied to the business environment and that impact is achieved.
tgt: Leswi swi ta humelerisa dyondzo ya xiakhademi eka xiyenge xa mabindzu ni ku cinca eka maendlelo ya swilo.

src: South Africa needs an entrepreneurial revolution in order to spark a shift in direction towards entrepreneurship and SMEs that will move the country forward.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga ri lava miehleketo leyintshwa yo tisungulela mabindzu leswaku ku ta va ni ku lumekiwa ka moya wo tumbuluxa mabindzu hambi ku ri lamantsongo na la ma lexikarhi (tiSME) lama nga ta yisa tiko emahlweni.

src: Government, big business and academic institutions need to collaborate when it comes to supporting job creation through enterprise development.
tgt: Mfumo, mabindzu lamakulu na minhlangano ya xiakhademi swi fanele ku vumba nyandza yin’we ku seketela ku tumbuluxiwa ka mintirho hi ndlela yo hluvukisa mabindzu.

src: In order to flourish, business creation needs an enabling environment where entrepreneurs have access to funding, best-practice tools and skills development.
tgt: Ku endlela leswaku mabindzu ya ndlandlamuka, ku laveka rivala leri baseke laha vanhu lava randzaka ku tumbuluxa mabindzu va nga ta kota ku fikelela timali to sungula hi tona, switirho swa xiyimo xa le henhla na nhluvukiso wa vuswikoti.

src: Key Cabinet decisionsCabinet approved the ratification of the signed Grand Inga Treaty between the Republic of South Africa and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) for tabling in Parliament.
tgt: Swiboho swa nkoka swa KhabineteKhabinete yi pasisile Ntwanano wo pasisa ku sayiniwa ka Grand Inga exikarhi ka Rhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga na Rhiphabuliki ra Xidemokirasi ra Khongo (DRC) leswaku wu ya tivisiwa epalamende.

src: The Treaty provides the framework for the facilitation of power generation from Grand Inga Project and its delivery to the border between the DRC and Zambia.
tgt: Ntwanano lowu wu tisa maendlelo yo kondlotela ku tumbuluxiwa ka matimba ku suka eka Projeke ya Grand Inga no tlhela ya rhumeriwa endzilikaneni wa DRC na Zambia.

src: Ratification of the Treaty enables development of Phase I of the Project, which will provide 2 500 Megawatts of electricity to South Africa and contribute to regional integration, energy security, access to energy and economic growth in an environmentally sustainable manner.
tgt: Ku pasisiwa ka Ntwanano lowu swi tisa ku hluvukisiwa ka Xiyenge xo sungula xa Projeke, leyi nga ta phamela 2 500 wa timegawatsi ta gezi eAfrika-Dzonga no tlhela wu tisa xiave eka vun’we bya rhigini, vuhlayiseki bya eneji, ku fikelela eneji ni ku ndlandlamuka ka ikhonomi hi ndlela leyi nga heriki.

src: The project has the potential to supply clean and affordable imported hydroelectric power to meet the needs of the DRC, South Africa and surrounding countries.
tgt: Projeke yi na vuswikoti byo phamela gezi ra le matini ro basa no xaveka ku fikelela swilaveko swa DRC, Afrika-Dzonga ni matiko lama vandzekaneke na wona.

src: It entails the generation of approximately 40 000 Megawatt of hydropower on the Congo River, over seven phases.
tgt: Leswi swi vula ku tumbuluxiwa ka kwalomo ka 40 000 wa timegawatsi ta gezi ra le matini ku suka Enambyeni wa Kongo, hi tindlela ta kombo.

src: The project holds the potential to fast-track Southern African Development Community (SADC) development alleviate energy poverty, stimulate economic growth and facilitate infrastructure development.
tgt: Projeke yi ni vuswikoti byo tisa nhluvuko wa SADC hi xihatla ku olovisa vusiwana byo pfumala gezi, ku nyanyula ku ndlandlamuka ka ikhonomi ni ku kondlotela nhluvuko wa switirhisiwa.

src: The Grand Inga project will seek to harness the power potential of the Congo River, sub-Saharan Africa's greatest waterway.
tgt: Projeke ya Grand Inga yi ta ringeta hi matimba ku humelerisa matimba lama nga Enambyeni wa Congo, ku nga matindlela lamakulu eka xiphemuntsongo xa Sahara wa Afrika.

src: This represents one of the most ambitious projects ever undertaken on the African continent, and one which will long be a resounding symbol of the rise of Africa and her people.
tgt: Leyi i yin’wana ya tiprojeke leyi tiyimeseleke ku humelela no simekiwa exifundzheninkulu xa Afrika, naswona leyi nga ta tshama yi ri xikombiso xa xiyimo xa le henhla xa ku tlakuka ka Afrika lokukulu ni vanhu va rona.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the upcoming International Gender, Water and Development Conference.
tgt: Khabinete yi pimeriwile hi ta Khoferense ya Misava ya Rimbewu, Mati na Nhluvuko.

src: The conference will be hosted by the Department of Water and Sanitation, Water Research and its partners in the sector.
tgt: Khoferense yi ta fambisiwa hi Ndzawulo ya Mati ni Nkululo, Nhlangano wa Vulavisisi bya Mati na vanghana va yona eka xiyenge lexi.

src: The conference will be held from the 3 to 7 November in East London under the theme “The Untapped Connection”.
tgt: Khoferense yi ta khomiwa ku suka hi ti 3 ku fika ti 7 ta Nhlangula eEast London ehansi ka mongo lowu nge “Vuhlanganisi Lebyi nga se Tumbuluxiwaka”.Khoferense yi landza n’wangulano lowu yaka emahlweni naswona lowu sunguleke endzhaku ka Khoferense ya Misava ya Mati lawo Tenga leyi veke kona hi Nhlangula 2012.

src: The conference follows a number of ongoing dialogues that started after the International Freshwater Governance Conference that was held in November 2012.
tgt: Khoferense yi ta nyika nkarhi wo tumbuluxa vunghana lebyi nga ta vulavula hi mintlhontlho leyi khumbhaka xiyenge xa timhaka ta mati.

src: It will also address the roll-out of the African Ministers Council on Water Gender Strategy.
tgt: Yi ta tlhela yi vulavula hi ku andlariwa ka Khansele ya Vaholobye va Afrika ya Pulani ya Rimbewu ya Mati.

src: Cabinet’s Position on Current Issues	Cabinet was briefed by the Minister of Health, Mr. Aaron Motsoaledi, on developments around Ebola and interventions made by South Africa .
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhaka ta sweswiKhabinete yi pimeriwile hi Holobye wa Rihanyo, Dokodela Aaron Motsoaledi, mayelana ni leswi nga ku humeleleni eka timhaka ta Ebola ni ku nghenelela ka Afrika-Dzonga eka timhaka ta vuvabyi lebyi.

src: Cabinet wishes to reiterate that no person has been found positive with the disease.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhandza ku engeta yi vula leswaku ku hava munhu loyi a nga kumeka a khomiwile hi vuvabyi lebyi.

src: The country’s state of readiness and response on Ebola requires strengthen capacity in the SADC region and the rest of the continent which South Africa can offer.
tgt: Xiyimo xa tiko mayelana ni ku lungheka ni nhlamulo ya rona ya Ebola swi lava leswaku rhigini hinkwayo ya SADC kun’we ni xifundzhankulu hinkwaxo swi tshama swi lunghekile hi ku nyikiwa matimba tani hihilaha Afrika-Dzonga ri nga swi kotaka hakona.

src: South Africa remains committed to provide support through screening, training and laboratory services for the SADC region.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga ri ti yimiserile ku nyika nseketelo hi ku tirhisa michini yo kota ku vona munhu a ha ri ekule loko a ri ni vuvabyi lebyi, ku letela ni vukorhokerhi bya le tilaborotari eka rhigini hinkwayo ya SADHolobye Motsoaledi u ta nyika nhlamuselo hi xitalo ya mhaka leyi hi 14:30.Khabinete yi amukela makungu ya Bangi ya le Xikarhi ya Afrika-Dzonga ni ntlawa wa vuvekisi ku suka eka xiyenge xa timali yo langutisisa matirhelo ya African Bank Limited (ABL) hi vuntshwa.

src: This will assist to appropriately safeguard retail depositors and minimise losses for investors in ABThis will also ensure the country’s financial sector remains strong and robust.
tgt: Leswi swi ta pfuna ku sirhelela hi ndlela leyi amukelakaka vavekisi va timali no tlhela swi hunguta ku lahleka ka timali eka ABSwi ta tlhela swi endla leswaku xiyenge xa swa timali xa tiko xi tshama xi tiyile handle ko tsekatseka.

src: Cabinet emphasised, the importance of the financial services sector to economic growth and highlighted that government, through the National Treasury, will continue to strengthen the sector, its oversight, and improve regulatory coordination.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshikelerile nkoka wa xiyenge xa vukorhokerhi bya swa timali eku kuriseni ka ikhonomi, yi tlhela yi tshikelela leswaku mfumo, hi ku tirhisa Timali ta Tiko, wu ta ya emahlweni wu tiyisa xiyenge lexi, wu tlhoma tihlo, no tlhela wu antswisa vuhlanganisi bya vufambisi bya xiyenge.

src: Cabinet noted with concern the misinformation about the various reforms regarding retirement funds (pension and provident funds).
tgt: Khabinete ya khumbheka hi vuhangalasi bya mahungu bya mavun’wa mayelana ni ku cinca loku nga kona eka timhaka ta vulawuri bya timali ta tiphexeni (timali ta swa tiphexeni na tiphurovhidente).

src: There is anecdotal evidence that some workers are resigning from work on fears that government will from next year prevent them from withdrawing their retirement savings when they change jobs, and that government wants to take over retirement funds.
tgt: Ku ni vumbhoni bya mahungundlela ya leswaku van’wana va vatirhi va le ku tshikeni ka mintirho hi ku tshava leswaku ku suka haxawa mfumo wu ta va sivela ku teka timali ta vona ta phexeni leti va ti vekeke loko va cinca mintirho, na leswaku mfumo wu lava ku teka vulawuri bya swa timali ta tiphexeni.

src: While government wants to encourage workers to preserve their savings until retirement, no laws have changed to stop withdrawal when workers change jobs.
tgt: Hambileswi mfumo wu lavaka ku khutaza vatirhi ku hlayisa mali ya vona ku kondza va ya ephexenini, ku hava nawu lowu sivelaka vanhu ku koxa mali ya vona loko va cinca mintirho.

src: By contrast, the various retirement reform proposals seek to:a) Encourage individuals to provide adequately for their own retirement and the needs of their dependents and to provide for retirement funding as part of the remuneration contractb) Make retirement funding arrangements cost-efficient, prudently managed, transparent and fair and c) Improve standards of fund governance, including standards of fund governance, including trustee knowledge and conduct, protection of members’ interest, accountability and disclosure of material information to members and contributors.
tgt: Ntiyiso hileswaku swipimanyeto swa ku cincacinca loku nga kona eka timhaka ta vulawuri bya tiphexeni swi lava ku:a) Khutaza vanhu ku endla vuvekisi byo ringanela bya phexeni ya vona hi ku languta swilaveko swa vanhu lava tiseketeleke hi vona kun’we ni ku endla leswaku timali ta vona ta tiphexeni ti va xiphemu xa ntwanano wa vona wa miholob) Endla leswaku timali ta vona ta phexeni ti lulamisiwa hi ndlela yo xaveka, ti lawuriwa hi vukheta, hi ndlela leyi nga rivaleni no lulama ni kuc) Antswisa xiyimo xa vulawuri bya timali, ku katsa ni vutivi bya mafambiselo, vuhlayisi ni ku navela ka swirho, vutihlamuleri ni ku tivisa swirho ni van’wana vanhu lava hoxaka xandla hi timhaka ta nkoka leti va khumbhaka.

src: Cabinet wants to assure the public that people’s retirement savings remain safe.
tgt: Khabinete yi lava ku khorisa vanhu leswaku vuvekisi bya vona bya tiphexeni byi hlayisekile.

src: There is no reason for any worker (both in the private and public sector) to resign so as to access their retirement savings.
tgt: Ku hava xivangelo xa mutirhi wihi kumbe wihi (wa xiyenge xa xihundla kumbe xa mani na mani) ku tshika ntirho hi xikongomelo xo koxa timali ta vona ta tiphexeni leti va ti vekiseke.

src: It should also be noted that those cashing out their pension or provident funds before retirement will not only get less money than they would had they preserved, but they may be taxed on early withdrawals and no longer enjoy the tax advantages.
tgt: Swi fanele swi vekiwa erivaleni leswaku lava tirhisaka mali ya vona ya phexeni kumbe phurovhidente va nga se huma phexeni a va nga kuma mali yi ntsanana ntsena eka leyi a va ta yi kuma loko a va yi tshikile tano, kambe va nga tlhela va hakerisiwa xibalo xo va va hatlile va kutsula mali ya vona nkarhi wu nga si fika, naswona a va ha vuyeriwa hi vuyelo wa xibalo lowu a va ta vuyeriwa ha wona.

src: Upcoming eventsMinister Nathi Mthethwa will launch Heritage Month in Gauteng on 31 August under the theme: “Celebrating 20 Years of Democracy: Tell Your Story that Moves South Africa Forward”.
tgt: Migingiriko leyi ha takaHolobye Nathi Mthethwa u ta simeka Nhweti ya Ndzhaka eGauteng hi ti 31 Mhawuri ehansi ka mongo lowu nge: “Ku tlangela 20 wa malembe ya Xidemokarisi: Vula Xitori xa Wena lexi Yisaka Afrika-Dzonga Emahlweni”.

src: Among the projects identified to advance the “Tell Your Story” campaign are the reburials of Nat Nakasa and Moses Kotane.
tgt: Exikarhi ka tiprojeke leti hlawuriweke ku yisa vumpfhumba bya “Vula Xitori xa Wena” emahlweni i ku lahliwa hi vuntshwa ka Nat Nakasa na Moses Kotane.

src: Repatriations of unsung heroes provide South Africans with an opportunity to learn more about their personal struggles, the circumstances that led to them living in exile and the impact they had on the liberation of our country.
tgt: Ku vuyisiwa ka tinhenha leti nga tlhomiwangiki tinsiva swi nyika maAfrika-Dzonga nkarhi wo dyondza hi switori swa vona swa vulwelantshuxeko, swiyimo leswi endleke leswaku va ya tshama evuchavelahwahwa ni xiave lexi va veke ni xona eka ntshuxeko wa tiko ra hina.

src: Other events include: National Book Week from 1 to 7 September under the theme: “Going Places” focusing on the power of books and how they can ‘figuratively’ and ‘literally’ take South Africans to places.
tgt: Mintlangu yin’wana yi katsa: Vhiki ra Buku ya Rixaka ku suka ti 1 ku fika ti 7 Ndzhati ehansi ka mongo: “Ku Famba Tindhawu” lowu kongomisiweke eka matimba ya tibuku na hileswi ti, hi ‘ririmi ro gega’ ni ‘ririmi ra ntolovelo’, yisaka maAfrika-Dzonga etindhawini.

src: Events are planned in all the provinces and will include reading in indigenous languages, storytelling and motivational talks, word-a-thons, poetry sessions and book debates.
tgt: Mintlangu yi kunguhatiwile eswifundzheninkulu hinkwaswo naswona yi ta katsa ku hlaya hi tindzimi ta xintu, ku hlaya switori na mbulavulo wo khutaza, nkarhi wa vutlhokovetseri ni njekanjekisano wa tibuku.

src: Also, on 3 September South Africa will commemorate the 30th Anniversary of the Vaal Uprising during which the Vaal Triangle community protested against rent increases, poor service delivery and an illegitimate, and defunct local government.
tgt: Ku engetela, hi ti 3 Ndzhati Afrika-Dzonga ri ta tlangela Lembe ra vu 30 ra Nkombisavilela wa Vaal, ku nga siku leri muganga wa Vaal Triangle wu kombiseke ku vilela hi ku tlakuka ka tihakelo ta rhente, vukorhokerhi bya xiyimo xa le hansi na mfumo wa miganga lowu a wu nga ri enawini no tlhela wu nga pfuni nchumu.

src: The Vaal Uprising introduced a new period of sustained protest that spread to large parts of the country, prompting the apartheid authorities to declare a state of emergency.
tgt: Nkombisavilela wa Vaal wu nghenisile rhengu rintshwa ra ku vilela loku nga heriki naswona lowu tluleleke eka swiyenge swo hlaya swa tiko, kutani swi kucetela vafambisi va mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu ku boha xiyimo xa khombo.

src: Minister Derek Hanekom will launch Tourism Month on 26 August at Maboneng Precinct, Johannesburg, under the theme: “Tourism Transforming Lives”, which is derived from World Tourism Day (27 September) and focuses on the social, cultural, political and economic value of tourism to the country.
tgt: Holobye Derek Hanekom u ta simeka Nhweti ya Vumpfhumba hi ti 26 Mhawuri ePrecinct ya Moboneng, eJoni, ehansi ka mongo: “Vumpfhumba byi Cinca Vutomi”, ku nga mongo lowu lombiweke eka Siku ra Vumpfhumba ra Misava (27 Ndzhati) naswona ri kongomisiwile eka nkoka wa vumpfhumba etikweni mayelana ni mahanyelo ya vanhu, ndhavuko, tipolitiki na ikhonomi.

src: South Africans are encouraged to travel within our country during Tourism Month and to familiarise themselves on the importance of tourism to the economy.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga va khutaziwa ku teka marendzo ya vona kwala tikweni hi nkarhi wa Nhweti ya Vumpfhumba no tlhela va titoloveta ku tsundzuka nkoka wa vumpfhumba eka ikhonomi.

src: National Arbor Week will be celebrated from 1 to 7 September under the theme: “Forests and People: Investing in a sustainable future”.
tgt: Vhiki ra Rixaka ro Byala Minsinya ri ta tlangeriwa ku suka hi ti 1 ku fika ti 7 ta Ndzhati ehansi ka mongo: “Swihlahla na Vanhu: Ku vekisa eka vumundzuku lebyi nga heriki”.

src: South Africans are encouraged to plant the identified trees for 2014, either the Vepris lanceolata (commonly known as: White Ironwood/ Witysterhout/ Muruvula/ Muhondwa/ umZane/ umOzana) or the Heteropyxis Natalensis Harvey (commonly known as: Lavender Tree/ Laventelboom/ iNkunzi).
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga va khutaziwa ku byala minsinya leyi hlawuriweke eka lembe ra 2014, ku nga miVepris lanceolata (leyi tivikaka tanihi: Muhondwa) kumbe Heteropyxis Natalensis Harvey (leyi tivikaka tanihi: Minsinya ya Lavender).Ndzawulo ya Vurimi, Swihlahla na swa Tinhlampfi (DAFF), hi ku tirhisana na Nhlangano wa Mbango na Vufambisi bya Vuhangalasi na Total South Africa, va ta fambisa mphikazano wa Sagwadi ra Doroba ra Minsinya ya Rixaka.

src: The purpose is to encourage Local Municipalities to green their areas of jurisdiction.
tgt: Xikongomelo i ku khutaza Mimfumo ya Miganga ku tisa rihlaza etindhawini ta vona.

src: National Arbor Week and the National Arbor City Award is conducted in line with the DAFF greening strategy which defines greening as an integrated approach to the planting, care and management of all vegetation in urban and rural areas.
tgt: Vhiki ro Byala Minsinya ya Rixaka na Sagwadi ra Doroba ra Minsinya ya Rixaka ri fambisiwi hi ku landzelela pulani ya DAFF yo tisa rihlaza, leri hlamuselaka vuhlaza tanihi maendlelo lama katsakatsiweke yo byala, ku hlayisa no fambisa swimilani hinkwaswo emadorobeni ni le matikoxikaya.

src: Appointments	Cabinet approved the following appointments:Mr Themba Stanley Kojana as Deputy Director-General: Teachers, Human Resource and Institutional Development, in the Department of Basic WEBTOKEN Clifford Abraham Appel as Chief Financial Officer at the Department of Social Development.
tgt: MintholoKhabinete yi pasisile ku thoriwa ka vanhu lava landzelaka:Tatana Themba Stanley Kojana tanihi Xandla xa Mufambisinkulu: Vadyondzisi, Vufambisi bya Vatirhi na Nhluvukiso wa Nhlangano, eka Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya le Masungulo.

src: Cabinet concurred with the following appointments to serve as members of the National Public Transport Regulator:a) Mr Lesedi Dinte, andb) Ms Divhani Edzisani Tshivhase.
tgt: Tatana Clifford Abraham Appel tanihi Mufambisinkulu wa swa Timali eka Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu.

src: c) ProfNtombizozuko Dyani-MhangoCabinet approved the appointment of Semira Mohammed as a Non-Executive Member to the Board of the Cross-Border Road Transport Agency.
tgt: Khabinete yi pfumelelanini ni ku thoriwa ka lava landzelaka ku tirha tanihi swirho eka Muleteri wa Vutleketli bya Mani na Mani:a) Tatana Lesedi Dinte, nab) Manana Divhani Edzisani Tshivhase.

src: Cabinet welcomes the official opening by President Zuma of the Dr Harry Surtie Hospital in Upington, Northern Cape, on 2 September 2014.
tgt: Mafambisele Xidzi ya Tiphurogireme ta Mfumo.1 Khabinete yi amukela ku pfuriwa ximfumo ka Xibedhlele xa Dokodela Harry Surtie eUpington, Kapa N’walungu hi 2 Ndzhati 2014.

src: This comes four days after another new hospital was opened by Minister of Health Dr Aaron Motsoaledi in Natalspruit, Gauteng.
tgt: Leswi swi ta endzhaku ka masiku ya mune ku pfuriwile xibedhlele xin’wana hi Holobye wa Rihanyo Dokodela Aaron Motsoaledi eNatalspruit, Gauteng.

src: These are amongst many important milestones in government’s national infrastructure programme which will see 43 hospitals and 213 clinics built over the next five years to meet the needs of the National Health Insurance system.
tgt: Lawa hi yan’wana ya magoza ya nkoka eka tiphurogireme ta switirhisiwa ta rixaka ta mfumo lawa ya nga ta vona ku akiwa ka 43 wa swibedhlele na 213 wa titliliniki eka malembe ya ntlhanu lawa taka ku fikelela swilaveko swa matirhelo ya Ndzindzakhombo ya Rihanyo ya Rixaka.2 Khabinete yi ndunduzela ku khomiwa ni ku tekiwa ka nhundzu loku nga va kona ehansi ka Project Darling ka ntlawa lowu ehleketiriwaka ku vutlela vachayeri tilori to rhwala nhundzu.

src: Cabinet commends the recent arrests and seizures under Project Darling and the arrest of a gang suspected of truck hijackings.
tgt: Project Darling yi tswale mihandzu hi ku vuyerisa dayimani leyo ka yi nga ri enawini ni hi nhundzu ya nxavo wa 50 wa mamiliyoni ya tirhandzi, 15 wa makaya na 43 wa timali ta matikomambe.

src: Later this month the police will release the annual crime statistics.
tgt: Eku heleni ka nhweti leyi maphorisa ya ta humesa tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ta lembe rin’wana ni rin’wana.

src: These figures are based on the actual number of cases reported to the Police, and will reflect successes and challenges.
tgt: Tinhlayohlayo leti ti landzelela nhlayo ya ntiyiso ya tikheyisi leti vikiweke Emaphoriseni, no tlhela ti komba ku humelela loku endliweke ni mintlhontlho leyi nga kona.

src: The publication of these figures allows us to engage in informed discussion on how to strengthen the partnerships with society around government’s comprehensive anti-crime strategic interventions.
tgt: Ku kandziyisiwa ka tinhlayohlayo leti swi hi pfumelela ku nghenelela hi xiviri eka mbulavulo wa ku teka magoza yo tiyisisa vunghana ni vaakatiko eka pulani ya mfumo yo nghenelela hi matimba ku lwa ni vugevenga.

src: For the country to be successful in fighting crime, Cabinet urges communities to play their part in reporting crime and supporting community safety forums as the fight against crime calls for community-wide effort.
tgt: Ku va tiko ri ta humelela ku lwa ni vugevenga, Khabinete yi khutaza miganga ku va ni xiave hi ndlela yo vika vugevenga ni ku seketela minhlangano ya miganga ya vuhlayiseki hikuva nyimpi yo lwa ni vugevenga yi lava leswaku miganga hinkwayo yi hlanganisa tinhloko.

src: Government condemns the brutal attacks we have seen against members of the South African Police Services while on duty.
tgt: Mfumo wo sola ku hlaseriwa hi tihanyi ka swirho swa Vukorokerhi bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga hi nkarhi wa ntirho.

src: On Sunday, 7 September 2014 government will honour and pay tribute to these police officers who lost their lives in the line of duty.
tgt: Hi Sonto 7 Ndzhati 2014 mfumo wu ta hlonipha ni ku hluvulela xihuku maphorisa lava lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya vona hi nkarhi wa ntirho.

src: Cabinet invites the nation to pay tribute these officers who died while trying to enforce the law.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba rixaka ku hluvulela xihuku maphorisa lava lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya vona loko va ri karhi va tirha ntirho wa vona ku humelerisa nawu wa tiko.3 Khabinete yi amukela ku tivisiwa hi ta xitirhisiwa xa vurimi bya mati ya lwandle xa nxavo wa R2 biliyoni eNdzhawini ya Nhluvukiso wa Vuendli bya Tinhundzu ya Coega eKapa Vuxa leyi nga ta avela 80 wa tihekitara eka vurimi bya abalone hi 2020 no tlhela yi tumbuluxa 2 080 wa mintirho ya nkarhi hinkwavo.

src: Cabinet welcomes the announcement of a R2 billion aqua-farming facility at the Coega Industrial Development Zone in the Eastern Cape which will allocate 80 hectares to abalone farming by 2020 and create about 2 080 permanent jobs.
tgt: Phurojeke leyi i xiphemu xa Operation Phakisa leyi lavaka ku pfula tinyangwa ta vuswikoti bya ikhonomi ya malwandle ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: This project is part of Operation Phakisa that seeks to unlock the economic potential of South Africa’s oceans.
tgt: Phurojeke yi ni vuswikoti byo tisa xiave eka ikhonomi hi kwalomu ka R177 biliyoni no tumbuluxa mintirho ya maliyoni yin’we hi 2033.

src: Cabinet appreciates the presence of a team of South African medical experts in the West African States of Guinea, Sierra Leone, and Liberia who are helping to fight the spread of the Ebola Virus.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza vavekisi ku endla vunghana ni Mfumo eku kuriseni ka ndhawu ni nkarhi wa ikhonomi leyintshwa.4 Khabinete yi amukela vukona bya ntlawa wa van’waswikoti va timhaka ta rihanyo va Afrika-Dzonga Ematikweni ya Vupeladyambu bya Afrika ya Guinea, Sierra Leone na Liberia lava nga ku hoxeni ka xandla ku lwa ni ku hangalaka ka Xitsongwatsongwani xa Ebola.

src: This team of highly trained specialists is equipped with a mobile laboratory and has been there for the past two (2) weeks assisting to diagnose the disease throughout that Region.
tgt: Ntlawa lowu wa van’waswikoti lava ntokoteke swinene va famba ni laboratara leyi hlomeke hi switirhisiwa naswona va vile ematikweni lawaya mavhiki mambirhi lama hundzeke va ri karhi va pfuneka ku kambela vuvabyi lebyiya eka Xifundzha hinkwayo.5 Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Xiyenge 1A, phurojeke leyi thwiweke Mphakelo wa Mati ya Xitalo wa Phongolapoort.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch of Phase 1A, project named the Pongolapoort Bulk Water Supply.
tgt: Phurojeke leyi pimanyetiweke nxavo wa R1,5 biliyoni yi ta tisa mphakelo wa mati yo tenga ni ku tis ku simekiwa ka matirhelo ya mati ya xitalo eka 134 864 wa vanhu eka 16 200 wa mindyangu.

src: The venture estimated to cost R1,5 billion will result in the supply of potable water and the installation of bulk water and reticulation networks to 134 864 people within 16 200 households.
tgt: Phurojeke yi ta tisa mati eka miganga ya Mfumo wa Miganga wa Jozini eKwaZulu-Natal.

src: The project will bring water to the community of Jozini Local Municipality, in KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Swiboho swa Nkoka swa Khabinete.1 Khabinete yi pasisile ku humesiwa ka mpfampfarhuto wa Mavonele ya Nhluvukiso wa Madoroba lama Katsaneke leswaku wu ya kaneriwa hi swiyenge leswi khumbhekaka ku katsa ni swiyenge swa mfumo hinkwaswo.

src: This will seek consensus on the agenda for urban transformation in South Africa.
tgt: Leswi swi ta lava ntwanano wa nongonoko wa ndlela leyi madoroba ya Afrika-Dzonga ya nga ta ndlandlamuxiwa hakona.

src: The Framework responds to President Jacob Zuma’s calls for a national integrated urban development framework to deal with the legacy of apartheid spatial patterns and to assist municipalities to effectively manage rapid urbanisation.
tgt: Mavonele lawa ya hlamula xirhambo xa Phuresidente Jacob Zuma xa mavonele ya nhluvukiso wa madoroba lawa katsaneke yo lwa ni switandzhaku swa mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu wa maakelo yo tsalanganya no pfuna timasipala ku ndlandlamuxa madoroba hi xihatla na hi ndlela leyi vuyerisaka.

src: The vision of the Framework is to promote livable, inclusive and resilient cities and towns.
tgt: Xivono xa Mavonele i ku tlakusa swidorobani ni Madoroba lama hanyekaka, lama amukelaka mani na mani ni ku tshameka.

src: It will address the legacy of spatial separation on racial and economic bases and create a more integrated, cohesive cities and towns.
tgt: Mavonele ya ta ololoxa swipiqo swa switandzhaku swa matshamelo ya nkarhi wa hambana hi ku ya hi nghohe na xiyimo xa ikhonomi no tlhela ya tumbuluxa swidorobani ni madoroba lama katsaneke ya tlhela ya va xilo xin’we.2 Khabinete yi pasisile Xiviko xa Rixaka xa Tindlu na Nhluvukiso wa Madoroba xa Afrika-Dzonga lexi nga ta boxiwa eka Khoferense ya Nhlangano wa Tinxaka (HABIT III) hi 2016.

src: Cabinet approved South Africa’s National Report on Housing and Urban Development which will be presented to the United Nation’s Conference (HABITAT III) in 2016.
tgt: Khoferense ya vutiyimiseri yo sungula ya Nhlangano wa Tinxaka (UN) yi ta khomiwa hi ti-17 na ti-18 Ndzhati 2014.Xiviko lexi xi languteriwile ku tumbuluxa ‘Nongonoko Wuntshwa wa Madoroba’ wa dzana ra malembe ra 21 lowu nga ta lwa ni mintlhontlho leyi matiko lama hluvukeke ni lama ha hluvukaka ya hlanganaka na yona, no lemuka nkoka lowu yaka emahlweni lowu madoroba ya hlanganeke na wona ku lwa ni timhaka leti khumbhaka vanhu hinkwavo va misava to fana ni ku hundzueka ka maxelo, makhombo ya ntumbuluko, ku hluvuka ka ikhonomi ni timfanelo ta vanhu.

src: Preparations for Habitat III come at a time when South Africa is developing its Integrated Urban Policy Framework and commencing preparations for our Green paper on Human Settlements.
tgt: Vutilulamiseri bya Habitat III byi fika hi nkarhi lowu Afrika-Dzonga ri tumbuluxaka Mavonele ya Pholisi ya Madoroba lama Katsaneke no tlhela ri sungula ku tilulamisela Mpfampfarhuto wo Sungula papila ra Rihlaza ra Vutshamo bya Vanhu.3 Khabinete yi pasisile ku simekiwa ka Ajensi ya Vufambisi bya Nhundzu ya Mfumo leyi nga ta langutela vufambisi bya nhundzu ya mfumo.

src: Cabinet approved the establishment of the State Property Management Agency which will oversee the management of the government property.
tgt: Ajensi leyi yi ta va Xiphemu xa Mfumo ehansi ka vulawuri bya Holobye wa Ndzawulo ya Mintirho ya Mfumo.

src: This will be a Government Component entity under the custodianship of the Minister of Public Works.
tgt: Holobye Nxesi u ta nyika vuxokoxoko bya mhaka leyi.4 Khabinete yi pasisile Pholisi leyi antswisiweke ya vuthori bya Vanhu lava tirhanaka na Vanhu lava Tsandzekaka ku Hakela Swikweleti leyi nga ta kandziyisiwa tanihi xiviko eka Gazete ya Mfumo.

src: The focus of the Policy is to promote consistency, fairness, transparency and the achievement of equality for persons previously disadvantaged by unfair discrimination.
tgt: Xikongomelo xa Pholisi i ku khutaza leswaku swilo swi endliwa ku fana matlhelo hinkwawo, ku tisa ndzinganelo, ku tisa matirhelo ya le rivaleni ni ku tisa ku ringana eka vanhu lava khumbhiweke hi xihlawuhlawu eminkarhini leyi hundzeke.

src: The biggest change that is being introduced by the amendment is the removal of the system called Requisition with a view to advance transformation.
tgt: Ku cinca lokukulu loku nghenisiwaka hi pholisi leyi antswisiweke i ku susuwa ka matirhelo lama vuriwaka ‘Xikombelo’ hi xikongomelo xo hundzuluxa swilo swi ya emahlweni.

src: The policy will only apply to appointments made in terms of the Insolvency Act, the Companies Act and the Close Corporations Act.
tgt: Pholisi yi ta tirha ntsena eka vuthoriwa lebyi endliweke hi ku landzelela Nawu wa Vutsandzeki byo Hakela Swikweleti, Nawu wa Tikhamphani ni Nawu wa Mabindzu lama Pfalekeke.

src: Cabinet approved that the Expropriation Bill, 2014 be tabled in Parliament.
tgt: Milawumbisi.1 Khabinete yi pasisile leswaku Nawumbisi wo Koxa Nhundzu, 2014 wu andlariwa ePalamende.

src: The Expropriation Act, 1975 predates the Constitution, 1996 making it imperative to align the overarching legislation governing the expropriation of property to the values and provisions of the Constitution.
tgt: Nawumbisi wo Koxa Nhundzu, 1975 wu vile kona Vumbiwa, 1996 ri nga si va kona leswi swi tisa nsusumeto wo cinca milawu yo koxa nhundzu hinkwayo leswaku yi landzelela timhaka letinene tanihihilaha Vumbiwa ri hlamuselaka hakona.

src: Minister Nxesi will expand more on this issue.
tgt: Holobye Nxesi u ta nyika vuxokoxoko bya mhaka leyi.

src: Cabinet is encouraged by the positive economic growth recorded in the second quarter of the year in spite of difficult economic conditions in the country and abroad.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhaka ta Sweswi.1 Khabinete ya khutazeka hi xiyimo xa ku kula ka ikhonomi leyo languteka tanihilaha swi vonakeke hakona eka kotara ya vumbirhi ya lembe, enkarhini wa swiyimo swo tika swa ikhonomi etikweni ni le ntsungeni.

src: The pace of economic expansion remains too weak to address our challenges of poverty, inequality and unemployment.
tgt: Magoza yo ndlandlamuxa ikhonomi ya ha debyisile tintambhu leswaku yi kota ku nghenelela eka mintlhontlho ya vusiwana, ku pfumaleka ka ndzinganelo ni ku pfumaleka ka mintirho.

src: Government is fast-tracking the implementation of the National Development Plan to address our structural challenges, increase permanently our growth potential and create jobs for our people.
tgt: Mfumo wu le ku hatlisiseni ku humelerisa Pulani ya Nhluvukiso ya Rixaka leswaku yi vulavula hi mintlhontlho ya matirhelo, yi tlakusa nkarhi hinkwawo, vuswikoti bya ikhonomi ni ku tumbuluxa mintirho eka vanhu va hina.

src: In this regard, our investment in infrastructure – electricity, transport, water, roads, schools and hospitals - builds a platform for faster, more inclusive economic growth.
tgt: Eka mhaka leyi, vuvekisi bya hina bya switirhisiwa – gezi, mati, mapatu, swikolo ni swibedhlele – swi tisa ndlela yo hatlisa yo tlakusa xiyimo xa ikhonomi leyi tlhelaka yi vuyerisa mani na mani.

src: The annual volume of capital investment by public enterprises has increased by more than 260 per cent in real terms over the past 10 years.
tgt: Ntlimbano wa lembe rin’wana ni rin’wana wa vuvekisi bya switirhisiwa hi tikhamphani ta mfumo wu engetelekile ku tlula 260 wa tiphesente hi ku landzelela rifuwo ra tiko eka malembe ya 10 lama hundzeke.

src: Local government’s annual infrastructure spending has doubled in real terms since the late 1990s.
tgt: Ku tirhisiwa ka mali ku xava switirhisiwa swa mfumo wa miganga swa lembe rin’wana ni rin’wana swi yile ehenhla kambirhi hi ku landzelela rifuwo ra tiko ku suka eku heleni ka malembe ya va 1990.Xiyenge xa mani na mani xi vekisile ku tlula thiriliyoni ya tirhandi ta switirhisiwa ku suka hi 2009/10.

src: We expect that growth in the second half of the year will be stronger as the mining and manufacturing sectors recover.
tgt: Hi langutela leswaku ku tlakuka ka ikhonomi eka xiphemu xa vumbirhi xa lembe ku ta tiyelela tanihiloko swiyenge swa migodi na vutumbuluxi bya tinhundzu swi sungula ku vuyelela evutshan’wini bya swona.

src: And government will continue to work with business and labour to create an environment, which is conducive to investment and economic growth.
tgt: Naswona mfumo wu ta ya emahlweni wu tirhisana ni van’wamabindzu ni swiyenge swa vatirhi leswaku ku tumbuluxiwa xiyimo lexi navetisaka vuvekisi ni ku ndlandlamuka ka ikhonomi.2 Khabinete yi sola maendlelo ni swivulavula leswi ha ku humelelaka swo kucetela mpfilumpfilu, ku nga swilo leswi hambanaka ni timhaka ta nkoka tanihilaha vumbiwa ri vulaka hakona, naswona swi xungeta ku langutela ehansi swilo leswinene leswi hi swi fikeleleke tanihi tiko.

src: Cabinet condemn the recent acts and statements that incite violence which go against our constitutional values and threaten to erode the gains that we have made as a country.
tgt: Ku fayeteriwa ka mabazi ni nhundzu ya wona loka ha ku humelelaka eKapa Vupeladyambu na swona swa soriwa hi marito ya vukari swinene.

src: The recent spate of the vandalising of buses in the Western Cape is also condemned in the strongest terms.
tgt: Khabinete yi ndunduzela vatswari lava tekeka magoza yo endla leswaku vana va tlhelela exikolweni eKapa N’walungu.

src: Cabinet commends parents who took it upon themselves to ensure that children go back to school in the Northern Cape.
tgt: Khabinete yi khensa vatswari ku va va nghenelerile eka vumundzuku bya vana va vona naswona yi kombela leswaku ku tsakela ka vana ku nga tshuki ku kandziyeriwa kumbe ku tirhisiwa hi xikongomelo xo humelerisa timhaka ta miganga.

src: Cabinet encourages South Africans to safeguard the country’s reputation on its ability to engage in constructive dialogue and to resolve issues irrespective of who is involved so as to move South Africa Forward.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza maAfrika-Dzonga ku hlayisa xindzhuti xa tiko xo kota ku ti nghenisa eka n’wangulano lowu akaka ni ku lulamisa swipiqo handle ko ya hi nghohe leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ri ya emahlweni.3 Khabinete yi amukela magoza yo vonaka lama vekiweke hi xiphemu xa SADC yo tisa ku Kurhula ni Nhlayiseko eka swipiqo swa tipolitiki leswi Lesotho yi hlanganeke na swona eka nkarhi lowu, naswona yi tlhela yi yisa nseketelo wa yona handle ka mpimo eka rhengu leri tekeke hi SADC leri alanaka ni ku ringeta ku vutla mfumo hi ku honisa vumbiwa.

src: Cabinet welcomes the decisive actions by the SADC organ on Peace and Security in the recent Lesotho political crises and reiterates its unconditional support for the SADC position that rejects all attempts to unconstitutional changes of government.
tgt: Hikokwalaho, khabinete yi rhamba mintlawa hinkwayo leyi khumbhekaka ku tirha swin’we ku vuyisela mafambiselo ya xidemokarisi eLesotho no humelerisa hi ku hetiseka Mintwanano leyi nga fekeleriwa hi xiphemu xa SADC.4 Khabinete yi xiyile ku tshika ntirho ka Mutshamaxitulu wa Khomixini ya Nhlawulo(IEC), Ghwetha Pansy Tlakula.

src: Her resignation comes against the backdrop of a successful 2014 General Election which she managed.
tgt: Ku tshika ka yena ntirho swi ta endzhaku ka Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wa 2014 lowu a wu fambiseke no tlhela wu humelela swinene.

src: She contributed immensely to ensure our democracy remains strong.
tgt: U vile ni xiave xikulu swinene ku endla leswaku xidemokarisi xa hina xi yima hi milenge.

src: Cabinet express its gratitude to the contribution made by Adv Tlakula and extends its thanks for her selfless contribution to our democracy and wishes her well.
tgt: Khabinete yi navela ku humesa ku khensa ka yona eka xiave lexi Ghwetha Tlakula a veke na xona naswona yi hundzisa swikhenso swa yona eka xiave lexi a veke na xona eka ku kondletela xidemokarisi xa hina handle ko languta yena n’wini naswona yi n’wi navelela minkateko.5 Khabinete yi amukela xiboho xa Huvo ya Vumbiwa lexi tiyisisaka leswaku pholisi ya endlelo ro lulamisa ra mfumo yi tshamiseka.

src: Cabinet welcomes the judgment by the Constitutional Court which is an affirmation that the government’s affirmative action policy is correct.
tgt: Mfumo wu yima hi rito ra leswaku tiphurogireme ta wona ti lulamisa swihoxo swo pfumala ndzinganelo eka vanhu ngopfungopfu swiyimo swa le mitirhweni.

src: Government remains steadfast in its programme to redress the social inequalities especially within the working environment.
tgt: Xiboho lexi xi tlhela xi tiyisisa leswaku i ntiyiso leswaku pholisi ya endlelo ro lulamisa ku katsa ni milawu ya ndzinganiso ya matholele yi tlakusa ku hundzuluxiwa ka swilo ni ku nyika vanhu lava a va tshikeleriwile matimba.

src: The Department of Basic Education will conduct the fourth Annual National Assessments (ANA) from 16 to 19 September 2014 to track progress of learning outcomes among Grades 1 - 6 and Grade 9 as part of the efforts to improve the quality of education.
tgt: Migingiriko leyi ya ha taka.1 Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya Masungulo yi ta fambisa Swikambelo swa Rixaka swa Lembe (ANA) ku suka hi ti-16 ku fika ti-19 Ndzhati 2014 ku landzelerisa ku yisa emahlweni ka mbuyelo wa dyondzo exikarhi ka Tigiredi ta 1-6 na Giredi 9 tanihi xiphemu xa tindlela to antswisa xiyimo xa dyondzo.

src: This year (2014) the Department of Basic Education will also pilot the assessment of a sample of learners in Grades 7 and 8 and the decision on this assessment will be taken in 2015.The ANA generates standardised evidence to monitor the success of various Government interventions to improve literacy and numeracy among learners and also enables teachers to identify areas that require additional support.
tgt: Lembe leri (2014) Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya Masungulo yi ta tlhela yi ringeta ku kambela ntlawa wa vadyondzi va ka Giredi 7 na 8 naswona xiboho xa xikambelo lexi xi ta tekiwa hi 2015.ANA yi tumbuluxa vumbhoni bya xiyimo xa le henhla lebyi nga tirhisiwaka ku hoxa tihlo eka ku humelela ka tindlela ta Mfumo to nghenelela hi xikongomelo xo antswisa ku hlaya ni ku hlayela exikarhi ka vadyondzi, naswona yi tlhela yi endla leswaku vadyondzisi va kota ku hlawula tindhawu leti lavaka nseketelo wo engetela eka vana.

src: Cabinet encourages parents and guardians to support their children and to ensure that the results are used to address any development areas.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza vatswari na vahlayisi va vana ku seketela vana va vona ni ku endla leswaku mbuyelo wa ANA wu tirhisiwa ku lulamisa swipiqo swihi ni swihi mayelana ni nhluvuko wa vana.

src: The ANA timetable and resources for 2014 is on available on: WEBTOKEThe Minister of Rural Development and Land Reform Gugile Nkwinti will host the 2014 Land Tenure Summit at Birchwood Hotel and OR Tambo Conference Centre, Boksburg from 4 to 6 September 2014.
tgt: Nongonoko wa ANA na switirhisiwa swa 2014 swi kumeka eka: www.

src: The Summit will focus on measures to reverse the country’s colonial and apartheid past which caused more than 75 per cent of the black population to be landless, property-less, unskilled and without secure tenure rights.
