src: Since the beginning of the year, there have been several deaths in KwaZulu-Natal and recently, deaths have also been reported in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Madzolonga lawa ya koxile vutomi bya vagingiriki wa vantshwa, ku katsa na khale ka Matsalanankulu wa Ligi ya Lavantshwa ya African National Congress (ANCYL) Sindiso Magaqa, loyi a nga chavi nchumu, loyi a ha ri na swotala ku swi endla eka ku aka Afrika-Dzonga leri humelelaka.

src: This violence has taken the lives young activists, including the fearless former African National Congress Youth League Secretary-General Sindiso Magaqa, who still had much to contribute in building a prosperous South Africa.
tgt: Hi kombela mavandla ya tipolotiki ku tlakusa ku amukelana exikarhi ka swirho swa wona na ku kombela vaaki ku seketela Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga eka vulavisisi bya vona.

src: Heritage Month.
tgt: N'hweti ya Ndzhaka.

src: Cabinet encourages all South Africans to continue to observe this year’s Heritage Month under the theme: “The Year of Oliver Reginald Tambo: Celebrating our Liberation Heritage”.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza MaAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni ya xixima N'hweti ya Ndzhaka lembe leri ehansi ka nkongomelo lowu nge: “Lembe ra Oliver Reginald Tambo: Ku Tlangela Ndzhaka ya Ntshuxeko wa hina."1.

src: This month coincides with the centenary birth of OR Tambo, an African Patriot, who showed an unwavering commitment to serve the people of South Africa, the continent and the world.
tgt: N'hweti leyi yi kotlana na lembe xidzana ra ku velekiwa ka OR Tambo, xirhandzatiko ra Afrika, loyi a nga kombisa ku tinyikela loku nga kanakaniseku ku korhokela vanhu va Afrika-Dzonga , tikonkulu na misava hinkwayo.

src: We have also marked the 40th anniversary of the death of Steve Bantu Biko, who was brutally murdered by the apartheid regime.
tgt: Hi tlhele hi fungha malembe ya 40 endzhaku ka rifu ra Steve Bantu Biko, loyi a nga dlayiwa hi ndlela ya tihanyi hi mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu.

src: The Minister of Arts and Culture, Mr Nathi Mthethwa, has released a programme of celebration for this month.
tgt: Holobye wa Vutshila na Mfuwo, Tatana Nathi Mthethwa, u humesile phurogireme ya ku tlangela ya n'hweti leyi.

src: Cabinet was apprised on the 1st performance quarterly progress reports for 2017/18 on the implementation of priority outcomes for the period between April and June 2017.Government continues to make considerable progress in implementing the 14 priority outcomes, derived from the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019, which brings us closer to realising the NDP Vision 2030.
tgt: Khabinete yi chumbuteriwile hi swiviko swa nhluvukiso swa matirhelo ya kotara ya1 swa 2017/18 eka ku simekiwa ka swikongomelonkulu swa swirhangana eka nkarhi wa le xikarhi ka Dzivamisoko na Khotavuxika 2017.

src: Cabinet was also briefed on areas that experienced delays in the implementation and appraised on actions required to fast-track delivery.
tgt: Mfumo wu ya emahlweni wu endla ku humelela loku vonakaka eka ku simeka mivuyelo ya swirhangana ya 14, leyi humaka eka Rimba ra Maqhinga ra Theme ya le Xikarhi ya 2014-2019, leri ri hi tshunetaka ekusuhi na ku fikelela Xivono xa NDP xa 2030.

src: Cluster Ministerial media briefings will be held to brief on the outcomes of these reports during the week of 6 October until 15 October 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi runguleriwa hi tindhawu leti saleleke endzhaku eka ku simekiwa na ku kamberiwa ka migingiriko leyi lavekaka ku hatlisisa vukorhokeri.

src: The schedule will be updated regularly and posted on WEBTOKECabinet has approved the proposal for South Africa to host the International Telecommunication Union Telecom World Exhibition in September 2018.
tgt: Ku vika eka vuhangalasamahungunyingi hi Ntlawa wa Vaholobye ku ta va kona ku hlamusela mivuyelo ya swiviko leswi hi nkarhi wa vhiki ra ti 6 Nhlangula ku fika hi ti 15 Nhlangula 2017.

src: This is an annual exhibition and forum for government and industry leaders to explore challenges, partnerships and solutions, and identify investment opportunities and best practices for socio-economic development through Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs).This will be the first time this event is held in Africa.
tgt: Xedulu yi ta antswisiwa hi mikarhi na ku posiwa eka WEBTOKEKhabinete yi pasisile xiringanyeto xa Afrika-Dzonga ku rhurhela Nkombiso wa Matiko ya Misava wa International Telecommunication Union Telecom hi Ndzati 2018.

src: During this event, the South African ICT industry will be afforded an opportunity to showcase their respective products.
tgt: Hi nkarhi wa ntlangu lowu, tifeme ta ICT ta laha Afrika-Dzonga ti ta nyikiwa nkateko ku kombisa swikumiwa swa vona.

src: The country’s tourism sector will also benefit during this period.
tgt: Sekithara ya vupfhumba yi ta vuyeriwa eka nkarhi lowu.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Mitlangu leyi Landzelaka.

src: President Zuma will lead a South African delegation to the 72nd Regular Session of the UN General Assembly under the theme “Focusing on People: Striving for Peace and a Decent Life for All on a Sustainable Planet” in New York, United States of America.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u ta rhangela vurhumiwa eka Ntshamo wa vu 72 wa Ntolovelo eka Nhlengeletano ya Mani na Mani ya UN ehansi ka nkongomelo lowu nge "Ku kongomisa eka vanhu: Ku Tikarhatela ku Rhula na Vutomi byo Hlonipheka eka Hinkwavo eka Pulanete leyi kotaka ku yisa emahlweni" eNew York, United States of Amerika.

src: South Africa will continue to work on achieving reform at the UN as it participates in the 72th Session.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga ri ta ya emahlweni ku tirhela ku fikelela ku cinca eka UN tanihi loko nghenelela eka Ntshamo lowu wa vu Phuresidente Zuma, tanihi Mutshamaxitulu wa (SADC) u ta lulamisa Samiti yo ka yi nga ri ya ntolovelo ya Double Troika na Tinhloko ta Matiko na Mfumo hi ti 15 Ndzati 2017 ePitori.

src: President Zuma, as the Chairperson of the SADC, will convene an Extraordinary Double Troika Summit of Heads of State and Government on 15 September 2017 in Pretoria.
tgt: Samiti ya Double Troika yi ta khomiwa hi mhaka ya xiyimo xa tipolitiki na vusirhelelo bya sweswi eka Vukosi bya le Lesotho.3 Vurhumiwa bya xiyimo xa le henhla bya Afrika-Dzonga byi ta endla xiviko xo sungula xa ku lava ku rhurhela 2023 xa Khapu ya Misava ya Rugby eLondom hi ti 25 ta Ndzati 2017.

src: South Africa has a strong proven record of hosting such events.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga ri na rhikhodo ya matimba ya ku rhurhela mitlangu yo tani.

src: Cabinet wishes to reiterate its strong support of this Bid and calls upon South Africans to support this Bid that will contribute immensely to social cohesion and nation-building, and also serve as a catalyst for sport development.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi vula nakambe nseketelo wa ku Bida loku na ku kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga ku seketela Bidi leyi nga ta hoxa xandla swinene eka ku tisa vun'we eka vaaki na ku aka rixaka na ku tlhela ku tirha tanihi xi nhlohlotelo eka nhluvukiso wa mitlangu.

src: Messages.
tgt: Mahungu ya Nkoka.

src: Cabinet wishes the citizens of Germany every success in preparation for Federal elections on 24 September 2017 to elect members of the 19th Bundestag, which in turn will elect a Chancellor and form a new government.
tgt: Khabinete yi navelela ku humelela eka vaaki va Jarimani eka ku tilulamisela mihlawulo ya Federali hi ti 24 Ndzati 2017 ku hlawula swirho swa vu 19 eka Bundestag, leswi endzhaku swi nga ta hlawula Muchanselara na vumba mfumo wuntshwa.

src: Germany is a prominent investor in South Africa, which looks forward to continued relations, cooperation and partnership.
tgt: Jarimani i tiko ra vuvekisi lebyi tivekaka laha Afrika-Dzonga, laha hi langutelaka ku ya emahlweni ka vuxaka, ntirhisano na xinakulobye.

src: Cabinet extends its sympathies to the Caribean as wells as parts of Cuba and the Unites Sates following the devastation caused by Hurricane Irma.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhumela marito yo khumbheka eka Makharibiyene ku katsa na swiphemu swa Cuba na Amerika endzhaku ka makhombo lawa ya vangiwaka hi Ndhambhi ya Irma.

src: Heartfelt condolences are extended to the loved ones of those who lost their lives and their belongings in this disaster.
tgt: Marito yo chavelela ya rhumeriwa eka varhandziwa lava lahlekeriweke hi vutomi na tinhundzu ta vona eka mhangu leyi.

src: Cabinet joins the nation in congratulating Kevin Anderson on making the finals of the US Open.
tgt: Khabinete yi yima na tiko ku hoyozela Kevin Anderson ku va a fikelerile eka tifayinali ta US Open.

src: He is the first South African player to make the final of a major tennis championship since 1994.
tgt: I mutlangi wa Afrika-Dzonga wo sungula ku fikelela tifayinali letikulu eka vunghwazi bya thenisi ku sukela hi 1994.

src: We are confident that he will continue building on his glittering achievement and inspiring other young and talented South Africans.
tgt: Hi na ku tshembha leswaku u ta ya emahlweni na ku humelela na ku hlohlotela lavantshwa na lava nga nyiko laha Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 27 September 2017, at the Union Buildings, Pretoria.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 27 Ndzati 2017, eUnion Buildings, ePitori.

src: Issues in the environmentUnited Nations General Assembly (UNGA)Cabinet welcomed President Jacob Zuma’s address to the 72nd Regular Session of the UNGA in New York, USA on 12 September 2017, under the theme “Focusing on People: Striving for Peace and a Decent Life for All on a Sustainable Planet”.Deliberations focused, amongst others, on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) climate change peace and security issues and UN reforms, especially UN Security Council reform.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela mbulavulo wa Phuresidente Jacob Zuma eka Ntshamo wa Ntolovelo wa vu 72 wa UNGA eNew York, eAmerika wa ti 12 Ndzati 2017, ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge "Ku kongomisa eka Vanhu: Ku Hitekela ku Rhula na Vutomi byo antswa bya Hinkwavo eka Pulanete leyi nga Hlayiseka.".

src: President Zuma also signed the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, which reflects South Africa’s continued commitment towards the achievement of a world free from the threat posed by nuclear weapons and ensuring that nuclear technology is used for peaceful purposes only.
tgt: Mikanelo a yi kongome eka swin'wana swakona, Swikongomelo swa Nhluvukiso leswi Tiyeke (SDG) ku cinca ka maxelo, ku rhula na timhaka ta nsirhelelo na ku cinciwa ka UN, ngopfu ngopfu ku cinciwa ka Huvo ya Vusirheleri ya UPhuresidente Zuma u tlhele a sayina Ntwanano wa ku Aleriwa ka Matlharhi ya Nyutliliya, leswi kombisaka ku ya emahlweni kA Afrika-Dzonga ku tinyiketa ka rona ku ya eku fikeleleni ka misava leyi pfumala xungeto lowu tisiwaka hi matlharhi ya nyutliliya na ku tiyisisa leswaku thekinoloji ya nyutliliya yi tirhisiwa hi xikongomelo xo tisa ku rhula ntsena.

src: President Zuma hosted a centenary celebratory dinner in honour of the late former President of the African National Congress, Mr Oliver Reginald Tambo.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u rhurherile malembexidzana eka fihlulo wa ku tlangela hi ku xixima khale ka Phuresidente wa African National Congress, Tatana Oliver Reginald Tambo.

src: Heritage MonthCabinet thanks all South Africans for celebrating Heritage Month in September and reiterates President Zuma’s Heritage Day message for all in the country to aspire for greater unity in WEBTOKEN the country concludes Heritage Month under the theme “The Year of Oliver Reginald Tambo: Celebrating our Liberation Heritage”, South Africans are encouraged to build on the values espoused in the Constitution and strengthen efforts to build a nation free from poverty, hunger, homelessness and WEBTOKEN fostering a spirit of heritage, Cabinet welcomes the agreement signed between South Africa and Tanzania, which is aimed at preserving the history of the liberation struggle.
tgt: Khabinete yi nkhensa MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku va vatlangerile N'hweti ya Ndzhaka hi Ndzati na ku tlhela va vula hungu ra Phuresidente Zuma ra Siku ra Ndzhaka eka hinkwavo haha tikweni ku va va tikarhatela vun'we hi matimba eka ku humelela ka hina.

src: The UN has endorsed the implementation of the Roads to Independence in Africa Project.
tgt: Tanihiloko tiko ri gimeta N'hweti ya Ndzhaka ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge "Lembe ra Oliver Reginald Tambo: Ku Tlangela Ndzhaka ya Ntshuxeko wa Hina", MaAfrika-Dzonga ya hlohloteriwa ku aka hi ku landzelela ku kholwa loku nga kona eka Vumbiwa na ku tiyisisa ku aka rixaka leri pfumalaka vusweti, ndlala, ku pfumaleka ka kaya na ku pfumaleka ka ku ringana.

src: It is a celebration of the spirit of solidarity and cooperation amongst Africa’s liberation movements and will see the construction of a museum, library and WEBTOKEN Tourism DaySouth Africa, under the leadership of the Minister of Tourism, Ms Tokozile Xasa, participated in World Tourism Day (27 September 2017) and the Tourism Month, under the theme “Sustainable Tourism – A Tool for Development”.
tgt: Hi ku hlohlotela moya we ndzhaka, Khabinete yi amukela ntwanano lowu sayiniweke exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Tanzania, lowu lavaka ku hlayisa matimu ya ku lwela ntshuxeko.

src: As a tourist destination, South Africa faces the prospects of growing its transversal tourism sectors to enable massive economic potential through the so-called traditional dominant tourism economic sectors.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga ri humelerile eka ku seketela vupfhumba hi ku tirhisa migingiriko yo hambana eka miako yo koka mahlo yo fana na mitanga, malwandle ya mujeko wa wasi, na tindhawu leti nga pasisiwa hi misava ta ndzhaka.

src: Antiretroviral pricing agreementCabinet welcomes the ground-breaking pricing agreement reached by the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, in collaboration with a number of international organisations, to accelerate the availability of the first affordable single-pill HIV-treatment WEBTOKEN is estimated that the price reduction will result in savings of up to R.7 billion over the next six years.
tgt: Tanihi ndhawu ya vupfhumba, Afrika-Dzonga ri langutana na ku kula ka sekithara ya ku ngeteleleka ka vupfhumba ku kotisa ku koteka ka ku kula ka ikhonomi hi ku tirhisiwa ka leswi tiviwaka tanihi sekithara ya ikhonomi ya vupfhumba leyi taleriweke hi ndzhavuko.

src: The pricing agreement makes the medicine Dolutegravir, which is recommended by the World Health Organization, more affordable for governments in low and middle-income WEBTOKEN light of the pricing agreement, the Department of Health plans to introduce the new fixed-dose combination of three drugs, Tenofovir, Lamivudine and Dolutegravir in April 2018.Cabinet calls on all sexually active South Africans, especially youth, to continue to live a healthy life which adopts preventative measures such as continuously practising safer sex by abstaining, being faithful and condomising, and regularly testing for HIV.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ntwanano wo hlamarisa wa tihakelo lowu fikeleriweke hi Holobye Rihanyo, Dok Aaron Motsoaledi, hi ku tirhisana na mihlangano yo hlaya ya matiko ya misava, ku hatlisisa ku va kona ka philisi yin'we leyi fikelelekaka ya ku dyiwa hi lava nga na HIKu ringanyetiwa leswaku ku hungutiwa ka nxavo ku ta hlayisa kwalomu ka R11,7 wa tibiliyoni eka malembe ya ntsevu lawa ya taka.

src: This world-class tertiary hospital is an investment to realise the National Development Plan’s (NDP) vision and the UN’s SDGs of universal healthcare.
tgt: Ntwanano wa tihakelo swi endla leswaku murhi wa Dolutegravir, lowu nga bumabumeriwa hi Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava wa Rihanyo, wu kota ku fikeleleka eka mimfumo leyi nga le hansi na le xikarhi ematikweni.

src: The 526-bed hospital is supported by an integrated system that will optimise delivery of quality healthcare.
tgt: Hi ku ya hi ntwanano wa tihakelo, Ndzawulo ya Rihanyo yi lava ku sungula ku nyika tiphilisi hi vunharhu bya tona bya swidzidziharisi, Tenofovir, Lamivudine na Dolutegravir hi Dzivamisoko 2018.

src: It applies technological innovation to reduce patient waiting times, improve diagnosis and enables a quicker health intervention in patients.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga lava ti nghenisaka eka swa masangu, ngopfu ngopfu vantshwa, ku ya emahlweni na rihanyo lerinene leri ku nga ndlela yo ya emahlweni no sivela na ku endla swa masangu hi ndlela leyi hlayisekeke hi ku nga ngheneleri, hi ku tshembheka na ku tirhisa khondhomo, na ku kamberiwa hi mikarhi na mikarhi eka HIRihanyo.

src: This R1 billion investment infrastructure will support local economic development in the townships.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku pfuriwa ka tlhelo rintshwa ra Xibedlhele xa Cecilia Makiwane eMdantsane, eMonti.

src: As we revitalise public health infrastructure, we are also expanding opportunities for local communities to improve their lives through job creation and local enterprise WEBTOKEN Development MonthCabinet calls on South Africans to continue to uplift those less fortunate than themselves ahead of Social Development Month in WEBTOKEN Development Month is held annually to commemorate the many strides the country has made, in providing social assistance to the poor and the most vulnerable in South Africa.
tgt: U riendzo lerinene ra ku fikelela ku simekiwa ka Ndzindzakhombo wa Rihanyo ra Rixaka leswi nga ta vuyerisa rihanyo lerinene, ngopfu ngopfu eka vaaki lava sweleke.

src: The South African Government’s social-assistance programme is built on a firm belief that social-security assistance is a basic human right and is key to restoring the dignity to its citizens.
tgt: Xibedlhele lexi xa xiyimo xa le henhla i vuvekisi bya ku fikelela xivono xa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Tiko (NDP) na SDG ya rihanyo ra misava hikuya hi UXibedlhele xa mibedwa ya 526 xi seketeriwa hi sisiteme leyi nga ta yisa ehenhla eku phakeleni ka rihanyo ra kahle.

src: Social grants bring financial relief to millions of households and working together with government uplifts the vulnerable so that their living conditions improve with dignity.
tgt: Xi tirhisa ndlandlamuxo wa thekinoloji ku hunguta nkarhi wa ku yima eka vavabyi, ku antswisa vukamberi na ku hatlisisa ku nghenelela ka rihanyo eka vavabyi.

src: Thusong Service Centres also empower communities with the necessary skills and training to better their lives, through existing partnerships with government, parastatals and the private sector.
tgt: Midende yi susa ku tikeriwa eka mamiliyoni ya mindyangu na ku tirha swin'we na mfumo ku tlakusa lava nga le khombyeni leswaku swiyimo swa vutomi hi ku tisa ndzhuti.

src: President Zuma attended the Inauguration Ceremony of President João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço in Luanda on Tuesday, 26 September 2017.South Africa and the Republic of Angola share a common history of the struggle against colonialism and apartheid.
tgt: Mfumo wu gimetile ku humelela ka Vhiki ra Senthara ya Vukorhokeri ya Thusong ya Lembe na Lembe eka lembe leri, leyi humeleleke ku suka hi ti 18 ku fika hi ti 22 ta Ndzati 2017 ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: "Lembe ra OR Tambo - Ku Yisa Emahlweni mabindzu lamantsongo na lawa ya nga le xikarhi ni la ma kulu eka Tisentharata ta Vukorhokeri ta Thusong.

src: Attack on tourists from NetherlandCabinet condemns the recent robbery of tourists from the Netherlands who were followed from OR Tambo International Airport.
tgt: Hi ku tirhisa phurogireme, mfumo wu ya emahlweni na ku lulamisa ku pfumaleka ka ku ringana ka khale hi ku tisa vukorhokeri bya risima ekusuhi na vaaki lava khale a va pfaleriwe ehandle eka nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vaaki ka nkoka.

src: Launch of the Bakoena Ba Mopeli customary law bookCabinet applauds the launch of the book, Bakoena Ba Mopeli Customary Law of Succession and Genealogy, as a milestone achievement for traditional leadership in South Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela kombela vaaki ku ya emahlweni na ku tirhisa Tisenthara ta Vukorhokeri ta Thusong ku fikelela vukorhokeri bya nkoka byo fana na bya Timhaka ta Xikaya, Vatirhi, Ejensi ya Nsirhelelo wa Vaaki ya Afrika-Dzonga na Nkwama wa Tinghozi ta le Magondzweni.

src: South Africa, as Chair of the SADC from August 2017 to August 2018, is committed to strengthening regional efforts to conserve transboundary natural resources and promote sustainable development within the SADC region.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga ri seketela xitatimende xa Matsalanankulu wa UN, António Guterres, loyi a nga tshikilela mhaka ya vutihlamuleri bya Mfumo wa Myanmar ku fikelerisa nsirhelelo eka hinkwavo lava khumbhekaka, na ku tlhela va kombela tiejensi ta Vumunhu ku nyika mfikelelo eka vaaki lava lavaka mpfuno na nsirhelelo.

src: This is aligned to the NDP, which prioritises the deepening of integration of the SADC region as well as ensuring environmental sustainability and an equitable transition to a low-carbon economy.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlohlotela mihlangano hinkwayo ku herisa madzolonga na ku papalata ku ya emahlweni na ku xanisiwa ka vanhu na ku kombela leswaku xiyimo xa Tiko ra Rakhine ku va xilulamisiwa hi ku landzelela nawu.

src: The Bill proposes harmonizing and standardizing the provisions which regulate the operations and governance of the public entities reporting to the Minister of Science and Technology.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku humesela ehandle na vuxokoxoko lebyi pfunaka vasindzisi va vulawuri bya nawu na ku kombela matimba hinkwawo ya nawu ku tirhisiwa eka lava kumiwaka va ri na nandzu.

src: Cabinet calls on all to work together to ensure the country’s transport infrastructure benefits all and encourages road users to take responsibility and apply road safety as part of their daily lives.
tgt: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka ku simekiwa ka buku, Bakoena Ba Mopeli Customary Law of Succession and Genealogy, tanihi goza rikulu leri nga fikeleriwa eka vurhangeri bya xintu eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: By working together we can reduce carnages on our roadsDuring Transport Month, government – led by the Department of Transport and its entities – will highlight the economic benefits of the sector by showcasing transport infrastructure services in aviation, maritime, public transport, roads and rail.
tgt: Holobye wa Mfumontirhisano na Timhaka ta Xintu, Tatana Des van Rooyen, na Vukosi bya Vuhosi Litsie III, Nhloko ya Vurhangeri bya Vuhosi bya Lesotho, vanghenelerile eka ntlangu lowu hi Musumbhunuku, 25 Ndzati 2017.

src: The national launch is being held at Sinaba Stadium in Daveyton in the City of Ekurhuleni on 29 September WEBTOKEN in the transport sector are stimulating development and creating jobs as part of South Africa’s Nine-Point Plan, which aims to grow the economy and create much-needed jobs.
tgt: Buku leyi yi ta pfuna ku twisisa matimu ya Bakoena Ba Mopeli na ku cincana ka rixaka exitulwini xa vuhosi ku kota ku hlayisa matimu.

src: South Africa to host the 2nd Session of the South Africa-Zimbabwe Bi-National Commission (BNC)President Jacob Zuma will host his Zimbabwean counterpart, His Excellency President Robert Mugabe, who will be in South Africa on 03 October 2017 on the occasion of the 2nd Session of the South Africa-Zimbabwe BNThe Agreement establishing the BNC was signed in April 2015 and inaugurated in October 2016 in Harare, Zimbabwe.
tgt: Xikongomelo xa maendlelo i ku seketela ku tirhisiwa hi ndlela leyi tiyeke na vufambisi bya ku cincana ka mindzilikano ya mbangu, leswi ku nga ku tsakela ka swirho swa matiko ya SADAfrika-Dzonga, tanihi mutshamaxitulu wa SADC ku sukela hi Mhawuri 2019 ku fikela hi Mhawuri 2018 ri tinyikerile ku tiyisisa matimba ya muganga ku hlayisa mindzilikano ya switirhisiwa swa ntumbuluko na ku hlohlotela nhluvukiso lowu tiyeke exikarhi ka muganga wa SADLeswi swifambelana na NDP, leyi rhangisaka vun'we bya muganga wa SADC na ku tiyisisa ku tiya ka mbangu na ku ringanana ka ku cincana ka ku hunguteka ka moya wa thyaka eka ikhonomi.

src: Zimbabwe is one of South Africa’s top - five trading partners on the Continent, with trade statistics showing annual growth.
tgt: I phurogireme ya UN leyi lavaka ku tisa vun'we bya vutivi ku suka eka tiejensi ta UN ta ntlhanu leti ku nga, hi ku ya hi mavin ya tona Phurogireme ya Mbangu wa UN, Mihlangano ya Vatirhi ya Matiko ya misava Phurogireme ya Nhluvukiso ya UN, Nhlanganowa Nhluvukiso wa Tifeme ta UN na Vuleteri na Vulavisisi wa Nhlangano wa UEku rhurheleni ka Khoniferense ya Vaholobye swi ya yisa emahlweni ajenda, laha kaya na le ka tikonkulu ra Afrika, eka kula loku hlanganeleke eka ku amukela moya wa thyaka lowu nga wu ntsongo na ndlela leyi nga tiya ya ikhonomi ya maxelo.

src: In 2016, South Africa’s exports to Zimbabwe amounted to approximately R.3 billion.
tgt: Huvo ya Mati ya Umngeni.1 Khabinete yi lemukisiwile hi xiyimo xa Huvo ya Mati ya Umngeni leyi ku nga huvo ya mati ya xiyimo xa vumbirhi etikweni leyi nghenisaka mali yo ringana R2,4 wa tibiliyoni ta tirhandi na mpimanyeto wa Matirhiselo ya Mali ya malembe ya ntlhanu ya ku tlula nkombo wa tibiliyoni ta tirhandi.

src: MessagesBirthday – Mama Winnie Madikizela-MandelaCabinet joins the rest of the country in wishing Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, affectionately known as the Mother of the Nation, a happy birthday as she turned 81 on Tuesday, 26 September 2017.Mama Madikizela-Mandela is one of South Africa’s most celebrated liberation icons.
tgt: Khabinete yi lemukisiwile hi mbhurisano wa Ndzawulo ya Mati na Nkululo lowu nga eku humeleleni na vavekisi.2 Ku kota ku tshamisekisa timhaka ta mafumelo eka Huvo ya Khabinete yi pasisile ku thoriwa ka Huvo ya Nkarhinyana loko Holobye a ha hatlisisa phurosese ya ku thoriwa ka Huvo leyi heleleke ya Mati ya Umngeni.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 18 October 2017, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 18 Nhlangula 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Issues on the environment.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.

src: Media Freedom Day.
tgt: Siku ra Ntshunxeko wa Swihangalasamahungu.

src: Cabinet joins South Africans in commemorating Media Freedom Day on Thursday, 19 October 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlangana na MaAfrika-Dzonga ku tsundzuka Siku ra Ntshunxeko wa Swihangalasamahungu hi Ravumune, 19 Nhlangula 2017.

src: Media played a critical role in the fight against apartheid, exposing atrocities and brutality committed by the apartheid regime.
tgt: Swihangalasamahungu swi tirhile ntirho wa nkoka swonghasi eka ku lwisana na xihlawuhlawu, ku humesela erivaleni maxangu na tihanyi leti endliweke hi mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu.

src: This year marks 40 years since the apartheid regime banned progressive newspapers such as the World, the Weekend World and the Voice.
tgt: Nan'waka ri fungha 40 wa malembe kusukela loko mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu wu yirisile maphephahungu yo seketela ncinco wa vaaki yo tanihi World, Weekend World na Voice.

src: Today, media freedom is firmly entrenched in South Africa’s Constitution and remains a fundamental feature of our developing nation.
tgt: Namuntlha, ntshunxeko wa swihangalasamahungu wu simekiwile hi ndlela yo tiya eka Vumbiwa ra Afrika-Dzonga naswona wu tama wa ha ri xihlawulekisi xa nkoka xa rixaka ra ka hina leri hluvukaka.

src: Cabinet further encourages South Africans to continue to promote access to information and use the right of media freedom responsibly to help build a united, non-racial, non-sexist, democratic and prosperous South Africa for all.
tgt: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi khutaza yi MaAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni va kondletela mfikelelo eka mahungu na ku tirhisa mfanelo ya ntshuxeko wa swihangalasamahungu hi ndlela ya vutihlamuleri ku pfuna ku aka Afrika-Dzonga ra hinkwavo leri nga na vun'we, leri nga yiki hi nghohe, leri nga yiki hi rimbewu, ra xidemokirasi na ku va leri humelelaka.

src: Oceans Economy.
tgt: Ikhonomi ya Malwandle.

src: Cabinet commends President Jacob Zuma in delivering a progress report to stakeholders on the implementation of Operation Phakisa for the Oceans Economy and calls on all stakeholders to continue partnering with government to unlock the economic potential of our oceans.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Phuresidente Jacob Zuma eku nyikeni xiviko eka vakhumbheki eka nsimeko wa Operation Phakisa eka Ikhonomi ya Malwandle naswona yi rhamba vakhumbheki hikwavo ku ya emahlweni va tirhisana na mfumo ku humesa vuswikoti bya ikhonomi ya malwandle ya hina.

src: The Oceans Economy has already contributed about 4.4% to South Africa’s Gross Domestic Product and the President’s report to stakeholders strongly demonstrates the concerted effort and support of all government partners tapping into the vast potential.
tgt: Ikhonomi ya Malwandle se yi hoxile xandla hi kwalomu ka 4.4% eka Swimakiwa Hinkwaswo swa Tiko swa Afrika-Dzonga naswona xiviko xa Phuresidente eka vanghenisaxandla xi kombisa hi ndlela ya matimba matshalatshala ya nhlanganelo na nseketelo wa vatirhisani hinkwavo va mfumo lava tirhisaka vuswikoti lebyikulu.

src: Oceans Economy projects have so far unlocked a combined R.6 billion in investment from government and the private sector, and have created more than 6 500 jobs.
tgt: Tiphurojeke ta Ikhonomi ya Malwandle kufika sweswi ti humesile R.6 wa tibiliyoni leti katsanisiweke eka vuvekisi kusuka eka mfumo na sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo, naswona ti tumbuluxile ku tlula 6 500 wa mitirho.

src: The largest investment in the Oceans Economy, facilitated through government incentives, was directed to infrastructure development, mainly ports, manufacturing, boatbuilding, aquaculture and scientific surveys in the oil and gas sector.
tgt: Vuvekisi lebyikulu eka Ikhonomi ya Malwandle, lebyi fambisiweke hi ku tirhisa swinavetisi swa mfumo, byi kongomisiwile eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa, ngopfungopfu mihlaluko, vumaki, vumakaswikwekwetsu, nkuriso wa swiharhi na swimilani swa le matini na mivalango ya xisayense eka sekitara ya oyili na gasi.

src: Government plans to establish the single largest boatbuilding facility in southern Africa.
tgt: Mfumo wu kunguhata ku tumbuluxa xitirhisiwa xa vumakelaswikwekwetsu xin'we lexikulu eka hinkwaswo edzongeni wa Afrika.

src: The KwaZulu-Natal Boatbuilding Park in the Port of Durban will harvest potential from new investment, exports and job creation.
tgt: Phaka ya Vumakaswikwekwetsu ya KwaZulu-Natal eka Hlaluko ra Durban yi ta hlengeleta vuswikoti kusuka eka vuvekisi lebyintshwa, tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho.

src: State visit to Zambia.
tgt: Vuendzi bya mfumo ku ya eZambia.

src: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes from President Zuma’s State Visit to the Republic of Zambia from 12 to 13 October 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo kusuku eka Vuendzi bya Mfumo bya Phuresidente Zuma ku ya eRhiphabuliki ra Zambia kusuka hi ti 12 kufika ti 13 Nhlangula 2017.

src: Interactions between President Zuma and his Zambian counterpart Edgar Lungu strengthened existing good political, economic and cultural relations between the two countries, underpinned by strong historical ties dating back from the years of the liberation struggle.
tgt: Min'wangulano exikarhi ka Phuresidente Zuma na ntangha yakwe hi ntirho ya Zambia Edgar Lungu yi tiyisile vuxaka lebyi nga kona bya xipolitiki, xiikhonomi na vuxaka bya mfuwo exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi, lebyi seketeriwaka hi vuxaka bya swa matimu byo tiya lebyi tumbulukeke kusuka emalembeni ya nyimpi ya ntshuxeko.

src: The two Heads of State officially opened the OR Tambo National Heritage site in Chelstone, Lusaka, in honour of OR Tambo’s contribution to the liberation struggle of southern Africa.
tgt: Tiphuresidente letimbirhi ti pfurile ximfumo ndhawu ya OR Tambo National Heritage eChelstone, Lusaka, hi ku xixima vuhoxaxandla bya OR Tambo eka nyimpi ya ntshuxeko edzongeni wa Afrika.

src: Zambia remains one of South Africa’s top trading partners in the region and the continent.
tgt: Zambia yi tama ya ha ri rin'wana ra vatirhisani va bindzu va le henhla va Afrika-Dzonga exifundzeni na le tikwenikulu.

src: Economic cooperation between South Africa and Zambia continues to grow, with South African exports to Zambia amounting to approximately R30 billion in 2016.
tgt: Ntirhisano wa swa ikhonomi exikarhi xa Afrika-Dzonga na Zambia wu ya emahlweni wu kula, laha tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe ta Afrika-Dzonga ku ya eZambia ti endleke kwalomu ka R30 wa tibiliyoni hi lembe ra 2016.

src: The two countries cooperate in a variety of areas, including trade and investment, science and technology, defence, agriculture, environment, energy and health.
tgt: Matiko lamambirhi ya tirhisana eka swiyenge swo hambanahambana, ku katsa mabindzu na vuvekisi, sayense na thekinoloji, vusirheleri, vurimi, mbangu, eneji na rihanyo.

src: Working visit to Nigeria.
tgt: Vuendzi byo tirha ku ya eNigeria.

src: Cabinet congratulates President Zuma on being honoured with a statue and a street being named after him in Nigeria, during a working visit to strengthen socio-economic relations and other cooperations.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Phuresidente Zuma eka ku va a xiximiwile hi xifaniso na xitarata leswi thyiweke mavito ya yena eNigeria, hi nkarhi wa vuendzi byo tirha ku tiyisa vuxaka bya vaaki na ikhonomi na mitirhisano yin'wana.

src: The Imo State Governor, Rochas Okorocha, conferred on President Zuma the Imo Merit Award, the highest award in the State conferred on those who have made a difference in the development of their communities.
tgt: Gavhenara wa Xifundzakulu xa Imo, Rochas Okorocha, u nyikile Phuresidente Zuma Sagwati ra Meriti ya Imo, sagwati ra le henhlahenhla ra Xifundzakulu leri nyikiwaka lava endleke ku hambana eka nhluvukiso wa le migangeni ya ka vona.

src: South Africa assumed Chair of the IORA during the 17th meeting held in Durban from 14 to 18 October 2017.
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya Huvo ya Vaholobye ya Indian Ocean Rim (IORA) ya vu Afrika-Dzonga ri sungule Vutshamaxitulu bya IORA eka nhlengeletano ya vu 17 leyi khomeriweke eDurban kusuka hi ti 14 kufika 18 Nhlangula 2017.

src: South Africa’s theme for its tenure is “Uniting the Peoples of Africa, Asia, Australasia and the Middle East through Enhanced Cooperation for Peace, Stability and Sustainable Development”.
tgt: Nkongomelo wa Afrika-Dzonga wa nkarhi wa rona wa ku va ehofisini i “Ku Hlanganisa Vanhu va Afrika, Asia, Australasia na Middle East hi Ntirhisano lowu Antswisiweke wa ku Rhula, Ntshamiseko na Nhluvukiso lowu Yisekaka Emahlweni”.

src: Cabinet has reiterated its commitment through this chairpersonship to further regional cooperation in areas such as the blue economy women economic empowerment small, medium and micro enterprise promotion youth empowerment, and cooperation in academics, science and technology.
tgt: Khabinete yi vule nakambe ku tiboha ka yona hi vutshamaxitulu lebyi eka ntirhisano wa xifundza wo yisa emahlweni eka swiyenge swo tanihi ikhonomi ya malwandle ku nyika matimba eka ikhonomi wa vavasati ku tlakusa mabindzu lamatsongo, ya le xikarhi na lamatsongo swinene ku nyika matimba eka vantshwa, na ntirhisano eka swa tidyondzo, sayense na thekinoloji.

src: Annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank.
tgt: Tinhlengeletano ta lembe na lembe ta Nkwama wa Timali wa Matiko ya Misava (IMF) na Bangi ya Misava.

src: Cabinet was briefed by the Minister of Finance, Mr Malusi Gigaba, following South Africa’s participation at the 2017 IMF and World Bank annual meetings, which took place from 13 to 15 October 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi Holobye wa Timali, Tat.

src: Cabinet was further briefed on the meeting Minister Gigaba held with sovereign credit rating agencies and investors to reaffirm South Africa’s current policies and approach to fiscal discipline.
tgt: Malusi Gigaba, hikwalaho ka vungheneri bya Afrika-Dzonga eka tinhlengeletano ta lembe na lembe ta Bangi ya Misava na IMF ya 2017, leti veke kona kusuka hi ti 13 kufika ti 15 Nhlangula 2017.

src: Cabinet is satisfied with the reassurance given to investors on government’s plans to grow the economy and government’s commitment to address governance issues in our state-owned entities.
tgt: Tinhlengeletano ti nyike xivandlanene xa ku hlela nhluvuko wa matiko eka timhaka ta nhluvukiso na ku tivisa mapfhumba ya rona Afrika-Dzonga eka nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vaaki, ku kula loku katsaka hinkwaswo, ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na ku hungutiwa ka vusweti.

src: The Medium Term Budget Policy Statement will be tabled in Parliament, Cape Town, on 25 October and will outline government’s spending plans over the next three years.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi hlamuseriwa ku ya emahlweni hi nhlengeletano leyi Holobye Gigaba a yi khomeke na tiejensi to pima swikweleti swa matiko lama tifumaka na vavekisi ku tiyisisa nakambe tipholisi na maendlelo ya nkarhi wa sweswi ya Afrika-Dzonga eka matikhomelo lamanene ya swa timali.

src: Cabinet applauded the massive boost in government’s infrastructure development with the official handover of three bridges in Botlokwa in Limpopo by President Zuma on 17 October 2017.
tgt: Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi xi ta andlariwa ePalamende, eKapa, hi ti 25 Nhlangula naswona xi ta katsakanya makungu ya matirhiselo ya timali ya mfumo eka malembe manharhu lama taka.

src: The South African National Roads Agency constructed the Botlokwa bridges, which consist of one road bridge and two pedestrian bridges on the N1 between Polokwane and Makhado.
tgt: Khabinete hi hoyozerile mpfuneto lowukulu eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa swa mfumo hi ku hundzisiwa ka ximfumo ka mabiloho manharhu eBotlokwa eLimpopo hi Phuresidente Zuma hi ti 17 Nhlangula 2017.

src: Cabinet is positive that this project will significantly improve travelling conditions and safety for all road users in the area.
tgt: Ejensi ya Magondzo ya Rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga yi akile mabuloho ya Botlokwa, lama nga na buloho rin'we ra gondzo na mabuloho mambirhi ya van'wamilenge eN1 exikarhi Polokwane na Makhado.

src: Small and medium enterprises.
tgt: Mabindzu lamatsongo na ya le xikarhi.

src: Cabinet commends the Department of Small Business Development for co-hosting this year’s China International Small and Medium Enterprises (SME) Fair, as it contributes to unlocking the Chinese market for South Africa’s small businesses and cooperatives.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo eka ku rhurhela Nkombiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo na ya le Xikarhi (SME) ya Matiko ya China, tanihileswi wu hoxaka xandla eka ku humesa makete wa China wa mabindzu lamatsongo na mabindzu ya nhlanganelo ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The SME Fair is taking place in Guangzhou, China from 10 to 27 October 2017.
tgt: Nkombiso wa SME wu le ku yeni emahlweni eGuangzhou, China kusuka hi ti 10 kufika ti 27 Nhlangula 2017.

src: Small businesses are the heartbeat of our economy and engine for economic growth and job creation in South Africa, and our participation in the trade fair promoted market access and opportunities to grow businesses.
tgt: Mabindzu lamatsongo hi wona xivindzi xa ikhonomi ya hina na njhini ya ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho eAfrika-Dzonga, naswona ku nghenela ka hina eka nkombiso wa mabindzu ku tlakusile mfikelelo eka timakete na swivandlanene eka ku kurisa mabindzu.

src: Cabinet is confident that this demonstrates government’s commitment to the goal of promoting and sustaining entrepreneurship.
tgt: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku leswi swi kombisa ku tiboha ka mfumo eka xikongomelo xa ku tlakusa na ku yisa emahlweni vubindzu.

src: Investing in small businesses will help the country respond to current socio-economic challenges.
tgt: Ku vekisa eka mabindzu lamatsongo swi ta pfuna tiko ku angula eka mitlhontlho ya ikhonomi ya vaaki ya sweswi.

src: Tourism.
tgt: Vupfhumba.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the National Tourism Monitors Programme in Soweto, on Tuesday, 17 October 2017, which aims to enhance the visitor experience as well as improve the safety of tourists.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Phurogireme ya Valanguteri va Vupfhumba ya Rixaka eSoweto, hi Ravumbirhi, 17 Nhlangula 2017, leri nga na xikongomelo xa ku tlakusa ntokoto wa vaendzi xikan'we na ku antswisa vuhlayiseki bya vapfhumba.

src: The Department of Tourism, in partnership with the Gauteng Tourism Authority, launched the programme in Vilakazi Street, which is the only street in the world boasting the residence of two Nobel Laureates – former President Nelson Mandela and Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba, hi ku tirhisana na Vulawuri bya Vupfhumba bya Gauteng, yi simekile pfhumba eXitarateni xa Vilakazi, lexi xi nga xitarata xi ri xoxe emisaveni lexi tinyungubyisaka hi vutshamo bya Vaxiximiwa va Sagwati ra Nobel vambirhi – Khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela na Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.

src: This programme is aligned to the National Development Plan (NDP) goals and aims to create employment for 200 youth, who will be trained to become monitors at tourism destinations for a 36-month period.
tgt: Pfhumba leri ri fambisana na swikongomelo swa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso ra Rixaka (NDP) naswona ri na xikongomelo xa ku tumbuluxa mitirho ya 200 ya vantshwa, lava va nga ta leteriwa ku va valanguteri eka tindhawu ta vupfhumba ku ringana nkarhi wa 36 wa tin'hweti.

src: Cabinet encourages business owners and communities in Gauteng to work with the tourism monitors to improve the safety of tourists and harness the economic potential from this industry.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza vini va mabindzu na miganga eGauteng ku tirha na valanguteri va vupfhumba ku antswisa vuhlayiseki bya vapfhumba na ku lawula vuswikoti bya ikhonomi kusuka eka xiyenge leyi.

src: Science and technology.
tgt: Sayense na Thekinoloji.

src: Cabinet welcomes and congratulates the scientists who participated in the South African Astronomical Observatory (SAAO) and the Southern African Large Telescope (SALT) telescopes exploration.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela na ku hoyozela vativi va sayenselava va ngheneleke mbalango wa tithelesikopu wa Muako wa Thelesikopu ya Ntivotinyeleti wa Afrika-Dzonga (SAAO) na Thelesikopu Leyikulu ya Dzongeni wa Afrika (SALT).

src: This resulted in an unprecedented international collaboration to investigate the origin of the first detection of gravitational waves produced by two colliding neutron stars.
tgt: Leswi swi vangile ntirhisano wa matiko lowu nga si tshamaka wu va kona ku lavisisa masungulo ya vuthumbhi byo sungula bya gandlati ra giravhithi leri humesiweke hi tinyeleti timbirhi ta tinyutironi leti tlumbaneke.

src: The collision also resulted in a kilonova explosion of light.
tgt: Nakambe ntlumbano lowu wu tlhele wu vanga mbhuluko wa khilonovha wa ku vonakala.

src: A kilonova is an astronomical event that occurs in a binary system when two neutron stars or a neutron star and a black hole merge into each other.
tgt: Khilonovha i xiendleko xa ntivotinyeleti lexi endlekaka eka sisiteme ya swilo swimbirhi loko tinyeleti ta tinyutironi timbirhi kumbe nyeleti ya nyutironi na nkele wa ntima swi pfangana.

src: The discovery marks the birth of a new era in astrophysics, the first cosmic event observed in both gravitational waves and light.
tgt: Vuthumbhi lebyi byi fungha ku fika ka nkarhi lowuntshwa wa asitirofizikisi, xiendleko xa ntumbuluko wa misava na tinyeleti lexi voniweke eka ngulumelo wa nkokelamisaveni na ku vonakala.

src: SALT and other SAAO telescopes have provided some of the very first data in what is turning out to be one of the most-studied astrophysical events ever.
tgt: SALT na tithelesikopu tin'wana ta SAAO ti nyikile switiviwa swo sungulasungula eka leswi swi vonakaka swi ri swiendleko swa asitirofizikisi leswi nga tshama swi dyondziwa.

src: SALT and SAAO are among the 70 ground- and space-based observatories that observed the cataclysmic explosion of two colliding neutron stars, immediately after their gravitational shock waves were detected by the United States-based Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory and the European-based Virgo detector.
tgt: SALT na SAAO ti le xikarhi ka yin'wana ya 70 ya miako ya thelesikopu leyi kumekaka ehansi na le mpfhukeni leyi hlanganeke na ku buluka wa lokukulu ka tinyeleti timbirhi ta nyutironi leti tlumbaneke, xikan'wekan'we endzhaku ka loko magandlati ya xoko ya giravhithi ya thumbhiwile hi Muako wa Thelesikopu wa Magandlati ya Giravhithi ya Nkatsano wa ku Vonakala ka Leyizara lowu kumekaka eUnited States na muthumbhi wa Virgo loyi a kumekaka eYuropa.

src: World Festival of Youth and Students.
tgt: Nkhuvu wa Misava wa Vantshwa na Swichudeni.

src: Russia is hosting the 2017 World Festival of Youth and Students from 14 to 22 October 2017, which is being attended by more than 20 000 young people from 150 countries.
tgt: Russia yi le ku rhurheleni Nkhuvu wa Misava wa Vantshwa na Swichudeni wa 2017 kusuka hi ti 14 kufika 22 Nhlangula 2017, lowu ku nga ku ngheneleleni ka ku tlula 20 000 wa vantshwa vo huma eka 150 wa matiko.

src: The purpose of the festival is to bring together the youth of the world community around the idea of justice, the strengthening of international relations, and the development of inter-ethnic and intercultural relations.
tgt: Xikongomelo xa nkhuvu i ku tisa endhawini yin'we vantshwa va misava eka mhaka ya vululami, ku tiyisa vuxaka bya matiko, na nhluvukiso wa vuxaka bya le xikarhi ka tinxaka na bya le xikarhi ka mifuwo.

src: Child protection.
tgt: Nsirhelelo wa vana.

src: Cabinet has expressed concern following disturbing reports of crimes against children, the most recent one being the alleged sexual assault of more than 80 pupils at the AB Xuma Primary School in Orlando, Soweto by a scholar patrol guard.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombisile ku khumbeka hikwalaho ka swiviko swo vavisa swa vugevenga ehenhla ka vana, xin'wana lexa ha ku vaka kona ku nga ri khale ngopfu ku nga nxaniso wa swa masangu lowu ehleketeleriwaka wa ku tlula 80 wa vana va xikolo eka Xikolo xa le Hansi xa AB Xuma eOrlando, Soweto hi murindzi wo tsemakanyisa vana va xikolo gondzo.

src: The provincial department is commended for the prompt response by removing, with immediate effect, the senior management of the school, bringing on board social workers and instituting an investigation by an independent body.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya xifundzakulu ya hoyozeriwa eka n'wangulo wa xihatla hi ku susa, xikan'wekan'we, vufambisinkulu bya xikolo, ku tisiwa vakondleteri na ku simeka vulavisisi hi huvo leyi tiyimeleke.

src: Cabinet calls on all communities in South Africa to work together to protect all children from any form of danger and abuse, and to partner with local police to keep our communities safe.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba miganga hinkwayo eAfrika-Dzonga ku tirhisana ku sirhelela vana hinkwavo eka muxaka wihi kumbe wihi wa khombo na nxaniso, na ku tirhisana na maphorisa ya muganga ku endla miganga yi tshama yi hlayisekile.

src: Examinations.
tgt: Swikambelo.

src: Cabinet is confident that end-of-year school examinations will proceed without interruption following this week’s mass demonstration led by the South African Democratic Teachers’ Union (SADTU).
tgt: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku swikambelo swa xikolo swa ku hela ka lembe swi ta ya emahlweni ku ri hava nkavanyeto endzhaku ka ku kombisa ku vilela ka ntshungu ka vhiki leri leyi loku a ku rhangeriwile hi Nhlangano wa Vadyondzisi wa Xidemokirasi wa Afrika-Dzonga (SADTU).

src: SADTU handed over a memorandum to the Minister of Basic Education, Ms Angie Motshekga, who has committed to resolving issues of concern as speedily as possibly.
tgt: SADTU yi nyikile memorandamu eka Holobye wa Dyondzo ya le Hansi, Man.

src: It is important that all stakeholders work together to create a conducive environment to better enable learners to focus on learning and their examiniations.
tgt: I swa nkoka leswaku vakhumbheki hinkwavo va tirhisana ku tumbuluxa mbangu wo tirheka ku kotisa vadyondzi hi ndlela yo antswa ku kongomisa eka ku dyondza na swikambelo swa vona.

src: Storms.
tgt: Swidzedze.

src: Cabinet expresses sincere condolences to the loved ones of those who lost their lives during the recent storms in some parts of the country.
tgt: Khabinete yi komba nchavelelo wa le mbilwini eka varhandziwa va lavaya va lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya vona eka swidzedze leswa ha ku vaka kona eka swiphemu swin'wana swa tiko.

src: Cabinet also extends its gratitude to all volunteers, civil-society organisations, communities, relief-aid workers and the Disaster Management teams for assisting those affected.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi khensa vatinyiketi hinkwavo, mihlangano ya leyi nga na ku navela kun’we ya vaaki, miganga, vatirhi va mphalalo-mpfuno na swipanu swa Mafambiselo ya Mhangu eka ku pfuna volava va khumbekeke.

src: The Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Mr Des van Rooyen, in his capacity as the head of the National Disaster Management Centre in South Africa, visited areas affected by storms and heavy rains in the eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality in KwaZulu-Natal on 13 October 2017 and Mogale City Local Municipality in Gauteng on 16 October WEBTOKEN a result of the heavy rains and storms that battered many parts of the country, 19 lives were lost and over 20 people injured.
tgt: Des van Rooyen, eka xiyimo xa yena tanihi murhangeri wa Senthara ya Mafambiselo ya Mhangu ya Rixaka eAfrika-Dzonga, u endzerile tindhawu leti khumbekeke hi swidzedze na timpfula ta matimba eka Masipalankulu wa Doroba ra eThekwini eKwaZulu-Natal hi ti 13 Nhlangula 2017 na le ka Masipala wa Muganga wa Doroba ra Mogale eGauteng hi ti 16 Nhlangula 2017.Hikwalaho ka timpfula ta matimba na swidzedze leswi hlaseleke swiphemu swo tala swa tiko, 19 wa vutomi byi lahlekile na swona ku tlula 20 wa vanhu va vavisekile.

src: Minister van Rooyen also visited the recent incidences in Philippi in the Western Cape where six family members, including three children, lost their lives due to the fire that ravaged three informal houses and a tuckshop.
tgt: Nakambe Holobye van Rooyen u endzerile tindhawu ta leti ta ha ku humeleriwaka hi timhangu ePhilippi eKapa-Vupeladyambu laha tsevu wa swirho swa ndyangu, ku katsa na vana vanharhu, swi lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya swona hikwalaho ka ndzilo lowu mbumburheleke tiyindlu tinharhu ta mixaxa na vhengelexiphaza.

src: Life Esidimeni.
tgt: Life Esidimeni.

src: Cabinet acknowledges the start of the Life Esidimeni alternative dispute resolution process as what could be the beginning of closure for families of patients who died.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku sungula ka endlelo ra xitshunxo xa nkwetlembetano rin'wana ra Life Esidimeni tanihileswi swi nga ta va masungulo ya makumu eka mindyangu ya vavabyi lava loveke.

src: Cabinet expresses full confidence in retired Constitutional Court Deputy Chief Justice Dikgang Moseneke, who is presiding over the matter and sincerely wishes family members strength as they observe what must be a difficult account of this tragedy.
tgt: Khabinete yi humesa ntshembo hi vutalo eka Xandla xa Muavanyisinkulu xa Khoto ya Vumbiwa Dikgang Moseneke, loyi a fambisaka nandzu lowu naswona yi navelela hi ku tshembeka swirho swa mindyangu matimba tanihiloko swi vona leswi swi nga vaka swi ri xivangelo xo tika xa khomborifu leri.

src: The investigation should not only assist in bringing closure to these affected families but also serve to provide lessons to government in general.
tgt: Vulavisisi lebyi a byi fanelangi ku pfuna ntsena eka ku tisa makumu eka mindyangu leyi khumbekaka kambe na ku tirha ku nyika tidyondzo eka mfumo hi ku angarhela.

src: Government is committed to providing quality services to all South Africans.
tgt: Mfumo wa tiboha ku nyika vukorhokeri bya risima eka MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo.

src: Avian Influenza.
tgt: Mukhuhlwana wa Tinyenyana.

src: Cabinet has been assured that the Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (DAFF) is undertaking consistent surveillance on farms across the country in an effort to prevent the spread of the Avian Influenza (HPAI) H5N8 outbreak.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshembisiwile leswaku Ndzawulo ya Vurimi, Swihlahla na swa Tinhlampfi (DAFF) yi le ku endleni vulanguteri bya nkarhi hinkwawo eka mapurasi ya tiko hinkwaro hi ku ringeta ku sivela ku hangalaka ka ntungu wa Mukhuhlwana wa Tinyenyana (HPAI) H5Ntshikelelo wa mukhuhlwana wa tinyenyana wu thumbiwile eka tinyenyana.

src: The strain of avian influenza has been detected in birds.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza vaaki ku sukela ku khomakhoma tinyenyana to vabya na leti nga fa naswona va nga ringeti ku phamela tinyenyana ta nhova kambe va nga ha mangala tinyenyana leti ehleketeleriwaka ku va ti vabya eka vulawuri bya le ndhawini.

src: Attacks on police.
tgt: Mihlaselo ehenhla ka Maphorisa.

src: Cabinet condemns the attack on six South African Police Service members in Vanderbijlpark in Gauteng on 10 October 2017 by members of the community.
tgt: Khabinete yi sola nhlaselo ehenhla ka tsevu wa swirho swa Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga eVanderbijlpark eGauteng hi ti 10 Nhlangula 2017 hi vaakandhawu.

src: The law-enforcement agencies are mandated to protect society from any act of criminality.
tgt: Tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ti nyikiwile matimba ya ku sirhelela rixaka eka xiendlo xihi kumbe xihi xa vugevenga.

src: Therefore, no amount of anger can justify anyone attacking the law-enforcement agencies.
tgt: Hikokwalaho, a ku na ntsengo wa nhlundzuko wu nga nyikaka xivangelo eka munhu wihi kumbe wihi xa ku hlasela tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu.

src: Cabinet urges members of that community to work with the police to apprehend criminal elements and help make South Africa safer for all.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlohlotela vaakandhawu lava ku tirhisana na maphorisa ku khoma swigevenga leswi na ku pfuna ku endla Afrika-Dzonga ri hlayiseka swinene eka hinkwavo.

src: Social Housing Programme.
tgt: Nongonoko wa Tiyindlu ta Vaaki.

src: Cabinet was apprised on the findings and recommendations of the Impacts and Implementation Evaluation of the Social Housing Programme and the improvement plan, with a view of overcoming apartheid spatial patterns by improving spatial location and urban integration of housing projects.
tgt: Khabinete yi tivisiwile hi mikumo na swibumabumelo swa Nkhumbho na Nkambelo wa Nsimeko wa Phurogireme ya Tiyindlu ta Vaaki na kungu ro antswisa, hi xikongomelo xa ku ololoxa tipheteni ta matshamelo ya xihlawuhlawu hi ku antswisa ndhawu ya matshamelo na mpfanganiso wa tiphurojeke ta tiyindlu.

src: The programme offers affordable rental accommodation for low and middle-income households in neighborhoods where market conditions would otherwise exclude them or allocate inadequate housing.
tgt: Phurogireme leyi yi nyika vutshamo bya rhente yo fikeleleka eka mindyangu ya malinghena ya le hansi na ya le xikarhi eka tindhawu laha swiyimo swa timakete nkarhi wun'wana a swi ta va siya ehandle kumbe ku avela tiyindlu leti nga ringanelangiki.

src: This is the only programme that gears debt financing considers long-term financial sustainability of projects and creates a virtuous financial cycle with tenants paying rentals and social-housing institutions paying rates, taxes and service charges to municipalities.
tgt: Leyi i phurogiremeba yi ri roxe leyi yi susumetaka ku hakeriwa ka swikweleti yi tekelaka enhlokweni ku yiseka emhalweni ka swa timali ta nkarhi wo leha ka tiphurojeke na ku tumbuluxa ndzhendzeleko wa swa timali lowunene na vahiri lava hakelaka tirhente na mihlangano ya tiyindlu ta vaaki leyi hakelaka tirhente, swibalo, na tihakelo ta vukorhokeri eka timasipala.

src: This report assists the relevant departments in further improving their respective operational plans.
tgt: Xiviko lexi xi pfuna tindzawulo leti faneleke eka ku antswisa ku ya emahlweni makungu ya tona ya matirhelo ya tindzawulo to hambanahambana.

src: The full report will be placed on the website of the Department of Performance Monitoring and Evaluation (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Xiviko hi vutalo xi ta vekiwa eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Nandzeleriso na Nhlahluvo wa Matirhelo kun’we na Vulawuri (WEBTOKEN).

src: National Youth Service (NYS).
tgt: Vukorhokeri bya Vantshwa bya Rixaka (NYS).

src: Cabinet approved the revised and improved NYS Programme Framework as part of developing young people as active citizens of South Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Rimba ra Phurogireme ra NYS leri pfuxetiweke na ku antswisiwa tanihi xiphemu xa vantshwa tanihi vaakatiko lava gingiritekaka va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The NYS is an enabler for young people in South Africa to become active citizens of the country and contribute positively to the country’s development while achieving personal and professional development.
tgt: NYS i mukotisi wa vantshwa eAfrika-Dzonga ku va vaakatiko lava gingiritekaka va tiko na ku hoxa xandla hi ndlela leyinene eka nhluvukiso wa tiko loko ku ri karhi ku fikeleriwa nhluvukiso wa munhu yena n'wini na wa xiphurofexinali.

src: This will involve young people participating in activities that benefit local communities while developing their abilities through service and learning so that their opportunities to successfully enter labour markets and become entrepreneurs are bolstered.
tgt: Leswi swi ta khumba vantshwa lava nghenelelaka eka migingiriko leyi vuyerisaka vaakandhawu va miganga loko ku ri karhi ku hluvukisiwa vuswikoti hi vukorhokeri na ku dyondza ku endlela leswaku swivandlanene swa vona swa ku nghena hi ndlela leyi humelelaka eka timakete ta vatirhi na ku va van'wamabindzu swi tiyisiwa.

src: 3rd African Forum for Agricultual Advisory Services Extension Week.
tgt: Foramu ya Afrika ya vu3 ya Vhiki ra Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi.

src: Cabinet approved the hosting of the 3rd African Forum for Agricultural Advisory Services Extension Week, which will be held in KwaZulu-Natal from 30 October to 3 November 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhurheriwa ka Foramu ya Afrika ya vu3 ya Vhiki ra Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi, leyi nga ta khomeriwa eKwaZulu-Natal kusuka hi ti 30 Nhlangula kufika ti3 Hukuri 2017.

src: The event is aligned to the NDP and identifies food security as a means to address the triple challenge of unemployment, poverty and inequality.
tgt: Xiendleko lexi xi fambisana na NDP naswona xi kuma nsirhelelo wa swakudya tanihi ndlela ya ku tirhana na ntlhontlho xinharhu wa mpfumaleko wa mitirho, vusweti na nkandzingano.

src: The theme is: “Scaling up climate smart agriculture: integrating youth, women, and the digital revolution”, and the event will be held under the leadership of the DAFF, in collaboration with the South African Society for Agricultural Extension and the African Forum for Agricultural Advisory Services.
tgt: Nkongomelo i: “Ku tlakusa vurimi lebyi fambelanaka na maxelo: ku pfanganisa vantshwa, vavasati, na ncinco wa xidijitali”, naswona xiendleko lexi xi ta khomeriwa ehansi ka vurhangeri bya DAFF, hi ku tirhisana na Nhlangano wa Afrika-Dzonga wa Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vurimi na Foramu ya Afrika ya Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi.

src: This continental network for Agricultural Extension and Advisory Services (AEAS) in Africa provides a platform for mutual learning and innovation among AEAS providers across Africa and the world.
tgt: Netiweke leyi ya tikokulu ya Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vurimi na Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo (AEAS) eAfrika yi nyika pulatifomo ya ku dyondzisana na maendlelo lamantshwa exikarhi vaphakeri va AEAS eAfrika na le misaveni hinkwayo.

src: The NDP also advocates for an improvement in skills development and training in the agricultural sector, including the training of a new cadre of extension practitioners who will respond effectively to the needs of smallholder farmers.
tgt: Nakambe NDP yi seketela vuantswisi eka nhluvukiso wa swikili na vuleteri eka sekitara ya vurimi, ku katsa na vuleteri bya swipanu leswintshwa swa vatirhi va mphakelo wa vuxokoxoko lava nga ta angula hi ndlela leyi vuyerisaka eka swidingo swa varimi va swipurasani.

src: World Wine Trade Group.
tgt: Ntlawa wa Mabindzu ya Vhinyo wa Misava.

src: In contributing to the removal of trade barriers, Cabinet was briefed on South Africa’s Chairship of the World Wine Trade Group from April 2017 to May 2018.
tgt: Eka ku hoxa xandla ka ku susiwa ka swirhalanganyi swa , khabinete hi nyikiwile vuxokoxoko hi Vutshamaxitulu wa Afrika-Dzonga wa Ntlawa wa Mabindzu ya Vhinyo wa Misava kusuka hi Dzivamisoko 2017 kufika hi Mudyaxihi 2018.

src: As chair, South Africa will host the annual meeting of the World Wine Trade Group in Cape Town from 1 to 3 November 2017.
tgt: Tanihi mutshamaxitulu, Afrika-Dzonga ri ta rhurhela nhlengeletano ya lembe na lembe ya Ntlawa wa Mabindzu ya Vhinyo wa Misava eKapa kusuka hi ti1 kufika hi ti3 Hukuri 2017.

src: The group aims to facilitate international trade in wine through information sharing, discussion of regulatory issues in wine markets and joint actions for the removal of trade barriers.
tgt: Ntlawa lowu wu na xikongomelo xa ku fambisa bindzu ra matiko eka vhinyo hi ku tirhisa ku avelana vuxokoxoko, nkanelo wa swiphiqo swa malawulelo na swiendlo swa nhlanganelo swa ku susiwa ka swirhalanganyi swa mabindzu.

src: Emerging producers and exports of the South African wine industry benefit from South Africa’s participation.
tgt: Vahumesi lava tumbulukaka na tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe ta vumaki bya vhinyo ya Afrika-Dzonga va vuyeriwa kusuka eka vungheneri bya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: This contributes to the Nine-Point Plan and the NDP, which seek to revitalise the agriculture and agro-processing value chain.
tgt: Leswi swi hoxa xandla eka Kungu ra Timhaka ta Kaye na NDP, leswi swi lavaka ku pfuxeta vurimi na nkhuluko wa nkoka wa ku phurosesiwa ka swirin'wa.

src: In the wine sector, the aim is to increase the area under wine production, support smallholder producers and target certain markets for export growth.
tgt: Eka sekitara ya vhinyo, xikongomelo i ku engetela ndhawu leyi nga ehansi ka vuhumesi bya vhinyo, ku seketela vahumesi va mpimo lowutsongo na ku pakanisa timakete to karhi eka ku kula ka tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe.

src: 5th Annual Meeting of ID4AFRICA Movement.
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu 5 ya Nhlangano wa ID4AFRICKhabinete yi pasisile ku rhurhela ka Afrika-Dzonga ka Nhlengeletano ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu 5 ya Nhlangano wa ID4AFRICA hi lembe ra 2019.

src: Cabinet approved South Africa’s hosting of the 5th Annual Meeting of the ID4Africa Movement in 2019.
tgt: ID4Africa i vandla ra vakhumbhekinyingi leri tlakusaka ku amukeriwa ka nkavuciva na loku nga na vutihlamuleri ka vutitivisi bya xidijiti eka ku fambisiwa ka nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vanhu.

src: ID4Africa is a multi-stakeholder movement that promotes the transparent and responsible adoption of digital identity for driving socio-economic development in Africa.
tgt: Mikanelo yi ta lava ku antswisa ndlela ya ntsariso wa vaaki na ku va switiviwa swa tinhlayohlayo ta nkoka swi hlengeletiwa, swi fambelanisiwa na ku xopaxopiwa, ku endliwa vuxokoxoko byo tshembeka byi kumeka eka vaendli va tipholisi.

src: Discussions will seek to improve the way civil registration and vital statistics data is collected, coordinated and analysed, making available reliable information to policymakers.
tgt: Ku rhurhela khonferense leyi swi ta pfuna Afrika-Dzonga ku humelerisa swin'wana swa swikongomelo swa NDP na ku tumbuluxa vulemukisi bya nkoka wa swa maqhinga wa tisisiteme ta vutitivisi bya Afrika-Dzonga to tanihi sisiteme yo rhekoda hi nkarhi wolowo ya phasipoto na makhadi ya mapasi (ID) lama hlayekaka hi khomphyuta.

src: Hosting this conference will assist South Africa to realise some of the objectives of the NDP and create awareness of the strategic value for the South African identity systems such as the live capture system for passport and smart identity document (ID) cards.
tgt: Nakambe yi ta hlohlotela hi ndlela leyinene matiko man'wana exifundzeni ku amukela mivuyelo ya khadi ra pasi leri hlayekaka hi khomphyuta.

src: National crime statistics.
tgt: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ta rixaka.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the national crime statistics for the period 1 April 2016 to 31 March 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi nyikiwile vuxokoxoko hi tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ta rixaka eka nkarhi wa kusuka ti1 Dzivamisoko 2016 kufika ti 31 Nyenyankulu 2017.

src: The annual crime statistics enables government to monitor key crime fighting targets, as set out in the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019.
tgt: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ta lembe na lembe ti ta kotisa mfumo ku veka tihlo eka mipakaniso ya ku lwisana na vugevenga, tanihilaha swi hlamuseriweke hakona eka Rimba ra swa Maqhinga ra Theme ya le Xikarhi ra 2014-2019.

src: The crime statistics are used as an early-warning mechanism to strengthen the crime-prevention operations and strategies of various departments.
tgt: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ti tirhisiwa tanihi endlelo ro tsundzuxa nkarhi wa ha ri kona ku tiyisa mitirho yo sivela vugevenga na maqhinga ya tindzawulo to hambanahambana.

src: Cabinet has approved the release of the report by the Minister of Police, Mr Fikile Mbalula.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku humesiwa ka xiviko hi Holobye wa Maphorisa, Tat.

src: Upcoming Events.
tgt: Mitlangu leyi Taka.

src: OR Tambo Centenary Celebration.
tgt: Ku Tlangeriwa ka Malembexidzana ya OR Tambo.

src: Cabinet is pleased that preparations for the centenary celebration of the birth of OR Tambo are at an advanced stage and calls on all South Africans to continually familiarise themselves with the legacy of our Struggle icon, the role he played in our liberation, and his values which still guide us today.
tgt: Khabinete ya tsaka leswaku malulamiselo ya ku tlangeriwa ka malembexidzana ya ku velekiwa ka OR Tambo ya le ka xiyimo xa le henhla naswona yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku titoloveta hi ndlela leyi yisaka emahlweni ndzhaka ya nhenha ya Nyimpi, xiave lexi a xi tekeke eka ntshuxeko wa hina, na mikhuvanene ya yena leya ha hi letelaka ni namuntlha.

src: President Zuma declared 2017 the Year of OR Tambo under the theme: “Life and Legacy of OR Tambo” and he will, on Thursday, 19 October 2017, unveil a life-size statue of OR Tambo at the OR Tambo International Airport in Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u tivisile 2017 tanihi Lembe ra OR Tambo ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Vutomi na Ndzhaka ya OR Tambo” naswona, hi Ravumune, 19 Nhlangula 2017, u ta pfula xifaniso xa sayizi yo ringanana na OR Tambo eXitichini xa Swihahampfhuka xa Matiko xa OR Tambo eEkurhuleni, Gauteng.

src: South Africans are encouraged to join in centenary celebrations, which will culminate on 27 of October in Mbizana, Eastern Cape, which was the birth place of this Struggle icon 100 years ago.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga ya khutaziwa ku tikatsa eka mitlangelo ya malembexidzana, leyi nga ta fika emakumu hi siku ra 27 Nhlangula eMbizana, Kapa-Vuhumadyambu, leyi a yi ri yona ndhawu ya ku velekiwa ya nhenha leya Nyimpi 100 ra malembe lama nga hundza.

src: Government continues to build on OR Tambo’s legacy since 1994, and our many gains as South Africans must be celebrated and defended.
tgt: Mfumo wu ya emahlweni wu aka ndzhaka ya OR Tambo kusuka hi lembe ra 1994, naswona mivuyelo ya hina leyotala tanihi MaAfrika-Dzonga yi fanele ku tlangeriwa na ku sirheleriwa.

src: The Inter-Ministerial Committee tasked to prepare for the centenary celebrations, chaired by Minister Jeff Radebe, will on Friday, 20 October 2017, brief the media on the state of readiness.
tgt: Komiti ya Vaholobye leyi nyikiweke ntirho wa ku lulamisa mitlangelo ya malembexidzana, leyi mutshamaxitulu wa yona ku nga Holobye Jeff Radebe, hi Ravuntlhanu, 20 Nhlangula 2017, yi ta nyika vuxokoxoko eka swihangalasamahungu hi xiyimo xa malunghekelo.

src: Messages.
tgt: Mahungu.

src: Somalia attack.
tgt: Nhlaselo eSomalia.

src: Cabinet strongly condemns the recent bomb attack outside a hotel in Mogadishu, Somalia.
tgt: Khabinete yi sola swinene nhlaselo wa bombo lowu wa ha ku vaka kona ehandle ka hotela eMogadishu, Somalia.

src: At least 300 people were reportedly killed and hundreds more left injured.
tgt: Kwalomu ka 300 wa vanhu va vikiwile ku va va dlawile naswona van'wana va madzanadzana va siyiwe va vavisekile.

src: Cabinet expresses condolences to the loved ones of those who perished in the heinous attack on innocent people.
tgt: Khabinete yi humesa nchavelelo eka varhandziwa va volava va hundzeke emisaveni eka nhlaselo wa tihanyi ehenhla ka vanhu lava nga riki na nandzu.

src: Condolences to the Lubisi family.
tgt: Nchavelelo eka ndyangu wa ka Lubisi.

src: Cabinet also expresses its heartfelt condolences to the Director-General in The Presidency, Dr Cassius Lubisi, following the loss of his wife, Ms Lumka Lubisi, earlier this month.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi humesile nchavelelo wo suka embilwini eka Mulawuri-Jenerali eka Hofisi ya Phuresidente, Dok Cassius Lubisi, endzhaku ka ku loveriwa hi nghamu ya yena, Man Lumka Lubisi, emasungulweni ya n'hweti leyi.

src: Cabinet wishes the family strength during this difficult time of grief.
tgt: Khabinete yi navelela ndyangu lowu matimba hi nkarhi lowo tika wa gome.

src: Cabinet met at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlanganile eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Issues in the environment.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.

src: Medium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTBPS) 2017 Cabinet welcomes the MTBPS delivered by the Minister of Finance, Mr Malusi Gigaba, in Parliament, Cape Town, last week.
tgt: Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa le Xikarhi ka Theme (MTBPS) xa 2017.

src: The adjustment budget continues to drive inclusive growth and fiscal consolidation whilst protecting and promoting social expenditure in education, health, basic infrastructure and social security, which many fellow South Africans rely on to enjoy a better life.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela MTBPS leyi andlariweke hi Holobye wa Timali, Tat.

src: In a constrained fiscal space, government’s commitment to meet challenges in South Africa is demonstrated by interventions to grow township and rural economies, strengthen good governance at state-owned companies, as well as the additional significant allocation of funding higher education.
tgt: Malusi Gigaba, ePalamende, eKapa, vhiki leri nga hundza.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to join increased efforts to grow the economy.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku tikatsa eka matshalatshala lama engeteriweke ku kurisa ikhonomi.

src: Labour Force Survey.
tgt: Mbalango wa Vatirhi.

src: Cabinet appreciates the recently released Quarterly Labour Force Survey for the third quarter of 2017, which showed that unemployment remained unchanged from the previous quarter at 27.7%.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela Mbalango wa Vatirhi wa Kotara na Kotara lowu wa ha ku humesiwaka wa kotara ya vunharhu ya 2017, lowu wu kombeke leswaku vupfumalantirho byi tshame byi nga cincangi kusuka eka kotara leyi nga hundza eka 27.7%.

src: The employment gains recorded in the formal sector of 187 000 over the quarter, the informal sector and agriculture sector recorded employment losses of 71 000 and 25 000 respectively.
tgt: Mivuyelo ya vupfumalantirho leyi rhekodiweke eka sekitara ya ximfumo ya 187 000 ekotareni, sekitara leyi nga riki ya ximfumo na sekitara ya vurimi ti rhekodile milahlekelo ya mitirho ya 71 000 na 25 000 hi ku landzelelana.

src: Government remains committed to doing everything possible to deal with the unemployment challenges and calls on the private sector to do their part.
tgt: Mfumo wu tama wa ha tibohile ku endla hinkwaswo leswi kotekaka ku tirhana na mitlhontlho ya vupfumalantirho naswona wu rhamba sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo ku tirha xiphemu xa yona.

src: Centenary of Oliver Reginald Tambo.
tgt: Malembexidzana ya Oliver Reginald Tambo.

src: Cabinet thanks all South Africans for celebrating the centenary of Struggle stalwart OR Tambo, which culminated in celebration on the Friday, 27 October 2017 at Nkantolo Village in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Khabinete yi khensa MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo eka ku tlangela malembexidzana ya Nhenha ya Nyimpi OR Tambo, loku heteleleke eka ku tlangeriwa hi Ravuntlhanu, 27 Nhlangula eka Muganga wa ka Nkatolo eKapa-Vuhumadyambu.

src: As part of the centenary celebrations, President Jacob Zuma officiated over improvement projects, including:The hand-over of the Ludeke Dam in Mbizana, which was built as part of the Greater Mbizana Regional Bulk Water Supply Scheme by the Department of Water and SanitationA visit to the Nyameni family in Ludeke Village where the President switched on electricity, as part of the broader government rural electrification programme in Mbizana and surrounding areasBicycles distributed to learners at OR Tambo Technical High School, as part of the Department of Transport’s Shova Kalula programme, which supports learners who walk more than three kilometres to schoolThe donation of computers to learners in the Vukuzenzele Special School for children with disabilities, led by the Minister of Communications, Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane.
tgt: Tanihi xiphemu xa mitlangelo ya malembexidzana, Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u vile rhangerile tiphurojeke ta vuantswisi, ku katsa na:Ku hundziseriwa ka Damu ra Ludeke eMbizana, leri ri akiweke tanihi xiphemu xa Xikimi xa Mphakelo wa Mati yo Tala xa Xifundza xa Greater Mbizana hi Ndzawulo ya Mati na MbhasisoVuendzi kuya eka ndyangu wa ka Nyameni eka Muganga wa ka Ludeke laha Phuresidente a lumekeke gezi, tanihi xiphemu xa pfhumba ra ku nghenisiwa ka gezi etindhawini ta le makaya ra mfumo ro angarhela eMbizana na le tindhawini ta le kusuhiSwikanyakanya swi phakeriwile eka vadyondzi va Xikolo xa le Henhla xa Vuthekiniki xa OR Tambo, tanihi xiphemu xa pfhumba ra Shova Kalula ra Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli, leri ri seketelaka vadyondzi lava va fambaka ku tlula tikhilomitara tinharhu ku ya exikolweniKu nyikeriwa ka tikhomphyuta eka vadyondzi va Xikolo xo Hlawuleka xa Vukuzenzele eka vana lava hanyaka na vutsoniwa, loku rhangeriweke hi Holobye wa Vuhlanganisi, Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane.

src: Crime Statistics Cabinet appeals to all South Africans and communities to partner with law-enforcement agencies to combat crime.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo na miganga hinkwayo ku tirhisana na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ku lwisana na vugevenga.

src: The crime statistics released recently by the Minister of Police, Mr Fikile Mbalula, have indicated some areas where we made progress in combating crime and some areas where crime levels remain high.
tgt: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga leta ha ku humesiwaka hi Holobye wa Maphorisa, Tat.

src: Cabinet is convinced that it is only through working together that we can all benefit from creating safer communities that are able to develop.
tgt: Fikile Mbalula, ti kombile tindhawu tin'wana laha hi khatseke ndzima eka ku lwisana na vugevenga na tindhawu tin'wana laha tilevhele ta vugevenga ti tamaka ta ha ri ehenhla.

src: The crime statistics assist government and the South African Police Service to monitor key targets and serve as an early-warning mechanism to strengthen the crime-prevention operations and strategies.
tgt: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ti pfuna mfumo na Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga ku endla vulanguteri eka swikongomisiwakulu na ku tirha tanihi endlelo ro tsundzuxa nkarhi wa ha ri kona ku tiyisa mitirho na maqhinga yo sivela vugevenga.

src: It is part of the crime-prevention strategy to ensure that all people in the country are and feel safe.
tgt: I xiphemu xa qhinga ro sivela vugevenga ku tiyisisa leswaku vanhu hinkwavo etikweni va titwa va hlayisekile.

src: Gender-based violence (GBV).
tgt: Madzolonga yo ya hi rimbewu (GBV).

src: Cabinet reiterates its condemnation of the sexual abuse of women and children, irrespective of the alleged perpetrators’ societal positions.
tgt: Khabinete yi vula nakambe ku sola ka yona ka nxaniso hi swa masangu wa vavasati na vana, handle ko languta swiyimo swa le rixakeni swa vaendlaswivi lava ehlekeleteriwaka.

src: Cabinet encourages victims to report these heinous crimes to law-enforcement authorities, who must investigate allegations of GBV and act firmly within the ambit of the law to ensure that justice is served.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza vaxanisiwa ku mangala vugevenga lebya tihanyi eka vulawuri bya nsindziso wa nawu, lebyi byi faneleke ku lavisisa swihehlo swa GBV na ku teka goza hi ndlela yo tiya leri nga endzeni ka nawu ku tiyisisa leswaku vaendlaswivi va tengisiwa na ku xupuriwa.

src: The 16 Days of Activism for No Violence Against Women and Children campaign is approaching and Cabinet has approved this year’s theme: “Count me In: Together Moving a Non-Violent South Africa Forward”.
tgt: Pfhumba ra 16 wa Masiku ya ku Lwisana na Madzolonga Ehenhla ka Vavasati na Vana ri le ku tshineleni naswona Khabinete yi pasisile nkongomelo wa nan'waka: "Ndzi katse na mina: Hi ri Kun'we hi Fambisa Afrika-Dzonga leyi nga riki na Madzolonga kuya Emahlweni”.

src: Cabinet also calls on citizens to educate one another on the rights of women and children, and on the various recourse mechanisms that exist to help victims of violence.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi tlhela yi rhamba vaakatiko ku dyondzisana hi timfanelo ta vavasati na vana, na hi tindlela to pfuna to hambanahambana leti nga kona ku pfuna vaxanisiwa va swa madzolonga.

src: The 16 Days of Activism Campaign is a United Nations (UN) campaign, which takes place annually from 25 November (International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women) to 10 December (International Human Rights Day).
tgt: Pfhumba ra 16 wa Masiku ya ku Lwisana i pfhumba ra Nhlangano wa Matiko (UN), leri vaka kona lembe na lembe kusuka hi ti 25 Hukuri (Siku ra Matiko ya Misava ra ku Herisiwa ka Madzolonga ehenhla ka Vavasati) kufika hi ti 10 N'wendzamhala (Siku ra Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ra Matiko ya Misava).

src: South Africans are encouraged to actively join advocacy and awareness-raising programmes in their respective communities and sectors.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga ya khutaziwa ku tikatsa hi ndlela yo gingiriteka eka mapfhumba ya nseketelo na ku tlakusa vulemukisi eka miganga ya ka vona na tisekitara ta vona.

src: Tourism Transformation Summit.
tgt: Samiti ya Cinco wa Vupfhumba.

src: Cabinet calls on all stakeholders to support the tourism sector’s transformation initiatives as it potentially benefits the economy by empowering disadvantaged communities and driving employment growth.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba mukhumbheki hinkwavo ku seketela mapfhumba ya cinco wa sekitara ya vupfhumba tanihi leswi ya vuyerisaka hi ndlela leyi koteka eka ikhonomi hi ku nyika matimba eka vaakindhawu lava a va tsandzisiwa na ku hlohlotela ku kula ka mitirho.

src: The Department of Tourism hosted the National Tourism Transformation Summit on 30 and 31 October 2017 under the theme: “Tourism for All: Transform, Grow and Sustain”, which saw the release of the State of Sector Transformation Report and the launch of the Tourism Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (B-BBEE) Portal and Tourism Transformation Fund.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba yi rhurherile Samiti ya Cinco wa Vupfhumba ya Rixaka hi ti 30 na ti 31 Nhlangula 2017 ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Vupfhumba bya hinkwavo: Cinca, Kula na ku Yisa Emahlweni”, leyi endleke leswaku ku humesiwa Xiviko xa Xiyimo xa Cinco wa Sekitara na nsimeko wa Photali yo Nyika Matimba eka Ikhonomi ya Vantima ya Endleloangarhelo ya Vupfhumba (B-BBEE) na Nkwama wa Cinco wa Vupfhumba.

src: State Visit by President Macky Sall of Senegal.
tgt: Vuendzi bya Tiko hi Phuresidente Macky Sall wa le Senegal.

src: Cabinet welcomes the State Visit by the President of the Republic of Senegal, His Excellency Macky Sall on 20 October 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela Vuendzi bya Tiko hi Phuresidente wa Rhiphabuliki ra Senegal, Muchaviseki Macky Sall hi ti 20 Nhlangula 2017.
