src: South Africa and Senegal exchanged views on critical regional and global issues and signed agreements in several areas.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga na Senegal ya cincanile mavonelo ehenhla ka timhaka ta xifundza na timhaka ta misava ta nkoka swonghasi naswona ya sayinile mitwanano eka swiyenge swo talanyana.

src: The two countries enjoy cordial bilateral political, economic and social relations underpinned by strong historical ties dating back to the years of the liberation struggle.
tgt: Matiko lamambirhi ya tiphina hi vuxaka bya xipolitiki, bya xiikhonomi na bya vaaki lebyi seketeriwaka hi vuxaka bya swa matimu byo tiya lebyi tumbulukeke kusuka emalembeni ya nyimpi ya ntshunxeko.

src: The signing of a Memorandum of Understanding on the twinning of Robben Island (used by the racist apartheid regime to incarcerate freedom fighters) and Gorée Islands (the route through which African people were shipped out for a life of slavery) further cements our countries’ cultural and historic ties as the 1987 Dakar Talks is commemorated.
tgt: Ku sayiniwa ka Memorandamu ya Ntwanano eka ku hlanganisiwa ka Xihlala xa Robben (lexi tirhisiweke hi mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu xo ya hi nghohe ku pfalela valwelantshunxeko) na Swihlala swa Gorée (ndlela leyi vanhu va Afrika va tlutiweke hi yona ku ya eka vutomi bya vuhlonga) swi tiyisa ku ya emahlweni ka vuxaka bya swa mfuwo na bya swa matimu bya matiko ya hina tanihileswi Mivulavulo ya Dakar ya 1987 yi tsundzukisiwaka xiswona.

src: Visit to South Africa by Indonesian delegation.
tgt: Vuendzi kuya eAfrika-Dzonga hi vurhumiwa bya Indonesia.

src: Cabinet welcomes the visit to South Africa by Sultan Husain Abubakar Syah of Tidore in Indonesia.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela vuendzi kuta eAfrika-Dzonga hi Hosinkulu ya Mamuzilimi Husain Abubakar Syah ya Tidore eIndonesia.

src: The Tidore delegation included Muhammad Amin Farouk, a descendant of Tuan Guru, a freedom fighter who was captured by the Dutch and sent to Robben Island in 1780.
tgt: Vurhumiwa bya Tidore byi katse na Muhammad Amin Farouk, wa yindlu ya Tuan Guru, mulwelantshunxeko loyi a khomiweke hi Madachi kutani a rhumeriwa eka Xihlala xa Robben hi lembe ra 1780.

src: Tuan Guru (Imam Abdullah ibn Qadi Abdussalam) and three of his companions were imprisoned for about 12 years and thereafter kept in exile in the Cape, where he contributed greatly to the development of the local community and the building of the first mosque.
tgt: Tuan Guru (Imam Abdullah ibn Qadi Abdussalam) na vanharhu va vanghana va yena va khotsiwile ku ringana kwalomu ka 12 wa malembe kutani endzhaku ka swoleswo va pfaleriwa evuchavelohwahwa eKapa, laha a hoxeke xandla swinene eka nhluvukiso wa vaakindhawu va muganga na ku akiwa ka kereke ya ximuzilimi yo sungula.

src: A number of South Africans trace their family history to him.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga vo tala va landzelerisa matimu ya mindyangu ya vona eka yena.

src: The delegation visited the National Assembly and the National Council of Provinces where they were welcomed by the presiding officers, Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa and Economic Development Minister Ebrahim Patel.
tgt: Vurhumiwa byi endzerile Huvo ya Rixaka na Huvo ya Rixaka ya Swifundzakulu laha byi amukeriweke hi vaofisiri vo fambisa, Xandla xa Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa na Holobye wa Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi Ebrahim Patel.

src: The visit highlighted the common history of colonial rule and the centuries-old fight for national liberation by the people of Indonesia and South Africa.
tgt: Vuendzi lebyi byi kombisile matimu yo fana ya mfumo wa xikoloni na nyimpi ya malembexidzana hi vukhale ya ntshunxeko wa rixaka hi vanhu va Indonesia na Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Today we celebrate trade, tourism and other economic links between the two countries.
tgt: Namuntlha hi tlangela mabindzu, vupfhumba na mihlanganiso yin'wana ya swa ikhonomoi exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi.

src: End-of-year examinations.
tgt: Swikambelo swa ku hela ka lembe.

src: Cabinet is satisfied that the end-of-year examinations currently taking place at schools and other learning institutions are going ahead unhindered.
tgt: Khabinete ya eneriseka leswaku swikambelo swa ku hela ka lembe eka nkarhi wa sweswi swi le ku endlekeni eswikolweni naswona mihlangano ya dyondzo yi le ku yeni emahlweni ku ri hava ku kavanyetiwa.

src: Education is one of the key drivers towards a better future for all in the country.
tgt: Dyondzo i xin'wana xa swihlohloterikulu swa vumundzuku byo antswa bya hinkwavo etikweni.

src: Parents and guardians are urged to continue to give the necessary support to learners during this period.
tgt: Vatswari na vahlayisi va khutaziwa ku nyika nseketelo lowu faneleke eka vadyondzi hi nkarhi lowu.

src: The Department of Basic Education’s catch-up programmes and other initiatives have assisted learners affected by protests during the year and a positive outcome is expected.
tgt: Mapfhumba yo hlongorisa ya Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya le Hansi na mapfhumba man’wana ya pfunile vadyondzi lava khumbekeke hi mikombiso ya ku vilela elembeni naswona mbuyelo lowunene wu languteriwile.

src: Cabinet commends the law-enforcement agencies and the collaboration from the communities who helped secure the conviction of Willem Oosthuizen and Theo Jackson.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu na ntirhisano kusuka eka vaakindhawu lava va pfuneke eka ku voniwa nandzu ka Willem Oosthuizen na Theo Jackson.

src: The two forced Victor Mlotshwa into a coffin and threatened to pour petrol on him.
tgt: Lavambirhi va sindzisile Victor Mlotshwa ku nghena ebokisini na ku n'wi chavisa hi ku vula leswaku va ta n'wi chela hi petirolo.

src: The judgement demonstrates that South African laws are firm in protecting the rights of all citizens.
tgt: Vuavanyisi lebyi byi kombisa leswaku milawu ya Afrika-Dzonga yi tiyile eka ku sirhelela timfanelo ta vaakatiko hinkwavo.

src: Cabinet further affirms the right of all South Africans to engage in peaceful protest as part of our constitutional democracy.
tgt: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi tiyisisa mfanelo ya Maafrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku endla nkombiso wa ku vilela wo rhula tanihi xiphemu xa xidemokirasi xa hina xa vumbiwa.

src: However, rights prescribed in the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 are not absolute and must not infringe on the democratic rights of others.
tgt: Hambiswiritano, timfanelo leti tsariweke eka Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996 a hi le ti hetisekeke naswona a ti fanelangi ku onha timfanelo ta xidemokirasi ta van'wana.

src: Cabinet condemns the blocking of public roads, displaying of symbols of past oppression and destruction of national symbols which are a reflection of our hard-earned democracy.
tgt: Khabinete yi sola ku pfariwa ka magondzo ya vaaki, hi ku kombisa mifungho ya ntshikelelo wa nkarhi lowu nga hundza na ku onhiwa ka mifungho ya rixaka leyi nga xikombiso xa xidemokirasi xa hina lexi kumekeke ku tika.

src: Cabinet is committed to its role to build a cohesive society for all and calls on all citizens to play their part responsibly and in the spirit of working together to build a united, non-racist, non-sexist, democratic and prosperous South Africa.
tgt: Khabinete ya tiboha eka xiave xa yona xa ku aka rixaka leri khomaneke ra hinkwavo naswona yi rhamba vaakatiko hinkwavo ku tirha xiphemu xa vona hi ndlela ya vutihlamuleri na hi moya wa ku tirhisana ku aka Afrika-Dzonga leri nga na vun'we, leri nga yiki hi nghohe, leri nga yiki hi rimbewu, ra xidemokirasi na ku va leri humelelaka.

src: Cabinet Decisions.
tgt: Swiboho swa Khabinete.

src: Cabinet approved the 2015/16 Report on State of Local Government in South Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Xiviko eka Xiyimo xa Mfumo wa Miganga xa 2015/16 eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: The report outlines progress made in implementing the Back to Basics (B2B) Programme, a plan of action to ensure delivery of basic services, good governance and sound financial management.
tgt: Xiviko xi katsakanya ndzima leyi khatsiweke eka ku simekiwa ka Pfhumba ra ku Vuyela eka Maendlelo ya Masungulo (B2B), kungu ra matirhelo ku tiyisisa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri bya masungulo, mafumelo lamanene na malawulelo ya swa timali lamanene.

src: The report highlights areas of challenges and provides a base for the implementation of the second phase of the B2B Programme.
tgt: Xiviko xi kombisa swiyenge swa mitlhontlho na ku nyika masungulo ya nsimeko wa xiyenge xa vumbirhi xa Pfhumba ra B2B.

src: The report will be tabled to Parliament.
tgt: Xiviko lexi xi ta andlariwa ePalamende.

src: Cabinet supported the proposed amendments of the three B-BBEE Sector Codes.
tgt: Khabinete yi seketerile mihundzuluxo leyi ringanyetiweke ya Tikhodi ta Sekitara ta B-BBEE tinharhu.

src: The amendments address sector challenges and peculiarities on transformation that would otherwise not be addressed fully by the generic codes.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo lexi yi tirhana na mitlhontlho na mihambuko ya sekitara eka cinco lowu nkarhi wun'wana a wu nga ta lulamisiwa hi ku hetiseka hi tikhodi to angarhela.

src: The three sectors are in Agriculture, Finance and Construction.
tgt: Tisekitara letinharhu ti le ka Vurimi, Timali na Vuaki.

src: The proposed amendments have been canvassed with the relevant stakeholders.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi ringanyetiwaka yi bumabumeriwile hi vakhumbheki lava faneleke.

src: All the amended sector codes will be gazetted.
tgt: Tikhodi ta sekitara leti hundzuluxiweke hinkwato ti ta gazetiwa.

src: Cabinet approved the National e-Strategy and its publication in the Government Gazette.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra Xielekitironiki ra Rixaka na nkandziyiso wa rona eka Gazete ya Mfumo.

src: It was published in April 2017 for public comments.
tgt: Ri kandziyisiwile hi Dzivamisoko 2017 ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: The e-strategy articulates a shared vision and paradigm shift from information society to a knowledge economy and WEBTOKEN addresses challenges, including a digital divide between the rich and poor, between racial groups, different geographical locations and gender WEBTOKEN provides a platform for South Africans to integrate technology, which is relevant and related towards advancing development and economic prosperity for the benefit of society as a whole.
tgt: Qhinga lera xielekitironiki ri hlamusela xivono lexi avelaniwaka na cinco wa endlelo kusuka eka rixaka ra vuxokoxoko kuya eka ikhonomi na rixaka ra vutivi.

src: It will bring digital transformation to the public services and enable the provision of improved quality of services whilst tapping into digital technologies.
tgt: Ri nyika pulatifomo eka MaAfrika-Dzonga ku hlanganisa thekinoloji, leyi faneleke na ku fambelana na ku antswisa nhluvukiso na ku humelela ka ikhonomi ku vuyerisa rixaka hinkwaro ka rona.

src: The strategy targets, amongst others, fragmentation of e-government initiatives and duplication of processes, databases, large-scale system incompatibilities and inefficiencies.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Vuhlanganisi bya Tiqingho na Vukorhokeri bya Poso yi ta nyika mahungu hi xitalo eka qhinga leri.

src: It will also increase the usage of information and communications technology (ICTs), foster innovation in technologies and applications for e-Government.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga na Kungu ra Mfumo wa Xielekitironiki ra Rixaka, leri ga ta kandziyisiwa eka Gazete ya Mfumo.

src: Cabinet approved the ICT Small, Medium and Micro-sized Enterprises (SMME) Development Strategy.
tgt: Ri ta tisa cinco wa xidijiti eka vukorhokeri bya vaaki na ku kotisa ku nyikiwa ka nkoka lowu antswisiweke wa vukorhokeri loko ku ri karhi ku tirhisiwa tithekinoloji ta xidijiti.

src: This is a sector-specific intervention to address challenges facing SMMEs operating in the ICT sector.
tgt: Qhinga ri kongomisa, exikarhi ka swin'wana, ku avanyisiwa ka mapfhumba ya mfumo ya xielekitironiki na tiphurosese leti endliwa hi kambirhi, nhlayisa-switiviwa, leswi nga katsanisekiki na leswi tirhaka hindlela leyi tlangisaka swipfuno swa tisisiteme ta xikalo lexikulu.

src: The strategy proposes interventions to accelerate the development and growth of small enterprises in the ICT sector, while facilitating an increase in the levels of uptake and usage of ICTs by the general small business sector.
tgt: Nakambe swi ta engetela matirhiselo ya thekinoloji ya vuhlanganisi na mahungu (tiICT), ku kondletela maendlelo lamantshwa eka tithekinoloji na switirhisiwa swa Mfumo wa Xielekitironiki.

src: The strategy aims to support start-up ICT enterprises, strengthen existing enterprises and extend support to potentially viable SMMEs.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo, ya le Xikarhi na Lamatsongo swinene (SMME) ra ICLowu i mphalalo lowu kongomaneke na sekitara ku lulamisa mitlhontlho leyi nga langutana na tiSMME leti tirhaka eka sekitara ya ICT.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the Report on the Evaluation of the National School Nutrition Programme.
tgt: Qhinga leri ri ringanyeta miphalalo yo hatlisisa nhluvukiso na ku kula ka mabindzu lamatsongo eka sekitara ya ICT, loko ku ri karhi ku humelerisiwa ntlakuko eka tilevhele ta matekelo na matirhiselo ya tiICT hi sekitara ya mabindzu lamatsongo hi ku angarhela.

src: This a government programme with an annual budget of R.5 billion resulting in nine million children from poor communities receiving a daily nutritious meal at school.
tgt: Qhinga leri ri na xikongomelo xa ku seketela mabindzu ya ICT lama ha sungulaka, ku tiyisa mabindzu lama nga kona na ku ndlandlamukisa nseketelo kuya eka tiSMME leti nga na vuswikoti bya ku tirha kahle.

src: The report provides areas of effective implementation and some areas that need improvement.
tgt: Xiviko lexi xi nyika tindhawu leti nga na nsimeko lowu tirhaka hindlela leyi vuyerisaka na tindhawu tin'wana leti ti lavaka vuantswisi.

src: The report will be made available on the website of the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Xiviko lexi xi ta endliwa xi kumeka eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Nkunguhato, Nandzeleriso na Nkambelo (WEBTOKEN).

src: Cabinet supports South Africa’s standing for re-election to the two-year membership of the International Maritime Organisation (IMO) Council.
tgt: Khabinete yi seketela ku yimela ku hlawuriwa hi vuntshwa ka Afrika-Dzonga eka vuxirho bya malembe mambirhi bya Khansele ya Nhlangano wa swa Malwandle wa Matiko ya Misava (IMO).

src: These elections will be held during the 30th Regular Session of the Assembly from 27 November to 6 December 2017 in London, United Kingdom.
tgt: Mihlawulo leyi yi ta khomiwa hi nkarhi wa Nhlengeletano yo Nyika Vuxokoxoko ya Nkarhi na Nkarhi ya Huvo ya vu 30 kusuka hi ti 27 Hukuri kufika ti 6 N'wendzamhala eLondon, eUnited Kingdom.

src: South Africa is a maritime nation with close to 80% of international trade done by sea.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga i tiko leri nga na malwandle leri nga na ekusuhi na 80% wa bindzu ra matiko ya misava leri endliwaka elwandle.

src: South Africa’s membership in the IMO Council contributes to employment growth derived from the Operation Phakisa: Oceans Economy.
tgt: Vuxirho bya Afrika-Dzonga eka Khansele ya IMO byi hoxa xandla eka ku kula ka mitirho loku endliwa ka suka eka Operation Phakisa: Ikhonomi ya swa Malwandle.

src: Cabinet approved the introduction to Parliament the ratification of the Amendment to the Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer to include hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs).
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku andlariwa ePalamende ka ku sayiniwa na ku pfumeleriwa ka Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Phurotokholo ya Montreal eka Mimusi leyi Onhaka Leyara ya Ozoni ku katsa na tihayidirofulorokhaboni (tiHFC).

src: The amendment seeks to phase down HFCs (the Kigali Agreement), which are some of the greenhouse gasses contributing to the depletion of the ozone layer.
tgt: Ndzhundzuluxo lowu wu lava ku herisa tiHFC (Ntwanano wa Khigali), leti ti nga tin'wana ta tigasi ta girinihawuzi leti ti hoxaka xandla eka ku onhiwa ka leyara ya ozoni.

src: South Africa is already a signatory to the Montreal Protocol.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga se i musayini eka Phurotokholo ya Montreal.

src: Cabinet also approved the introduction into Parliament the ratification of the Minamata Convention on Mercury.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi pasisile ku andlariwa ePalamende ka ku pfumeleriwa ka Ntwanano wa Minamata eka Mekhuri.

src: It provides opportunities for the protection of vulnerable groups, especially those staying in areas where there is mining activity, against the adverse consequences of mercury on the environment and human health.
tgt: Wu nyika swivandlanene eka nsirhelelo wa mitlawa leyi nga sirhelelekangiki, ngopfungopfu liyani yi tshamaka etindhawini laha ku nga na nghingiriko wa vucelamigodi, ehenhla ka switandzhaku swa khombo swa mekhuri eka mbangu na rihanyu ra vanhu.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the Report of the Commission of Inquiry into Higher Education and Training in the Republic of South Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi Xiviko xa Khomixini ya Ndzavisiso eka Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri eRhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The Presidential Fiscal Committee will sit soon to interrogate financial implications.
tgt: Komiti ya Nkwama wa Hofisi ya Phuresidente yi ta tshama ku nga ri khale ku konanisa leswi swi vulaka swona eka swa timali.

src: The Department of Higher Education and Training will have to review relevant policies and legislation, where necessary.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri yi ta fanela ku kambisisa tipholisi ta milawu leyi fambelanaka, laha swi faneleke.

src: President Zuma will release the report to the public soon and the President’s spokesperson, Dr Bongani Ngqulunga, will make an announcement regarding this matter.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u ta humesa xiviko eka vaaki ku nga ri khale naswona muvulavuleri wa Phuresidente, Dok.

src: Bills.
tgt: Milawumbisi.

src: Cabinet approved the National Minimum Wage Bill effecting the minimum wage to the lowest paid workers in the South African Labour Market.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Muholo wa Mpimohansi wa Rixakalowu khumbaka muholo wa mpimohansi eka vatirhi lava holeriwaka muholo wa le hansihansi eka Vanhu lava ringaneleke ku Tirha eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: The Bill calls for every worker to be paid a wage that is no less than the national minimum wage.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu koxa ku va mutirhi un'wana na un'wana a holeriwa muholo lowu nga riki ehansi ka muholo wa mpimohansi wa rixaka.

src: Once this Bill takes effect employers will be expected to pay their workers no less than the national minimum, which is to be adjusted annually.
tgt: Xikan'wekan'we loko Nawumbisi lowu wu sungula ku tirha vathori va ta languteriwa ku holela vatirhi va vona muholo lowu nga riki ehansi ka mpimohansi wa rixaka, lowu faneleke ku cinciwanyana lembe na lembe.

src: Cabinet also approved the submission to Parliament of the Basic Conditions of Employment Amendment Bill of 2017.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xo ya ePalamende xaNawumbisi-Ndzhundzhuluxo waSwipimelo swa Masungulo swa le Ntirhweni wa 2017.

src: This amends the Basic Conditions of Employment Act, 1997 (Act 75 of 1997) to ensure it provides for the Minimum Wage Bill.
tgt: Lowu wu hundzuluxa Basic Conditions of Employment Act, 1997 (Act 75 of 1997) (Nawu wa Swipimelo swa Masungulo swa le Ntirhweni, 1997 (Nawu wa 75 wa 1997) ku tiyisisa leswaku wu lulamisela Nawumbisi wa Muholo wa Mpimohansi.

src: Cabinet approved the submission to Parliament of the Labour Relations Amendment Bill of 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xo ya ePalamende xa Nawumbisi-Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Vuxaka bya Vatirhi wa 2017.

src: The Bill is a culmination of consultation with all the relevant stakeholders.
tgt: Nawumbisi i mahetelelo ya nkanelo wa vakhumbheki lava faneleke hinkwavo.

src: It addresses, amongst others, picketing procedures, the protracted strikes and arbitration advisory structures.
tgt: Exikarhi ka swin'wana, wu klulamisa maendlelo yo kombisa ku vilela, switereko leswi kokaka nkarhi wo leha kufika emakumu na mitlawa yo tsundzuxa ya vulamuri.

src: Cabinet approved the submission to Parliament of the Local Government: Municipal Structures Amendment Bill of 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xo ya ePalamende xa Mfumo waMiganga: Nawumbisi-Ndzhundzhuluxowa Swivumbeko swa Timasipala wa 2017.

src: This amends the Local Government: Municipal Structures Act, 1998 (Act 117 of 1998).The Bill seeks to strengthen intergovernmental and democratic governance arrangements.
tgt: Lowu wu hundzuluxa Local Government: Municipal Structures Act, 1998 (Act 117 of 1998) (Mfumo wa Miganga: Nawu wa Swivumbeko swa Timasipala, 1998 (Nawu wa 117 wa 1998).Nawumbisi wu lava ku tiyisa milulamiselo ya mafumelo ya le xikarhi ka mifumo na ya xidemokirasi.

src: It also seeks to address issues around the administration and management of municipal elections, and to promote the effective and efficient implementation of the Act, as well as to strengthen oversight and governance in municipalities.
tgt: Nakambe wu lava ku lulamisa timhaka leti fambelanaka na mafambiselo na malawulelo ya mihlawulo ya timasipala, na ku kondletela ku pfuna na vuswikoti bya nsimeko wa Nawu, xikan'we na ku tiyisisa vuangameri na mafumelo eka timasipala.

src: Cabinet approved for the submission to Parliament of the Electronic Deeds Registration Systems Bill of 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xo ya ePalamende xa Nawumbisi waTisisiteme ta Ntsariso wa Mapapila ya Vun'wini bya Miako ya Xielekitironiki wa 2017.

src: The Bill has already gone through public WEBTOKEN allows for the development of an electronic deeds registration system (e-DRS), for the processing of deeds, to effect the registration of large volumes of deeds as necessitated by Governments’ land reform initiatives.
tgt: Wu pfumelela nhluvukiso wa sisiteme ya ntsariso wa mapapila ya vun'wini bya miako ya xielekitironiki (e-DRS), eka ku phurosesiwa ka mapapila ya vun'wini bya miako, ku humelerisa ntsariso wa tivholomu letikulu ta mapapila ya vun'wini bya miako tanihilaha swi laviwaka hakona hi mapfhumba ya mpfuxeto wa misava ya Mfumo.

src: As part of promoting the use of ICTs to build an inclusive economy, Cabinet approved the iKamva National e-Skills Institute Bill of 2017 (iNeSI Bill) to be gazetted for public consultation and comment.
tgt: Tanihi xiphemu xa ku kondletela ntirhiso wa tiICT ku aka ikhonomi leyi katsaka hinkwavo, Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Vandla ra Swikili swa Xielekitironiki ra Rixaka ra iKamva wa 2017 (Nawumbisi wa iNeSI) ku va wu gazetiwa ku va na nkanelo na mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: The iNeSI Bill provides for the establishment of iNeSI as a public entity with its own enabling legislation, to address the e-skills shortage that hinders investment, socio-economic development and capacity development in the country.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa iNeSI wu lulamisela ku tumbuluxiwa ka iNeSI tanihi vandla ra mfumo leri nga na milawu leyi kotisaka ya rona n'wini, ku lulamisa nkayivelo wa swikili swa xielekitironiki leswi swi kavanyetaka vuvekisi, nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vanhu na nhluvukiso wa vuswikoti etikweni.

src: This will establish ICT production hubs in each province, which will then assist iNeSI to develop and design relevant programs and training material, promote and undertake innovative research, and provide research capacity to postgraduate students.
tgt: Leswi swi ta tumbuluxa tihabu ta ntshovelo wa ICT eka xifundzakulu xin'wana na xin'wana, leswi endzhaku ka swona swi nga ta pfuna iNeSI ku hluvukisa na ku dizayina tiphurogireme leti faneleke na matheriyali wo letela, ku kondletela na ku endla ndzavisiso wa vutumbuluxi, na ku nyika vuswikoti bya ndzavisiso eka swichudeni swa le ndzhaku ka mithwaso ya digiri.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the Postal Services Amendment Bill in the Government Gazette for public comment.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile vuhangalasi bya Nawumbisi-Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Vukorhokeri bya Poso eka Gazete ya Mfumo ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: This amends the Postal Services Amendment Act No.
tgt: Lowu wu hundzuluxa Postal Services Amendment Act No.

src: 124 of 1998.The Bill provides for the restructuring of the postal sector in general to contribute to the provisions of universal access to innovative e-services while continuing to provide quality and secure traditional postal services.
tgt: 124 of 1998 (Nawu wa-Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Vukorhokeri bya Poso wa No.

src: This contributes to equality and human dignity through access to information and affordable postal services, which facilitate social development and improve the quality of life for individuals and communities.
tgt: 124 wa 1998).Nawumbisi wu lulamisela ku vumbiwa hi vuntshwa ka sekitara ya poso hi ku angarhela ku hoxa xandla eka milulamiselo ya mfikelelo wa vanhu hinkwavo eka vukorhokeri bya xielekitironiki bya vutumbuluxi loko ku ri karhi ku yiwa emahlweni na ku nyika vukorhokeri bya poso bya ntolovelo bya nkoka na ku va byo hlayiseka.

src: Upcoming eventsCabinet also acknowledged some of the upcoming events in the government calendar.
tgt: Mitlangu leyi TakaNakambe Khabinete yi amukela yin'wana ya mitlangu leyi taka eka khalendara ya mfumo.

src: Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring Programme.
tgt: Pfhumba ra Nandzeleriso ra Siyahlola ra Hofisi ya Phuresidente.

src: President Zuma is scheduled to visit the Steve Biko Academic Hospital in Tshwane on Friday, 3 November 2017 to monitor the delivery of healthcare services as part of the Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring Programme.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u kunguhateriwileku endzela Xibedhlele xa Tidyondzo xa Steve Biko eTshwane hi Ravuntlhanu, 3 Hukuri 2017 ku endla nandzeleriso wa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri bya nhlayiso wa swa rihanyu tanihi xiphemu xa Pfhumba ra Nandzeleriso wa Siyahlola ra Hofisi ya Phuresidente.

src: The hospital is one of the best performing public hospitals in the country and is named after Steve Bantu Biko, the late liberation struggle hero and former medical student at the then University of Natal (now called University of KwaZulu-Natal).President Zuma’s visit is part of the ongoing government monitoring programme that aims to address challenges facing public hospitals and to improve the healthcare system in the country, which is one of government’s key priorities.
tgt: Xibedhlele lexi i xin'wana xa swibedhlele leswi tirhaka kahle etikweni naswona xi thyiwile endzhaku ka Steve Bantu Biko, sirha nhenha ya nyimpi ya ntshunxeko na khale ka xichudeni xa vudokodela eka khale ka Yunivhesiti ya Natal (sweswi yi vitaniwaka Yunivhesiti ya KwaZulu-Natal).Vuendzi bya Phuresidente Zuma i xiphemu xa pfhumba ra nandzeleriso ra mfumo leri yaka emahlweni leri nga na xikongomelo xa ku lulamisa mitlhontlho leyi nga langutana na swibedhlele swa mfumo na ku antswisa sisiteme ya nhlayiso wa swa rihanyu etikweni, lexi xi nga xin'wana xa swirhanganakulu swa mfumo.

src: National Disability Rights Awareness Month.
tgt: N'hweti ya Vulemukisi bya Timfanelo ta Vutsoniwa bya Rixaka.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to support National Disability Rights Awareness Month between 3 November and 3 December 2017, which also coincides with the International Day of Persons with Disabilities.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku seketela N’hweti ya Vulemukisi ya Timfanelo ta Vutsoniwa bya Rixaka exikarhi ka ti3 Hukuri na ti3 N'wendzamhala 2017, leyi tlhelaka yi kotlana na Siku ra Vanhu lava hanyaka na Vutsoniwa ra Matiko ya Misava.

src: South Africans are encouraged to raise awareness and protect the rights of people with disabilities, while recognising the gains that have been made to address challenges faced by people with disabilities.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga ya khutaziwa ku tlakusa vulemukisi na ku sirhelela timfanelo ta vanhu lava hanyaka na vutsoniwa, loko ku ri karhi ku tekeriwa enhlokweni mivuyelo leyi yi kumekeke ku lulamisa mitlhontlho leyi langutaneke na vanhu lava hanyaka na vutsoniwa.

src: National Local Economic Development Conference.
tgt: Khomferense ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi ya Miganga ya Rixaka.

src: The Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs and Department of Small Business Development will convene the first National Local Economic Development Conference on 9 and 10 November 2017 in Gauteng.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Mfumontirhisano na Timhaka ta Xintu na Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo ti ta rhamba Khomferense ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi ya Miganga ya Rixaka yo sungula hi ti 9 na 10 Hukuri 2017 eGauteng.

src: The conference is a strategic platform for dialogue between public and private sector on topical and critical issues relating to stimulating local economies by creating an enabling environment to achieve inclusive economic development.
tgt: Khomferense i pulatifomo ya xiqhinga ya n'wangulano exikarhi ka sekitara ya mfumo na leyi nga riki ya mfumo eka timhaka leti nga emahungwini na ta nkoka swonghasi hi mayelana na ku hlohlotela tiikhonomi ta le migangeni hi ku tumbuluxa mbangu lowu kotisaka ku fikelela nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi lowu katsaka vanhu hinkwavo.

src: Messages.
tgt: Mahungu.

src: Cabinet welcomes the announcement of over one billion US dollar to be invested over several months in the South African Economy in technology, education and agribusiness.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela xitiviso xa ku tlula biliyoni yin'we ya tidolara ta US leti nga vekisiwa eka tin'hweti to talanyana eka Ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga eka thekinoloji, dyondzo na bindzuvurimi.

src: This was announced by Ambassador Harold Doley, Jr, the Governor of the African Development Bank.
tgt: Leswi swi tivisiwile hi Muyimelatiko Harold Doley, Jr, Gavhenara wa Bangi ya Nhluvukiso ya Afrika.

src: Cabinet congratulates Dr Nono Simelela on her appointment as World Health Organisation (WHO) Assistant Director-General.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Dok.

src: Dr Simelela will head the WHO Family, Women, Children and Adolescents Division from 13 November 2017.
tgt: Simelela u ta rhangela Xiyenge xa Ndyangu, Vavasati, Vana na Vakondlo-a-ndzi-dyi xa WHO kusuka hi ti 13 Hukuri 2017.

src: She is the first African woman to become a gynaecologist in South Africa.
tgt: I wansati wa MuAfrika wo sungula ku na gayinokholojisiti eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Cabinet welcomes the announcement by World Rugby that has recommended South Africa as the preferred country to host the 2023 Rugby World Cup tournament.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela xitiviso hi Rhagibi ya Misava lexi xi bumabumeleke Afrika-Dzonga tanihi tiko leri tsakeriwaka ku rhurhela mphikizano wa Khapu ya Misava ya Rhagibi ya 2023.

src: Cabinet also commends the work of the Minister of Sport and Recreation, Mr Thulas Nxesi, Deputy President Ramaphosa and the South African Rugby Union bid team.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi hoyozela ntirho wa Holobye wa Mitlangu na Vuhungasi, Tat.

src: World Rugby will announce the final decision on 15 November 2017.
tgt: Rhagibi ya Misava yi ta tivisa xiboho xo hetelela hi ti 15 Hukuri 2017.

src: Cabinet congratulates all participants and winners of the 15th Annual Public Sector Innovation Awards.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela vangheneri hinkwavo na vahluri va Masagwadi ya Maendlelo Lamantshwa ya Sekitara ya Mfumo ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu Masagwadi lama ya tekela enhlokweni mapfhumba ya mphakelo wa vukorhokeri lama humeleleke na lama vuyeriseke lama ya fikeleriweke hi ku tirhisiwa ka maendlelo lamantshwa na switirho leswintshwa.

src: These awards recognise successful and effective service-delivery initiatives that have been achieved through the application of innovative approaches, methodologies and tools.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Xipanu xa Bolo ya Milenge xa SuperSport United eka ku va xi fikelerile makumu ya Khapu ya Khonfederexini ya CAF endzhaku ka ku hlula xipanu xa le Tunisia xa Club Africa hi swikoro swa 3-1 na 4-2 hi nkatsakanyo.

src: Cabinet congratulates SuperSport United FC for reaching the finals of the CAF Confederation Cup after beating Tunisian side Club Africa 3-1 and 4-2 on aggregate.
tgt: Xipanu lexi hi ntolovelo xi tivekaka tanihi Matsatsantsa xi ta ombana na TP Mazembe eka makumu ya mphikizano wa swipanu swa tikokulu wa xiyenge xa vumbirhi n'hweti leyi taka.

src: The team generally known as Matsatsantsa will meet TP Mazembe in the second-tier continental club competition final next month.
tgt: Khabinete yi humesile nchavelelo wa yona eka ndyangu na vanghana va Ian McLeod, loyi ku hundza ka yena emisaveni swi veke ndzahlekelo eka bolo ya milenge ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: He became the first South African to referee at a FIFA World Cup tournament, when he officiated in the 1998 global showpiece in France.
tgt: U vile MuAfrika-Dzonga wo sungula ku va n'watipempe eka mphikizano wa Khapu ya Misava ya FIFA, loko a fambisile mphikizano wa misava wa 1998 eFurwa.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Ku thoriwa hinkwako ku ya hi ku tiyisisiwa ka mithwaso na ku basisiwa loku faneleke.

src: Directors to the Board of the Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited:a. Ms Lerato Herriette Mothae andb.
tgt: Valawuri va Huvo ya Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited:a.

src: Reappointment of two part-time members of the Competition Tribunal:a. ProfImraan Valodia andb.
tgt: Swirho swa nkarhi hinkwawo swa Huvo ya Vatirhisi ya Rixaka:a.

src: Ms Nasima Badshad.
tgt: Hazel Viloshni Devraj nab.

src: ProfRelebohile Moletsanee.
tgt: Gqwetha John Rinton Simpson.

src: ProfHaroon Bhoratf.
tgt: Ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa ka swirho swa nkarhinyana swimbirhi eka Huvo ya Mphikizano:a. Phur.

src: ProfShireen Hassimg.
tgt: Imraan Valodia nab.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 15 November 2017 at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 15 Hukuri 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Issues in the environment.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakakulu.

src: Investment.
tgt: Vuvekisi.

src: Cabinet welcomes Ford Motor Company’s R3-billion investment into the Silverton Plant, Pretoria, Gauteng.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela vuvekisi bya R3 wa tibiliyoni ku suka eka Khamphani ya Mimovha ya Ford ku ya eka Feme ya le Silverton, ePitori, Gauteng.

src: This investment will result in the creation of direct and indirect jobs due to the expected increased production of its Ford Ranger model.
tgt: Vuvekisi lebyi byi ta vuyerisa hi ku tumbuluxa mitirho yo kongoma na yo ka yi nga kongomi hikokwalaho ka ku languteriwa ka ntlakuko wa andziso wa modele ya wona ya Ford Ranger.

src: Such investments affirm the work that we continue to do as government in growing the economy and addressing the challenges of unemployment.
tgt: Vuvekisi byolebyo byi tiyisisa ntirho lowu hi ya ka emahlweni hi wu endla tanihi mfumo eku kuriseni ka ikhonomi na le ku lulamiseni ka mitlhontlho ya vupfumalantirho.

src: Through government’s R.8 billion incentive scheme in Automotive Production and Development Programme, R.5 billion private investments have been unlocked.
tgt: Hi ku tirhisa xikimi xa xinavetisi xa mfumo xa R.8 wa tibiliyoni eka Phurogireme ya Nhluvukiso na Andziso wa vumaki bya Mimovha, R.5 wa tibiliyoni ta vuvekisi byo ka byi nga ri bya mfumo byi humesiwile.

src: These include the announcement by Toyota to manufacture their new Toyota Hilux and Fortuner models as part of R.1billion investment.
tgt: Lebyi byi katsa xitiviso hi Toyota ku endla timodele ta vona tintshwa ta Toyota Hilux na Fortuner tanihi xiphemu xa vuvekisi bya R.1 wa tibiliyoni.

src: Also, BMW plans to construct a R6 billion state-of-the-art body shop.
tgt: Nakambe, BMW yi kunguhata ku aka garaji yo lungisela mimovha ya ximanguva lawa ya R6 wa tibiliyoni.

src: The Beijing Automobile International Corporation plans to invest R11 billion in an automotive manufacturing plant in South Africa.
tgt: Khamphani ya Matiko hinkwawo ya Mimovha ya le Beijing yi kunguhata ku vekisa R11 wa tibiliyoni eka feme ya vumaki bya mimovha eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: 2017 Tax Season.
tgt: Nguva ya Xibalo ya 2017.

src: Cabinet extends its gratitude to all taxpayers who have already submitted their tax returns for the 2016/17 tax year.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzisela ku khensa eka vahakeri va xibalo hinkwavo lava se va tlheriseke tifomo to hlela xikweleti xa vona xa xibalo ta lembe ra xibalo ra 2016/17.

src: The revenue generated from income tax ensures government has the capacity to provide much-needed services and social support to millions of less fortunate South Africans.
tgt: Mali leyi nga hlengeletiwa ku suka eka xibalo yi tiyisisa leswaku mfumo wu na vuswikoti byo nyika vukorhokeri lebyi laveka swinene na nseketelo wa vanhu eka timiliyoni ta MaAfrika-Dzonga lama pfumalaka.

src: Cabinet reminds taxpayers that the deadline for submission is Friday 24 November 2017 and encourages them to submit their tax returns.
tgt: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa vahakeri va xibalo leswaku siku ro pfala ku rhumela i Ravuntlhanu 24 Hukuri 2017 na ku va khutaza ku rhumela tifomo to hlela xikweleti xa vona xa xibalo.

src: Inaugural National Local Economic Development (LED) Conference.
tgt: Nhlengeletano yo Sungula ya laha Kaya ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi (LED) ya Rixaka.

src: Cabinet is pleased with the outcomes of the recently held National LED Conference.
tgt: Khabinete ya tsaka hi mivuyelo ya Nhlengeletano ya LED ya Rixaka leyi ya ha ku va ka kona.

src: It was held under the leadership of the Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Mr Des van Rooyen and the Minister of Small Business Development, Ms Lindiwe Zulu.
tgt: A yi khomiwile ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Holobye wa Mfumontirhisano na Timhaka ta Xintu, Tat.

src: It presented an opportunity to craft a new South African Local Economic Development agenda guided by the National Development Plan (NDP) priorities.
tgt: Yi nyikile xivandlanene xo tumbuluxa ajenda yintshwa ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga hi ku leteriwa hi swirhangana swa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka (NDP).

src: Its outcomes included the launch of the first Economic Development Council of South Africa (EDCSA), which aims to professionalise the economic development sector.
tgt: Mivuyelo ya yona yi katsa ku simekiwa ka Huvo ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga (EDCSA) yo sungula, loku kongomisaka eka ku endla sekithara ya nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi yi va ya xiphurofexinali.

src: As a professional body, the EDCSA will manage and monitor the professional conduct of the many practitioners who participate in the different development initiatives.
tgt: Tanihi nhlangano wa xiphurofexini, EDCSA yi ta fambisa na ku landzelerisa matikhomelo ya xiphurofexini ya vatirhi vo tala lava nghenelelaka eka mapfhumba ya nhluvukiso wo hambana.

src: Cabinet noted also the historic launch of the Global Entrepreneurship Week (GEW) at 22 on Sloane, a new start-up campus, on the 10th of November 2017, in which the Minister of Small Business Development, Ms Lindiwe Zulu, hosted World entrepreneurship luminary, Sir Richard Branson.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi xiyaxiya ku simekiwa ka matimu ka Vhiki ra Vubindzunyingi bya Matiko hinkwawo (GEW) e22 on Sloane, khamphasi leyi ya ha ku sunguriwaka, hi ti 10 Hukuri 2017, laha Holobye Zulu a rhurheleke munhu wo tiveka ngopfu wa vubindzunyingi bya matiko, Sir Richard Branson.

src: The campus is the first one opened by the Global Entrepreneurship Network – offering direct and virtual support services to entrepreneurs throughout Africa as well as access to an international network of mentors, investors and entrepreneurial support organisations.
tgt: Khamphasi i yo sungula ku pfuriwa hi Netiweke ya Vubindzunyingi bya Matiko hinkwawo.

src: During Global Entrepreneurship Week, roughly 10 million participants take part in 35,000 events, activities and competitions in more than 165 countries around the world.
tgt: Hi nkarhi wa GEW, kwalomu ka 10 wa timiliyoni ta vangheneleri va teke xiave eka mikhuvo, migingiriko na miphikizano ya 35 000 eka matiko yo tlula 165 emisaveni hinkwayo.

src: Heher Commission Report.1 Cabinet noted the release on Monday, 13 November 2017 of the Report of the Commission of Inquiry into the Feasibility of making High Education and Training Fee-free in South Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi xiyaxile ku humesiwa hi Musumbhunuku, 13 Hukuri 2017 ka Xiviko xa Khomixini ya Vulavisisi eka ku Koteka ka ku endla Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri yi va Mahala eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to study the report and its implications for the country while the recommendations are being considered by government.2 The President will make a pronouncement on the report in due course after processing by the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Higher Education Funding and the Presidential Fiscal Committee.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku hlaya xiviko na switandzhaku swa xona eka tiko loko mfumo wa ha anakanyisisa swibumabumelo.

src: Government remains determined to resolve the barriers to access higher education, and looks forward to concluding a sustainable solution for higher education funding.
tgt: Phuresidente u ta endla xitiviso xa xiviko hi ku famba ka nkarhi endzhaku ka ku langutisisiwa hi Komiti ya Vaholobye eka ku Hakelela Dyondzo ya le Henhla na hi Komiti ya swa xibalo ya Phuresidente.

src: Drought.
tgt: Dyandza.

src: The current dam levels in the country remain a concern as there is more evaporation than rainfall.
tgt: Xiyimo xa madamu sweswi etikweni xi tshama xi hi vilerisa tanihileswi ku nga na ku phya ko tala ku tlula mpfula.

src: The fact that South Africa has not received sufficient rainfall to recharge our water sources to adequate levels means that the country is not yet out of the drought situation.
tgt: Mhaka ya leswaku Afrika-Dzonga a ri si kuma mpfula leyi ringaneke ku tatisa nakambe swihlovo swa mati swa hina ku fikela tilevhele leti ringaneleke swi vula leswaku tiko a ri si huma eka xiyimo xa dyandza.

src: Forecasts predict that the country will only receive its major rainfall from the beginning of January 2018.
tgt: Ku vhumbiwa leswaku tiko ri ta kuma ntsena mpfula yo tala ku suka emasungulweni ya Sunguti 2018.

src: Cabinet wishes to assure the public that national, provincial and local government are cooperating and working together to ensure South Africa does not run out of water.
tgt: Khabinete yi navelela ku tiyisisa vaaki leswaku mfumo wa tiko, wa swifundzankulu na muganga, yi le ku tirhisaneni ku tiyisisa leswaku Afrika-Dzonga a ri heleriwi hi mati.

src: Cabinet encourages everyone to play their part in saving and using water wisely and sparingly.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza un'wana na un'wana ku teka xiave eku hlayiseni na le ku tirhiseni ka mati hi vutlharhi naswona hi matsanana.

src: Zimbabwe.1 Cabinet supports the intervention by President Jacob Zuma, in his capacity as Chair of SADC in response to the Zimbabwean situation.
tgt: Khabinete yi seketela ku nghenelela hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma, eka ntirho wa yena tanihi Mutshamaxitulu wa Muganga wa Nhluvukiso wa Matiko ya le Dzongeni wa Afrika (SADC) hi ku angula eka xiyimo xa MaZimbabwe.

src: He has sent Special Envoys, Minister of Defence and Military Veterans Ms Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula and State Security Minister, Adv Bongani Bongo.
tgt: U rhumerile Varhumiwa vo Hlawuleka, Holobye wa Vusirheleri na Khale ka Masocha, Man.

src: They are to meet with President Robert Mugabe and the Zimbabwean Defence Force.
tgt: Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula na Holobye wa Xiyenge xa Vuhlayiseki bya Tiko, Adv Bongani Bongo.

src: Thereafter proceed to brief President João Lourenço as the Chairperson of the SADC Organ on Politics, Defence and Security.
tgt: Va ta hlangana na Phuresidente Robert Mugabe na Vuthu ra Vusirheleri ra le Zimbabye.

src: Further updates on this matter will be communicated by the Presidency.
tgt: Hofisi ya Phuresidente yi ta tivisa leswi ya ka emahlweni eka mhaka leyi.

src: Square Kilometre Array (SKA).
tgt: Square Kilometre Array (SKA).

src: Cabinet welcomes the economic and social development achievements derived from the focused investment in social development in the region of the SKA South Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku humelela ka nhluvukiso wa vanhu na wa ikhonomi loku kumekeke ku suka eka vuvekisi lebyi a byi kongomiwile eka nhluvukiso wa vanhu eka rhijini ya SKA ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Communities neighbouring the SKA area continue to benefit through better education and training projects, investment in small businesses and increased job opportunities.
tgt: Miganga leyi nga kusuhi na ndhawu SKA yi ya emahlweni yi vuyeriwa hi tiphurojeke ta dyondzo na vuleteri to antswa, vuvekisi eka mabindzu lamatsongo na ku tlakuka ka swivandlanene swa mitirho.

src: The Department of Science and Technology, under the leadership of the Minister of Science and Technology, Ms Naledi Pandor, will hold a public-participation programme to celebrate achievements with the communities around Carnarvon, Northern Cape from 16 to 19 November 2017.Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Thekinoloji, ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Holobye wa Sayense na Thekinoloji, Man.

src: Cabinet was apprised on the second performance quarterly progress reports for 2017/18 (July to September 2017) by all the five clusters.
tgt: Naledi Pandor, yi ta va na nongonoko wa ku nghenelela ka vaaki ku tlangela ku humelela na miganga ya le kusuhi na le Carnarvon, eKapa-N'walungu ku suka hi ti 16 ku fika hi ti 19 Hukuri 2017.Swibohonkulu swa Khabinete.

src: This forms part of Cabinet’s broad monitoring and evaluation of the Programme of Action derived from the Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) 2014 to 2019.
tgt: Swiviko swa ku humelela swa kotara ya vumbirhi hi matirheloswa 2017/1.

src: The Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation and the Ministerial Cluster Committees will conduct media briefings to unpack the progress of these reports.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi swiviko swa ku humelela swa kotara ya vumbirhi hi matirhelo swa 2017/18 (Mawuwana ku fika Ndzati 2017) hi mitlawa hinkwayo ya ntlhanu.

src: The GCIS will coordinate the media briefings and publish the schedule on WEBTOKEN in due course.
tgt: Leswi swi vumba xiphemu xa nandzeleriso na nkambelo wo angarhela wa Khabinete wa Phurogireme ya Nghingiriko lowu kumekeke ku suka eka Rimba ra swa Maqhinga ra Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi (MTSF) wa 2014 ku fika 2019.

src: Update on address harvesting initiative and assignment of addresses.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Makunguhatelo, Kambisisa Matirhelo no Hlela na Tikomiti ta Tlawa wa Vaholobye va ta fambisa mbhurisano na vuhangalasi bya mahungu ku hlamusela hi xitalo ku humelela ka swiviko leswi.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the progress report on the implementation of the Constitutional Court Judgement to assign addresses to the voters roll.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi xiviko xa nhluvukiso eka masimekelo ya Maavanyiselo ya Khoto ya Vumbiwa ku nyika tikherefu eka rhijisitara ra vavhoti.

src: Cabinet appreciated the full compliance with the six monthly progress reports submitted to the Constitutional Court.
tgt: Khabinete yi tsakisiwile hi ku landzelela ko helela ka swiviko swa nhluvukiso swa le ndzhaku ka tin'hweti tin'wana na tin'wana ta tsevu leswi rhumeriweke eka Khoto ya Vumbiwa.

src: To date the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), working with other state agencies has attained almost 75% success in collecting the addresses of potential voters.
tgt: Ku fikela sweswi Khomixini ya Nhlawulo yo Tiyimela (IEC), hi ku tirhisana na tiejensi tin'wana ta mfumo, yi kumile ku humelela ka kwalomu ka 75% eku hlengeleteni ka tikherefu ta lava va nga tshukaka va ri vavhoti.

src: Cabinet was also briefed on the planned programme by the SAPO to assist those who do not have physical addresses.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi nongonoko lowu kunguhatiweke wa SAPO ku pfuna lava nga riki na tikherefu ta laha va tshamaka kona.

src: Cabinet is pleased with the progress and the collaborative work conducted by SAPO, the IEC and other state agencies on the assignment of addresses project.
tgt: Khabinete yi tsakisiwile hi nhluvukiso na ku tirhisana loku endliweke hi SAPO, na IEC tiejensi tin'wana ta mfumo eku nyikeni ka phurojeke ya tikherefu.

src: Cabinet further calls on those who have not updated their addresses to do so during the next voter registration week in March 2018.Upcoming events.
tgt: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi kombela volavo va nga si antswisaka tikherefu ta vona ku endla tano hi nkarhi lowu taka wa vhiki ra ntsariso wa vavhoti hi Nyenyankulu.

src: Fourth session of the South Africa-Botswana Binational Commission (BNC).
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya vumune ya Khomixini ya Matikomambirhi ya Afrika-Dzonga na Botswana (BNC).

src: President Jacob Zuma will undertake a working visit to participate in and co-chair the Fourth Session of the South Africa-Botswana BNC to be held in Gaborone, Botswana on Friday, 17 November 2017.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u ta sungula riendzo ra ntirho ku nghenelela na ku rhangela Nhlengeletano ya Vumune ya Matikomambirhi ya Afrika-Dzonga na Botswana BNC leyi nga ta khomeriwa eGaborone, eBotswana hi Ravuntlhanu, 17 Hukuri 2017.

src: South Africa and Botswana meet annually at the level of the Heads of State within the framework of the BNC to review bilateral cooperation and discuss issues of common interest.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga na Botswana ya hlangana lembe na lembe eka levhele ya Tihloko ta Matiko eka rimba ra BNC ku xopaxopa ntirhisano wa matiko ha vumbirhi na ku kanela timhaka ta ntsakelo wo fana.

src: The two countries enjoy cordial relations which are informed by cultural ties and geographical proximity.
tgt: Matiko lamambirhi ya tiphina hi vuxaka bya xinghana lebyi vumbiweke hi ku hlangana ka swa mfuwo na ku va kusuhi na ku kusuhi.

src: They cooperate on a number of issues including, transport, trade and investment, health, environmental issues etc.
tgt: Ya tirhisana eka timhaka to talanyana leti katsaka, vutleketli, bindzu na vuvekisi, rihanyu, timhaka ta swa mbango sw. sw. Afrika-Dzonga hi rin'wana ra vatirhisani va bindzu lavakulu va Botswana, ku na tikhamphani to hlaya ta Afrika-Dzonga ti nga ri tingani leti tirhaka eka tiko rero.

src: Angolan State President visit.
tgt: Riendzo ra Phuresidente wa Angola.

src: President Zuma will host his Excellency, the President of the Republic of Angola, João Lourenço, for a historic State Visit to South Africa from 23 November 2017.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u ta rhurhela Muchaviseki, Phuresidente wa Riphabliki ra Angola, João Lourenço, eka Riendzo ra Mfumo ra matimu eAfrika-Dzonga ku suka hi ti 23 Hukuri 2017.

src: This will be his first state visit to our country after his inauguration.
tgt: Leri ku ta va ku ri Riendzo ra Mfumo ra yena ro sungula etikweni ra hina endzhaku ka loko a vekiwile exitulwini.

src: The two countries have historical and fraternal ties dating back from the days of the liberation struggle when Angola housed and supported South African liberation cadres in various camps in that country.
tgt: Matiko lamambirhi ya na ku hlangana ka xinghana na ka matimu kusukela eka masiku ya ku lwela ntshuxeko loko Anglola ri rhurhele na ku seketela tinhenha ta ku lwela ntshuxeko ta Afrika-Dzonga eka tikamba to hambanahambana etikweni leriya.

src: Trade and economic cooperation between the two countries has grown substantially, to the extent that South Africa is Angola’s number one trading partner on the continent.
tgt: Ntirhisano wa ikhonomi na bindzu exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi wu kurile swinene, ku fikela laha Afrika-Dzonga ri nga muringani wa bindzu wo rhanga wa Angola eka tikonkulu.

src: Many South African companies are conducting business in Angola in a variety of sectors including construction, mining, housing, retail, food and beverages, hotels and leisure, banking and medical services.
tgt: Tikhamphani ta Afrika-Dzonga to tala ti le ku endleni ka bindzu eAngola eka tisekitara to hambanahambana ku katsa na vuako, migodi, tindlu, nxaviso xin'wexin'we, swakudya na swakunwa, tihotela na ku tiphina, vukorhokeri bya swa vutshunguri na byo banga.

src: During his visit João Lourenço will also host a Lecture on 24 November 2017 at OR Tambo Building in Pretoria.
tgt: Hi nkarhi wa riendzo ra yena, Phuresidente Lourençou u ta tlhela a fambisa Dyondzo hi Ravuntlhanu, 24 Hukuri 2017 eka Muako wa OR Tambo ePitori.

src: 16 Days of Activism.
tgt: Masiku ya 16 ya ku Lwisana na madzolonga.

src: Cabinet joins all South Africans who are taking a stand against women and child abuse.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlangana na MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo lawa ya teka goza ro lwa na ku xanisiwa ka vavasati na vana.

src: The 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children campaign is taking place between 25 November and 10 December 2017.
tgt: Pfhumba ra Masiku ya 16 yo Lwisana na Madzolonga ehenhla ka Vavasati na Vana ri ta va kona exikarhi ka ti 25 Hukuri na 10 N'wendzamhala 2017.

src: This is the 19th year of the campaign in South Africa and it will continue under the theme: “Count Me In: Together Moving a Non-Violent South Africa Forward”.
tgt: Leri i lembe ra vu 19 ra pfhumba eAfrika-Dzonga naswona ri ta ya emahlweni ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Na Mina Ndzi Hlaye: Swin'we hi Yisa Emahlweni Afrika-Dzonga ro Pfumala Madzolonga”.

src: President Zuma will launch the 16 Days of Activism campaign in the Eastern Cape on Saturday, 25 November 2017.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u ta simeka pfhumba ra Masiku ya 16 yo Lwisana na madzolonga eKapa Vuxa hi Mugqivela, 25 Hukuri 2017.

src: It will focus on the continued roll-out of National Dialogues, which encourage people to talk about the scourge of gender-based violence.
tgt: Ri ta kongomisa eka ku yisiwa emahlweni ka ku sunguriwa ka n'wangulano wa Rixaka, leyi khutazaka vanhu ku vulavula hi mayelana na ntungu wa madzolonga ya ku ya hi rimbewu.

src: This will be preceded by International Men’s Day on Sunday, 19 November 2017, which calls on men to play their part in building a safer and more socially cohesive society.
tgt: Leswi swi ta landzeriwa hi Siku ra Vavanuna ra Matiko hinkwawo hi Sonto, 19 Hukuri 2017, leri rhambaka vavanuna ku tlanga xiphemu xa vona eku akeni muganga lowu hlayisekeke na vun'we bya vanhu.

src: The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development will undertake the second community radio campaign under its Let’s Talk Justice series, which brings government services to people by providing listeners with an opportunity to engage with officials on topical issues.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Vululami na Nhluvukiso wa Vumbiwa yi ta fambisa pfhumba ra rhadiyo ra muganga ra vumbirhi ehansi ka minongonoko ya A hi Vulavuleni ku Lulama, leri tisaka vukorhokeri bya mfumo eka vanhu hi ku nyika vayingiseri nkateko wo tihlanganisa na vaofisiri eka timhaka leti nga emahungwini.

src: The launch of a Sexual Offences Court during the campaign will also ensure better access to the justice system.
tgt: Ku simekiwa ka Khoto ya Milandzu ya swa Masangu hi nkarhi wa pfhumba ku ta tlhela ku tiyisisa mfikelelo wo antswa eka sisiteme ya vululami.

src: Cabinet is confident that by working together we can end the cycle of abuse.
tgt: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku hi ku tirhisana hi nga herisa ndzhendzheleko wa nxaniso.

src: Through our collective efforts we can act to prevent abuse while ensuring a safer society for women and children.
tgt: Hi ku hlangana ka matshalatshala ya hina hi nga tirha ku sivela nxaniso loko hi karhi hi tiyisisa muganga lowu hlayisekeke eka vamanana na vana.

src: All people in South Africa are urged to wear a white ribbon as a symbolic pledge towards eliminating this scourge from our society.
tgt: Vanhu hinkwavo eAfrika-Dzonga va khutaziwa ku ambala rhibono yo basa tanihi mfungho wa ku tiboha ku herisa ntungu lowu ku suka emigangeni ya hina.

src: Build up to World AIDS Day.
tgt: Ku lunghiselela Siku ra AIDS ra Misava 2016.

src: Cabinet calls on all in society to participate in Red Ribbon Friday activations ahead of World AIDS Day on 1 December and up until the end of that month.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba vaaki hinkwavo ku nghenelela eka ku sunguriwa ka Ravuntlhanu ra Rhibono yo Tshuka loko ku nga si fika Siku ra AIDS ra Misava hi ti1 N'wendzamhala na ku ya fika emahelweni ya n'hweti yoleyo.

src: Wearing a red ribbon is a symbol of solidarity and commitment to the fight against HIV and AIDWorld AIDS Day is an opportunity for every community to unite in the fight against HIV, show support for people living with HIV and remember those who have passed on.
tgt: Ku ambala rhibono yo tshuka i mfungho wa vun'we na ku tiboha ku lwa na HIV na AIDSiku ra AIDS ra Misava i nkateko eka muganga wun'wana na wun'wana ku hlangana eka ku lwa na HIV, ku kombisa nseketelo eka vanhu lava hanyaka na HIV na ku tsundzuka lava hundzeke emisaveni.

src: This year’s event will be held under the theme: “My Right to Know My Status, Prevention Is My Responsibility”, which links to the global theme: “The Right to Health”.
tgt: Nkhuvo wa lembe leri wu ta endliwa ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Mfanelo ya Mina ku Tiva Xiyimo xa Mina, Nsivelo I Vutihlamuleri bya Mina”, lowu khomanaka na nkongomelo wa matiko hinkwawo: “Mfanelo eka Rihanyu”.

src: This bolsters implementation of South Africa’s National Strategic Plan for HIV, Tuberculosis and Sexually-Transmitted Illnesses 2017 - 2022 (NSP), which is a key pillar in South Africa’s progress towards achieving universal healthcare as reflected in the NDP, which promotes a healthier, stronger and more equitable nation.
tgt: Leswi swi tiyisisa nsimeko wa Kungu ra swa Maqhinga ra HIV ya Rixaka ra Afrika-Dzonga, vuvabyi bya rifuva na Mavabyi ya Ntlulelo wa swa Masangu 2017 - 2022 (NSP), leswi ku nga phuphu ya nkoka eka nhluvukiso wa Afrika-Dzonga ku yisa eku fikeleleni nhlayiso wa rihanyu wa misava hinkwayo hilaha swi kombisiweke hakona eka NDP, leswi tlakusaka rixaka leri hanyeke kahle, ro tiya na ku va na ndzingano swinene.

src: Cabinet calls on communities to join participation in the upcoming 7th National Imbizo Focus Week, expected to be held from 27 November to 3 December 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba miganga ku nghenela ku nghenelela eka Vhiki ro Kongomisa eka Imbizo ya Rixaka ya vu 7 leyi taka, leri ehleketeleriwaka ku va kona ku sukela hi ti 27 Hukuri ku ya fika hi ti3 N'wendzamhala 2017.

src: Under the leadership of the GCIS, this platform promotes interactive engagements between members of the Executive and communities.
tgt: Ehansi ka vurhangeri bya GCIS, ndlela leyi yi tlakusa n’wangulano exikarhi ka Swirho swa Huvonkulu na miganga.

src: It is taking place within the context of the centennial of Oliver Reginald Tambo, who advocated for gender equality.
tgt: Yi ta va kona eka rimba ra malembe xidzana ya Oliver Reginald Tambo, loyi a seketeleke ndzingano wa rimbewu.

src: The activities are aimed to support the 16 Days of Activism campaign.
tgt: Migingiriko yi kongomisiwe ku seketela pfhumba ra Masiku ya 16 yo Lwisana na madzolonga.

src: Events will be placed on the national calendar and shared on the government website (WEBTOKEN).Bills.
tgt: Mikhuvo yi ta vekiwa eka khalendara ya rixaka na ku averiwa eka webusayiti ya mfumo (WEBTOKEN).Milawumbisi.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of a notice in terms of section 74(5) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile nkandziyiso wa xitiviso hi ku ya hi xiyenge xa 74(5) xa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.

src: The aim is to initiate a national and provincial consultation process for purposes of effecting changes to provincial boundaries in respect of the Matatiele Local Municipality in the Eastern Cape and certain areas of Ba Ga Mothibi in North West.
tgt: Xikongomelo i ku sungula endlelo ro tihlanganisa ra xifundzankulu na ra rixaka hi swikongomelo swo endla ku cinca eka mindzilekana ya xifundzankulu hi mayelana na Masipala wa Muganga wa Matatiele eKapa-Vuxa na tindhawu tin'wana ta Ba Ga Mothibi eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu.

src: The intended redetermination of the provincial boundaries emanates from the communities of the areas in question who wish to be relocated to neighboring provinces.
tgt: Ntshuxeko lowu languteriweke wa mindzilekana ya swifundzankulu wu sukela eka miganga ya tindhawu leti ku vulavuriwaka hatona leyi lavaka ku rhurhisiwa ku ya eka swifundzankulu swa le kusuhi.

src: Messages.
tgt: Mahungu.

src: Cabinet congratulates France as the preferred host of the 2023 Rugby World Cup and thanks government’s delegation, headed by Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa, Sport and Recreation Minister Thulas Nxesi and the South African Rugby Union, for the work done in promoting South Africa’s bid to host the event.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Furwa tanihi tiko ro rhurhela leri tsakeriweke ra Khapu ya Misava ya Rhagibi na ku khensa vurhumiwa bya mfumo, lebyi a byi rhangeriwile hi Xandla xa Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa, Holobye wa Mitlangu na Vuhungasi Thulas Nxesi na Nhlangano wa Rhagibi wa Afrika-Dzonga, eka ntirho lowu va nga wu endla eku tlakuseni ka bidi ya Afrika-Dzonga ku va ri ta rhurhela ntlangu.

src: Cabinet congratulates Minister Pandor, who was awarded the Outstanding Educator Award.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Holobye Pandor, loyi a nyikiweke sagwadi ra Mudyondzisi wa Xiyimo xa le henhla.

src: The award was presented to Minister Pandor by the Chancellor of the University of South Africa, former President Thabo Mbeki.
tgt: Sagwadi ri nyikiwile Holobye Phandor hi Chanselara wa Yunivhesiti ya Afrika-Dzonga, khale ka Phuresidente Thabo Mbeki.

src: The Outstanding Educator Award, one of four categories, acknowledges the contribution of any outstanding educator who has excelled in or advanced teaching, learning, skills development and/or research in their area of expertise.
tgt: Sagwadi ra Mudyondzisi wa Xiyimo xa le henhla, rin'we ya mitlawa ya mune, ri amukela ku hoxa xandla ka mudyondzisi wa xiyimo xa le henhla wihi na wihi loyi a tirheke kahle swinene eka ku dyondzisa kumbe ku yisa ku dyondzisa emahlweni, ku dyondza, nhluvukiso wa vutshila na/kumbe ndzavisiso eka ndhawu ya yena ya vuswikoti.

src: Cabinet commends the work done by the South African Astronomical Observatory, which is part of the Wide Angle Search for Planets consortium of planet hunters who have detected three new planets.
tgt: Khabinete yi ndhundhuzela ntirho lowu endliweke hi Laborethari ya Dyondzo ya swa tinyeleti ya Afrika-Dzonga, leyi ku nga xiphemu xa Ndzavisiso wa Ndlela yo Angarhela ya Tipulanete ta ntlawa wa vativi va sayense lava lavaka ku kuma tipulanete hi mahlo ya ngati lava se va kumeke tipulanete tintshwa tinharhu.

src: Cabinet congratulates the participants and winners of the 2017 Govan Mbeki Awards, which honour those in the construction sector who have excelled in the delivery of houses.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela vangheneleri na vahluri va masagwadi ya Govan Mbeki ya 2017, lawa ya xiximaka lava nga eka sekithara ya vuako lava tirheke kahle eka mphakelo wa tindlu.

src: Cabinet convened for its last 2017 meeting at the Union Buildings in Pretoria.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlanganile ro hetelela eka 2017 eUnion Buildings ePitori.

src: Cabinet DecisionsCabinet approved the National Tourism Sector Strategy (NTSS) 2016-2026 for implementation.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra Sekithara ra Vupfhumba ra Rixaka (NTSS) 2016-2026 ku va ri simekiwa.

src: The NTSS is anchored on five strategic pillars, namely marketing, facilitation of ease of access for tourists, enhance visitor experience, destination management and broad-based benefits.
tgt: NTSS yi yima hi tiphuphu ta maqhinga ta ntlhanu , ku nga ku maketa, ku fambisa mfikelelo wo olova eka vapfhumba, ku antswisa ntokoto wa vaendzi, mafambiselo ya tindhawu ta vuendzi na mivuyelo ya endleloangarhelo.

src: The full document is available on the Department of Tourism’s website: www.
tgt: Tsalwa hinkwaro ri kona eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba: WEBTOKEKhabinete yi pasisile rimba ra ku tumbuluxiwa ka Khamphani ya Netiweke ya Broadband ya Rixaka.

src: Cabinet approved the framework for the establishment of a National Broadband Network Company.
tgt: Leswi swi ta fambisa ku sunguriwa ka swilo leswi nga ni vuxaka na ku fambisa hi ndlela yo hlanganela na ku tumbuluxa vurhangeri bya broadband ya rixaka.

src: It will be formed out of the merger of Sentech and Broadband Infraco.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Xiviko xa ku Humelela xa Lembe na lembe xo Sungula eka ku Simekiwa ka Mpfapfarhuto wa tirhele wa Timfanelo ta Vanhu lava hanyaka na Vutsoniwa (WPRPD).

src: This will facilitate the roll-out of the interdependent elements in a coordinated manner and create a national broadband champion.
tgt: Xiviko xi angarhela nkarhi wa ku suka hi ti1 Sunguti ku fika hi ti 31 N'wendzamhala 2016.Xiviko xi nyika vuhleri bya xiyimo xa le henhla xa hilaha tindzawulo ta mfumo ti nga sungula ku nghenelerisa swileriso swa pholisi ya WPRPD eka makunguhatelo, mapimanyetelo, na mphakelo wa vukorhokeri na maendlelo ya ku vika ya tona.

src: Cabinet approved the First Annual Progress Report on Implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (WPRPD).
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Rimba ra Maqhinga ya Pholisi ya Vatsoniwa eka Tidyondzo ta le Henhla na Maendlelo ya Vuleteri leswaku ku rhumeriwa swibumabumelo.

src: The report covers the period from 1 January to 31 December 2016.The report gives a high-level assessment of the extent to which government departments have started embedding the policy directives of WPRPD into their respective planning, budgeting, and service delivery and reporting systems.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi mivuyelo ya Nkambisiso wa Phurogireme ya ku Herisa Mathekisi loku nga endliwa ku suka hi Hukuri 2015 ku fika Ndzati 2016.

src: The programme is part of the broader Public Transport Strategy, which aims to provide an integrated safety and efficient transport system in South Africa.
tgt: Phurogireme i xiphemu xo angarhela xa Qhinga ra Vutleketli bya Vaaki, leri lavaka ku fikelerisa sisiteme ya vuhlayiseki byo hlanganela na vutleketli lebyi pfunaka eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Cabinet approved that more consultation and work must be done with relevant departments before the National Department of Transport can embark on the revised approach.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile tinhlengeletano to tala na ntirho wo tala wu fanele ku endliwa na tindzawulo leti nga fanela loko Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli ya Rixaka yi nga si sungula ku pfuxeta maendlelo.

src: Cabinet approved the public release of the 8th edition of the Development Indicators (2016).
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku humesiwa ku ya eka vaaki ka nkandziyiso wa vu 8 wa Swikombo swa Nhluvukiso swa (2016).

src: The Development Indicator Report focuses on South Africa’s development since democracy and monitors implementation of the National Development Plan Vision 2030.Cabinet approved measures to strengthen the management of discipline of public servants in relation to officials conducting business with organs of state.
tgt: Xiviko xa Xikombo xa Nhluvukiso xi langutisa eka nhluvukiso wa Afrika-Dzonga ku sukela loko ku ri na xidemokirasi na ku landzelerisa ku simekiwa ka Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka: Xivono xa Khabinete yi pasisile tindlela ta ku tiyisisa mafambiselo ya matikhomelo ya vatirhelamfumo loko swi ta eka vatirhi lava endlaka bindzu na marhavi ya mfumo.

src: It gives effect to the Public Service Regulations 2016, which prohibits public servants from conducting business with the State.
tgt: Swi cinca Swinawana swa Vatirhelamfumo swa 2016, leswi alelaka vatirhelamfumo ku endla bindzu na Mfumo.

src: From 1 March, National Treasury, supported by the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA), will monitor all new registrations on the online Central Supplier Database against the Persal System.
tgt: Ku sukela hi ti1 Nyenyankulu, Nkwama wa Mfumo, hi ku seketeriwa hi Ndzawulo ya Vatirhelamfumo na Vulawuri (DPSA), va ta landzelerisa mitsariso yintshwa eka Nhlayisa-switiviwa ya Vaphakeri ya le Xikarhi eka Sisiteme ya Phesali.

src: Cabinet approved the New Performance Management and Development System for Heads of Department, which accurately reflects the link between individual and organisational performance.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Mafambiselo ya Matirhelo Yantshwa na Sisiteme ya Nhluvukiso wa Tinhloko ta Tindzawulo, leswi kombaka nkahoxeko ku hlangana exikarhi ka matirhelo ya munhu na matirhelo ya nhlangano.

src: It comes into effect on 1 April 2018.Cabinet approved the introduction and implementation of the Public Service Graduate Recruitment Scheme Framework.
tgt: Leswi swi ta sungula ku tirha hiti1 Dzivamisoko Khabinete yi pasisile ku sunguriwa na ku simekiwa ka Rimba ra Xikimi xa ku Thola Vatirhelamfumo lava Thwaseke.

src: This forms part of the development programme within the Public Service to attract talented graduates into the Public Service.
tgt: Leswi swi vumba xiphemu xa phurogireme ya nhluvukiso eka Vatirhelamfumo ku kota ku koka rinoko eka mathwasana lawa ya nga na vuswikoti eka Vutirhelamfumo.

src: The framework includes earmarking a percentage of each department’s vacant posts for the recruitment of graduates in scarce occupations.
tgt: Rimba ri katsa ku languta phesente ya ndzawulo yin'wana na yin'wana laha ku nga na swivandla swa mitirho ku kota thola mathwasana eka mitirho leyi kaleriwaka hi mathwasana.

src: The Minister of Public Service and Administration will also align this framework to the Youth Employment Service Programme.
tgt: Holobye wa Vutirhelamfumo na Vulawuri u ta tlhela a xaxameta rimba leri na Phurogireme ya Vukorhokeri bya ku Thola Vantshwa.

src: Cabinet approved for the publication of the following Notices in the Government Gazette relating to the Rationalisation of Courts Jurisdiction, which aims to increase access to justice for previously marginalised and under-serviced rural villages.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Switiviso leswi landzelaka eka Gazete ya Mfumo leswi fambelenaka na ku Kongomisa Swiboho swa Huvo eka Mindzilekano, leswi xikongomelo ku nga ku tlakusa mfikelelo eka vululami eka lava khale a va siyiwile ehandle na le ka matikoxikaya lawa a ya nga korhokeriwi hi ku ringanela.

src: The rationalisation is in magisterial districts in the Free State and Northern Cape, and the removal of certain Magisterial Districts from the Gauteng Division of the High Court and placing them under the jurisdiction of the North West Division of High Court.
tgt: Ku kongomisiwa swi le ka miganga ya majisitarata wa le Free State na le Kapa-N'walungu, na ku susuwa ka Miganga yin'wana ya Majisitarata ku suka eka Rhavi ra Gauteng ra Huvo ya le Henhla na ku ti veka ehansi ka ndzilekana wa Rhavi ra Huvo ya le Henhla ra N'walungu-Vupeladyambu.

src: Cabinet approved the Regulations on Mediation Rules in terms of the Protection of Investment Act, 2015 (Act 22 of 2015).
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Swipimelo eka Milawu ya Vulamuri hi ku ya hi Nawu wa ku Sirhelela Vuvekisi, 2015 (Nawu wa 22 wa 2015).

src: The regulations provide for an investor that has a dispute in respect of action taken by government that affects an investment, to request the Department of Trade and Industry (the dti) to intervene with possible mediation mechanism.
tgt: Swinawana swi fikelerisa muvekisi loyi a nga na mikanetano hi ku ya hi xiboho lexi tekiweke hi mfumo lexi khumbhaka vuvekisi, ku kombela Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki (dti) ku nghenelela hi tindlela leti kotekaka ta vulamuri.

src: Cabinet approved the convening and hosting of the following conferences:National Community Development Workers Programme Consultative Conference 2018 by the DPSInternational Association of Prosecutors 23rd Annual Conference, to be hosted by the National Prosecuting Authority in Durban during September 2018.2021 World Science Forum in South Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hlangana na ku rhurheriwa ka tikhonferense leti landzelaka: Khonferense yo Tihlanganisa ya Phurogireme ya Nhluvukiso wa Vatirhi va Muganga va Rixaka ya 2018 hi DPSKhonferense ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu 23 ya Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava ya Vachuchisi, leyi nga ta rhurheriwa hi Vulawuri bya Vachuchisi bya Rixaka eDurban hi Ndzati 2018.

src: The Department of Science and Technology will engage with the World Science Forum Steering Committee for possible hosting.2017 African Union (AU) High-Level Dialogue, hosted by the DPSA from 6 to 8 December 2017.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Thekinoloji yi ta burisana na Komiti ya Vufambisi eka Foramu ya Sayense ya Misava loko swikoteka ku va yi rhurhela.

src: Cabinet approved for the designs and commemorative collectors’ and circulation coin series to be issued in 2018.The coin designs, with their proclamations, will be printed in the Government Gazette: 2018 2oz, 22-carat gold Krugerrand2018 24-carat gold Natura coin series (Rise of the dinosaurs – Archosauria)2018 24-carat gold R1 coin series (Reptiles of South Africa – the parrot beaked padloper)2018 bi-metal R5 circulation coin (Nelson Mandela Centenary)2018 24-carat gold and sterling-silver Protea coin series (Life of Legend – Nelson Mandela)2018 sterling-silver R2 Crown and 2 ½ Tickey series (South African inventions – Computed Tomography) and2018 sterling-silver colour finished coin series (Birds and Flowers of the Waterberg Biosphere Reserve).Issues in the EnvironmentGDP Growth ResultsCabinet is pleased with South Africa’s economy growth which grew by an annualised 2% in the third quarter of 2017, from an upwardly revised 2.8% in the second quarter.
tgt: 2017 N’wangulano wa Xiyimo xa le Henhla xa Nhlangano wa Afrika (AU), lowu nga ta rhurheriwa hi DPSA ku sukela hi ti 6 ku fika hi ti 8 N'wendzamhala 2017.

src: The stronger-than-expected performance was mainly due to continued strong growth in the agriculture sector, which contributed percentage points to overall growth on the back of per cent quarter-on-quarter growth.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile tidizayini na nhlengeleto wa ku tsundzuka na ku hangalasiwa ka mali ya nsimbhi leyi nga ta humesiwa hi 2018.Tidizayini ta mali ya nsimbhi, na ku tivisiwa ka tona, swi ta kandziyisiwa eka Gazete ya Mfumo: 2018 ku hangalasiwa ka mali ya R5 ya tinsimbhi timbirhi (Lembexidzana ra Nelson Mandela)2018 24 wa tikharete ta nsuku ta nongonoko wa R1 (Mikolombyani ya Afrika-Dzonga, pheroto yi jovote futsu)2018 24 wa tikharete ta nsuku eka nongonoko mali ya nsimbi ya Nachura (Ku tlakuka ka dayinasoro - Archosauria)2018 2oz, 22 wa tikharete ta nsuku ta randi ya Kruger 2018 24 wa tikharete ta nsuku na silivhere yo vangama ya mali ya nongonoko wa mali ya Phurothiya (Vutomi bya Nhenha -Nelson Mandela)2018 wa silivhere yo vangama ya Harhi ya R2 na 2 ½ wa nongonoko wa Tiki (Vutumbuluxi bya Afrika-Dzonga - vukombisi bya xithekiniki hi Khomphyuta) na2018 silivhere yo vangama ya nongonoko lowu nga totiwa muhlovo (Tinyenyani na Swiluva swa Ntanga wa Swimilani wa Waterberg).Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.

src: Strong performance in agriculture, which has seen three consecutive quarters of robust growth, was due to higher production of field crops (such as maize) in summer rainfall areas and horticultural products.
tgt: Mivuyelo ya Swimakiwa Hinkwaswo swa TikoKhabinete yi tsakile hi ku kula ka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi kuleke hi ku hlayiwa hi lembe hi 2% eka kotara ya vunharhu ya 2017, ku suka eka mpfuxeto wa le henhla wa 2.8% eka kotara ya vumbirhi.

src: Mining and manufacturing also contributed to the growth recorded, with mining and quarrying increasing by 6.6% and contributing percentage points to growth.
tgt: Matirhelo lawa ya nga tiya lawa ku tlula lawa a ya languteriwile ya vile kona hi mhaka ya ku kula loku ya ka emahlweni eka sekithara ya vurimi, leyi nga hoxa xandla eka wa tiphesente eka ku kula hinkwako endzhaku ka 44.2% eka kotara hi kotara ya ku kula.

src: Growth in household consumption of 2.6% was mainly due to spending on durable goods, which accounted for percentage points of the 2.6% increase.
tgt: Matirhela ya kahle ya vurimi, laha hi nga vona tikotara tinharhu ta ku kula ka xiyimo xa le henhla, swi vile kona hi ntshovelo wa le henhla wa swirimiwa (yo fana na mavele) eka tindhawu ta mpfula ya ximumu na swirimiwa swa swo xavisiwa.

src: Stronger-than-expected growth and the upward revision to the second quarter growth outcomes means growth could reach per cent in 2017.This is higher than the per cent anticipated at the time of the Medium Term Budget Policy Statement.
tgt: Migodi na vutumbuluxi swi hoxile xandla eka kula loku nga rhikhodiwa, laha migodi na ku ceriwa ka maribye swi nga kula hi 6.6% na ku hoxa xandla hi 0.5% wa tipoyinti eka ku kula.

src: It aims to create a conducive environment by providing a focal point of contact for investors to obtain all services to fast-track projects and reduce government red-tape when starting a business.
tgt: Mfumo wu fanele ku tiyisisa leswaku matimba ya ku kula ku ya emahlweni ku tshama ku ri kona hi ku yisa emahlweni ku simeka tindlela ta 14 ta ku tlakusa ku tshemba leti yisaka ehenhla ku tshemba ka vatirhisi naswona ku nga vuyerisa ku tshemba ka mabindzu.

src: South Africa-Angola relationsCabinet welcomes the agreements signed during the State Visit to South Africa by Angolan President João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.
tgt: InvestSA One-Stop ShopKhabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka InvestSA One-Stop Shop eKwazulu-Natal hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma tanihi xiphemu xa ku antswisa ku endla bindzu na Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The summit provided an opportunity for South Africa to enhance strategic economic and diplomatic relations through various engagements in the summit and in side events such as the Business Forum and Youth Summit, with a focus on inclusive economic growth, youth employment and entrepreneurship.
tgt: Leyi lavaka ku endla leswaku ku va na mbangu wa kahle wa ku fikelerisa nkongomelo wa vuhlanganisi eka vavekisi ku kuma vukorhokeri hi ku hatlisisa tiphurojeke na ku hunguta vuyimayima loko u sungula bindzu.

src: Slave trade of African migrantsCabinet joins the international community in condemning the reports of auctioning of African migrants in Libya as slaves.
tgt: Vuxaka bya Afrika-Dzonga na AngolaKhabinete yi amukela ntwanano lowu nga sayiniwa hi nkarhi wa Riendzo ra Tiko hi Phuresidente wa Angola João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.

src: Such inhumane acts go against the ideals of the AU, and relevant African and international instruments, including the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights.
tgt: Mitwanano leyi landzelaka yi sayiniwile: Memorandamu ya Ntwanano (MoU) eka ku tumbuluxiwa ka Khomixini ya Matiko hayambirhi ya va Phuresidente, MoU eka Ntirhisano eka Xiyenge xa Mbango, Nsimeko wa Swiletelo swa ku nga tirhisi vhisa, Maendlelo eka Ntirhisano wa Maphorisa na Ntwanano eka Mpfuno wa Vulawuri bya Milawu ya Timhaka ta Xibalo xa tinhundzu leti tlulaka mindzilekana.

src: Cabinet welcomes the announcement by authorities that they will set up a transit and departure facility in Tripoli for refugees and migrants in need of international protection.
tgt: Samiti ya Vuntlhanu ya Nhlangano wa AU-Yuropo (EU).Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo ya vuntlhanu ya Samiti ya AU-ESamiti yi fikelerisile xivandlanene eka Afrika-Dzonga ku yisa emahlweni vuxaka bya xidipilomati na maqhinga ya ikhonomi hi ku burisana ko hambanahambana eka samiti na le ka mitlangu ya le tlhelo yo fana na Foramu ya Mabindzu na Vantshwa, leyi nga kongoma eka ku kula ka ikhonomi loku katsaka, ku thoriwa ka vantshwa na mabindzu.

src: Outbreak of ListeriosisCabinet appeals to all people to take the necessary precaution – such as washing their hands before preparing food and avoiding raw or uncooked foods – to curb the spread of Listeriosis, whilst investigations continue to establish the source of the bacteria.
