tgt: Ku xavisiwa ka mahlonga ya vapfhumba va MaAfrikaKhabinete yi hlangana na vaaki va matiko ya misava ku yirisa ku xavisiwa ka vapfhumba va MaAfrika eLibya tanihi mahlonga.

src: The disease is caused by a bacteria found in soil, water, vegetation and non-pasteurised dairy products, and may result in flu-like symptoms with diarrhoea.
tgt: Ntungu wa ListeriosisKhabinete yi kombela vanhu hinkwavo ku endla leswi nga ringanela ku tisirhelela, ku fana na ku hlamba mavoko loko va nga si lulamisa swakudya na ku papalata swakudya swi mbisi kumbe leswi nga swekiwangiki, ku hunguta ku hangalaka ka listeriosis, loko vulavisisi bya ha ya emahlweni ku kuma laha xitsongwatsongwani xi humaka kona.

src: It can be successfully treated with antibiotics, if detected early.
tgt: Vuvabyi byi vangiwa hi xitsongwatsongwani lexi humaka emisaveni, ematini, eswimilannii na le ka switirhisiwa swa masi lama nga tengisiwangiki, naswona swi nga vanga matitwelo yo fana na ya mukhuhlwani lawa ya nga na nchuluko.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to continue using water sparingly as the country still continues to experience drought/.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni na ku tirhisa mati kahle loko tiko ra ha ya emahlweni ri tokota dyandza.

src: Notwithstanding the recent rains, the dam levels nationally continue to decline.
tgt: Hi nga languti timpfula leti ta ha ku va kona, mipimo ya madamu ya tiko ya ya ehansi.

src: This is due to the high temperatures as well as that we did not as yet have consistent rains.
tgt: Leswi swi vangiwa hi maxelo ya ku hisa kasi a hi se va na mpfula leyi tshamelaka ku na.

src: Cabinet is encouraged by the progressive negotiations with the highly indebted municipalities towards finding a solution to the municipal debt.
tgt: Khabinete ya hlohloteleka hi ku ya emahlweni ka mivulavurisano na timasipala leti nga na swikweleti swa le henhla ku kuma xintshuxo eka xikweleti xa masipala.

src: BillsCabinet approved the submission to Parliament of following Bills.1 Social Assistance Amendment Bill of 2017.The Bill provides improved benefits with respect to child support grants for orphaned and vulnerable children, including those residing in child-headed households.2 Property Practitioners Bill of 2017 The Bill repeals the current Estate Agency Affairs Act, 1976 (Act 112 of 1976).
tgt: Nawumbisi wa ku Cinca Mpfuno wa Vaaki wa 2017.Nawumbisi wu nyika mivuyelo leyi antswisiweke eka mudende wa vana lava nga swisiwana na vana lava nga sirheleriwangiki, ku katsa na volava va tshamaka emindyangwini leyi rhangeriweke hi vana.

src: It creates an enabling regulatory environment to enhance economic activity within the real estate industry while also addressing a need to ensure transformation in the sector.3 National Qualifications Framework Amendment Bill of 2016The Bill strengthens the current National Qualifications Framework Act, 2008 (Act 67 of 2008).
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Vaxavisi va Tinhundzu wa 2017Nawumbisi wu herisa Nawu wa Timhaka ta Tiejensi to Xavisa Tindlu, wa 1976 (Nawu wa 112 wa 1976).

src: It introduces measures to deal with issues of misrepresentation and imposes consequences on persons who misrepresent their qualifications or organisations that issue qualifications that are invalid.4 International Crimes Bill of 2017The Bill provides an improved legislative framework to deal with international crimes committed in South Africa and across our border.
tgt: Wu endla leswaku ku va mbangu wa vulawuri ku yisa emahlweni migingiriko ya ikhonomi eka vumaki bya ku xavisa tindlu loko ku karhi ku tiyisisiwa ku lulamisa ku tisa ku cinca eka sekithara.

src: He has served the country with distinction as a South African Ambassador to Russia and as Chairperson of the South African Nuclear Energy Corporation.
tgt: Mejara Seitebatso Pearl Block eka ku xiximiwa ka yena ku va a kuma Sagwadi ra Lembe ra Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava (UN) hi ku va a ri Gqweta ra Madzolonga ya ku ya hi Rimbewu eka Mavuthu.

src: President Zuma had declared a Special Provincial Official Funeral for him.4 The family and friends of Struggle stalwart and ex-Robben Island prisoner, Mr Eddie Daniels, who recently passed away.
tgt: Sagwadi leri ri tekela enhlokweni ku tinyikela na matimba ya munhu loyi a tisaka ku rhula na ku seketela milawu eka Xintshuxo xa Huvo ya Vusirheleri ya UN ya 1324, leyi kombelaka mavandla hinkwawo lawa ya lwaka ku sirhelela vavasati na vanhwanyana eka mixaniso ya swa masangu na madzolonga ya ku ya hi rimbewu.

src: He will be remembered for his selfless dedication and service to the people of South Africa.5 The family of Minister of Defence and Military Veterans, Ms Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, on the passing away of her father, Mr Douglas Mapisa.
tgt: Ladysmith Black Mambazo, lava va nga vayimelakulangwa va Masagwadi ya tiGrammy ya 2018.

src: He passed away at the Cecilia Makiwane Hospital in East London at the age of 96.Upcoming EventsCommemoration of Nelson MandelaCabinet joins South Africans in commemorating the fourth anniversary of Nelson Mandela's passing on 5 December 2013.
tgt: Ko sungula ku le ka xiyenge xa Alibamu ya Vunanga bya Matiko ya Misava bya Kahle hi Alibamu ya vona ya Shaka Zulu Revisited: 30th Anniversary Celebation, ya vumbirhi yi le ka Alibamu ya Vana ya Khale eka Songs of Peace & Love for Kids & Parents around the World Masagwadi ya tiGrammy ya ta va kona hi ti 28 Sunguti 2018.

src: In 2018 the country will mark the centenary of the life of Mandela and all South Africans are encouraged to join in the year-long celebration as we pay tribute to one of Africa’s greatest sons.
tgt: Chad Le Clos, ku va a vile muhlamberi wa xinuna wo sungula ku va a hlula hi ka mune eka Khapu ya Misava ya ku Hlambela ya FINA eka nongonoko wa swiyenge.

src: The Minister of Transport, Mr Joe Maswanganyi, launched the Arrive Alive campaign on the 5 December in Bela-Bela, Limpopo.
tgt: N’wambhuri wa Afrika-Dzonga, Demi-Leigh Nel-Peters, ku va hlurile eka N'wambhuri wa Matiko ya Misava eka Van’wambhuri wa vu 66 lowu a wu khomeriwe eAmerika.

src: The SAPS is implementing its nationwide campaign for a safer festive season and all have a responsibility to support the SAPS by upholding the law and behaving responsibly.
tgt: Dr Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, loyi a nga nyikiwa sagwadi ra Lifetime Achievement hi Foramu ya Misava ya Varhangeri va Vamanana va Tipolitiki.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 28 February 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlangane hi Ravunharhu, 28 Nyenyanyana 2018, eTuynhuys, Kapa.

src: National Budget Speech.
tgt: Mbulavulo wa Mpimanyeto wa Rixaka.

src: Cabinet appreciates the overwhelming confidence expressed in the 2018 National Budget which was tabled in Parliament, Cape Town, last week.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ntshembo lowukulu lowu paluxiweke eka Mpimanyeto wa Rixaka wa 2018 lowu andlariweke ePalamende, Kapa, vhiki leri nga hundza.

src: In the recent spirit of renewal that has gripped our great nation, Cabinet calls on all South Africans to partner with government to grow our economy and create much-needed jobs.
tgt: Eka moya lowu wa ha ku va ka kona wa mpfuxelelo lowu khomeke tiko ra ka hina lero saseka, Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku tirhisana na mfumo ku kurisa ikhonomi ya hina na ku tumbuluxa mitirho leyi dingiwaka swonghasi.

src: The reduction in expenditure of R85 billion over the next three years demonstrates government’s commitment to fiscal consolidation and the prudent allocation of resources to grow the economy.
tgt: Ku hunguteka eka ntirhiso wa timali ta R85 wa tibiliyoni eka malembe manharhu lama taka ku kombisa vutiyimiseri bya mfumo ku hlanganisa swa timali na avelo wa vurhon’wana wa switirhisiwa ku kurisa ikhonomi.

src: The steps announced to slow the pace of debt accumulation and contain the budget deficit greatly improve our fiscal framework and give South Africans confidence in the future prospects of our economy.
tgt: Magoza ya tivisiwile ku hunguta rivilo ra mpfelelo wa xikweleti na ku lawula nkayivelo wa mpimanyeto swinene ku antswisa rimba ra swa timali ta hina na ku nyika MaAfrika-Dzonga ntshembo eka leswi nga humelelaka mikarhi leyi taka swa ikhonomi ya hina.

src: Cabinet is resolute that the interventions will reflect in our country’s economic growth, affirm its economic standing and safeguard its investment grade status.
tgt: Khabinete ya tiboha leswaku miphalalo yi ta kombeta eka ku kula ka ikhonomi ya tiko ra ka hina, yi tiyisisa xiyimo xa rona xa timali na ku sirhelela xiyimo xa rona xa giredi ya vuvekisi.

src: The 2018 National Budget supports the poor in our society through a comprehensive social assistance programme and fee-free tertiary education for students from poor households.
tgt: Mpimanyeto wa Rixaka wa 2018 wu seketela lava sweleke erixakeni ra hina hi ku tirhisa pfhumba ra mpfuneto wa vaaki na dyondzo ya le henhla ya mahala eka swichudeni leswi humaka emitini leyi sweleke.

src: As a response to the concern raised on the Value-Added Tax (VAT) increases proposed, Cabinet is considering expanding the list of basic goods that are zero-rated on VANelson Mandela Centenary.
tgt: Tanihi angulo eka ku khumbeka loku boxiweke eka miengetelo ya Xibalo xa Mixavo (VAT), Khabinete yi le ku langutisiseni ka ku ndlandlamuxa nxaxamelo wa tinhundzu ta masungulo leti nga hakerisiwiki xibalo.

src: Cabinet joins President Cyril Ramaphosa in his call on South Africans to reaffirm a shared commitment to serve people as we continue to celebrate the centenary of the birth of former President Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Khabinete yi tikatsa na Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa eka xirhambo xa yena xa MaAfrika-Dzonga ku tiyisisa hi vuntshwa ku tiboha ka yona ka nhlanganelo ku korhokela vanhu tanihiloko hi ya emahlweni hi tlangela malembexidzana ya ku velekiwa ka khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela.

src: Madiba is the first President of a Democratic South Africa and would have turned 100 years of age on 18 July 2018.
tgt: Madiba i Phuresidente wo sungula wa Afrika-Dzonga ya xidemokirasi naswona a ta va a ri na 100 wa malembe hi vukhale hi siku ra 18 Mawuwani 2018.

src: Madiba is a global icon who is revered worldwide as a Champion of Human Rights, non-racism and non-sexism.
tgt: Madiba i mfungho wa misava loyi a xiximiwaka misava hinkwayo tanihi Nghwazi ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu, loyi a nga yiki hi nghohe na ku va loyi a nga yiki hi rimbewu.

src: He played a critical role in unifying South Africans, and inspiring democratic unity across Africa and the globe.
tgt: U tirhile ntirho wa nkoka swonghasi eka ku hlanganisa MaAfrika-Dzonga, na ku hlohlotela vun’we bya xidemokirasi eAfrika hinkwaro na le misaveni hinkwayo.

src: The first celebration of Nelson Mandela’s centenary took place during the African Union Summit in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia in January 2018.
tgt: Ku tlangeriwa ko sungula ka malembexidzana ya Nelson Mandela ku vile kona hi nkarhi wa Samiti ya Nhlangano wa Afrika eAddis Ababa, Ethiopia hi Sunguti 2018.

src: A number of events will be held throughout the country this year to reflect on the life of Tata Madiba.
tgt: Swiendleko swo tala swi ta endliwa etikweni hinkwaro nan’waka ku ehleketa hi vutomi bya Tatana Madiba.

src: Cabinet calls upon all South Africans to join in the centenary celebrations in their workplaces, schools, churches and civic organisations.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku tikatsa eka mitlangelo ya malembexidzana emitirhweni, eswikolweni, etikerekeni na le ka mihlangano ya vaaki ya vona.

src: It calls on each one of us this year to emulate the values of Nelson Mandela by working in our respective ways to build a united, non-racist, non-sexist and prosperous country.
tgt: Yi rhamba munhu un’wana na un’wana wa hina nan’waka ku encenyeta mikhuvanene ya Nelson Mandela hi ku tirha hi tindlela ta hina ku aka tiko leri nga na vun’we, leri nga yiki hi nghohe, leri nga yiki hi rimbewu na ku va leri humelelaka.

src: The country also celebrates the centenary of one of the great daughters of the African soil Mama Albertina Sisulu, who dedicated her life to fight for the emancipation of women and the liberation of South Africa.
tgt: Nakambe tiko ri tlangela malembexidzana ya yin’wana ya tintombi ta kahle ta tiko ra Afrika Manana Albertina Sisulu, loyi a nyiketeke vutomi bya yena ku lwela ntshunxeko wa vavasati na ntshunxeko wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Cabinet will in the next meeting also outline a programme for the celebration of the Centenary of Mama Albertina Sisulu.
tgt: Khabinete eka nhlengeletano leyi landzelaka yi ta tlhela yi hlamusela nongonoko wa ku tlangela Malembexidzana ya Manana Albertina Sisulu.

src: Drought.
tgt: Dyandza.

src: Cabinet appreciates the relentless efforts made by the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Drought together with stakeholders in all spheres of government and society in dealing with the persistent drought conditions that have hit several parts of the country.
tgt: Khabinete yi khensa matshalatshala lama nga heriki ntamu lama endliweke hi Komiti ya le Xikarhi ka Vaholobye eka Dyandza swin’we na vakhomaxiave eka swiyenge hinkwaswo swa mfumo na rixaka eka ku tirhana na swiyimo swa dyandza leswi phikelelaka leswi hlaseleke swiphemu swi nga ri swingani swa tiko.

src: Apart from the fact that South Africa is a water-scarce country, the effects of global warming continue to affect the rain patterns, thus causing our dam levels to remain low.
tgt: Handle ka ntiyiso wa leswaku Afrika-Dzonga i tiko leri nga na vukali bya mati, switandzhaku swa nkufumelo wa xibakabaka swi ya emahlweni swi khumba manelo ya mpfula, hikwalaho ka sweswo swi vanga mipimo ya madamu ya hina ku tshama yi ri ehansi.

src: The Inter-Ministerial Task Team on Drought continues to facilitate work between national government, provinces and municipalities in all drought-affected areas.
tgt: Xipano xa Ntirho wa le Xikarhi ka Vaholobye eka Dyandza xi ya emahlweni xi humelerisa ntirho exikarhi ka mfumo wa rixaka, swifundzakulu na timasipala eka tindhawu leti khumbekeke hi dyandza hinkwato.

src: This includes implementing short, medium and long-term measures to address and mitigate the potential impact of this drought.
tgt: Leswi swi katsa ku simeka magoza ya nkarhinyana, ya nkarhi wa le xikarhi na wo leha ku lulamisa na ku hunguta ntshikelelo lowu nga vaka kona wa dyandza leri.

src: Government has made funds available to provide short-term assistance to affected provinces.
tgt: Mfumo wu endlile leswaku timali ti kumeka ku nyika mpfuneto wa nkarhinyana eka swifundzakulu leswi khumbekeke.

src: It has provided a relief grant worth R473 million and an additional R6 billion in the 2018/19 financial year to augment water infrastructure in the Western Cape‚ Eastern Cape and Northern Cape.
tgt: Wu nyikile mali ya nhlayiso wo phalala leyi nga na nkoka wa R473 wa timiliyoni na R6 wa tibiliyoni eka lembeximali ra 2018/19 ku engetela swimakiwakulu swa mati eKapa-Vupeladyambu, Kapa-Vuhumadyambu na Kapa-N’walungu.

src: Cabinet calls on all to continue to work with government in conserving water by using it responsibly and sparingly.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba hinkwerhu ku ya emahlweni hi tirhisana na mfumo eka ku hlayisa mati hi ku ya tirhisa hi ndlela ya vutihlamuleri naswona hi matsananatsanana.

src: Cabinet remains committed to making South Africa a country of choice for visitors and potential investors alike.
tgt: Khabinete yi tama ya ha tibohile ku endla Afrika-Dzonga tiko leri nga hlawuriwaka hi vayeni naswona swi tano eka vavekisi lava nga tshukaka va va kona.

src: Police killings.
tgt: Ku dlayeteriwa ka maphorisa.

src: Cabinet expresses condolences to the families and friends of the five police officers and a former soldier who were recently brutally murdered in an attack on the Ngcobo Police Station in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Khabinete yi yisa michavelelo eka mindyangu na vanghana va ntlhanu wa maphorisa na khale ka socha lava va ha ku dlayiwaka hi ndlela ya tihanyi eka nhlaselo wa le Xitichini xa Maphorisa xa Ngcobo eKapa-Vuhumadyambu.

src: Cabinet strongly condemns any senseless killing of our servicemen and women.
tgt: Khabinete yi sola swinene ku dlayeteriwa ku ri hava xivangelo ka vavanuna na vavasati lava hi korhokelaka.

src: The loss of one police officer, soldier or any other person who serves to protect society and our people is unacceptable.
tgt: Ku lahlekeriwa hi phorisa rin’we, socha kumbe munhu wihi kumbe wihi un’wana loyi a tirhaka ku sirhelela rixaka na vanhu va hina a swi amukeleki.

src: Cabinet has committed, through the Minister of Police, to do whatever possible to capacitate our police stations to prevent such attacks in the future.
tgt: Khabinete yi tibohile, hi ku tirhisana na Holobye wa Maphorisa, ku endla xihi kumbe xihi lexi nga kotekaka ku antswisa switichi swa hina swa maphorisa ku sivela mihlaselo yo tano emikarhini leyi taka.

src: Cabinet further appeals to parents and society at large to ensure children are kept safe at all times and to partner with law-enforcement agencies to protect the rights of our children.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela ku ya emahlweni eka vatswari na rixaka hi ku angarhela ku tiyisisa leswaku vana va hlayisiwa hi mikarhi hinkwayo na ku tirhisana na vayimeri vo sindzisa nawu ku sirhelela timfanelo ta vana.

src: Any form of abuse against a child must be exposed and reported immediately.
tgt: Muxaka wihi kumbe wihi wa nxaniso ehenhla ka n’wana wu fanele ku humeseriwa erivaleni na ku mangariwa xikan’wekan’we.

src: By working together, we can keep our communities safe and ensure that criminal elements have no place to hide.
tgt: Hi ku tirhisana, hi nga endla miganga ya ka hina yi tshama yi hlayisekile na ku tiyisisa leswaku vanhu lava endlaka vugevenga va pfumala vutumbelo.

src: Cabinet decisions Cabinet approved the Draft Revised White Paper on National Transport Policy to be published for public comments.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Mpfapfarhuto wa Tirhele leri Pfuxetiweke eka Pholisi Vutleketli ya Rixaka ku va wu kandziyisiwa ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: The policy aims to provide a transport system that is integrated with other related sector plans so as to reduce both the cost of commuting and doing business.
tgt: Pholisi yi na xikongomelo xa ku nyika sisiteme ya vutleketli leyi hlanganisiweke na makungu ya tisekitara tin’wana leti fambelanaka ku hunguta havumbirhi bya madurhelo ya ku khandziya xifambo ku ya entirhweni na ku endla bindzu.

src: It also aligns the country’s transportation plans to the global transportation trends.
tgt: Nakambe yi yelanisa makungu ya vutleketli ya tiko eka mitolovelo ya vutleketli bya misava.

src: Cabinet approved the Green Paper on Roads Policy for South Africa to be published for public comments.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Mpfampfarhuto wo Sungula eka Pholisi ya Magondzo ya Afrika-Dzonga ku va wu kandziyisiwa ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: The policy provides the overarching framework that ensures South Africa’s roads are better managed, safer and include all modes of transport to deliver a sustainable approach to roads management.
tgt: Pholisi leyi yi ta nyika rimba ro angarhela leri ri endlaka leswaku magondzo ya Afrika-Dzonga ya lawuriwa ku antswa, ya va ya hlayisekile swinene na ku katsa tinxaka hinkwayo ta vutleketli ku humelerisa endlelo leri yisekaka emahlweni ra malawulelo ya magondzo.

src: It guides the road regulations, infrastructure, safety, road funding and non- motorised transport.
tgt: Wu lawula swinawana swa le magondzweni, switirhisiwa, vuhlayiseki, ku nyikiwa ka timali ta magondzo na vutleketli lebyi nga fambiki hi njhini.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the findings of the 2015/16 National Survey of Research and Experimental Development (R&D Survey).R&D is an integral part of the country’s socio-economic development.
tgt: Khabinete yi nyikiwile vuxokoxoko hi mikumo ya Mbalango wa Rixaka wa Nhluvukiso wa Nkambisiso na Ndzavisiso (Mbalango wa R&D) wa 2015/16.

src: This has been collective efforts of government, industry and research institutions.
tgt: Lawa ya vile matshalatshala ya nhlanganelo ya mfumo, vumaki na mihlangano ya ndzavisiso.

src: The report is available on the Department of Science and Technology (DST) website: WEBTOKECabinet approved the designs of the 2018 commemorative collector’s coin series, which will be produced by the South African Mint Company.
tgt: Xiviko lexi xa kumeka eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Thekinoloji (DST): WEBTOKEKhabinete yi pasisile tidizayini ta ntlhandlamano wa swingwece swa muhlengeleti swo tsundzuka wa 2018, lowu nga ta humesiwa hi Khamphani ya Mint ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The 2018 designs collection will be celebrating the Nelson Mandela Centenary.
tgt: Nhlengeleto wa tidizayini ta 2018 wu ta va ku tlangela Malembexidzana ya Nelson Mandela.

src: These collections were preceded by the 2017 commemorative coins that celebrated South Africa under the theme of Freedom, Democracy and Cultures.
tgt: Mihlengeleto leyi yi rhangeriwile hi swingwece swo tsundzuka swa 2017 leswi tlangeleke Afrika-Dzonga ehansi ka nkongomelo wa Ntshunxeko, Xidemokirasi na Mifuwo.

src: Bills.
tgt: Milawumbisi.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Customary Initiation Bill of 2018 to Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhumeriwa ka Nawumbisi wa Ngoma ya Xintu wa 2018 ePalamende.

src: The Bill seeks to protect, promote and regulate the governance aspect of the practice of customary WEBTOKEN provides national norms and standards aimed at the protection of life and the prevention of injuries and all forms of abuse experienced by initiates.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu lava ku sirhelela, ku kondletela na ku lawula xiphemu xa mafumelo ya endlelo ra ngoma ya xintu.

src: Cabinet approved for the submission of the National Qualifications Framework Amendment Bill of 2016 to Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhumeriwa ka Nawumbisi-ndzhundzhuluxo wa Rimba ra Mithwaso ya Rixaka wa 2016 ePalamende.

src: The Bill, which amends the National Qualifications Framework Act, 2008 (Act 67 of 2008), strengthens the Act by improving measures to deal with issues of misrepresentation, imposes consequences on persons who misrepresent their qualifications or organisations that issue invalid WEBTOKEN also proposes regulations to ensure that fraudulent qualifications are referred to the relevant professional bodies (database of individuals who misrepresented their qualifications).
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu hundzuluxa Nawu wa Rimba ra Mithwaso wa Rixaka, 2008 (Nawu wa 67 wa 2008), wu tiyisa Nawu hi ku antswisa magoza ya ku tirhana na swiphiqo swa vunwa, wu rhwexa switandzhaku eka vanhu lava va nyikaka mithwaso ya vona ya vuxisi kumbe mihlangano leyi yi nyikaka mithwaso leyi nga riki enawini.

src: It also addresses the accreditation of foreign qualifications.
tgt: Nakambe wu ringanyeta swinawana swa ku tiyisisa leswaku mithwaso ya vuxisi yi kongomisiwa eka tihuvo ta xiphurofexinali leti faneleke (nhlayisa-switiviwa ya vanhu lava va nyikeke mithwaso ya vona ya vuxisi).

src: Cabinet approved the Railway Safety Bill of 2017 to be published for public comments.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Vuhlayiseki bya le Swiporweni wa 2017 ku va wu kandziyisiwa ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: The Bill seeks to improve railway safety and create a governance structure to oversee the work of the Rail Safety Regulator of South Africa.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu lava ku antswisa vuhlayiseki bya le swiporweni na ku tumbuluxa xivumbeko xa mafumelo ku fambisa ntirho wa Vulawuri bya Vuhlayiseki bya le Swiporweni bya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: It is also aligned to the National Rail Policy regarding the strengthening of safety monitoring, and the promotion and enforcement of safety in our railways.
tgt: Nakambe wu yelanisiwe na Pholisi ya Swiporo ya Rixaka hi mayelana na ku tiyisiwa ka vuvekatihlo bya vuhlayiseki, na ntlakuso na nsindziso wa vuhlayiseki eswiporweni swa hina.

src: Cabinet approved for the Draft Economic Regulation of Transport Bill of 2017 to be published for public comments and consultation.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisimpfapfarhutwa wa Vulawuri bya Ikhonomi ya Vutleketli wa 2017 ku va wu kandziyisiwa ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki na ku tihlanganisa na vaaki.

src: The Bill addresses the regulatory and capacity gaps in respect of provision of a cost-effective and efficient transport system.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu lulamisa mavangwa yo lawula na ya vuswikoti hi mayelana na ku nyikiwa ka sisiteme ya vutleketli leyi nga na nxavo lowu pfunaka na ku va wa vuswikoti.

src: South Africa will be hosting the Southern African Development Community Ministers of Labour, Employment and Social Security, as Chair, from 1 to 2 March 2018 at the Cape Town International Convention Centre.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga ri ta va ri rhurhela Vaholobye va Mitirho va Miganga ya Nhluvukiso ya le Dzongeni wa Afrika, Vuthori na Nsirhelelo wa Vanhu, tanihi Mutshamaxitulu, kusuka 1 kufika 2 Nyenyankulu 2018 eCape Town International Convention Centre.

src: The theme of the conference is: “Horizon decent work: Advancing connectivity, coherence and inclusivity”.
tgt: Nkongomelo wa khomferense leyi i: “Kombisa ntirho lowu eneriseka: Ku antswisa ku hlanganisiwa, ntwanano na ku katsa hinkwavo”.

src: Participants will include social partners – organised business, labour and community.
tgt: Vatekaxiave va ta katsa vatirhisani va vaaki – mabindzu lama nga emitlaweni, vatirhi na vaakandhawu.

src: President Ramaphosa in his capacity as the Chair of SADC will undertake consultative visits to Angola, Botswana and Namibia from 2 to 3 March 2018.
tgt: Phuresidente eka xiyimo xa yena tanihi Mutshamaxitulu wa SADC u ta teka tendzo to tihlanganisa ku ya eAngola, Botswana na Namibia kusuka 2 kufika 3 Nyenyankulu 2018.

src: He will be accompanied by the Minister of International Relations and Cooperation Lindiwe Sisulu and Minister of Defence and Military Veterans Nosiviwe Maphisa Nqakula.
tgt: U ta heleketiwa hi Holobye wa Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava na Ntirhisano Lindiwe Sisulu na Holobye wa Vusirheleri na Khale ka Masocha Nosiviwe Maphisa Nqakula.

src: South Africa will co-host the 17th World Conference on Tobacco or Health (WCTOH) from 7 to 9 March 2018 in Cape Town under the theme: “Uniting the World for a Tobacco-free Generation”.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi rhurhela hi ku tirhisana Khomferense ya Misava ya vu17 eka Fole kumbe Rihanyu (WTCOH) kusuka 7 kufika 9 Nyenyankulu 2018 eKapa ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Ku Hlanganisa Misava eka Rixaka ro Pfumala Fole”.

src: This is the first hosting in Africa.
tgt: Lebyi i vurhurhelo byo sungula eAfrika.

src: The WTCOH calls for committed action and provides a platform for governments, civil-society organisations, United Nations agencies, international organisations, health workers and other stakeholders to discuss shared knowledge and experiences, particularly regarding to youth and women who are exposed to tobacco WEBTOKEN the conference contributes towards addressing the National Development Plan’s goals by creating awareness and education on the harmful effects of tobacco use, and the need to intensify tobacco control measures.
tgt: WTCOH yi rhamba goza ro tiboha na ku nyika ndlela eka mifumo, mihlangano ya vaaki lava nga na ntsakelo wun’we, vayimeri va Nhlangano wa Matiko mihlangano ya matiko ya misava, vatirhi va swa rihanyu na vakhomaxiave van’wana ku kanela vutivi na mitokoto ya nhlanganelo, ngopfungopfu hi mayelana na vantshwa na vavasati lava va kumeka eka xiyimo xa ku tirhisiwa ka fole.

src: On the 10 and 11 March the IEC will open the Voting Registration Centres for people to come and register and check their registration details.
tgt: Ku rhurhela khomferense swi hoxa xandla eka ku lulamisa swikongomelokulu swa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso ra Rixaka hi ku tumbuluxa ndzemukiso na dyondzo ya switandzhaku swo vavisa swa ntirhiso wa fole, na xidingo xa ku tiyisa magoza yo lawula fole.

src: Cabinet urges all eligible voters to visit their voting stations to update the voters’ roll in preparation for the 2019 general elections.
tgt: Hi ti 10 na 11 Nyenyankulu IEC yi ta pfula Tisenthara ta Ntsariso wo Vhota leswaku vanhu va ta va ta tsarisa na ku kamba vuxokoxoko bya vona bya ntsariso.

src: Cabinet particularly calls on first-time voters to ensure they participate in their constitutional democratic right to vote by going to register to vote.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza vavhoti lava fikelelaka hinkwavo ku endzela switichi swa vona swo vhotela ku ya pfuxeta nxaxamelo wa vavhoti hi ku lulamisela mihlawulo ya mani na mani ya 2019.

src: This registration weekend is a milestone towards the culmination of a two-year project to obtain the residential addresses of all registered voters.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba ngopfungopfu vavhoti vo sungula ku tiyisisa leswaku va teka xiave eka mfanelo ya vona ya xidemokirasi xa vumbiwa ya ku vhota hi ku ya va ya tsarisela ku vhota.

src: The voting stations will be open between 08:00 and 17:00 to assist new voters to register to vote, and allow registered voters who have relocated to reregister in their correct voting district and update their address details on the voters’ roll.
tgt: Mahelo lama ya vhiki ra ntsariso ya ta va xiendleko xa nkoka lexi nga ta hetelela eka phurojeke ya malembe mambirhi ya ku kuma tikherefu ta vutshamo ta vavhoti hinkwavo lava tsariseke.

src: Messages.
tgt: Mahungu.

src: Cabinet commends all teachers who were honoured at the 18th National Teaching Awards which took place in Johannesburg on Saturday, 17 February 2018.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozele vadyondzisi hinkwavo lava va xiximiweke eka Masagwadi ya ku Dyondzisa ya Rixaka ya vu18 lama veke kona eJoni hi Mugqivela, 17 Nyenyanyana 2018.

src: The awards recognised outstanding teaching and leadership in several categories, including the Nelson Mandela Lifetime Achievement Award and Profssor Kader Asmal Award.
tgt: Masagwadi lama a ya tekela enhlokweni ku dyondzisa na vurhangeri bya xiyimo xa le henhla eka mikhetekanyo yi nga ri yingani, ku katsa na Sagwadi ra Mfikelelo wa Vutomi Hinkwabyo ra Nelson Mandela na Sagwadi ra Phurofesa Kader Asmal.

src: Cabinet conveys its condolences to Deputy Minister Obed Bapela on the loss of his wife Constance Bapela, who served the country as a councillor at the time of her passing.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzise michavelelo ya yona eka Xandla xa Holobye Obed Bapela eka ku lahlekeriwa hi nghamu yakwe Constance Bapela, loyi a tirha tanihi mukhanselara hi nkarhi wa ku hundza ka yena.

src: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in conveying condolences to the family, friends and associates of the political economist and author, ProfJohannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, who passed on at the age of Cabinet congratulates Minister Naledi Pandor on her recognition by Leiden University in the Netherlands as an Oort Honorary Visiting Profssor of Astronomy and Development.
tgt: Khabinete yi tikatsa na Phuresidente Ramaphosa eka ku hundzisa michavelelo eka ndyangu, vanghana na vanakulobye va mutivinkulu wa ikhonomi ya swa tipolitiki tlhelo mutsari, Phurof Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, loyi a hundzeke emisaveni a ri na malembe ya 84 hi vukhale.

src: This is in recognition of the Minister’s extraordinary accomplishment in harnessing science, particularly astronomy, as a tool for global development and societal benefit.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Holobye Naledi Pandor eka ku tekeriwa enhlokweni ka yena hi Yunivhesiti ya Leiden eNetherlands tanihi Xirho xo Xiximiwa xa Phurofesa yo Endzela ya Ntivotinyeleti na Nhluvukiso.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Leswi i ku tekeriwa enhlokweni ka mifikelelo loku nga tolovelekangiki ka Holobye eka ku endla leswaku sayense yi tirhiseka ku humesa eneji, ngopfungopfu, ntivotinyeleti, tanihi xitirho xa nhluvukiso wa misava na mbuyelo wa rixaka.

src: Ms Lerato Matabogeas Deputy Director-General (DDG): Tradeand Investment South Africa, Department of Trade and Industry (the dti).
tgt: Man Lerato Mataboge tanihi Xandla xa Mulawuri-Jenerali (DDG): Mabindzu na Vuvekisi bya Afrika-Dzonga, Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki (dti).

src: Ms Shandokane Evelyn Masotjaas DDG: Consumer and Corporate Regulation, the dti.
tgt: Man Shandokane Evelyn Masotja tanihi DDG: Vulawuri bya Vatirhisi na Tikhamphani, dti.

src: Ms Vuyelwa Vumendlini as DDG: International and Regional Economic Policy, National Treasury.
tgt: Man Vuyelwa Vumendlini tanihi DDG: Pholisi ya Ikhonomi ya Matiko ya Misava na ya Xifundza, Nkwama wa Timali wa Rixaka.

src: Mr Joseph Tebogo Leshope as Chief Operations Officer of SENTECMs Vuyo Zitumane as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Amatola Water.
tgt: Tat Joseph Tebogo Leshope tanihi Muofisirinkulu wa Matirhelo wa SENTECMan Vuyo Zitumane tanihi Muofisirinkulu wa Matirhelo (CEO) wa Amatola Water.

src: Adv Seeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele as Chief Ombud of the Community Schemes Ombud Service.
tgt: Adv Seeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele tanihi Mulavisisinkulu wa Swivilelo wa Vukorhokeri bya Vulavisisi bya Swivilelo swa Swikimi swa Vaakandhawu.

src: Mr Edward Mamadise as CEO of the National Regulator for Compulsory Specifications.
tgt: Tat Edward Mamadise tanihi CEO wa Mulawuri wa Rixaka wa Swikoxometo Leswi Bohaka.

src: Dr Sagren Moodley as the representative from the DST on the South African Council for Natural Scientific Profssions.
tgt: Dok Sagren Moodley tanihi muyimeri wo huma eka DST eka Khansele ya Tiphurofexini ta Sayense ya swa Ntumbuluko ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Reappointments to the Patent Examination Board:a. Ms Shanaaz Tiry Mahomedb.
tgt: Lava thoriweke hi vuntshwa eka Bodo ya Swikambelo swa Tiphetente:a.

src: Ms Sandra Cleilandc.
tgt: Man Shanaaz Tiry Mahomedb.

src: ProfChristiena Maria van der Bank andd.
tgt: Man Sandra Cleilandc.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 14 March 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape TownIssues in the environment.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 14 Nyenyankulu 2018, eTuynhuys, eKapaXiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.

src: Economic growth.
tgt: Ku kula ka ikhonomi.

src: Cabinet welcomes the 1.3% growth in the economy in 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela 1.3% ya ku kula ka ikhonomi hi 2017.

src: This is an increase from 0.3% in 2016.
tgt: Loku i ku tlakuka kusuka eka 0.3% hi 2016.

src: The performance of the economy under difficult conditions bodes well for the country’s future economic prospects.
tgt: Matirhelo ya ikhonomi ehansi ka swiyimo leswo tika ya tshembisa leswinene eka mikoteko ya nkarhi lowu taka ya tiko.

src: The growth figures signal that the economy is on an upward trajectory, with National Treasury expecting the economy to expand by 1.5% this year and accelerate to 2.1% in 2020.
tgt: Tinhlayo ta ku kula ti komba leswaku ikhonomi yi le ka mafambelo lama yaka ehenhla, laha Nkwama wa Timali wa Rixaka wu langutelaka ikhonomi ku ndlandlamuka hi 1.5% nyan’waka na ku engetela kufika eka 2.1% hi 2020.

src: Cabinet calls on all sectors of society to build on the positive momentum of 2017, and work with government to translate its plans into concrete action to sustain economic growth and create jobs.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba tisekithara hinkwato ta rixaka ku aka ehenhla ka nkhinkhi lowunene wa 2017, na ku tirhisana na mfumo ku hundzuluxela makungu ya wona ya va xiendlo xo khomeka ku hlayisa ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxa mitirho.

src: Land reform Cabinet welcomes the adopted motion to amend the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 so as to allow for the expropriation of land without compensation.
tgt: Mpfuxeto wa Misava Khabinete yi amukela kungu leri amukeriweke ku hundzuluxa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ya Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996 ku endlela ku pfumelela ku tlherisiwa ka vun’winyi bya misava ku ri hava ndziriso.

src: Government has since 1994 worked hard to reverse the legacy of land dispossession under colonialism and apartheid.
tgt: Kusukela hi 1994 Mfumo wu tirhile hi matimba ku tlherisela endzhaku ndzhaka ya ku tekeriwa vun’winyi bya misava ehansi ka mfumo wa xikoloni na wa xihlawuhlawu.

src: Working within the law, government has done much to ensure the continued productivity of the land, while speeding up the process of redress for those affected by land dispossessions.
tgt: Ku ri karhi ku tirhiwa hi ku landzelela nawu, mfumo wu endlile swo tala ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na ntshovelo lowu yaka emahlweni wa misava, loko ku ri karhi ku hatlisisiwa endlelo ra ndzulamiso eka lava khumbekaka hi ku tekeriwa vun’winyi bya misava.

src: The matter has been referred to the Constitutional Review Committee, which must report back to Parliament by 30 August 2018.
tgt: Mhaka leyi yi kongomisiwile eka Komiti ya Nkambisiso wa Vumbiwa, leyi yi faneleke ku vuyisa xiviko ePalamende hi kwalomu ka 30 Mhawuri 2018.

src: The recommendations to the National Assembly will be informed by a series of public hearings followed by committee meetings.
tgt: Swibumabumelo eka Huvo ya Rixaka swi ta leteriwa hi ntlhandlamano wa tinhlengeletano to twa miehleketo ya vaaki leti nga ta landzeriwa hi tinhlengeletano ta komiti.

src: Cabinet calls on all stakeholders to make their input during this process of engagement, which will guide the solutions to take our country forward.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba lava khumbhekaka hinkwavo ku nyika vonelo ra vona hi nkarhi wa endlelo lera mbulavurisano, leri ri nga ta letela switshunxo ku yisa tiko ra ka hina emahlweni.

src: As a caring and people-centred government, all stakeholders will be engaged during this process.
tgt: Tanihi mfumo lowu hlayisaka na ku va wu simekiwe eka vanhu, lava khumbhekaka hinkwavo va ta vulavurisana hi nkarhi wa endlelo leri.

src: Cabinet further urges communities to desist from illegal land invasions.
tgt: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi khutaza vaakandhawu ku sukela ku phanga misava loku nga riki enawini.

src: We are a law-abiding and peace-loving country with adequate mechanisms of dealing with issues, including the land issue.
tgt: Hi tiko leri landzelelaka nawu na ku va ro rhandza ku rhula leri nga na maendlelo yo ringanela ku tirhana na swiphiqo, ku katsa na xiphiqo xa misava.

src: South Africa remains open for business, and investments in agriculture and farming are welcomed.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi tshama yi pfulekile eka bindzu, naswona vuvekisi eka vurimi na vufuwi bya amukeriwa.

src: It is in South Africa's interests to have commercial farmers and this process can ensure we have even greater numbers of successful commercial farmers.
tgt: Swi vuyerisa Afrika-Dzonga ku va na vafuwi va xibindzu naswona endlelo leri ri endla leswaku hi va na tinhlayo letikulu ta vafuwi va xibindzu lava humelelaka.

src: Nofingxana community’s Double Drift Wildlife Economy Project.
tgt: Phurojeke ya Ikhonomi ya Swiharhi na Swimilana swa Nhova ya Double Drift ya muganga wa ka Nofingxana.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Nofingxana community’s Double Drift Wildlife Economy Project, at Double Drift Nature Reserve in the Eastern Cape by the Minister of Environmental Affairs, Dr Edna Molewa.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Phurojeke ya Ikhonomi ya Swiharhi na Swimilana swa Nhova ya Double Drift ya muganga wa ka Nofingxana eka Ntanga wa Ntumbuluko wa Double Drift eKapa-Vuxa hi Holobye wa Timhaka ta Mbango, Dok Edna Molewa.

src: This included the handing over of the title deed to the Likhaya Lethu Communal Property Association (CPA) on behalf of the Minister of Rural Development and Land Reform, Ms Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.
tgt: Leswi swi katse ku nyikiwa ka papila ra vun’winyi eka Likhaya Lethu Communal Property Association (CPA) hi ku yimela Holobye wa Nhluvukiso wa Matikoxikaya na Antswiso wa Misava, Man Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.

src: The Double Drift community was dispossessed of the residential and grazing rights by the 1913 Land Act.
tgt: Muganga wa Double Drift a wu tekeriwile timfanelo ta vutshamo na madyelo ya swifuwo hi Nawu wa Misava wa 1913.

src: In 1994, this community lodged a land claim that was settled in 2012, resulting in Likhaya Lethu CPA being established.
tgt: Hi 1994, muganga lowu wu nghensile xikoxo xa misava lexi tshamisekisiweke hi 2012, leswi heteleleke eka Likhaya Lethu CPA ku va yi tumbuluxiwa.

src: The Likhaya Lethu CPA consists of 1 500 Double Drift Community members and received R6 million from the Department of Environmental Affairs to develop a wildlife economic business venture in the farm Naudeshoek (1 400 hectares).
tgt: Likhaya Lethu CPA yi vumbiwa 1 500 wa swirho swa Muganga wa Double Drift naswona yi kumile R6 wa timiliyoni kusuka eka Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Mbango ku hluvukisa ndzingeto wa bindzu ra ikhonomi ya swiharhi na swimilana swa nhova epurasini ra Naudeshoek (1 400 wa tihekitara).

src: The transaction was processed through the Department of Rural Development and Land Reform.
tgt: Nxaviselano lowu wu tirhiwile hi Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Matikoxikaya na Antswiso wa Misava.

src: Cabinet has noted the South African Reserve Bank announcement with regard to the VBS Mutual Bank.
tgt: Bangi ya Nhlanganelo ya VBKhabinete hi tekerile enhlokweni xitiviso xa Bangikulu ya Afrika-Dzonga hi mayelana na Bangi ya Nhlanganelo ya VBVufambisi lebyi thoriweke byi ta seketela Bangi ya Nhlanganelo ya VBS ku tshamisekisa mitlhontlho ya makumelo ya timali na ku korhokela mitsakelo ya vaaki na vadipoziti va VBKhabinete yi tama ya ha tibohe eka ku hambanisa na ku cinca ka sekithara leya swa timali ku ri hava ku nghenisiwa ekhombyeni ka ntsakelo wa vadipoziti.

src: Investment campaign.
tgt: Pfhumba ra vuvekisi.

src: Cabinet welcomes the ‘CEOs Know’ campaign by Brand South Africa, in collaboration with Business Leadership South Africa, to promote South Africa as an investment destination.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela pfhumba ra ‘CEOs Know” hi Ejensi ya Swimakiwa swa Afrika-Dzonga, hi ku tirhisana na Nhlangano wa Vurhangeri bya Mabindzu bya Afrika-Dzonga, ku tlakusa Afrika-Dzonga tanihi ndhawu ya vuvekisi.

src: This builds on our world-class infrastructure through InvestSA One-Stop Shop, research and development capabilities, innovation and an established manufacturing base to support investors.
tgt: Leswi swi aka ehenhla ka swimakiwakulu swa ka hina tlilasi ya misava hi ku tirhisa Vhengele leri nga na Hinkwaswo ra InvestSA, vuswikoti bya ndzavisiso na nhluvukiso, maendlelo lamantshwa na tshaku ra vuendli leri tumbuluxiweke ku seketela vavekisi.

src: New growth areas have also been opened in the oceans economy, renewable energy, the green economy and shale-gas exploration.
tgt: Tindhawu ta ku kula letintshwa na tona ti pfuriwile eka ikhonomi ya malwandle, eneji leyi pfuxetekaka, ikhonomi ya swa rihlaza na mbalango wa xeli-gasi.

src: The campaign features CEOs from multinational corporations based in South Africa sharing their insights on continued investment in South Africa.
tgt: Pfhumba leri ri katsa tiCEO to huma eka tikhaphani letikulu leti nga eka matikonyingi leti kumekaka eAfrika-Dzonga ku avelana mitwisiso ya tona eka vuvekisi lebyi yaka emahlweni eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Cabinet encourages all South Africans in the spirit of “Thuma Mina” (Send Me) sweeping across our nation to play their part by sharing their positive stories to build our country’s reputation and grow its investment appeal.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza Maafrika-Dzonga hinkwavo hi moya wa “Thuma Mina” (Rhuma Mina) lowu hungaka etikweni hinkwaro ku tirha xiphemu xa vona hi ku rungulelana switori leswinene ku aka vito lerinene ra tiko ra ka hina na ku kurisa xikombelo xa rona xa vuvekisi.

src: Independent Power Producers (IPPs) Procurement Programme.
tgt: Nongonoko wa Maxavelo ya Vahumesi va Eneji lava Tiyimeleke (tiIPP).

src: Cabinet has noted the High Court case filed by two non-governmental organisations regarding government’s decision to sign the power purchase agreements with 27 IPPs.
tgt: Khabinete yi tekerile enhlokweni leswaku nandzu wa Khoto ya le Henhla lowu nghenisiweke hi mihlangano leyi nga riki ya mfumo yimbirhi hi mayelana na xiboho xa mfumo xa ku sayina mitwanano ya ku xava eneji na 27 wa tiIPNandzu lowu wu ta gimetiwa hi Khoto ya le Henhla hi siku ra 27 Nyenyankulu 2018.

src: In the spirit of constitutionalism and the rule of law, the signing has been postponed.
tgt: Hi moya wa matirhelo ya vumbiwa na mfumo wa nawu, ku sayiniwa ku tlheriseriwile endzhaku.

src: Cabinet affirms the commitment to resolve the matters around these programmes.
tgt: Khabinete yi tiyisisa vutiboheleri bya yona ku ololoxa timhaka leti fambelanaka na minongonoko leyi.

src: The Renewable Energy Independent Power Producer Procurement Programme will ensure that consumers in our country have access to cost-efficient and clean energy, and will bring much-needed investment in South Africa.
tgt: Nongonoko wa Maxavelo ya Vahumesi va Eneji lava Tiyimeleke wa Eneji leyi Pfuxetekaka wu ta tiyisisa leswaku vatirhisi lava nga etikweni ra ka hina va va na mifikelelo lowu madurhelo lama fambelanaka na tihakelo na eneji yo basa, naswona wu ta tisa vuvekisi lebyi dingekaka swinene eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: These projects will provide 61 600 full-time jobs, 95% of which are for South African citizens, specifically targeting the youth.
tgt: Tiphurojeke leti ti ta nyika 61 600 ya mitirho ya nkarhi hinkwawo, 95% ta yona yi nga ya vaakatiko va Afrika-Dzonga, ngopfungopfu ku ri karhi ku pakanisiwa eka vantshwa.

src: Cabinet reaffirms its commitment to a solid public-private partnership as we pursue our energy transition objectives of the future and a better life for all.
tgt: Khabinete yi tiyisisa hi vuntshwa vutiboheleri bya yona eka xinakulobye xa mfumo na lexi nga ri nga riki xa mfumo tanihiloko hi landzelela swikongomelo swa hina swa ncinco wa eneji swa nkarhi lowu taka na vutomi byo antswa bya hinkwavo.

src: This is needed to bring much-needed policy and regulatory certainty, and maintain South Africa’s position as an energy investment destination of choice.
tgt: Leswi swa laveka ku tisa pholisi leyi dingekaka swinene na ntiyisiso wo lawula, na ku hlayisa xiyimo xa Afrika-Dzonga tanihi ndhawu leyi nga hlawuriwaka ya vuvekisi bya eneji.

src: Listeriosis.
tgt: Listeriosis.

src: Cabinet extends its heartfelt condolences to the friends and family of those who lost their lives after contracting Listeriosis, and wishes those who are recuperating a speedy recovery.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzisa nchavelelo wa yona wo huma embilwini eka vanghana na ndyangu wa lavaya va lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya vona endzhaku ka ku khomiwa hi Listeriosis, naswona yi navelela lavaya va nga ku antsweni ku hola hi ku hatlisa.

src: More than 180 people died and 940 cases were reported in South Africa.
tgt: Kutlula 180 wa vanhu va lovile naswona 940 wa timhangu ti vikiwile eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Cabinet is encouraged by the intensive efforts by the Department of Health, the National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD) and the World Health Organisation to stop the listeria bacteria from spreading.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaziwa hi matshalatshala ya matimba hi Ndzawulo ya Rihanyu, Vandla ra Mavabyi yo Tlulela ra Rixaka (NICD) na Nhlangano wa Rihanyu wa Misava ku yimisa xitsongwatsongwana xa listeria ku va xi hangalaka.

src: To further strengthen these efforts, the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, will meet with the South African Nursing Council on Thursday, 15 March 2018.
tgt: Ku tiyisa matshalatshala lama, Holobye wa Rihanyu, Dok Aaron Motsoaledi, u ta hlangana na Huvo ya Vuongori ya Afrika-Dzonga hi Ravumune, 15 Nyenyankulu 2018.

src: Cabinet acknowledges that the positive progress made in identifying and isolating the source of the deadly Listeriosis outbreak.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ndzima leyinene leyi khatsiweke eka ku kuma na ku hambanisa xihlovo xa ku tumbuluka ka Listeriosis leyi nga na khombo swinene.

src: The subsequent recall of food products from three Enterprise and Rainbow meat processing plants – where the bacteria was found – was a defining moment to stop the outbreak.
tgt: Ku vitaniwa ku tlheriseriwa endzhaku ka swimakiwa swa swakudya kusuka eka tipulanti to phurosesa nyama tinharhu ta Enterprise na Rainbow – laha xitsongwatsongwana xi kumekeke kona – a xi ri xiendleko lexi paluxeke muxaka wa ku tumbuluka loku.

src: The food-borne disease was first identified in June 2017.
tgt: Vuvabyi lebyi tumbulukaka eka swakudya byi kumekile ro sungula hi Khotavuxika 2017.

src: Listeriosis is a serious and preventable illness that can be treated successfully with antibiotics.
tgt: Listeriosis i vuvabyi byo tivikana na ku va lebyi sivelekaka lebyi nga tshunguriwaka hindlela leyi humelelaka hi swilwisaswitsongwatsongwana.

src: Those most at risk are pregnant women, very young infants, elderly persons and people with a weakened immune system.
tgt: Lavaya va nga enxungetweni swinene i vayimana, tincece letitsongo swinene, vadyuhari na vanhu lava sisiteme ya vona ya nsawuto yi tsaneke.

src: People who show symptoms of fever, muscle aches, nausea or diarrhoea should visit their medical practitioner or local clinic immediately.
tgt: Vanhu lava va kambaka swikombeto swa ku hisa ka miri, ku pandza ka mipfimbi, ku hlambiwa hi timbilu kumbe nchuluko va fanele ku ya eka mutirhi wa vona wa swa vutshunguri kumbe etliliniki ya le mugangeni xikan’wekan’we.

src: Cabinet is optimistic that South Africa will defeat the current outbreak and urges all people to observe the five food safety rules during this time:Wash hands with soap and water before handling food, and after using a bathroomCook food thoroughly and do not eat half-cooked food as the Listeria bacteria will die when food is well cookedDo not handle raw and cooked food togetherKeep food at appropriate temperatures andMake sure that all milk products are pasteurised or at least parboiled and wash non-cooked food with clean running water before ingestion or at least with pre-boiled water.
tgt: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi ta hlula ku tumbuluka ka nkarhi wa sweswi naswona yi khutaza vanhu hinkwavo ku landzelela milawu ya vuhlayiseki bya swakudya leya ntlhanu hi nkarhi lowu:Hlamba swandla hi xisibi na mati u nga si khoma swakudya, na le ndzhaku ka ku tirhisa xihambukeloSweka swakudya swinene naswona u nga dyi swakudya leswi nga swekiwa hafu tanihileswi xitsongwatsongwana xa listeria xi nga ta fa loko swakudya swi swekiwa swineneU nga khomakhomi swakudya swimbisi na leswi swekiweke swin’weHlayisa swakudya eka mahiselo lama faneleke, naswonaTiyisisa leswaku swimakiwa swa masi hinkwaswo swi xuviwile kumbe swi virisiwile nkarhinyana naswona hlantswa swakudya leswi nga swekiwangiki hi mati ya phayiphi yo tenga u nga si swi dya kumbe hi mati lama nga rhanga ya virisiwa.

src: Those with any uncertainty related to Listeriosis may contact the NICD on 011 386 Social grants.
tgt: Lavaya va nga na ku kanakana kwihi kumbe kwhi loku fambelanaka na Listeriosis va nga ha tihlanganisa na NICD eka 011 386 Timali ta nhlayiso wa vaaki.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the state of readiness by the South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) to provide the hybrid model in the distribution of social grants to beneficiaries on 1 April 2018.
tgt: Khabinete yi nyikiwile vuxokoxoko hi xiyimo xa malunghekelo ya Ejensi ya Timali ta Nhlayiso wa Vaaki ya Afrika-Dzonga (SASSA) ku nyika xivumbeko xa mpfangano eka ku holeriwa ka timali ta nhlayiso eka vavuyeriwa hi siku ra ti1 Dzivamisoko 2018.

src: This is in line with the Constitutional Court (ConCourt) judgement that ordered the extension of the current contract with the Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) up until 31 March 2018.
tgt: Leswi swi fambisana na xiboho xa Khoto ya Vumbiwa (Concourt) lexi xi leriseke ku engeteriwa ka kontiraka ya nkarhi wa sweswi na Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) kufika ti 31 Nyenyankulu 2018.

src: The current SASSA cards remain valid until December 2018.
tgt: Yi enerisekile leswaku vavuyeriwa va ta holeriwa hi siku ra 1 Dzivamisoko 2018.Makhadi ya SASSA ya nkarhi wa sweswi ya tama ya ha ri enawini kufikela hi N’wendzamhala 2018.

src: The process of changing the beneficiary cards will be done in a seamless manner that will not disrupt the payment of grants.
tgt: Endlelo ra ku cinca makhadi ya vavuyeriwa ri ta endliwa hi mukhuva lowu nga riki na swiphiqo lowu nga kavanyetiki ku hakeriwa ka timali ta nhlayiso.

src: All beneficiaries who receive their grants through their respective paypoints which includes commercial banks, South African Post Office (SAPO) and other retailers.
tgt: Vavuyeriwa hinkwavo va ta kuma timali ta vona ta nhlayiso etindhawini ta vona to hakela leti va kumekaka eka tona leti ti katsaka tibangi ta xibindzu, Hofisi ya Poso ya Afrika-Dzonga (SAPO) na vaxavisi van’wana.

src: All beneficiaries who receive their grants through their respective paypoints which includes commercial banks, South Post Office and other retailers.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba lava va nga riki na makhadi ya bangi ku endzela marhavi ya SAPO ya le kusuhi na vona ku ya pfula tiakhawunti ta vona.

src: Cabinet calls on those who do not have bank accounts to visit their nearest SAPO branches to open their accounts.
tgt: Khabinete yi lerisile SASSA, xikan’we na Vufambisi bya Mfumo bya Vuhlanganisi na Mahungu (GCIS), ku endla hinkwaswo leswi nga kotekaka ku tivisa vavuyeriwa hinkwavo hi ku cinca loku nga tshukaka ku va kona kwihi kumbe kwihi loku nga ha vaka kona eka endlelo ra ncinco kusuka eka CPS kuya eka xivumbeko xa mpfangano lowuntshwa.

src: Cabinet has instructed the SASSA, together with the Government Communication and Information System (GCIS), to do everything possible to inform all the beneficiaries of any possible changes that may take place in the process of transition from CPS to the new hybrid model.
tgt: Khabinete yi tama ya ha tibohile ku tiyisisa leswaku yi landzelela xiboho xa Khoto ya Vumbiwa.

src: Cabinet remains committed to ensuring government adheres to the ConCourt judgement.
tgt: Tihofisi ta SASSA ti ta va ti pfurile na ku va ti lunghekile ku tirhana na swikombelo leswintshwa.

src: Cabinet urges all members of the public, especially beneficiaries and their families, to contact SASSA on 0800 60 10 11 or visit their nearest SASSA office for more information.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza vaaki hinkwavo, ngopfungopfu vavuyeriwa na mindyangu ya ka vona, ku tihlanganisa na SASSA eka 0800 60 10 11 kumbe va endzela hofisi ya SASSA ya le kusuhi ku kuma vuxokoxoko hi xitalo.

src: Voter registration.
tgt: Ntsariso wa vavhoti.

src: Cabinet joins the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) and President Cyril Ramaphosa in thanking all South Africans who heeded the call to register to vote or to update their address details in the past weekend’s voter registration drive.
tgt: Khabinete yi tikatsa na Khomixini ya Mihlawulo leyi Tiyimelaka (IEC) na Phuresidente Ramaphosa eka ku khensa Maafrika-Dzonga lava va xiximeke xirhambo xa ku tsarisa ku vhota na ku pfuxeta vuxokoxoko bya vona bya tiadirese eka pfhumba ra ntsariso wa vavhoti ra mahelo ya vhiki lama nga hundza.

src: This is a milestone in preparation for the sixth national and provincial elections expected to take place in 2019.
tgt: Lexi i xiendleko xa nkoka eka lulamisela mihlawulo ya rixaka na ya swifundzakulu leyi languteriwaka ku va kona hi 2019.

src: A total of 2 767 139 citizens visited voting stations over the past weekend.
tgt: Ntsengo wa vaakatiko va 2 767 139 va endzerile switichi swo vhotela eka mahelo ya vhiki lama nga hundza.

src: Of the 2.76 million plus voters who visited their voting stations:Just over million re-registered in their current voting districtMore than 800 000 changed their registration to a new voting districtAlmost 500 000 were voters registering for the first timeOf the new votes registrations, 82% were under the age of 30 and approximately 54% were womenGauteng saw the most new registrations at 23.69%, followed by KwaZulu-Natal with 18.78% and Limpopo with 17.03%.
tgt: Eka timiliyoni ta 2.76 ku katsa na muvhoti na vavhoti lava va endzeleke switichi swa vona swo vhotela:Ehenhlanyana ka miliyoni yi.3 va tsarisile hi vuntshwa eka xifundza xa ka vona xo vhotela xa nkarhi wa sweswiKutlula 800 000 va cincile ntsariso wa vona ku ya eka xifundza xo vhotela lexintshwaKwalomu ka 500 000 a ku ri vavhoti lava a va tsarisa ro sungulaEka mitsariso ya vavhoti lavantshwa, 82% a ku ri va le hansi ka 30 wa malembe hi vukhale naswona kwalomu ka 54% a ku ri vaxisatiGauteng yi vile na mitsariso leyintshwa yo tala eka hinkwayo yi ri eka 23.69%, yi landzeriwa hi KwaZulu-Natal yi ri na 18.78% na Limpopo yi ri na 17.03%.

src: The Eastern Cape had the highest level of registration at 87%, followed by the Free State at just over 82%, and KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo and Northern Cape at 79% respectively.
tgt: Kapa-Vuxa yi vile na mpimo wa le henhla eka hinkwayo wa ntsariso eka 87%, yi landzeriwa hi Free State yi ri ehenhlanyana ka 82%, na KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo na Kapa-N’walungu eka 79% hi ku landzelelana.

src: Gauteng’s overall registration was at 67.3%.
tgt: Ntsariso hinkwawo wa Gauteng a wu ri eka 67.3%.

src: The IEC reported that the voters’ roll now stands at 26 250 939 voters, which roughly equates to 75% of the eligible voting population, based on Statistics South Africa’s voting age population estimates.
tgt: IEC yi vike leswaku nxaxamelo wa vavhoti wu yime eka 26 250 939 ta vavhoti, leswi hi ku katsakanya swi ringana na 75% ta rixaka ra vavhoti lava fikelelaka, hi ku ya hi mikumbetelo ya vukhale bya malembe ya ku vhota ya Nhlangano wa Tinhlayonhlayo wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: About 300 000 citizens who visited voting stations are among the almost million voters for whom the IEC did not have an address going into the weekend.
tgt: Kwalomu ka 300 000 ya vaakatiko lava va endzeleke switichi swo vhotela va le ka vavhoti va kwalomu ka timiliyoni ta lava IEC a yi nga ri na adirese ya vona loko ku yiwa eka mahelo lama ya vhiki.

src: An up-to-date and accurate voters’ roll affirms the credibility of the voters’ roll and strengthens our democracy by ensuring free, fair and credible elections.
tgt: Nxaxamelo wa vavhoti lowu pfuxetiweke na ku va wa nkhaqato wu tiyisisa vutshembeki bya nxaxamelo wa vavhoti na ku tiyisisa xidemokirasi xa hina hi ku endla leswaku ku va na mihlawulo yo tshunxeka, leyinene na ku va leyi tshembekaka.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans who were not able to visit their local voting station over the past weekend to visit their local IEC office to verify and update their addresses.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba Maafrika-Dzonga hinkwawo lava a va nga koti ku endzela xitichi xo vhotela xa le mugangeni wa ka vona hi mahelo ya vhiki lama nga hundza ku endzela hofisi ya IEC ya le migangeni ya ka vona ku ya tiyisisa na ku pfuxeta tiadirese ta vona.

src: Alternatively, the IEC’s online facility at WEBTOKEN and the app remains available 24 hours a day for registered votes to check and update their address details.
tgt: Ndlela yin’wana, xitirhisiwa xa le ka Inthanete eka WEBTOKEN naswona xitirhisiwa lexi xi tshama xi ri karhi xi kumeka 24 wa tiawara hi siku eka tivhoti lava tsariseke ku kamba na ku pfuxeta vuxokoxoko bya vona bya tiadirese.

src: Well wishes for triathlete Mhlengi Gwala.
tgt: Ku navelela leswinene eka xitsutsumi xa swiphemu swinharhu Mhlengi Gwala.

src: Cabinet joins the Minister of Sport and Recreation, Ms Thokozile Xasa, in denouncing the barbaric act of violence against a young triathlete, Mhlengi Gwala, who was attacked with a chainsaw while cycling in KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Khabinete yi tikatsa na Holobye wa Mitlangu na Vuhungasi, Man Thokozile Xasa, eka ku sola xiendlo xa tihanyi xa madzolonga ehenhla ka xitsutsumi lexitsongo xa swiphemu swinharhu, Mhlengi Gwala, lexi xi hlaseriweke hi sahu ya nketani loko xi ri karhi xi chovha xikanyakanya eKwaZulu-Natal.

src: Cabinet wishes the athlete a speedy recovery and extends a warm thank you to the medical team of St Augustine Hospital who are caring for him.
tgt: Khabinete yi navelela xitsutsumi lexi ku hola hi ku hatlisa na ku rhumela xikhenso eka xipano xa vutshunguri xa Xibedhlele xa St Augustine lexi nga eku xi ongoleni.

src: Crime has no place in our society and Cabinet calls on communities to work together with law-enforcement agencies to bring the criminals to book.
tgt: Vugevenga byi hava ndhawu erixakeni ra ka hina naswona Khabinete yi rhamba vaakandhawu ku tirhisana na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu leswaku swigevenga swi tisiwa eku xupuriweni.

src: Drought declared a national disaster.
tgt: Dyandza ri tivisiwa tanihi mhangu ya rixaka.

src: Under the leadership of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs Minister Zweli Mkhize, government has declared a national state of disaster to deal with the country’s drought and water crisis.
tgt: Ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Holobye wa Mafumelo ya Ntirhisano na Timhaka ta Ndhavuko Zweli Mkhize, mfumo wu tivisile xiyimo xa mhangu ya rixaka lexi xi tirhanaka na dyandza na xirilo xa mati xa tiko.

src: Cabinet extends its appreciation to those in South Africa who continue to save water and the relentless efforts made by the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Drought, together with stakeholders in all spheres of government and society, in dealing with the persistent drought conditions that have hit several parts of the country.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzisa xikhenso xa yona eka lavaya eAfrika-Dzonga va yaka emahlweni va hlayisa mati na matshalatshala lama nga heriki ntamu lama endliwaka hi Komiti ya le Xikarhi ka Tindzawulo to Hambana eka Dyandza, xikan’we na lava khumbhekaka lava nga le ka swiyenge hinkwaswo swa mfumo na le rixakeni, eka ku tirhana na swiyimo swa dyandza leswi phikelelaka leswi swi hlaseleke swiphemu swo hambanahambana swa tiko.

src: Apart from the fact that South Africa is a water-scarce country, Cabinet is assured that we remain a preferred choice of destination for tourists.
tgt: Hambileswi ku nga na ntiyiso wa leswaku Afrika-Dzonga i tiko leri nga na vukali bya mati, Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku hi tama ha ha ri xihlawuriwa lexi tsakeriwaka xa ndhawu yo endzela ya vupfhumba.

src: Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Swiboho swa Khabinete.

src: Cabinet approved that the Agreement Amending Annex 1 (Cooperation on Investment) of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Protocol on Finance and Investment (FIP) be tabled in Parliament for ratification.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Xiengetelwa xo Hundzuluxa Ntwanano xa 1 (Ntirhisano eka Vuvekisi) xa Phurotokholo eka Timali na Vuvekisi (FIP) ya Matiko ya Nhluvukiso ya le Dzongeni wa Afrika (SADC) ku va xi andlariwa ePalamende ku ya pfumeleriwa.

src: The purpose of the FIP is to harmonise financial and investment policies of Member States, so that they are consistent with the objectives of the SADThis will ensure that any changes to financial and investment policies in one Member State does not necessitate undesirable adjustments in other Member States.
tgt: Xikongomelo xa FIP i ku fambelanisa tipholisi ta swa timali na vuvekisi ta Mifumo leyi nga Swirho, ku endlela leswaku ti fambisana na swikongomelo swa SADLeswi swi ta tiyisisa leswaku ku cinca kwihi kumbe kwihi eka tipholisi ta swa timali na vuvekisi eka Mfumo wun’we lowu nga Xirho ku nga endli leswaku ku va na ku cincanyana loku nga naveriwiki eka Mifumo yin’wana leyi nga Swirho.

src: The amendments aim to preserve the right of governments to regulate in the public interest, and to balance the rights and obligations of investors and governments.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi na xikongomelo xa ku hlayisa mfanelo ya mifumo ku lawula hindlela leyi nga ta vuyerisa vaaki, na ku ringanisa timfanelo na miboheko ya vavekisi na mifumo.

src: Cabinet approved the tabling of the Revised and Renamed United Nations (UN) Standard Minimum Rules for the Treatment of Prisoners (“Nelson Mandela Rules”), in Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku andlariwa ka Milawu ya Mpimohansi leyi Tirhisiwaka ya Nhlangano wa Vun’we bya Tinxaka ta Matiko (UN) leyi Pfuxetiweke na ku Tshuriwa hi Vuntshwa ya Makhomelo ya Vakhotsiwa (“Milawu ya Nelson Mandela”), ePalamende.

src: The renaming of the Standard Minimum Rules to “Nelson Mandela Rules” honours the legacy of our former President, who spent 27 years in prison.
tgt: Ku tshula hi vuntshwa Milawu ya Mpimohansi leyi Tirhisiwaka eka “Milawu ya Nelson Mandela” swi xixima ndzhaka ya khale ka Phuresidente wa hina, loyi a tshameke 27 wa malembe ekhotsweni.

src: There has also been a worldwide extension of the Nelson Mandela International Day scope, observed by UN Member States on 18 July, to promote humane conditions of imprisonment, raise awareness about prisoners being a part of society and value the work of prison staff as a social service.
tgt: Nakambe ku vile na ndlandlamukiso wa misava hinkwayo wa vuanami bya Siku ra Matiko ya Misava ra Nelson Mandela, leri xiximiwaka hi Matiko lama nga Swirho swa UN hi siku ra 18 Mawuwani, ku kondletela swiyimo swa vumunhu eka ku pfaleriwa ekhotsweni, ku tlakusa vulemukisi hi mayelana na vakhotsiwa ku va xiphemu xa rixaka na nkoka wa ntirho wa vatirhi va le khotsweni tanihi vukorhokeri bya vaaki.

src: The rules will assist South Africa to speed up the transformation towards a people’s developmental correctional system that is consistent with various international principles and guidelines.
tgt: Milawu leyi yi ta pfuna Afrika-Dzonga ku hatlisisa ncinco kuya eka sisiteme yo lulamisa nhluvukiso wa vanhu leyi fambisanaka na misinya na swiletelo swa matiko ya misava swo hambanahambana.

src: Bills.
tgt: Milawumbisi.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Prevention and Combating of Hate Crimes and Hate Speech Bill of 2018 into Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xa Nawumbisi wa Nsivelo na Heriso wa Vugevenga bya Rivengo na Mbulavulo wa Rivengo wa 2018 ePalamende.

src: The Bill aims to create the offences of hate crimes and hate speech, and to put in place measures to prevent and combat these offences.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu na xikongomelo xa ku tumbuluxa milandzu ya vugevenga bya rivengo na mbulavulo wa rivengo, na ku tumbuluxa magoza ya ku sivela na ku herisa milandzu leyi.

src: It intends to address violence against persons on the basis of prejudice.
tgt: Wu kunguhata ku lulamisa madzolonga ehenhla ka vanhu hi xivangelo xo vavisa hikwalaho ka vuahluri byo pfumala vumbhoni.

src: It will also give effect to South Africa’s obligations in terms of international human rights instruments.
tgt: Wu ta tlhela wu humelerisa miboheko ya Afrika-Dzonga hi ku landza mitwanano ya timfanelo ta ximunhu ta matiko ya misava.

src: Cabinet approved for the iKamva National e-Skills Institute (iNeSI) Bill of 2018 to be submitted to Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Vandla ra Swikili swa Xielekitironiki ra Rixaka ra iKamva (iNeSI) wa 2018 ku va wu rhumeriwa ePalamende.

src: The Bill provides for the establishment of iNeSI as a legal entity with its own legislation to address e-skills (digital skills) capacity challenges in the country.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu lulamisela ku tumbuluxiwa ka iNeSI tanihi vandla ra xinawu leri nga na milawu ya rona ku tirhana mitlhontlho ya vuswikoti bya swikili swa xielekitironiki (swikili swa xidijitali) etikweni.

src: Capacity development of e-skills is seen as one of the priority areas of government in building an inclusive economy, and to establish a capable and developmental state.
tgt: Nhluvukiso wa vuswikoti bya xielekitironiki wu voniwa tanihi xin’wana xa swiyenge leswi rhangisiwaka emahlweni swa mfumo eka ku aka ikhonomi leyi katsaka hinkwavo, na ku tumbuluxa mfumo lowu nga na vuswikoti na ku va wa nhluvukiso.

src: The iNeSI will act as a national catalytic collaborator and change agent, for the development of digital skills and organisational capacity in the country.
tgt: iNeSI yi ta tirha tanihi mutirhisani wo hatlisisa na muyimeri wo cinca wa rixaka, eka nhluvukiso wa swikili swa xidijitali na vuswikoti bya malulamiselo etikweni.

src: Cabinet approved for the introduction of the Hydrographic Bill of 2018 into Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku andlariwa ka Nawumbisi wa Hayidirogirafi wa 2018 ePalamende.

src: The Bill seeks to recognise and grant legislative status to the Office of the Hydrographer, which has been in existence in the Department of Defence (South African Navy) since the inception of hydrographic services in South WEBTOKEN will enable the Hydrographer of the South African Navy to be recognised as the National Hydrographer.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu lava ku tekela enhlokweni na ku nyika xiyimo xa xinawu eka Hofisi ya Hayidirogirafa, leyi veke kona eka Ndzawulo ya Vusirheleri (Vuthu ra le Matini ra Afrika-Dzonga) kusukela loko ku simekiwile vukorhokeri bya hayidirogirafi eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: It will ensure that the provision of hydrographic services is formalised and enacted into law.
tgt: Wu ta tiyisisa leswaku ku nyikiwa ka vukorhokeri bya hayidirogirafi ku endliwa ku va ka ximfumo na ku pasisiwa ku va nawu.

src: This is in line with the International Maritime Organisation and the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea, which is an international maritime treaty that sets minimum safety standards in the construction, equipment and operation of merchant ships.
tgt: Leswi swi fambisana na Nhlangano wa Malwandle ya Matiko ya Misava na Ntwanano wa Matiko ya Misava wa Vuhlayiseki bya Vutomi Elwandle, lowu wu nga ntwanano wa malwandle ya matiko ya misava lowu wu vekaka mipimo ya vuhlayiseki ya mpimohansi eka vuaki, switirhisiwa na matirhelo ya swikwekwetsu swa bindzu.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Mitlangu leyi landzelaka.

src: Human Rights Month/DayThe 2018 National Human Rights Month/Day commemorations will be held under the theme: “The year of Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: promoting and deepening a human rights culture across society”.The national event will take place on 21 March 2018 at George Thabe Cricket Pitch, Sharpeville in Vereeniging.
tgt: N’hweti/Siku ra Timfanelo ta XimunhuKu tsundzukiwa ka N’hweti/Siku ra Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ra 2018 ku ta endliwa ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Lembe ra Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: ku kondletela na ku tiyisa mfuwo wa timfanelo ta ximunhu erixakeni hinkwaro.”Xiendleko xa rixaka xi ta va kona hi siku ra 21 Nyenyankulu 2018 Erivaleni ra Khirikhete ra George Thabe, Sharpeville Vereeniging.

src: Cabinet urges all sectors to pay homage to this national day, which celebrates South Africa’s human rights tradition and honours people such as Madiba who paid the ultimate price and sacrificed for the achievement of liberation and freedom that we enjoy today.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza tisekithara hinkwato ku xixima siku lera rixaka, leri ri tlangelaka ndhavuko wa timfanelo ta ximunhu wa Afrika-Dzonga naswona ri xixima vanhu vo tanihi Madiba lava va hakeleke hakelo leyikulu eka hinkwato na ku tinyikela ku kuma mifikelelo wa ntshunxeko lowu hi tiphinaka hawona namuntlha.

src: National Imbizo Focus WeekThe National Imbizo Focus Week will take place from 9 to 15 April 2018 under the theme: “Together we move South Africa forward”.
tgt: Vhiki ra Nkongomiso wa Xivijo xa RixakaVhiki ra Nkongomiso wa Xivijo xa Rixaka ri ta va kona kusuka 9 kufika 15 Dzivamisoko 2018 ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Hi ri swin’we hi yisa Afrika-Dzonga emahlweni”.

src: This year, the Mandela Centenary celebration forms a big part of the focus week, under the sub-theme: “Be the legacy”.
tgt: Nyan’waka, ku tlangeriwa ka Malembexidzana ya Mandela ku vumba xiphemu lexikulu xa vhiki ra nkongomiso, ehansi ka nkongomelotsongo: “Va na ndzhaka”.

src: The Executive will be engaging with communities in various parts of the country.
tgt: Vurhangerinkulu byi ta vulavurisana na miganga eka swiphemu swo hambanahambana swa tiko.

src: The respective programmes of Ministers will be communicated in due course.
tgt: Minongonoko hi ku landzelelana ya Vaholobye yi ta tivisiwa hi nkarhi lowu faneleke.

src: Youth employment President Ramaphosa is expected to launch the pilot of the Youth Employment Services initiative at the Riversands Incubation Hub in Diepsloot on 27 March 2018.
tgt: Phuresidente Ramaphosa u languteriwa ku simeka ndzingeto wa pfhumba ra Vukorhokeri bya ku Thoriwa ka Vantshwa eRiversands Incubation Hub eDiepsloot hi siku ra 27 Nyenyankulu 2018.

src: The initiative, in collaboration with the private sector, aims to empower one million young people over the next five years to become economically active, either as a member of the workforce or running their own businesses or finding their passion for further study.
tgt: Pfhumba leri, hi ku tirhisana na sekithara leyi nga riki ya mfumo, ri na xikongomelo xa ku havaxerisa miliyoni yin’we ya vanhu lavatsongo eka ntlhanu wa malembe lama taka ku va va kota ku tirha hindlela ya xiikhonomi, ku nga va tanihi xirho xa vuthu ra vatirhi kumbe ku fambisa mabindzu ya vona vini kumbe ku kuma hiseko wa dyondzo yo yisa emahlweni.

src: Working visits to Mozambique and ZimbabwePresident Ramaphosa will undertake working visits to the Republic of Mozambique and Republic of Zimbabwe respectively on Saturday, 17 March 2018.
tgt: Tendzo to tirha ku ya eMozambique na le ZimbabwePhuresidente Ramaphosa u ta teka tendzo to tirha ku ya eRhiphabuliki ya Mozambique na Riphabuliki ya Zimbabwe hi ku landzelelana hi Mugqivela, 17 Nyenyankulu 2018.

src: The visits will mainly focus on strengthening bilateral relations with the abovementioned countries.
tgt: Tendzo leti ti ta kongomisa ngopfungopfu eka ku tiyisa vuxaka bya matiko lamambirhi na matiko lama vuriweke laha henhla.

src: The President will also exchange views on peace and security matters in the region and the continent, and further deliberate on global issues of mutual interest.
tgt: Phuresidente u ta tlhela a kombisana mavonelo eka timhaka ta ku rhula na nsirhelelo exifundzeni na le ka tikokulu, na ku kanerisana hi timhaka ta misava hinkwayo ta ntsakelo wa matlhelo hinkwawo.

src: Messages.
tgt: Mahungu.

src: Cabinet congratulates Ntsiki Biyela, South Africa’s first black woman winemaker who launched her own brand.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Ntsiki Biyela, muendli wa vhinyo wa xinsati wa wantima wo sungula wa Afrika-Dzonga loyi a simekeke burende ya yena n’wini.

src: With a degree in viticulture from Stellenbosch University plus 13 years’ working experience, her Aslina Wines will in 2018 sell 12 000 bottles in the United States of America, Germany, Taiwan and Ghana.
tgt: Hi digiri ya vurimi bya madiriva kusuka eka Yunivhesiti ya Stellenbosch ku katsa na ntokoto wo tirha wa 13 wa malembe, Aslina Wines ya yena hi 2018 yi ta xavisa 12 000 wa mabodhlela eUnited States of America, Germany, Taiwan na Ghana.

src: Cabinet congratulates Caster Semenya on breaking the South African 1 000m record that stood for 35 years at the Athletix Grand Prix meeting held at Tuks in Pretoria.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Caster Semenya eka ku tshova rhekodo ya 1 000m ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi tshameke ku ringana 35 wa malembe eka mphikizano wa Athletix Grand Prix lowu a wu khomiwe eTuks ePitori.

src: Our golden girl won the race in a time of 2:35:44, beating the old record set in 1983 by Ilze Wicksell by almost two seconds.
tgt: Nhwana wa ka hina lowa ndhuma swinene u winile nsiyano lowu hi nkarhi wa 2:35:44, a tshova rhekodo ya khale leyi vekiweke hi 1983 hi Ilze Wicksell hi kwalomu ka tisekondi timbirhi.

src: Cabinet also commends Semenya for fulfilling her long-held goal to get a university qualification when she completed her Diploma in Sports Science at the North-West University in Potchefstroom.
tgt: Nakambe khabinete yi hoyozela Semenya eka ku humelerisa xikongomelokulu xa yena lexi a ri na xona khale xa ku kuma nthwaso wa le yunivhesiti loko a heta Dipuloma ya yena eka Sayense ya swa Mitlangu eYunivhesiti ya N’walungu-Vupeladyambu ePotchefstroom.

src: Cabinet expresses condolences to the friends and family of Honourable Member of Parliament, Ms Loliwe Fazeka, who was killed in a car crash in the Eastern Cape, last week.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzisa nchavelelo eka vanghana na ndyangu wa Muhlonipheki Xirho xa Palamende, Man Loliwe Fazeka, loyi a dlaweke eka ntlumbano wa mimovha eKapa-Vuxa, vhiki leri nga hundza.

src: Cabinet also sends condolences to the loved ones of South Africa’s Ambassador to Sweden, Ms Faith Radebe, who passed on Tuesday, 13 March 2018.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi rhumela nchavelelo eka varhandziwa va Muyimeri wa Tiko wa Afrika-Dzonga eSweden, Man Faith Radebe, loyi a loveke hi Ravumbirhi, 13 Nyenyankulu 2018.

src: She was previously the Inspector-General of Intelligence in South Africa.
tgt: Eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza na Mukamberi-Jenerali wa Vuhlori eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa hinkwako ku ta fanela ku landzelela ntiyisiso wa mithwaso na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.

src: Dr Philemon Mjwara as Director-General of the Department of Science and Technology for an extended contract period of three years, commencing on 1 April Ms Memme Sejosengwe as Secretary-General at the Office of the Chief Justice for an extended contract period of three years, effective from 1 April Ms Thuli E Radebe, as Executive Director at the Centre of Public Service Innovation for an extended contract period of six months.
tgt: Dok Philemon Mjwara tanihi Mulawuri-Jenerali wa Sayense na Thekinoloji eka nkarhi wa kontiraka lowu ndlandlamukisiweke wa malembe manharhu, loyi a sungulaka ku tirha hi siku ra 1 Dzivamisoko Man Memme Sejosengwe Matsalani-Jenerali eka Hofisi ya Muavanyisinkulu eka nkarhi wa kontiraka lowu ndlandlamukisiweke wa malembe manharhu, loyi a sungulaka ku tirha hi siku ra Dzivamisoko Man Thuli E Radebe, tanihi Mulawuri wa Vurhangerinkulu eka Senthara ya Maendlelo Lamantshwa ya Vukorhokeri bya Vaaki eka nkarhi kontiraka ya lowu ndlandlamukisiweke wa tsevu wa tin’hweti.

src: Mr Thilivhali Archibald Ramawa as the Chief Financial Officer of the National Electronic Media Institute of South Africa.
tgt: Tat Thilivhali Archibald Ramawa tanihi Muofisirinkulu wa swa Timali wa Vandla ra Swihangalasamahungu swa Xielekitironiki ra Rixaka ra Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Board of Sentech SOC Limited:a. Mr Magatho Mello (reappointment as non-executive director and Chairperson)b. Mr Lumko Mtimde (reappointment as non-executive director)c. Dr Sandile Malinga (non-executive director) andd.
tgt: Huvo ya Sentech SOC Limited:a. Tat Magatho Mello (ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa tanihi mulawuri loyi a nga riki xiphemu xa vurhangerinkulu na Mutshamaxitulu)b. Tat Lumko Mtimde (mulawuri loyi a nga riki xiphemu xa vurhangerinkulu)c. Dok Sandile Malinga (mulawuri loyi a nga riki xiphemu xa vurhangerinkulu) nad.

src: Ms Elizabeth Malaka (non-executive director).
tgt: Man Elizabeth Malaka (mulawuri loyi a nga riki xiphemu xa vurhangerinkulu).

src: Board of Broadband Infraco:a. Mr Mandla Ngcobo (reappointment as non-executive director and Chairperson)b. Ms Nokuthula Selamolela (reappointment as non-executive director)c. Mr Gift Mphefu (non-executive director)d. Ms Zandile Matilda Kabini (non-executive director) ande.
tgt: Huvo ya Broadband Infraco:a. Tat Mandla Ngcobo (ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa tanihi mulawuri loyi a nga riki xiphemu xa vurhangerinkulu na Mutshamaxitulu)b.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 25 April 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape TownIssues in the environment.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 25 Dzivamisoko 2018, eTuynhuys eCape Town.

src: Funerals of stalwarts and veterans.
tgt: Mikosi ya valwelantshuxeko na tinghwazi.

src: Cabinet thanks all people around the world, especially South Africans, for their warm and generous response in the wake of the passing of ‘imbokodo’ Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Struggle stalwart Dr Zola Skweyiya and trade unionist Archie Sibeko.
