tgt: Khabinete yi khensa vanhu hinkwavo va matiko ya misava, ngopfungopfu MaAfrika-Dzonga, eka ku kombisa ka vona rirhandzu eka ku hundza emisaveni ka "imbokodo" Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Mulwelantshuxeko nhenha Dok Zola Skweyiya na murhangeri wa mihlangano ya vatirhi Archie Sibeko.

src: Our stalwarts dedicated their lives to the dream of a better South Africa and our countrymen and women are drawing inspiration from their struggles.
tgt: Valwelantshuxeko va hina va nyikerile vutomi bya vona eka norho wa ku va na Afrika-Dzonga ro antswa naswona vavanuna na vamanana va tiko ra hina va kuma nhlohlotelo ku suka eka maxangu ya vona.

src: Cabinet also joins President Cyril Ramaphosa in paying tribute to the late Veteran diplomat, Ambassador George Nene, who served South Africa with distinction and dedication during his period in exile in mobilising our region and continent to secure the liberation of South Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi yima na Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa ku rhumela marito yo khensa eka Nghwazi ya vudipilomati, Murhumiwa George Nene, loyi a nga tirhela Afrika-Dzonga hi ndlela ya kahle swinene na ku nyikela hi nkarhi wa yena evuchavelahwahwa hi ku hlanganisa muganga na tikonkulu ra hina ku tiyisisa ku ntshuxeka ka Afrika-Dzonga.

src: North West protests.
tgt: Ku kombisa ku vilela eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu.

src: Cabinet deliberated on the unstable situation that has unfolded in North West, which has affected a number of services, particularly health services.
tgt: Khabinete yi kanerile hi xiyimo xo kayivela ka ntshamiseko lexi humelelaka eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu, leswi nga khumba vukorhokeri byo hlaya, ngopfungopfu vukorhokeri bya rihanyu.

src: As a caring government, Cabinet has approved two immediate interventions to restore order and stability in the area.
tgt: Tanihi mfumo lowu nga na malwandla, khabinete yi pasisile ku nghenelela hi tindlela timbirhi ku vuyelerisa ku rhula na ntshamiseko eka ndhawu.

src: Cabinet approved the invoking of Section 100(1) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 to address the apparent crisis, particularly in the health sector.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku tirhisiwa ka Xiyenge xa 100(1) xa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996 ku ololoxa mikitsikitsi leyi nga kona, ngopfungopfu eka sekithara ya rihanyu.

src: The main objective of this intervention will be to:restore trust and confidence between labour and governmentassist the province to upgrade its systems and capabilities to a new normalityensure compliance with the legislative and regulatory framework of governmentstabilise the labour environment, restore sustainable service delivery, ensure security of staff and improve financial management.
tgt: Xikongomelonkulu xa ku nghenelela loku i ku:ku vuyelerisa ku tshemba exikarhi ka vatirhi na mfumoku pfuna xifundzankulu ku antswisa tisisiteme na vuswikoti bya xona ku ya eka ntolovelo lowuntshwaku tiyisisa ku landzelela nawu na rimba ra vulawuri ra mfumoku tshamisekisa mbango wa vatirhi, ku vuyelerisa ntshamiseko wa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri, ku tiyisisa vuhlayiseki bya vatirhi na ku antswisa mafambiselo ya timali.

src: Cabinet also mandated a task team of Ministers to visit North West to establish the facts on the ground.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi rhumela xipano xa Vaholobye ku endzela xifundzankulu xa N'walungu-Vupeladyambu ku ya kuma swivangelo eka vaaki.

src: They are expected to submit a report in the next two weeks.
tgt: Va fanele ku rhumela xiviko eka mavhiki mambirhi lawa ya taka.

src: The report back will assist in determining any further interventions that may still be required.
tgt: Xiviko xi ta hi pfuna ku teka xiboho eka ku nghenelela kun'wana loku nga ha lavekaka.

src: The Task Team comprises the Ministers of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation (Convener) Health Finance Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, as well as the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster of Ministers.
tgt: Xipano xi katsa Vaholobye va Nkunguhato, (Muhlanganisi), Kambisisa Matirhelo no Hlela Rihanyu, Timali, Mfumontirhisano na Timhaka ta Xintu, ku katsa na Vaholobye va Tlilasitara ya Vululami, Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Nsirhelelo.

src: Whilst noting the concerns that were raised by communities, Cabinet strongly condemns the acts of violence, looting and destruction of property that accompanied protests in some areas of the province.
tgt: Loko hi ri karhi hi tekela enhlokweni swivilelo leswi vaaki va swi kombiseke, Khabinete yi sola swiendlo swa madzolonga, ku phanga na ku onha tinhundzu leswi nga humelela hi nkarhi wa ku kombisa ku vilela eka tindhawu tin’wana ta xifundzankulu.

src: Public sector wage negotiations.1 Cabinet was briefed on the current Public Service wage negotiations.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi mikanerisano ya sweswi ya miholo ya Vatirhelamfumo.

src: Cabinet urged the Department of Public Service and Administration together with the mandating committee to work expeditiously to resolve the impasse on the wage negotiations.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlohlotele Ndzawulo ya Vatirhelamfumo na Vulawuri xikan'we na komiti leyi nga lerisiwa ku tirha hi xihatla ku ololoxa mikanelo ya miholo laha tihakeke rimitsu.

src: Bus strike.
tgt: Xitereko xa mabazi.

src: Cabinet calls on all stakeholders in the public transport sector to bring a speedy end to the national bus strike.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela hinkwavo lava khumbekaka eka sekithara ya vutleketli bya vaaki ku hatlisisisa ku herisa xitereko xa tiko xa mabazi.

src: We urge all parties to return to the negotiation table so as to reach an agreement that is in the best interest of all parties and the country.
tgt: Hi kombela mavandle hinkwawo ku vuyela eku kanerisaneni ku kota ku fikelela ntwanano lowu nga kahle eka mavandla hinkwawo na tiko.

src: Violence at Moses Mabhida Stadium.
tgt: Madzolonga eRivaleni ra mitlangu ra Moses Mabhida.

src: Cabinet condemns the senseless violence and malicious damage to property by soccer fans following a pitch invasion at Durban’s Moses Mabhida Stadium during a Premier Soccer League game at the weekend.
tgt: Khabinete yi sola madzolonga ya tihanyi na ku onhiwa ka nhundzu hi valandzeri va bolo ya milenge endzhaku ka ku nghena endzeni ka Rivala ra mitlangu ra Moses Mabhida eDurban hi nkarhi wa Premier Soccer League emaheleni ya vhiki.

src: Law-enforcement agencies are urged to ensure that all those involved in hooliganism and acts of violence at the match are held responsible for their actions.
tgt: Tiejensi ta ku sindzisa nawu ta hlohloteriwa ku tiyisisa leswaku hinkwavo lava nga nghenelela eka swiendlo swa manyala na madzolonga hi nkarhi wa ntlangu va rhwexiwa vutihlamuleri eka leswi va swi endleke.

src: Cabinet calls for a swift investigation and the implementation of stricter security measures to ensure the safety of spectators and officials.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela vulavisisi bya xihatla na ku simekiwa ka tindlela ta vusirheleri bya xiyimo xa le henhla ku tiyisisa vuhlayiseki bya vahlaleri na vatirhi.

src: It urges all role players to cooperate with investigations to prevent future occurrences.
tgt: Yi kombela ntirhisano wa hinkwavo lava khumbekaka eka vulavisisi ku sivela ku ri swi nga ha humeleli eka nkarhi lowu taka.

src: Community radio stations.
tgt: Switichi swa swiyanimoya swa miganga.

src: Cabinet welcomes the agreement reached to reconnect 15 community radio stations that were suspended by Sentech for non-payment of signal distribution fees, while more sustainable solutions are being sought.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ntwanano lowu nga fikeleriwa ku tlhela va vuyisela switichi swa xiyanimoya leswi a swi yimisiwile swa nkarhinyana hi Sentech hi ku tsandzeka ku hakela tihakelo ta vuhangalasi bya xihondzo, loko tindlela tin'wana ta nkarhi wo leha ta ha ri eku laviweni.

src: The agreement was reached after government met with Sentech, the National Community Radio Forum, the Media Development and Diversity Agency and the Independent Communications Authority of South Africa.
tgt: Ntwanano wu fikeleriwile endzhaku ka loko mfumo wu hlanganisile na Sentech, Foramu ya Xiyanimoya ya Miganga ya Tiko, Ejensi ya Tinxakaxaka na Nhluvukiso wa Vuhangalasamahungu na Vulawuri bya Vuhlanganisi byo Tiyimela hi byoxe bya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The community radio sector is a critical communication platform that gives our people access to information and which serves as a means to creating an informed citizenry.
tgt: Sekithara ya xiyanimoya ya muganga i ndlela ya vuhlanganisi bya nkoka lebyi nyikaka vanhu va hina mfikelelo wa mahungu na ku tirha tanihi ndlela ya ku endla ku ri vanhu va va na vutivi.

src: All parties have agreed to convene soon to come up with a long-lasting solution that will result in the sustainability of these stations.
tgt: Mavandla hinkwawo ya twananile ku tlhela ya hlangana ku nga ri khale ku ta na xintshuxo xa nkarhi wo leha lexi nga na mbuyelo wo va switichi leswi swi kota ku tiyisa emahlweni.

src: Cabinet welcomes the adoption of the Programme of Action for the Commonwealth for the next two years.
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya Varhangeri va Mimfumo ya Vun'we bya Matiko Khabinete yi amukela ku amukeriwa ka Nongonoko wa Leswi nga ta endliwa hi Vun'we bya Matiko eka malembe mambirhi lawa ya ha taka.

src: President Ramaphosa led a South African Delegation to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM 2018) under the theme: “Towards a Common Future” from 19 to 20 April 2018.
tgt: Phuresidente Ramaphosa u rhangerile Vurhumiwa bya Afrika-Dzonga eka Nhlengeletano ya Varhangeri va Mimfumo ya Vun'we bya Matiko (CHOGM 2018) ehansi ka nkongomelo: "Ku ya eka Vumundzuku Byin'we" ku sukela hi ti 19 ku fika hi ti 20 ta Dzivamisoko 2018.

src: In positioning South Africa as one of the world’s leading emerging market investment destination, President Ramaphosa also addressed the African Leaders’ Roundtable of the Commonwealth Business Forum, and engaged with senior international investors and business leaders.
tgt: Hi ku veka Afrika-Dzonga tanihi rin'wana ra ndhawu ya vuvekisi bya timakete leti rhangelaka emisaveni hinkwayo, Phuresidente Ramaphosa u nyikile mbulavulo eka Mikanerisano na Varhangeri va Afrika eka Foramu ya Mabindzu ya Vun'we bya Matiko, na ku burisana na vavekisi lavakulu va matiko ya misava na varhangeri va mabindzu.

src: He also extended an invitation to leading investors and leaders of business to attend South Africa’s much anticipated Investment Summit scheduled for later this year.
tgt: U tlhele a rhumela xirhambo eka vavekisi lava rhangelaka na varhangeri va mabindzu ku nghenelela eka Samiti ya Vuvekisi leyi nga yimeriwa hi mahlongati eAfrika-Dzonga emaheleni ya lembe leri.

src: Under the leadership of President Ramaphosa, the South African delegation also used the opportunity presented by the CHOGM to continue lobbying for South Africa’s candidature to the United Nations (UN) Security Council for the term 2019 – 2020.
tgt: Ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Phuresidente Ramaphosa, vurhangeri bya Afrika-Dzonga byi tlhele byi tirhisa xivandlanene lexi nyikiweke hi CHOGM ku ya emahlweni byi kombela nseketelo wa vuyimela ku langwa bya Afrika-Dzonga eka Huvo ya Vusirheleri ya Nhlangano wa Matiko eka theme ya 2019 – 2020.

src: These elections are scheduled for 8 June 2018 in New York, USInvestment.
tgt: Mihlawulo leyi yi ta va kona hi ti 8 Khotavuxika 2018 eNew York, USVuvekisi.

src: Cabinet welcomes President Ramaphosa’s appointment of four special envoys on investment to engage both domestic and foreign investors around economic opportunities in South Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku thoriwa hi Phuresidente Ramaphosa ka va varhumiwa vo hlawuleka eka vuvekisi ku tihlanganisa na vavekisi va laha kaya na va matikomambe eka swivandlanene swa ikhonomi eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: These envoys are mandated to attract investment in a focused and cost-effective manner.
tgt: Varhumiwa lava va nyikiwile ntirho wa ku koka rinoko eka vuvekisi hi ndlela yo kongoma na ku nga tirhisa ngopfu mali.

src: The investment drive will culminate in a major investment conference towards the end of the year to raise more than R1 trillion in new investments over five years.
tgt: Pfhumba ra vuvekisi ri ta hetelela hi khomferense leyikulu ya vuvekisi emaheleni ya lembe ku tlakusa ku tlula R1 wa tithiriliyoni eka vuvekisi byintshwa bya malembe ya ntlhanu.

src: Launch of Gauteng’s InvestSA One-Stop Shop.
tgt: Ku simekiwa ka InvestSA One-Stop Shop eGauteng.

src: Cabinet strongly encourages local and international investors to use the Provincial One-Stop Shop investment facilities being launched around the country – the latest being Gauteng’s One-Stop Shop.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza vuvekisi bya laha tikweni na bya matiko ya misava ku tirhisa pfhumba ra Xifundzankulu ra One-Stop shop leri nga eku simekiweni hinkwako laha tikweni - laha sweswi swi One-Stop Shop yi nga eGauteng.

src: The InvestSA One-Stop Shop is a presidential programme to promote and facilitate investment in South Africa.
tgt: InvestSA One-Stop Shop i phurogireme ya phuresidente ku tlakusa na ku fambisa vuvekisi eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Already, the InvestSA One-Stop Shop has been successfully implemented in KwaZulu-Natal and the Western Cape.
tgt: Sweswi, InvestSA One-Stop Shop yi simekiwile yi humelela eKwazulu-Natala na le Kapa-Vupeladyambu.

src: One-Stop Shop investment centres are being rolled out in all the provinces, and will be used to coordinate and incorporate the special economic zones, provincial investment agencies, local authorities and the relevant government departments involved in regulatory, registration, permits and licensing matters.
tgt: Tisenthara ta Vuvekisi bya One-Stop Shop ta karhi ta hangalasiwa na swifundzankulu hinkwaswo, naswona ti ta tirhisiwa ku hlanganisa na ku nghenelerisa tizoni to hlawuleka ta ikhonomi, tiejensi ta vuvekisi ta swifundzankulu, vulawuri bya miganga na tindzawulo ta mfumo leti nga fanela leti nghenelelaka eka vulawuri, ntsariso, mpfumelelo na timhaka ta mapapila ya mpfumelelo.

src: New Post Office-SASSA Post Bank cards.
tgt: Makhadi yantshwa ya Bangi ya Poso-SASSKhabinete yi amukela ku ringetiwa ka ku hangalasiwa ka makhadi ya Ejensi ya Nsirhelelo wa Vaaki ya Afrika-Dzonga eka tiposo leti nga hlawuriwa eKapa-Vupeladyambu ku pfumelela vavuyeriwa va mudende ku cinca makhadi lawa ya nga kona ku ya eka makhadi ya Poso ya Afrika-Dzonga (SAPO) - SASSA Postbank.

src: Cabinet welcomes the successful pilot roll-out of new South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) cards at selected post offices in the Western Cape to allow social-grant beneficiaries to swap existing cards for the new South African Post Office (SAPO)-SASSA Postbank cards.
tgt: Lava kumaka mudende na vinyi va makhadi va nga ha tirhisa makhadi lawa va nga na wona ku fikela hi N'wendzamhala 2018, kambe Khabinete yi khutaza vavuyeriwa ku cinca makhadi hi ku endzela SASSA ya le kusuhi kumbe SAPO ku sukela hi ti2 Mudyaxihi ku fikela emaheleni ya Ndzati Dyondzo ya le Henhla.

src: Social-grant recipients and cardholders are still able to use their existing cards until December 2018, but Cabinet encourages beneficiaries to swap their old cards by visiting their nearest SASSA or SAPO from 2 May until the end of September Higher Education.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku ya emahlweni ka ku simekiwa ka dyondzo ya mahala tanihilaha swi nga andlariwa hakona hi Holobye wa Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri.

src: The announcement of a significant increase in baseline allocation to NSFAS from R9,849 billion 2017/18 to R35,321 billion in 2020/21 demonstrates Governments commitment to assisting students from poor and working class households.
tgt: Xitiviso xa ku engeteleriwa ka mphakelo wa NSFAS ku suka eka R9,849 wa tibiliyoni hi 2017/18 ku fika eka 35,321 wa tibiliyoni hi 2020/21 swi kombisa ku tinyikela ka Mfumo ku pfuna swichudeni leswi sweleke na leswi humaka eka mindyangu ya lava tirhaka.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Employment Promotion through the small, medium and micro-sized enterprise (SMME) Support Programme, which is a partnership between the Department of Small Business Development (DSBD) and the European Union.
tgt: Phurogireme ya Nseketelo ya SMMKhabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Ntlakuso wa ku Thoriwa hi ku tirhisa Phurogireme ya Nseketelo wa mabindzu lamatsongo, ya le xikarhi na lamakulu (SMME), laha ku nga vutirhisani na Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamantsongo (DSBD) na Nhlangano wa Yuropa.

src: It will support SMMEs through business development services, assist them with access to markets, improve their access to finance, and help ease the administrative and regulatory burden on small businesses.
tgt: Yi ta seketela ti-SMME hi ku tirhisa vukorhokeri bya nhluvukiso wa mabindzu, yi va pfuna ku fikelela timakete, yi tlakusa ku fikelela ka vona eka swa timali, na ku pfuna ku hunguta ndhwalo wa vulawuri bya mabindzu lamatsongo.

src: Science and Technology.
tgt: Sayense na Thekinoloji.

src: Cabinet commends all those involved in the realisation of ZACUBE-2, which is Africa’s largest and most advanced cube satellite.
tgt: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka hinkwavo lava nga hoxa xandla eka ku fikeleriwa ka ZACUBE -2, leyi ku nga sathelayiti ya khubu leyikulu eka Afrika hinkwaro na ku va ya ximanguvalawa.

src: The 4kg ZACUBE-2 satellite – which was developed by the Cape Peninsula University of Technology (CPUT) and the French South African Institute of Technology, and managed by the South African National Space Agency – was funded by the Department of Science and Technology.
tgt: Sathelayiti ya 4kg ya ZACUBE-2 - leyi nga endliwa hi Cape Peninsula University of Technolofy (CPUT) na French South African Institute of Technology, na ku fambisiwa hi Ejensi ya Xibakabaka ya Rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga - yi seketeriwile hi swa timali hi Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Thekinoloji.

src: It is the second nanosatellite to be developed at the CPUThe cube satellite has been sent to India for launching into space.
tgt: I sathelayiti ya vumbirhi ya nano leyi nga endliwa hi CPUSathelayiti ya khubu yi rhumeriwe eIndia ku va yi simekiwa exibakabakeni.

src: It will help gather data to unlock economic growth in the oceans economy.
tgt: Yi ta pfuna ku kuma vuxokoxoko ku pfula ku kula ka ikhonomi eka ikhonomi ya le malwandle.

src: The nanosatellite will assist in addressing the needs of the Operation Phakisa Oceans Economy programme and also help track marine activity along South Africa’s coast and proactively detect forest fires.
tgt: Sathelayiti ya nano yi ta pfuna ku fikelela swilaveko swa nongonoko wa Ikhonomi ya Malwandle ya Operation Phakisa na ku tlhela yi pfuna landzelerisa migingiriko ya le lwandle laha Afrika-Dzonga na ku tlhela yi kota ku vona mantshwa ya nhova.

src: KwaZulu-Natal Mining Indaba.
tgt: Indaba ya Migodi eKwaZulu-Natal.

src: Cabinet welcome the outcome of the two-day KwaZulu-Natal Mining Indaba, where delegates deliberated on issues that will help in transforming the sector and unlock mining value-chain opportunities in the province.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela mbuyelo wa Indaba ya Migodi ya masiku mambirhi eKwazulu-Natal, laha varhumiwa va nga bula hi timhaka leti nga pfunaka ku cinca sekithara na ku pfula swivandla swa mafambiselo ya migodi eka xifundzankulu.

src: Mining is one of the key sectors that can assist us to transform our economy and Cabinet has called on the mining companies, labour and communities to strengthen relations in order for mining to be sustainable.
tgt: Migodi hi yin'wana ya tisekirhara ta nkoka leti pfunaka ku cinca ikhonomi naswona Khabinete yi kombele tikhamphani ta migodi, vatirhi na vaaki ku tiyisisa vuxaka ku endla leswaku migodi yi tiya.

src: Cabinet decisions Cabinet approved the Monitoring and Evaluation Framework for the National Youth Policy (NYP) 2015-2020.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Rimba ra Nandzeleriso na Nhlahluvo ra Pholisi ya Vantshwa va Rixaka (NYP) 2015-2020.

src: The framework provides for accountability and efficiency in the achievement of the NYP 2020 objectives.
tgt: Rimba ri fikelerisa vutihlamuleri na matirhelo ya kahle eka ku fikelela swikongomelo swa NYP 2010.

src: The policy aims to improve performance and enhance service delivery, particularly to the programmes of the youth.
tgt: Pholisi yi lava ku fikelela ku antswisa matirhelo na ku yisa emahlweni mphakelo wa vukorhokeri, ngopfungopfu eka minongonoko ya vantshwa.

src: Cabinet approved the hosting of the Annual Africa Month Programme for May 2018 under the theme: “A Year of Nelson Mandela – Building a Better Africa and a Better World”.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhurheriwa ka Nongonoko wa N'hweti ya Afrika ya Lembe na lembe hi Mudyaxihi 2018 ehansi ka nkongomelo: "Lembe ra Nelson Mandela - Ku Aka Afrika yo Antswa na Misava yo Antswa."

src: The month of May celebrates the achievements made in the development of Africa.
tgt: N'hweti ya Mudyaxihi hi ta va hi tlangela leswi hi nga swi fikelela eka ku hluvukisiwa ka Afrika.

src: The events culminate in Africa Day on 25 May, which is a day declared by the African Union and celebrated in Africa.
tgt: Mitlangu yi ta hela hi Siku ra Afrika hi ti 25 ta Mudyaxihi, leri ku nga siku leri nga hlambanyiwa hi Nhlangano wa Afrika na ku tlangeriwa eAfrika.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the report and interventions made on the status of sexual exploitation, abuse and serious misconduct cases against the deployed South African National Defence Force (SANDF) members that support the UN Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi xiviko na ku nghenelela loku nga endliwa eka xiyimo xa ku xanisiwa hi swa masangu, ku xanisiwa na milandzu ya matikhomelo yo biha ehenhla ka swirho leswi nga rhumeriwa swa Vuthu ra Vusirheleri ra Afrika-Dzonga (SANDF) leswi seketelaka Xikongomelo xa Ntshamiseko xa UN eDemokiratiki Rhiphabuliki ya Congo.

src: Whilst Cabinet was satisfied with interventions made in addressing these abuses, it condemns in the strongest possible terms any form of sexual abuse and acts of misconduct by the SANDF members in the mission areas.
tgt: Loko khabinete yi enetekile hi ku nghenelela loku nga endliwa eka mixaniso leyi, yi tlhela yi sola hi tindlela hinkwato mixaniso yihi kumbe yihi ya swa masangu na swiendlo swa matikhomelo yo biha ya swirho swa SANDF eka tindhawu leti va nga rhumeriwa kona.

src: A team was deployed to investigate all the reported allegations.
tgt: Xipano xi rhumeriwile ku ya endla vulavisisi eka swihehlo hinkwaswo leswi nga vikiwa.

src: Although some of the cases have been finalised, others are already at the stage of military trials.
tgt: Hambileswi yin'wana ya milandzu yi nga gimetiwa, yin'wana se yi le ku kamberiweni eka xiyimo xa mavuthu.

src: All these investigations have been conducted through the military legal process in a transparent and accountable manner.
tgt: Mindzavisiso leyi hinkwayo yi fambisiwile hi maendlelo ya xinawu ya mavuthu hi ndlela leyi nga erivaleni na ku va na vutihlamuleri.

src: South Africa will as usual continue to react swiftly when dealing with such incidences.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga tanihi ntolovelo ri ta angula hi ku hatlisa loko ku tirhaniwa na timhangu ta muxaka lowu.

src: Ill-discipline and criminal behaviour in the ranks of the SANDF is despised and will not be tolerated.
tgt: Ku pfumala mahanyelo na mahanyelo ya vusulavoya eka swiyenge swa SANDF a swi pfumeleriwi naswona ku bakanyeriwa etlhelo.

src: Those found to have transgressed will be dealt with through the Code of Conduct and Military Disciplinary Code.
tgt: Lava nga kumiwa va tshovile nawu ku ta tirhaniwa na vona hi ku tirhisa Nawu wa Matikhomelo na Nawu wa Mahanyelo ya Mavuthu.

src: Cabinet further supported the finalisation of the Military Disciplinary Bill, which seeks to deal with overall discipline in the SANDF, including strengthening the definition of sexual exploitation and the minimum sanction increased to 10 years.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi seketela ku gimetiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Mahanyelo ya Mavuthu, lowu lavaka ku tirhana na matikhomelo yo angarhela ya SANDF, ku katsa ku tiyisisa hlamuselo ya ku xanisiwa hi swa masangu na ku yirisiwa ka mpimohansi ku engeteriwa ku fika eka 10 wa malembe.

src: Bills.
tgt: Milawumbisi.

src: Cabinet approved for the publication of the Control of Tobacco Products and Electronic Delivery Systems Bill of 2017 in the Government Gazette for public comments.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Vulawuri bya Switirhisiwa swa Fole na Tisisiteme ya Mphakelo wa Xielekitironiki wa 2017 eka Gazete ya Mfumo ku kuma swibumabumelo swa vaaki.

src: The Bill repeals the Tobacco Products Control Act, 1993 (Act 83 of 1993) so as to promote public health and to align the South African tobacco control law with the World Health Organisation Framework Convention on Tobacco Control.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu herisa Nawu wa Vulawuri bya Switirhisiwa swa Fole, 1993 (Nawu wa 83 wa 1993) ku kota ku tlakusa rihanyu ra vaaki na ku fambelanisa nawu wa ku lawula fole wa Afrika-Dzonga na Ntwanano wa Rimba ra Nhlangano wa Rihanyu ra Matiko ya misava eka Vulawuri bya Fole.

src: It addresses key areas relating to indoor public areas, display of tobacco products at point of sale, use of electronic devices and the introduction of plain packaging of tobacco products.
tgt: Wu lulamisa swilo swo hlayanyana leswi fambelenaka na tindhawu leti nga ndzeni ta vaaki, nkombiso wa switirhisiwa swa fole laha swi xavisiwaku kona, ku tirhisiwa ka swilo swa xielekitironiki na ku sunguriwa ka ku paka switirhisiwa swa fole swi nga khavisiwanga.

src: Cabinet approved for the publication of the Integrated Framework Bill of 2018 to be published in the Government Gazette for public comments.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Rimba ra Nhlanganelo wa 2018 ku va wu hangalasiwa eka Gazete ya Mfumo ku kuma swibumabumelo swa vaaki.

src: The Bill seeks to achieve coordinated and integrated planning across all spheres of government, which are mutually reinforcing and work cohesively to promote more effective implementation of the National Development Plan (NDP).Institutionalising planning is in line with the NDP and seeks to give effect to the commitment in the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019 to establish mechanisms and capacity within the State to undertake long-term development planning.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu lava ku fikelela makunguhatelo lawa ya nga hlanganela na ku hlanganisa swiyenge hinkwaswo swa mfumo, leswi swi tiyisisaka ku ringana na ku tirha swin'we ku tlakusa ku simekiwa ka kahle ka Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka (NDP).Makungu ya vandla ya fambisana na NDP na ku lava ku sungula ku tiboha eka Rimba ra swa Maqhinga ra le Xikarhi ka Theme 2014-2019 ku sungula tindlela na matimba ya Tiko ku sungula swikongomelo swa nkarhi wo leha swa nhluvukiso.

src: It will promote a more coordinated and responsive State that would be more effective in promoting the structural changes required for inclusive growth, and for developing the country’s human resource base and a stronger democracy.
tgt: Wu ta tlakusa nhlanganelo na ku angula ka Tiko loku nga ta tirha kahle eka ku tlakusa ku cinca ka xivumbeko loku lavekaka eka ku kula ko katsa hinkwaswo, na le ka vuthori bya matiko lawa ya ha hluvukaka na ku xidemokirasi lexi nga tiya.

src: Upcoming events Freedom DayCabinet commends all South Africans and sectors who are in various ways participating in the current Freedom Month celebrations.
tgt: Siku ra NtshuxekoKhabinete yi bela mandla eka MaAfrika-Dzonga na tisekithara lava hi tindlela to hambanahambana va nghenelelaka eka ku tlangela N'hweti ya Ntshuxeko.

src: President Ramaphosa will deliver the keynote address at the National Freedom Day celebration on 27 April 2018 at Dr Petrus Molemela Stadium in Bloemfontein, Free State under the theme: “The year of Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: towards full realisation of our freedom through radical socio-economic transformation”.The event will be followed by the 2018 National Orders Awards on Saturday, 28 April 2018 in Pretoria, where President Ramaphosa will bestow to deserving recipients the Order of the Baobab, The Order of Ikhamanga, The Order of Luthuli and The Order of the Companions of OR Tambo.
tgt: Phuresidente Ramaphosa u ta nyika mbulavulo wa siku eka ku tlangela Siku ra Ntshuxeko wa Rixaka hi ti 27 Dzivamisoko eRivaleni ra mitlangu ra Dr Petrus Molemela eBloemfontein, eFree State ehansi ka nkongomelo: "Lembe ra Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: hi ya fikelela ntshuxeko wa hina hi ku tirhisa ncico wa ikhonomi ya vaaki wo helela.

src: National Orders are the highest awards that South Africa bestows, through the President, on citizens and members of the international community who have contributed meaningfully towards making the country a free, democratic and successful nation united in its diversity.
tgt: "Tlangu wu ta landzeriwa hi Masagwati ya Rixaka ya 2018 hi Mugqivela , 28 Dzivamisoko ePitori, laha Phuresidente Ramaphosa a nga ta nyika lava nga fanela ku Xiximiwa hi Baobab, Ku Xiximiwa ka Ikhamanga, Ku Xiximiwa ka Luthuli na ku Xiximiwa ka Vanghana va OR Tambo.

src: May Day celebrationsCabinet calls on all workers around the country to join in celebrating the Workers’ Day on Tuesday, 1 May 2018 and to reflect on the gains of workers’ rights since the dawn of democracy.
tgt: Masagwati ya Rixaka I masagwati ya le henhla lawa Afrika-Dzonga yi wa nyikaka, hi ku fambisiwa hi Presidente, eka vaakatiko na swirho swa muganga wa matiko ya misava leswi hoxeke xandla eku endleni tiko ri ntshuxeka, xidimokirasi na ku va rixaka ro humelela, ri va rin’we eka ku hambanahambana ka vanhu va rona.. Ku tlangela Siku ra DzivamisokoKhabinete yi rhamba vanhu hinkwavo laha tikweni ku nghenelela eka ku tlangela Siku ra Vatirhi hi Ravumbirhi, 1 Dzivamisoko 2018 na ku languta leswi nga fikeleriwa eka timfanelo ta vatirhi ku sukela loko xidemokirasi xi sungurile.

src: This day serves as a reminder that workplaces should be safe and that employers must do more to ensure the safety of their workers, especially in the mining sector.
tgt: Siku leri ri tirha ku hi tsundzuxa leswaku tindzhawu to tirha ti fanele ku va tihlayisekile naswona vathori va fanele ku endla swotala ku tiyisisa vuhlayiseki bya vatirhi, ngopfungopfu emigodini.

src: Cabinet also expressed its heartfelt sympathy to the families, friends and colleagues of the six miners who were burnt to death when the bus taking them to work was set alight by a petrol bomb thrown by unknown attackers.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi kombisa ku khumbeka ka yona eka mindyangu, vanghana na vatirhikulorhi wa swirho swa ntsevu leswi nga tshwa swi lova loko bazi ri karhi ri swi yisa entirhweni ri hisiwa hi bomo ya petirolo leyi nga hoxiwa hi un'wana wa vahlaseri lava nga tiviweki.

src: Cabinet called on community members to assist the police in their quest to swiftly crack this case.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela swirho swa vaaki ku pfuna maphorisa eka ku lavisisa ka vona hi xihatla ku kota ku tirhana na nandzu lowu.

src: MessagesCabinet congratulates:1.
tgt: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka:1.

src: Ndebele artist Esther Mahlangu, who received an honorary doctorate from the University of Johannesburg in recognition of her outstanding contribution to South African indigenous arts and culture.
tgt: N'wavutshila wa Mundevele Esther Mahlangu, ku va a xiximiwile hi vudokodela ku suka eYunivhesiti ya Joni hi ku tekela enhlokweni ku hoxa xandla xa yena ko hlamarisa eka vutshila na mfuwo wa laha tikweni eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Team South Africa who held our flag high at the Commonwealth Games on Australia's Gold Coast, when they finished sixth with a total of 37 medals (13 gold, 11 silver and 13 bronze).
tgt: Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga lexi nga tlakusa mujeko wa hina eka Mitlangu ya Vun'we bya Matiko eGold Coast eAustralia, loko va hetile va ri eka xiyimo xa vutsevu na ku va na 37 wa timendlele (13 ta nsuku, 11 ta silivhere na 13 ta koporo).

src: Their success is a result of hard work, determination and perseverance.
tgt: Ku humelela ka vona i hi kwalaho ka ku tirha swinene, ku tinyikela na ku tiyisela.

src: This is an inspiration to young athletes and reaffirms that sport is part of the social fabric that binds us together as South Africans.
tgt: Leswi swi hlohlotela lavantshwa eka mitlangu na ku tiyisisa leswaku mitlangu i xiphemu xa vutomi na ku hi vumba hi va nchumu wun'we tanihi Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Top achievers who won gold medals include:Caster Semenya – women’s 800m and 1500mLuvo Manyonga – men’s long jumpNdodomzi Ntutu – men’s T12 100mHenri Schoeman – men’s triathlonTatjana Schoenmaker – women’s 100m and 200m breaststrokeChad le Clos – men’s 50m, 100m and 200m butterflyCameron van der Burgh – men’s 50m breaststrokeAkani Simbine – men’s 100m andMartin Erasmus – men’s 97kg wrestling freestyle.
tgt: Lava nga fikelela leswikulu hi ku kuma timendlele ta nsuku va katsa:Caster Semenya - eka vaxisati 800m na 1500mLuvo Manyonga - vaxinuna eka ku tlula ko lehaNdodomzi Ntutu, eka vaxinuna T12 100mHenri Schoeman - eka vaxinuna eka mitlangu yinharhuTatjana Schoenmaker - eka vaxisati 100m na 200m eku hlambeleniChad le clos - vaxinuna 50m, 100m na 200m eka ku hlambelaCameron van der Burgh - vaxinuna eka 50m hi ku hlambelaAkani Simbine - vaxinuna eka 100 na Martin Erasmus - vaxinuna eka 97 eka ku tlimbana.

src: Profssor Sibongile Muthwa and Dr Geraldine Fraser-Moleketi on their recent inauguration as vice-chancellor and chancellor respectively of the Nelson Mandela University.
tgt: Phurofesa Sibongile Muthwa na Dok Geraldine Fraser-Moleketi eka ku thoriwa ka vona ku va xandla xa muchanselara na ku va muchanselara eYunivhesiti ya Nelson Mandela.

src: Team South Africa for winning three awards at the 10th Global Entrepreneurship Congress in Istanbul, Turkey in April 2018, in recognition for the country’s commitment and dedication to advancing SMMEs.
tgt: Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga eka ku hlula eka masagwati ya Nhlangano wa Mabindzu ya Misava ya vu 10 eInstanbul, Turkey hi Dzivamisoko 2018, hi ku tekela enhlokweni ku tinyikela ka vona na ku yisa emahlweni ti-SMMNdzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo na xirho xa yona, 22 eSloane, khemphasi leyikulu eAfrika, va hlurile eka Tiko ra Mabindzu eka Masagwati ya Lembe ya Matiko ya misava.

src: The Department of Small Business Development with its partner, 22 on Sloane, Africa’s largest start-up campus, won the Global Entrepreneurship Country of the Year Award.
tgt: Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga xi tlhele xi hlula eka Tinghwazi ta Mavito na Tinghwazi ta Vulavisisi, laha ku tekeriwaka enhlokweni Nhlanganelo wa Mabindzu ya Misava eka matiko hinkwawo ya misava.

src: Team South Africa also won the Brand Champions and Research Champions Award, which recognises Global Entrepreneurship Network countries from around the world.
tgt: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa ku va kona endzhaku ka nkambelo wa tidyondzo na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 9 May 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape TownIssues in the environment.
tgt: Xitatimende xa Nhlengeletano ya Khabinete ya ti 9 Mudyaxihi 2018Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 9 Mudyaxihi 2018, eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Gender-based violence (GBV).
tgt: Madzolonga ya ku ya hi Rimbewu (GBV).

src: Cabinet reiterates its condemnation of violence against women and children, and calls on all of us in our respective formations to take a stand in stopping violence against women, children and the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual and Transgender communities.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi sola madzolonga ehenhla ka vaxisati na vana, na ku kombela eka hinkwerhu eka mihlangano hinkwayo ku lwa na ku herisa madzolonga ehenhla ka vaxisati, vana, Vavasati vo rhandza rimbewu-fanana, Vavanuna vo rhandza rimbewu-fanana, rimbewumbirhi na lava nga cincaka rimbewu.

src: It is the duty of every South African to educate one another on the rights of women and children, and on the various recourse mechanisms that exist to help victims of violence.
tgt: I ntirho wa MuAfrika-Dzonga wihi kumbe wihi ku dyondzisana hi timfanelo ta vaxisati na vana, na hi tindlela to hambanahambana leti nga kona ku pfuna vaxanisiwa hi madzolonga.

src: Cabinet welcomes the decision by the South Gauteng High Court to sentence convicted murderer Sandile Mantsoe to 32 years in prison for the murder of his ex-girlfriend Karabo Mokoena.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela xiboho xa Khotonkulu ya Gauteng Dzonga xa ku khotsa mudlayi Sandile Mantsoe ku tshama ekhotsweni malembe ya 32 eka ku dlaya khale ka muhlekisani wa yena Karabo Mokoena.

src: Other cases such as the discovery of the body of 10-year-old Katlego Joja in Mamelodi West, east of Pretoria and the killing of Zolile Khumalo, by a former student, at the Mangosuthu University of Technology in Durban, is testimony to the continuing challenges we face as a nation.
tgt: Eka milandzu yin’wana yo fana na ku kumiwa ka ntsumbu wa n'wana wa malembe ya 10 Katlego Joja eMamelodi Vupeladyambu, evuxeni bya Pitori na ku dlayiwa ka Zolile Khumalo, ni khale ka muchudeni kulobye, eYunivhesiti ya Thekinoloji ya Mangosuthu eDurban, i vumbhoni bya ku ya emahlweni ka mitlhontlho leyi rixaka ri hlanganaka na yona.

src: Cabinet extends its heartfelt condolences to the Joja and Khumalo families.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhumela marito yo chavelela eka mindyangu ya ka Joja na Khumalo.

src: While justice and the law-enforcement agencies are seized with ensuring that the perpetrators do not go unpunished, as a society we all have a role to play in stopping these crimes.
tgt: Loko lava va vululami na tiejensi to sindzisa nawu ti ri na vun’winyi bya ku tiyisisa leswaku lava nga endla manyala va hela va xupuriwa, tanihi vaaki hinkwerhu hi na ntirho lowu hi faneleke ku wu endla ku herisa vugevenga lebyi.

src: South Africans are encouraged to actively join advocacy and awareness-raising programmes in their respective communities and sectors.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga va hlohloteriwa ku nghenelela va gingirika eka minongonoko yo seketela na ku tlakusa ndzemukiso eka miganga na tisekitara ta vona to hambanahambana.

src: Cabinet also encourages victims to report these heinous crimes to law-enforcement authorities, who must investigate allegations of GBV and act firmly within the ambit of the law to ensure that justice is served.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi khutaza vaxanisiwa ku vika vugevenga lebyi bya tihanyi eka vulawuri byo sindzisa nawu, lava va faneleke ku lavisisisa swihehlo swa GBV na ku tirha swinene hi ku landza nawu ku tiyisisa leswaku vululami bya fikeleriwa.

src: In a separate but related issue, the United Nations (UN) General Assembly proclaimed 13 June as International Albinism Awareness Day.
tgt: Eka mhaka yo hambana kambe leyi yelanaka, Nhlengeletano yo Angarhela ya Nhlangano wa Matiko (UN) yi vekile 13 Khotavuxika tanihi Siku ra Ndzemukiso wa Alibinizimi wa Matiko ya Misava.

src: The campaign aims to raise awareness about people living with albinism who are fully protected by the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Phfumba ri lava ku tlakusa ndzemukiso mayelana na vanhu lava hanyaka na alibinizimi lava nga sirheleriwa hi ku hetiseka hi Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ya Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.

src: It is the duty of all South Africans to educate themselves and others in the community on albinism so as to dispel myths and misconceptions.
tgt: I ntirho wa MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku ti dyondzisa na ku dyondzisa swirho swa vaaki hi alibinizimi leswaku ku bakanyeriwa etlhelo swikholwakholwani na leswi nga ri ki ntiyiso.

src: This will alleviate the trauma experienced by people with albinism and their families.
tgt: Leswi swi ta hunguta ku chava loku nga kona eka vanhu lava nga na alibinizimi na mindyangu ya vona.

src: International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF) decision.
tgt: Xiboho xa Federexini ya Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava ya Swipotso (IAAF).

src: Cabinet expressed concerns with the developments regarding to the new regulations of the International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF).
tgt: Khabinete yi kombise ku vilela hileswi humelelaka mayelana na swipimelo swintshwa IAAKhabinete yi amukela ntirho lowu nga ku endliweni hi Ndzawulo ya Mitlangu na Vuhungasi ya Afrika-Dzonga na leswaku, phanele ya xiyimo xa le henhla ya vativi eka swiyenge leswi fambelenaka swa mirhi na nawu swi hlanganisiwile hi SRSPhanele leyi yi ta hlaya swipimelo leswi hi vuxiyaxiya na ku kanela hi vumbhoni bya xisayense lebyi IAAF yi nga khomelela eka byona.

src: Cabinet welcomes the work being done by the Department of Sport and Recreation South Africa and, the fact that a high level panel of experts in the related fields of medicine and law were assemble by SRSThis panel will study these regulations closely and interrogate the scientific evidence that the IAAF had relied upon.
tgt: Yi ta kambela vulavisisi na vumbhoni bya xisayense hinkwabyo lebyi nga kona ku katsa na timhaka ta matikhomelo na ku tirhisa mbuyelo lowu ku tlhontlha swipimelo leswi eka tiforamu leti nga fanela.

src: It will evaluate all available research & scientific evidence as well as related ethical issues and use the outcome to challenge these regulations in the appropriate forums.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku seketela van’waswipotso hinkwavo lava nga va ka va khumbiwile hi swipimelo leswi kwala ekaya na lava nga le matikweni ya misava hinkwayo.

src: Situation in North West.
tgt: Xiyimo xa le N'walungu-Vupeladyambu.

src: Cabinet was presented with the report by the Inter-Ministerial Task Team (IMTT) on North West.
tgt: Khabinete yi nyikiwile xiviko hi Xipano xa va Vaholobye (IMTT) mayelana na swa le N'walungu-Vupeladyambu.

src: The report provided the preliminary work that has been done in the last two weeks.
tgt: Xiviko xi nyikile ntirho wo sungula lowu nga endliwa eka mavhiki mabirhi lawa ya nga hundza.

src: Cabinet was satisfied with the progress made by the IMTT in its efforts to stabilise the Province.
tgt: Khabinete yi enetekile hi ku humelela loku nga fikeleriwa hi IMTT eka matshalatshala ya yona ya ku tshamisekisa Xifundzankulu.

src: The IMTT, led by Minister in The Presidency, Dr Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, will remain seized with the North West issues.
tgt: IMTT, leyi nga rhangeriwa hi Holobye wa le Hofisini ya Phuresidente, Dok Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, yi na vun’winyi eka timhaka ta le N'walungu-Vupeladyambu.

src: A detailed media briefing on the outcomes of this work by the IMTT will be held in the North West next week.
tgt: Xiviko xo helela eka vahangalasamahungu hi mivuyelo ya ntirho lowu wa IMTT xi ta endliwa eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu vhiki leritaka.

src: Japan-Africa Public-Private Economic Forum.
tgt: Foramu ya Ikhonomi ya Mfumo-Mabindzu exikarhi ka Japan-Afri.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa delivered a keynote address at the inaugural Japan-Africa Public-Private Economic Forum held at the Sandton Convention Centre from 3 to 4 May 2018.
tgt: Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa u nyikile mbulavulo wa siku eka ku pfuriwa ka Foramu ya Ikhonomi ya Mfumo-Mabindzu exikarhi ka Japan-Afrika leyi a yi khomeriwile eSandton Convention Centre ku sukela hi ti3 ku fika hi ti 4 Mudyaxihi 2018.

src: The forum was co-hosted by South Africa, together with the government of Japan and the Japan External Trade Organization.
tgt: Foramu yi rhurheriwile xikan'we hi Afrika-Dzonga, na mfumo wa Japan na Nhlangano wa Mabindzu ya le Handle ka Japan.

src: Cabinet welcomes the continued commitment that was made at the Tokyo International Conference on African Development in Nairobi, Kenya in 2016, which saw Japan pledging US$30 billion in Africa between 2016 and 2019.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku tinyikela ku ya emahlweni loku endliweke eka Nhlengeletano ya Matiko ya Misava eTokyo hi Nhluvukiso wa Afrika eNairobi, eKenya hi 2016, loku nga vona Japan yi tshembisa US$30 wa tibiliyoni eAfrika exikarhi ka 2016 na 2019.

src: More than 100 Japanese companies have a presence in Africa.
tgt: Ku tlula 100 wa tikhamphani ta le Japan ti kona laha Afrika.

src: United States (US) Steel and Aluminum Tariff increase.
tgt: Ku Engeteleriwa ka Tihakelo ta Tinsimbhi na Aluminiyamu hi Amerika (US).

src: Cabinet expresses its disappointment on the decision by the US not to exempt South Africa from the application of steel and aluminum duties.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombisa ku nga khomeki kahle hi xiboho xa Amerika ku ka yi nga humesi Afrika-Dzonga eka xikombelo xa ku nga hakeri swibalo swa tinsimbhi na aluminiyamu.

src: The South African Government will continue to engage with US authorities to find a mutually acceptable outcome.
tgt: Mfumo wa Afrika-Dzonga wu ta ya emahlweni na ku burisana na vulawuri bya Amerika ku kuma mbuyelo lowu amukelekaka eka hinkwavo.

src: Cabinet also encourages domestic exporters to continue to lobby US buyers to apply for product exemptions, as South African companies export niche products and semi-processed products for further processing in the URevitalisation of Industrial Parks.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi khutaza varhumeri va tinhundzu va laha kaya ku ya emahlweni va hlohlotela vaxavi va le Amerika ku endla xikombelo xa ku sivela ku hakeriwa ka swibalo, tanihileswi tikhamphani ta Afrika-Dzonga ti rhumelaka swimakiwa swa xiyimo xa le henhla na swimakiwa leswi nga helelangiki ku va swi ya hetisisiwa eAmerika.

src: Cabinet welcomes the completion of the first phase of the revitalisation of the Phuthaditjhaba Industrial Park in the Free State as an important milestone in implementing the Revitalisation of Industrial Parks Programme.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku hetisiwa ka xiyenge xo sungula xa ku vuyelerisa ka Phaka ya Mabindzu ya Phuthaditjhaba eFree State tanihi goza ra nkoka eku simekiweni ka Phurogireme ya ku Vuyelerisa ka Tiphaka ta Mabindzu.

src: The R50-million upgrades will attract more local entrepreneurs to set up their operations due to the improved infrastructure and security.
tgt: Ku kurisa loku nga endliwa hi R50 wa timiliyoni ku ta koka rinoko eka van'wamabindzu va laha kaya ku sungula mitirho ya vona hi mhaka ya ku antswisiwa ka miako na vuhlayiseki.

src: Investment.
tgt: Vuvekisi.

src: Cabinet congratulates the partnership between the Department of Trade and Industry (the dti) and Aspen Pharmacare, which has resulted in the announcement of a R1-billion investment in the pharmaceutical drug plant in Port Elizabeth in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka xinakulobye exikarhi ka Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki (dti) na Aspen Pharmacare, leswi nga endla leswaku ku tivisiwa vuvekisi bya R1 wa tibiliyoni eka feme ya ku endla swidzidziharisi ePort Elizabeth eka Kapa-Vuxa.

src: The pharmaceutical company benefited from the dti’s 12I Tax Incentive with a tax credit of about R209 million.
tgt: Khamphani ya ku endla mirhi yi vuyeriwile hi ku suka eka Xinavetisi xa Xibalo xa 12I xa dti hi ntsengo wa xibalo xa xikweleti wa kwalomu ka R209 wa timiliyoni.

src: The opening of the facility will create 500 new jobs.
tgt: Ku pfuriwa ka muako swi ta tumbuluxa 500 wa mitirho yintshwa.

src: This is a significant investment which is taking South Africa into a new level of manufacturing space and creating the necessary jobs that the country needs.
tgt: Lebyi i vuvekisi byikulu lebyi yisaka Afrika-Dzonga eka xiyimo xintshwa xa ku vumaki na ku endla mitirho yintshwa ya nkoka leyi lavekaka etikweni.

src: Lower data costs.
tgt: Tihakelo ta le Hansi ta Datha.

src: Cabinet welcomes the new rules proposed by the Independent Communications Authority of South Africa to improve regulations around data, SMS and voice services.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela milawu yintshwa leyi nga ringanyetiwa hi Ndzawulo yo Tiyimela ya Vuhlanganisi bya Afrika-Dzonga ku antswisa swipimelo mayelana na datha, SMS na vukorhokeri bya ku vulavula.

src: The changes are steps toward ensuring fairness in business practice around data pricing and ensure that consumers will not lose unused data.
tgt: Ku cinca i magoza ya ku tiyisisa vululami eka matirhelo ya bindzu eka timhaka ta mahakelelo ya datha na ku tiyisisa leswaku vatirhisi va nga lahlekeriwi hi datha leyi va nga yi tirhisangiki.

src: The Market Inquiry being conducted by the Competition Commission will highlight and focus on additional measures, to ensure South African data prices support broader digital access and prepare us for the opportunities created by the Fourth Industrial Revolution.
tgt: Vulavisisi bya Timakete lebyi nga le ku endliweni hi Khomixini ya Mphikizano byi ta kombisa swinene na ku kongomisa eka tindlela to engetela, ku tiyisisa leswaku tihakelo ta datha laha Afrika-Dzonga tiseketela mfikelelo wa dijithali wo anama na ku hi lulamisela swivandlanene leswi nga endliwa hi Hundzuluxo wa Vumaki wa Vumune.

src: Mining Sector.
tgt: Sekithara ya Migodi.

src: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in expressing sadness following the loss of lives of mineworkers at the Sibanye-Stillwater’s Driefontein Mine near Carletonville on the West Rand, and furthermore extends its condolences to the families and friends of the deceased.
tgt: Khabinete yi yima na Phuresidente Ramaphosa ku ku kombisa ku twa ku vava endzhaku ka ku lahleka ka vutomi bya vatirhi va le migodini eMugodini wa Sibanye-Stillwater’s Driefontein ekusushi na Carletonville eWest Rand, naswona yi rhumela marito yo chavelela eka mindyangu na vanghana va lava hundzeke emisaveni.

src: The Minister of Mineral Resources, Mr Gwede Mantashe, is expected to represent government at a memorial service to be held this week.
tgt: Holobye wa Swicelwa, Tat Gwede Mantashe, u languteriwe ku yimela mfumo eka ntirho wa ku tsundzuka lowu nga ta khomiwa eka vhiki leri.

src: Cabinet urges the mining sector to fast-track their research that will assist us in the capability in detecting seismic activities in the mines and save lives.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlohlotela sekithara ya migodi ku hatlisisa vulavisisi bya yona lebyi nga ta hi pfuna eka vuswikoti bya ku kuma ku tsekatseka ka migodi na ku ponisa vutomi.

src: UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF).
tgt: Nkwama wa Vana wa UN (UNICEF).

src: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in expressing appreciation for UNICEF’s support and cooperation in empowering the youth of South Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi yima na Phuresidente Ramaphosa eka ku kombisa ku nkhensa eka nseketelo na ntirhisano wa UNICEF eka ku nyika matimba eka vantshwa va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Executive Director of UNICEF, Ms Henrietta Fore, paid a courtesy call to President Ramaphosa on Monday, 7 May 2018.
tgt: Mulawurinkulu wa UNICEF, Manana Henrietta Fore, u endzerile ximfumo e Phuresidente Ramaphosa hi Musumbunuku, 7 Mudyaxihi 2018.

src: She outlined UNICEF's report on South Africa's initiatives in the areas of education, work skills development and economic opportunities for young people, especially for those between 10 and 18 years old.
tgt: U andlarile xiviko xa UNICEF eka migingiriko ya Afrika-Dzonga eka timhaka ta dyondzo, nhluvukiso wa swikili swa mitirho na swivandlanene swa ikhonomi eka vantshwa, ngopfungopfu eka lava nga ni malembe ya le xikarhi ka 10 na 18 hi vukhale.

src: UNICEF commended South Africa’s efforts to create opportunities for young people to participate meaningfully in the economy, and expressed willingness to assist our country’s schools with the provision of water and sanitation.
tgt: UNICEF yi bele mandla eka Afrika-Dzonga eka ku tirha ku endla swivandlanene eka vantshwa ku ku va va nghenelela hi ku hetiseka eka ikhonomi, na ku kombisa ku tsakela ku pfuna swikolo swa tiko ra hina eka ku fikeleriwa ka mati na mbhasiso.

src: UNICEF has invited South Africa to share its success on youth empowerment as part of its global campaign to advance opportunities for youth – a sure sign of our country’s strengthening relations with the UN.
tgt: UNICEF yi rhambile Afrika-Dzonga ku avelana ku humelela ka yona eku nyikeni matimba eka vantshwa tanihi pfhumba ra matiko ya misava ku yisa emahlweni swivandlanene eka vantshwa - ku nga xikombiso xo tiya xa ku tiyisisa vuxaka bya tiko ra hina na UN.

src: Cabinet approved the Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) 2018/19 – 2020/21.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Kungu ra Migingiriko ra Pholisi ya Vumaki (IPAP) 2018/19 - 2020/21.

src: This is the 10th iteration of a rolling annual action plan aligned to successive three-year cycles of the Medium Term Expenditure Framework.
tgt: Loku i ku vuyelela ka vu 10 ka kungu ra migingiriko ya lembe na lembe ya nhluvukiso lowu fambisanaka na ku humelela ka malembe ya nharhu hi ku landzelelana ka Rimba ra Ntirhiso wa le Xikarhi ka Theme.

src: The revised IPAP summarises the achievements of the industrial policy over the past nine years.
tgt: IPAP leyi nga pfuxetiwa i nkomiso wa leswi nga fikeleriwa eka pholisi ya vumaki eka malembe ya kaye lawa ya nga hundza.

src: It provides an economic analysis of the global and domestic economy relevant to industrial policy, summarises the challenges and constraints to the optimal implementation of the industrial policy, as well as a range of transversal and sector specific time-bound key action plans assigned to the respective departments.
tgt: Yi nyika nxopaxopo wa ikhonomi ya misava na ya laha kaya leyi nga fanela eka pholisi ya vumaki, nkomiso wa mitlhontlho na mitlimbo eka ku simekiwa hi ku hetiseka ka pholisi ya vumaki, ku katsa na ku cincana ko hambanahambana na makungu ya migingirikonkulu ya nkarhi lowu vekiweke hi sekithara yokarhi lawa ya nyikiweke tindzawulo hi ku hambana ka tona.

src: Cabinet approved that the Tripartite Free Trade Area (TFTA) Agreement be tabled in Parliament for ratification.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Ntwanano wa Mabindzu ya Mihlangano yi Nharhu ya Mahala (TFTA) ku va yi andlariwa ePalamende.

src: The agreement establishes the Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa, East African Community and Southern African Development Community.
tgt: Ntwanano wu tumbuluxa Makete lowu Fanaka wa le Vuxeni na le Dzongeni wa Afrika, Muganga wa le Vuxeni bya Afrika na Muganga wa Nhluvukiso wa le Dzongeni wa Afrika.

src: This TFTA is a key Africa-led project that marks a decisive step to overcome the continent’s colonial heritage of small fragmented markets, by promoting intra-African investments and attracting more foreign investment into the free trade WEBTOKEN a result of regional integration efforts and stable economies, there has been strong growth in intra-African investments.
tgt: TFTA leyi i phurojeke leyi rhangeriwaka hi Afrika leyi kombisaka ku teka swiboho ku hlula ndzhaka ya xikoloni laha Afrika eka timakete letintsongo leti nga hambana, hi ku seketela vuvekisi bya kwala Afrika na ku koka rinoko ra vuvekisi byo tala bya matikomambe eka tindhawu ta mabindzu lawa ya nga ri ki na swipimelo.

src: Cabinet approved South Africa’s Third National Communication Report for submission to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).The primary objective of the UNFCCC is to achieve the stabilisation of greenhouse gas concentrations in the atmosphere to a level that would prevent dangerous anthropogenic activities from interfering with the climate system.
tgt: Tanihi mbuyelo wa ku hlangana ka miganga na ku tshamiseka ka tiikhonomi, ku vile na ku kula eka vuvekisi bya kwala tikweninkulu ra Afrika eka vuvekisi.

src: South Africa’s report contains an analysis of its progress from the initial National Communication to the Second National Communication and subsequently the Third Communication Report, as reviewed by the international community and domestic stakeholders.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Xiviko xa Vuhlanganisi xa Rixaka xa Vunharhu xa Afrika-Dzonga ku va xi rhumeriwa eka Rimba ra UN eka Ntwanano wa ku Cinca ka Maxelo (UNFCCC).Xikongomelo xo rhanga xa UNFCCC i ku fikelela ntshamiseko eka nhlanganelo wa mimoya ya le xibakabakeni ku fika eka xiyimo lexi nga ta sivela migingiriko leyi nga ya khombo ya matumbulukelo ya vanhu ku va yi kavanyeta sisiteme ya maxelo.

src: Bills.
tgt: Milawumbisi.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Aquaculture Development Bill of 2018 to Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhumeriwa ka Nawumbisi wa Nhluvukiso wa swa le Lwandle wa 2018 ePalamende.

src: The Bill, which came out of full consultation with all the relevant stakeholders in the aquaculture sector, seeks to promote aquaculture development in the oceans economy.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu ku nga burisaniwa na hinkwavo lava khumbhekaka lava nga fanela, wu lava ku tlakusa nhluvukiso wa swa le lwandle eka ikhonomi ya le lwandle.

src: It provides, amongst others, the institutional arrangements of the sector sets out the licensing and permitting requirements for aquaculture and the establishment of the aquaculture development zones.
tgt: Wu nyika, eka swin'wana swa kona, mitwanano ya mihlangano ya sekithara, ku endla mapapila ya mpfumelelo na swilaveko swa mpfumelelo eka swa le lwandle na ku tumbuluxiwa ka tizoni ta nhluvukiso ta swa le lwandle.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Occupational Health and Safety Bill of 2018 to Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhumeriwa ka Nawumbisi wa Vuhlayiseki na Rihanyo ra le Ntirhweni wa 2018 ePalamende.

src: The Bill amends the Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 (Act 85 of 1993).
tgt: Nawumbisi wu antswisa Nawu wa Vuhlayiseki na Rihanyo ra le Ntirhweni, 1993 (Nawu wa 85 wa 1993).

src: Once adopted, the Bill will ensure greater protection of workers in respect of injuries and diseases at the workplace.
tgt: Loko wu amukeriwile, Nawumbisi wu ta tiyisisa nsirhelelo wa le henhla wa vatirhi loko swi ta eka ku vaviseka na mavabyi etindhawini ta ntirho.

src: The Bill establishes a clearly defined Health and Safety Management System and is in line with international best practice.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu tumbuluxa nhlamuselo leyi nga erivaleni ya Sisiteme ya Vufambisi bya Vuhlayiseki na Rihanyo leyi fambisanaka na matirhelo ya xiyimo xa le henhla xa matiko ya misava.

src: It also provides for mandatory risk assessment to be conducted by the employer and a workplace-specific risk management plan developed and implemented to minimise the exposure of employees to risk.
tgt: Wu tlhela wu nyika vuhleri bya nxungeto lowu bohaka ku va wu endliwa hi muthori na kungu ra mafambiselo ya nxungeto wo nkarhi wa laha ku tirhiwaka kona ku va wu endliwa na ku simekiwa ku hunguta ku va ekhombyeni ka vathoriwa.

src: Messages.
tgt: Mahungu ya nkoka.

src: Congratulations.
tgt: Ku hoyozela.

src: Cabinet congratulates President Ramaphosa, who has been invited by the International Labour Conference (ILO) Governing Body to co-chair the Global Commission on Future of Work.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Phuresidente Ramaphosa, loyi a nga rhambiwa hi Khomfarense ya Nhlangano wa Vatirhi va Matiko ya Misava (ILO) ya Huvo leyi Fumaka ku va mutshamaxitulukulorhi eka Mitirho ya Mundzuku eka Khomixini ya Misava.

src: The President has also been invited to address the conference, which is celebrating 100 years of existence.
tgt: Phuresidente u tlhele a rhambiwa ku nyika mbulavulo eka khomfarense, leyi tlangelaka 100 wa malembe yi ri kona.

src: Whilst there he, will pay homage and honour the Centenary of former President Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Loko a ha ri kwale, u ta tlhela a tsundzuka na ku xixima Malembexidzana ya Khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela.

src: Cabinet thanks the Africa Group in the ILO governing body for leading the discussion in Geneva and appreciates the discussions held by the country’s ruling party in their local constituencies.
tgt: Khabinete yi nkhensa Ntlawa wa Afrika eka huvo ya mafumele ya ILO ku va yi rhangela mbhurisano eGeneva na ku khensa mivulavurisano leyi nga khomiweke hi vandla leri fumaka eka miganga ya kwala kaya.

src: Cabinet expresses condolences to the family and friends of the late former and first Minister of Finance of democratic South Africa, Mr Derek Keys, who played a significant role in the smooth handover of Treasury to a democratically elected government in 1994.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhumela marito yo chavelela eka ndyangu na vanghana va khale na Holobye wo sungula wa Timali eka Afrika-Dzonga ra xidemokirasi, Tat Derek Keys, loyi a nga hoxa xandla swinene eka ku hundzisela Nkwama wa tiko ku ya eka mfumo wa xidemokirasi lowu nga hlawuriwa hi 1994.

src: Ramadan.
tgt: Ramadan.

src: Cabinet extends well wishes to the Muslim community as they begin fasting for the holy month of Ramadan next week.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhumela ku navelela ka kahle eka rixaka ra Mamozileme loko va ha sungula ku titsona eka n'hweti yo tenga ya Ramadan vhiki leri landzaka.

src: During Ramadan, Muslims fast from sunrise to sunset, as they spend time deepening their spirituality.
tgt: Hi nkarhi wa Ramadan, Mamozileme va titsona ku sukela loko dyambu ri tlhava ku fikela loko ripela, loko va teka nkarhi va kula eximoyeni.

src: Upcoming Events.
tgt: Mitlangu leyi landzelaka.

src: President Ramaphosa will today, 10 May 2018, visit the Department of Defence and Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs (CoGTA) respectively, as part of his efforts to engage with senior leadership to ensure that the work of government is effectively aligned.
tgt: Namuntlha Phuresidente Ramaphosa, 10 Mudyaxihi 2018, u ta endzela Ndzawulo ya Vusirheleri na Ndzawulo ya Mfumontirhisano na Timhaka ta Xintu (CoGTA) hi ku landzelelana, tanihi xiphemu xakwe xa ku burisana na vurhangerinkulu ku tiyisisa leswaku mitirho ya mfumo yi fambisana kahle.

src: This visit is part of the President’s commitment announced in his maiden State of the Nation Address in February 2018 to visit every national department in this regard.
tgt: Riendzo leri i xiphemu xa ku tinyikela ka Phuresidente tanihiloko a vurile eka Mbulavulo wa yena na Rixaka wo sungula hi Nyenyanyana 2018 wa ku endzela ndzawulo yin'wana na yin'wana ya rixaka hi mayelana na mhaka leyi.

src: Deputy President David Mabuza will today, 10 May 2018, address the 3rd Human Resource Development Council of South Africa Summit at Emperors Palace in Johannesburg under the theme: ‘Partnerships revitalising work and learning’.
tgt: Namuntlha Xandla xa Phuresidente David Mabuza, 10 Mudyaxihi 2018, u ta vulavula eka Samiti ya vunharhu ya Huvo ya Nhluvukiso wa Vuthori ya Afrika-Dzonga eEmperors Palace eJoni ehansi ka nkongomelo: 'Xinakulobye xa ku pfuxelela ntirho na ku dyondza.'

src: The two-day summit will bring together key industry leaders, labour experts and academics to deliberate on various issues, including proposals to deal with youth unemployment, and advance empowerment and the Fourth Industrial Revolution.
tgt: Samiti ya masiku mambirhi yi ta tisa varhangeri va vumaki bya nkoka, vativi va swa mitirho na swidyondzeki ku tekela enhlokweni timhaka to hambanahambana, ku katsa na swiringanyeto swa ku tirhana na ku pfumaleka ka mitirho ya vantshwa, na ku yisa emahlweni ku nyika matimba ku yisa emahlweni na Hundzuluxo wa Vumaki wa Vumune.

src: Cabinet also reiterates the invitation to South Africans to join the year-long Centenary celebrations of Tata Nelson Mandela and Mama Albertina Sisulu, who helped build the foundation of the South Africa’s democracy we enjoy today.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi vuyelerisa xirhambo eka MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku va va nghenelela eka ku tlangela Malembexidzana ya Tatana Nelson Mandela na Manana Albertina Sisulu, lava nga pfuna ku aka masungulo ya xidemokirasi xa Afrika-Dzonga lexi hi tiphinaka ha xona namuntlha.

src: The Inter-Ministerial Committee on the Nelson Mandela Centenary and Centenary of Albertina Sisulu launched the National Programme this week.
tgt: Komiti ya Vaholobye ya Malembexidzana ya Nelson Mandela na Malembexidzana ya Albertina Sisulu yi simekile Phurogireme ya Rixaka vhiki leri.

src: Details of the celebrations can be found on the government website (WEBTOKEN), where other upcoming government scheduled briefings/activities can also be found.
tgt: Vuxokoxoko bya ku tlangela byi nga kumeka eka webusayiti ya mfumo eka (WEBTOKEN)), laha mitlangu yin'wana leyi ya ha taka ya mfumo na migingiriko yi nga kumekaka kona.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa ku va kona endzhaku ka nkambelo wa tidyondzo na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.

src: Ms Lerato Mataboge as the dti representative to the Board of the Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited.
tgt: Manana Lerato Mataboge tanihi muyimeri wa dti eka Huvo ya ku Rhumeriwa ka Ndzindzakhombo wa Xikweleti wa Afrika-Dzonga SOC limited.

src: Ms RS Mogaladi as Deputy Director-General: Institutional Support and Co-ordination, CoGTA.
tgt: Manana RS Mogaladi tanihi Xandla xa Mulawuri wo Angarhela: Mafambiselo na Nseketelo wa Nhlangano, CoGTA.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 23 May 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.
tgt: Xitatimente xa Nhlengeletano ya Khabinete xa ti 23 Mudyaxihi 2018Khabinete yi hlangenile hi Ravunharhu, 23 Mudyaxihi 2018, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Issues in the environment.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.

src: Gender-Based Violence (GBV).
tgt: Madzolonga lama yaka hi Rimbewu (GBV).

src: Cabinet strongly condemns the violence against women and children.
tgt: Khabinete yi sola hi matimba madzolonga ehenhla ka vavasati na vana.

src: The most recent cases of Nonkululeko Mpanza and Nompumelelo Mhlongo in Thokoza, Ekurhuleni Katlego Joja in Mamelodi, Tshwane Promise Mthembu in KwaZulu-Natal and Jabulile Nhlapo, the Unisa student, brings into sharp focus the level of violence that threatens the lives of our women and children.
tgt: Milandzu leyi ya ha ku vaka kona sweswinyana ya Nonkululeko Mpanza na Nompumelelo Mhlongo eThokoza, Ekurhuleni Katlego Joja eMamelodi, Tshwane Promise Mthembu eKwaZulu-Natal na Jabulile Nhlapo, xichudeni lexa le Unisa, yi tisa nkongomiso lowukulu eka mpimo wa madzolonga lowu chavisetaka vutomi bya vavasati na vana va hina.

src: Cabinet expresses its deepest condolences to the families and friends of these women and children.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzisa michavelelo ya yona leyikulu eka mindyangu na vanghana va vavasati na vana lava.

src: The issue of crime against women and children requires all of us to actively be involved in fighting it.
tgt: Xiphiqo xa vugevenga ehenhla ka vavasati na vana xi lava hinkwerhu ka hina ku khumbeka hi ndlela yo gingiriteka eka ku lwisana na xona.

src: Cabinet continues to strengthen law-enforcement agencies in the fight to stop GBAmongst the Bills approved in this last Cabinet is the Criminal Procedure Amendment Bill of 2018, which amends the Criminal Procedure Act, 1977 (Act 51 of 1977).
tgt: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi tiyisa tiejensi to sindzisa nawu eka nyimpi ya ku yimisa GBExikarhi ka Milawumbisi leyi pasisiweke eka Khabinete leyi nga hundza i Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Mafambiselo ya Vugevenga wa 2018, lowu hundzuluxaka Nawu wa Mafambiselo ya Vugevenga, 1977 (Nawu wa 51 wa 1977).

src: The Bill will extend the list of sexual offences in respect of the prosecution and significantly it will allow the sexual cases to go before courts even after 20 years.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu ta ndlandlamukisa nxaxamelo wa milandzu ya swa masangu hi mayelana na vuchuchisi naswona hindlela yo tivikana swinene wu pfumelela milandzu ya swa masangu ku ya emahlweni ka tikhoto hambi ku ri endzhaku ka 20 wa malembe.

src: These interventions add to a number of measures that government has already put in place.
tgt: Ku nghenelela loku ku ta engetela nhlayo ya magoza lama mfumo se wu ya tekeke.

src: A total of 54 Thuthuzela Care Centres across the country have been opened to serve as a one-stop facility to reduce secondary victimisation and reduce the time of finalising sexual cases.
tgt: Ntsengo wa 54 wa Tisenthara ta Nhlayiso ta Thuthuzela etikweni hinkwaro ti pfuriwile ku tirha tanihi xitirhisiwa lexi nga na vukorhokeri hinkwabyo ku hunguta ku xanisiwa ka vumbirhi na ku hunguta nkarhi wa ku hetisisa milandzu ya swa masangu.

src: Government has set up 75 dedicated Sexual Offences Courts to deal decisively with sexual violence against women.
tgt: Mfumo wu simekile 75 wa Tikhoto ta Milandzu ya swa Masangu leti endleriweke hi xikongomelo xa ku tirhana hi ndlela yo tisa mbuyelo eka madzolonga ya swa masangu ehenhla ka vavasati.

src: Furthermore, the South African Police Service has established 1 047 dedicated facilities for victims at police stations countrywide to accommodate and assist victims of GBChild Protection Week will be held from 27 May to 2 June 2018.
tgt: Ku yisa emahlweni, Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga hi tumbuluxile 1 047 wa switirhisiwa leswi nyikeriweke vaxanisiwa eswitichini swa maphorisa etikweni hinkwaro ku rhurhela na ku pfuneta vaxanisiwa va GBVhiki ra Nsirhelelo wa Vana ri ta khomiwa kusuka hi siku ra 27 Mudyaxihi kufika ra 2 Khotavuxika 2018.

src: Cabinet calls on parents, guardians and communities to work with law-enforcement agencies to protect our children.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba vatswari, vahlayisi na vaakandhawu ku tirhisana na tiejensi to sindzisa nawu ku sirhelela vana va hina.

src: Cabinet reiterates that if you suspect your child is missing, you must immediately report to your nearest police station.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshikelele leswaku loko u ehleketelela leswaku n’wana wa wena wa kayivela, u fanele ku mangala xikan’wekan’we exitichini xa maphorisa xa le kusuhi na wena.

src: We must work together as a peace-loving and law-abiding society to tackle all crimes against women and children.
tgt: Hi fanele ku tirhisana tanihi rixaka leri rhandzaka ku rhula na ku va leri hlayisaka nawu ku tirhana na vugevenga hinkwabyo ehenhla ka vavasati na vana.

src: Cabinet calls on those aware of any crimes against children to contact the toll-free Childline on 0800 055 555 or Crime Stop on 086 0010.111.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba lava va tivaka hi vugevenga byihi kumbe byihi ehenhla ka vana ku bela riqingho eka nomboro ya mahala yo Pfuna hi swa Vana eka 0800 055 555 kumbe Riqingho ro Mangala Vugevenga eka 086 0010.111.

src: If you are a woman in distress or if you are aware of a woman in distress, the GBV Command Centre’s toll-free number is 0800 428 428 or (0800 GBV GBV).
tgt: Loko u ri wansati loyi a nga eku xanisekeni kumbe loko u tiva wansati loyi a nga eku xanisekeni, nomboro ya mahala ya Senthara ya Ndzeriso ya GBV i 0800 428 428 kumbe (0800 GBV GBV).

src: Cabinet calls on all of us to work together to do more to prevent violence against women and children, support survivors of abuse and bring perpetrators to justice.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba hinkwerhu ka hina ku tirhisana ku endla swo tala ku sivela madzolonga ehenhla ka vavasati na vana, ku seketela lava poneke nxaniso na ku endla leswaku vaonhi va xupuriwa.

src: It is the duty of everyone to report those who hurt, exploit and abuse women and children so that the perpetrators can be arrested and convicted.
tgt: I vutihlamuleri bya munhu un’wana na un’wana ku mangalela lava va vavisaka, va va tirhisaka hindlela yo homboloka na ku xanisa vavasati na vana ku endlela leswaku vaonhi va khomiwa na ku voniwa nandzu.

src: EconomyCabinet welcomes the positive growth in employment of two hundred and six thousand jobs reflected in the first quarter of 2018, from the latest Quarterly Labour Force Survey released by Statistics South Africa.
tgt: IkhonomiKhabinete yi amukela ku kula lokunene eka ku thoriwa ka madzanambirhi na magiditsevu wa mitirho leyi kombisiweke eka kotara yo sungula ya 2018, kusuka eka Mbalango wa Vatirhi wa Kotara na Kotara lowu wa ha ku humesiwaka hi Nhlangano wa Tinhlayonhlayo wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The upswing in employment was driven by increases in six of the 10 industries.
tgt: Ku tlakuka eka ku thoriwa a ku hlohloteriwa hi mitlakuko eka tsevu wa 10 ra tiindasitiri.

src: The unemployment rate amongst our young people, however, remains high at 52.4%, with an absorption rate of only 12.2%.
tgt: Mpimo wa vupfumalantirho exikarhi ka vanhu va ka hina lavatsongo, hambiswiritano, ku tama ka ha ri ehenhla eka 52.4%, laha ku nga na mpimo wa ku nghena entirhweni wa 12.2% ntsena.

src: Cabinet calls on sectors of society to continue to pull together to tackle youth WEBTOKEN the spirit of ‘Thuma Mina – Send Me’ inspired by President Cyril Ramaphosa in his maiden State of the Nation Address in February 2018, Cabinet calls on all South Africans, in particular the private sector, to help create jobs and invest locally so that more South Africans can be drawn into the economy.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba tisekitara ta rixaka ku ya emahlweni ti tirhisana ku tirhana na vupfumalantirho bya vantshwa.

src: EnergyCabinet welcomes as a milestone the launch of the Xina Solar One Concentrated Solar Power Project in the Northern Cape.
tgt: Hi moya wa ‘Thuma Mina – Send Me’ lowu hlohloteriweke hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa eka Mbulavulo wa yena Xiyimo xa Rixaka wo sungula hi Nyenyanyana 2018, Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo, ngopfungopfu sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo, ku pfuna ku tumbuluxa mitirho na ku vekisa laha tikweni ku endlela leswaku Maafrika-Dzonga vo tala va kota ku nghenisiwa eka ikhonomi.

src: The Xina Solar One plant will provide clean energy to Eskom under a 20-year power purchase agreement.
tgt: EnejiKhabinete yi amukela tanihi mpimo ku simekiwa ka Phurojeke ya Matimba ya Dyambu lama Hlengeletaneke ya Xina Solar One eKapa-N’walungu.

src: This will translate into 95 000 South African households receiving clean energy, especially during peak hours.
tgt: I yin’wana ya nkombo wa Tiphurojeke ta Matimba ya Dyambu lama Hlengeletaneke leti nga ehansi ka Nongonoko wa Maxavelo ya Vahumesi va Matimba lava Tiyimelaka va Eneji leyi Vuyelerisekaka wa Ndzawulo ya Eneji.

src: North West.
tgt: N’walungu-Vupeladyambu.

src: Cabinet received a second report from the Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) on North West and is satisfied with the progress in stabilizing the province.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukele xiviko xa vumbirhi kusuka eka Komiti ya Vaholobye (IMC) eka N’walungu-Vupeladyambu naswona yi enerisekile hi ndzima leyi khatsiweke eka ku tshamisekisa xifundzakulu.

src: In its previous meeting, Cabinet approved that North West be placed under Section 100 (1) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Eka nhlengeletano ya yona leyi nga hundza, Khabinete yi pasise leswaku N’walungu-Vupeladyambu yi vekiwa ehansi ka Xiyenge xa 100 (1) xa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.

src: Cabinet also increased the members of IMC with the Ministers of Basic Education Public Service and Administration Human Settlements Social Development Tourism Environmental Affairs and Transport.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi engetele swirho swa IMC hi Vaholobye va Dyondzo ya Masungulo Vutirhelamfumo na Vulawuri Vutshamiso bya Vanhu Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu Vupfhumba Timhaka ta Mbangu na Vutleketli.

src: The IMC was asked to do further work in the province and advise Cabinet on which of the provincial departments should be placed under Section 100 (1)
tgt: IMC yi komberiwile ku endla ntirho wo yisa emahlweni exifundzenikulu na ku tsundzuxa Khabinete eka leswaku hi tihi ta tindzawulo ta xifundzakulu lexi ti faneleke ku vekiwa ehansi ka Xiyenge xa 100 (1)

src: or section 100(1)
tgt: kumbe Xiyenge xa 100 (1)

src: of the Constitution.
tgt: xa Vumbiwa.

src: As a result of this work, Cabinet has approved that five of the provincial departments should be placed under Section 100 (1) :(1).
tgt: Hikwalaho ka ntirho lowu, Khabinete yi pasisile leswaku ntlhanu wa tindzawulo ta xifundzakulu ti fanele ku vekiwa ehansi ka Xiyenge xa 100 (1) :Hofisi ya PhirimiyaNdzawulo ya Vuhlayiseki bya Vaakandhawu na Mafambiselo ya VutleketliNdzawulo ya Dyondzo ya Masungulo na Nhluvukiso wa MitlanguNdzawulo ya Rihanyu naNdzawulo ya Mitirho ya Mfumo na Magondzo.

src: The IP Policy Phase I is informed among others by the Constitution, the NDP, the National Drug Master Plan, the National Industrial Policy Framework and the various iterations of the Industrial Policy Action WEBTOKEN will serve as an important policy instrument in promoting innovation, technology transfer, research and development, creative expression, consumer protection, industrial development and more broadly, economic growth.
tgt: Wu angarhela, exikarhi ka swin’wana, nsirhelelo wa miri wa matheriyali eka ntirho wa le tikweni, vuhlayiselo na vutleketli, na nsirhelelo wa timatheriyali na switirhisiwa swa nyutliliya ehenhla ka ku onhiwa.

src: Cabinet approved the ratification of the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons by Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku rhurhela hi ku hlanganela ka Mihlangano ya Mavuthu lama Hlomeke ya Khomferense ya Matiko ya Misava ya Valavisisi va Swivilelo swa Vaaki ya vu 10, hi Hofisi ya Mulavisisi wa Swivilelo swa Vaaki wa Masocha, leyi yi xeduriweke ku va kona hi Nhlangula 2018.Lexi i xiendleko xa lembe na lembe xa Senthara ya Vulawuri bya Xidemokirasi xa Mavuthu lama Hlomeke, leyi kumekaka eGeneva, Switzerland, naswona ku ta va rosungula ku rhurheriwa hi nhlanganelo eAfrika.

src: Cabinet approved the Amendment to the Convention on the Physical Protection of Nuclear Material, to be tabled in Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Swikimi swa Vutshunguri wa 2018 ku kandziyisiwa eka Gazete ya Mfumo leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.

src: The Convention on the Physical Protection of Nuclear Material is the only legally binding international instrument in the area of physical protection of nuclear material.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu hundzuluxa Nawu wa Swikimi swa Vutshunguri wa 1998 (Nawu wa 131 wa 1998) ku wu fambelanisa na Mpfapfarhuto wa Tirhele ra Mfumo ra Ndzindzakhombo wa Rihanyu wa Rixaka (NHI) na Nawumbisimpfapfarhutwa wa Nkwama wa NHNawumbisi wu lava, exikarhi ka swin’wana, ku antswisa vulawuri wa bya indasitiri ya swikimi swa vutshunguri na ku tlhela wu fambelanisa rimba ro lawula eka ku cinca loku veke kona eka malembexikhume lama nga hundza eka sekitara leyi.

src: The amended convention is an important milestone in international efforts to improve the physical protection of nuclear materials and facilities by setting common standards of WEBTOKEN covers among others, the physical protection of nuclear material in domestic use, storage and transport, and the protection of nuclear materials and facilities against sabotage.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu ta tlhela wu tiyisisa leswaku vavuyeriwa va sirheleriwa ku antswa naswona wu ta kondletela mfikelelo wo antswa wa timali ta rihanyu leti humaka eka swiyenge leswi nga riki swa mfumo.

src: Cabinet approved the co-hosting of the 10th International Conference of the Ombud’s Institutions of the Armed Forces, by the Office of the Military Ombud, which is scheduled for October 2018.This is an annual event organised by the Centre for the Democratic Control of the Armed Forces, based in Geneva, Switzerland, and will for the first time be co-hosted in Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku andlariwa ka Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Swikweleti swa Mfumo wa 2018 ePalamende.

src: This Bill will also ensure that beneficiaries are better protected and promotes better access to private-health funding.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi ta engetela swipfuno swa timali leswi kumekaka eka swibedhlele swa swifundzakulu ku nyika vukorhokeri bya nhlayiso wa swa rihanyu.

src: Cabinet approved the introduction of the State Liability Amendment Bill of 2018 to Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise nkandziyiso wa Nawumbisi wa ku Cinca ka Maxelo wa Rixaka wa 2018 ku va vaaki va nyika mavonelo.

src: The Bill amends the State Liability Act of 1957.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu pfumelela ku fambelanisiwa ka tipholisi leti ti hlohlotelaka angulo wa ku cinca ka maxelo wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: It provides for the settlement structure of claims against the State that came as a result of wrongful medical treatment of persons by servants of the State.
