src: Cabinet endorses the intervention by the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster to urgently engage on a comprehensive strategy to deal with various issues emanating from the recently released crime statistics.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela mphalalo hi Ntlawa wa Vululami, Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Nsirhelelo ku vulavurisana hi ku hatlisa hi qhinga ro angarhela ku tirhana na swiphiqo swo hambanahambana leswi tumbulukaka eka tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga leta ha ku humesiwaka ku nga ri khale.

src: This includes the recently held National Summit on Crime and Violence Prevention held under the theme “Building safer communities through an integrated, developmental approach to crime and violence prevention”, which developed a joint vision on safety as a collective responsibility, and provided a platform for key stakeholders and experts to engage on the effective implementation of the 2016 White Paper on Safety and Security across all sectors.
tgt: Leti ti katsa Samiti ya Rixaka eka Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Madzolonga leya ha ku khomiwaka ehansi ka nkongomelo "Ku aka miganga yo hlayiseka swinene hi ku tirhisa endlelo leri pfanganisiweke, ro hluvukisa eka nsivelo wa vugevenga na madzolonga", leri ri hluvukiseke xivono xa nhlanganelo eka vuhlayiseki tanihi vutihlamuleri bya nhlanganelo, na ku nyika pulatifomo eka vakhomaxiavenkulu na vativinkulu ku vulavurisana hi nsimeko lowu tirhaka kahle wa Mpfapfarhuto wa Tirhele na Vuhlayiseki na Nsirhelelo 2016 eka tisekitara hinkwato.

src: Incidents of violence.
tgt: Timhangu ta madzolonga.

src: Cabinet is deeply concerned by the level of violence in our society and calls on all sectors, communities and law-enforcement agencies to work together to ensure that schools and public spaces are safe and secure.
tgt: Khabinete yi khumbeka swinene hi mpimo wa madzolonga erixakeni ra hina naswona yi kombela tisekitara hinkwato, vaakandhawu na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ku tirhisana na ku tiyisisa leswaku swikolo na swivandla swa vaaki swi hlayisekile na ku sirheleleka.

src: The acts of violence that broke out in several parts of the country are unacceptable and go against our Constitution.
tgt: Swiendlo swa madzolonga leswi tumbulukeke eka swiphemu swo tala swa tiko a swi amukeleki naswona swi hambana na Vumbiwa ra hina.

src: Cabinet commends the South African Police Service for the swift responses in arresting those suspected of being involved in public violence and possession of suspected stolen goods.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga eka miangulo ya xihatla eka ku khoma lava ehleketeleriwaka ku va va khumbeka eka madzolonga ya vaaki na ku va va ri na nhundzu leyi ehleketeriwaka ku va yo yiviwa.

src: Klebsiella outbreak.
tgt: Ntungu wa Tlilebisiyela.

src: Cabinet extends condolences to the families of the six babies who died following an outbreak of Klebsiella pneumoniae at the Thelle Mogoerane Hospital in Vosloorus.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzisa michavelelo eka mindyangu ya tsevu wa tincece leti ti loveke endzhaku ka ntungu wa nyumoniya ya Tlilebisiyela eXibedhlele xa Thelle Mogoerane eVosloorus.

src: The outbreak is currently under control.
tgt: Ntungu lowu eka nkarhi wa sweswi wu le hansi ka vulawuri.

src: The Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, has since announced the transfer of babies and their mothers to the Nelson Mandela Children’s Hospital and Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Academic Hospital respectively.
tgt: Holobye wa Rihanyu, Dok Aaron Motsoaledi, se u tivisile ku hundziseriwa ka tincece na vamana wa tona eXibedhlele xa Vana xa Nelson Mandela na Xibedhlele xa Dyondzo xa Joni xa Charlotte Maxeke hi ku landzelelana.

src: This gives the provincial health department an opportunity to scrub down and decontaminate the environment, and also address the structural issues, without any disturbance.
tgt: Leswi swi nyika Ndzawulo ya Rihanyu ya xifundzakulu xivandlanene xa ku khulela na herisa nthyakiso wa mbangu, na ku tlhela yi tirhana na swiphiqo leswi nga na xivumbeko, ku ri hava ku kanganyiseka.

src: Decisions.
tgt: Swiboho.

src: Stimulus packageCabinet deliberated and approved the proposed stimulus package which proposes measures to reignite our economy from a number of related portfolios.
tgt: Mpako wa swihlohloteriKhabinete yi kanerile na ku pasisa mpako wa swihlohloteri lowu ringanyetiweke lowu ringanyetaka magoza ya ku pfuxelela ikhonomi ya hina kusuka eka tiphotifoliyo leti fambelanaka to tala.

src: A media briefing led by President Cyril Ramaphosa will held on Friday 21 September to present this package.
tgt: Ku nyika vuxokoxoko eka swihangalasamahungu loku rhangeriwaka hi Phuresidente Ramaphosa ku ta khomiwa hi Ravuntlhanu 21 Ndzati ku nyika mpako lowu.

src: VISA related reformsCabinet also received a joint report from the Ministers of Home Affairs and Tourism respectively, on a number of visa-related reforms which will make it easier for tourists, business people and academia to come to South Africa.
tgt: Mipfuxeto leyi fambelanaka na VISANakambe Khabinete yi kume xiviko xa nhlanganelo kusuka eka Vaholobye va Timhaka ta Xikaya na Vupfhumba hi ku landzelelana, eka mipfuxeto leyi fambelanaka na tivhisa yo tala leyi yi nga ta olovisela swinene vapfhumba, van'wamabindzu na swidyondzeki ku ta eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: The reforms include amendments to the regulations applying to foreign minors travelling to South Africa, which will be gazetted in October.
tgt: Mipfuxeto leyi yi katsa mihundzuluxo eka swinawana leswi tirhaka eka swihlangi swa vahlapfa leswi tekaka rendzo ku ta eAfrika-Dzonga, leyi yi nga ta gazetiwa hi Nhlangula.

src: Negotiations on visa waivers and relaxation of visa requirements for certain countries are also being finalised.
tgt: Mikanerisano eka mipfumelelo ya tivhisa na ku vevukisiwa ka swilaveko swa tivhisa eka matiko yo karhi na yona ya karhi ya hetisisiwa.

src: Further details will be announced this week.
tgt: Vuxokoxoko byin'wana byi ta tivisiwa vhiki reri.

src: Bills.
tgt: Milawumbisi.

src: Cabinet approved the following Bills for publication for public comment:.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise Milawumbisi leyi landzelaka leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo:.

src: Employment Equity Amendment Bill of 2017.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Ndzingano wa ku Thoriwa wa 2017.

src: The amendments seek to strengthen the compliance mechanisms and will allow for the setting up of employment equity sector-specific numerical targets.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi lavaka ku tiyisa tindlela ta vulandzelelanawu naswona yi ta pfumelela ku simekiwa ka mipakaniso ya tinomboro to kongoma ta sekitara ya ndzingano wa ku thoriwa.

src: The Minister of Labour, in consultation with the sector’s stakeholders, will be able to set employment equity sector-specific numerical targets.
tgt: Holobye wa Vatirhi, hi ku pfumelelana na vakhomaxiave va sekitara leyi, u ta kota ku simeka mipakaniso ya tinomboro to kongoma ta sekitara ya ndzingano wa ku thoriwa.

src: Financial Sector Laws Amendment Bill of 2018: The amendments seek to strengthen the curatorship provisions for banks, including mutual and cooperative banks, and certain non-banks.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Milawu ya Sekitara ya swa Timali wa 2018: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi lava ku tiyisa milulamiso ya vulanguteri bya tibangi, ku katsa na tibangi ta ku vuyerisa matlhelo hinkwawo na ta ntirhisano, na leti nga riki tibangi.

src: The changes will ensure that should these financial institutions experience difficulties, they can be assisted in a way that protects vulnerable depositors with minimal disruptions to the financial system and broader economy.
tgt: Ku cinca ku ta tiyisisa leswaku loko mihlangano leya swa timali yi tshuka yi hlangana na ku tikeriwa, yi kota ku pfuniwa hi ndlela leyi sirhelelaka vadipoziti lava nga sirhelelekangiki hi ku kanganyiseka ka mpimohansi eka sisiteme ya swa timali na ikhonomi hi ku angarhela.

src: Upcoming Events.
tgt: Swiendleko leswi Taka.

src: Heritage Day The 2018 National Heritage Day celebration under the theme: “The Year of Nelson Mandela: Advancing transformation of South Africa’s heritage landscape”, takes place at the Riverview Stadium in Kokstad, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Siku ra Ndzhaka Ntlangelo wa Siku ra Ndzhaka ra Rixaka ra 2018 ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Lembe ra Nelson Mandela: Ku antswisa ncinco wa mbangu wa ndzhaka ya Afrika-Dzonga", wu ta va kona eRivaleni ra mitlangu ra Riverview eKokstad, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: This is part of the month-long programme of activities which are addressing issues of transformation, promotion and preservation of South Africa’s rich and diverse heritage, national identity, nation-building and social cohesion.
tgt: Leswi i xiphemu xa nongonoko wa n'hweti hinkwayo wa migingiriko leyi nga ta tirhana na swiphiqo swa ncinco, nkondletelo na nhlayiso wa ndzhaka yo fuwa na ku hambanahambana ya Afrika-Dzonga, vutitivisi bya rixaka, ku akiwa ka tiko na nkhomano wa vaaki.

src: The Heritage Day celebration is in honour of Adam Kok and the Griqua community for their courage, determination and fortitude in resisting colonial occupation.
tgt: Ntlangelo wa Siku ra Rixaka wu xixima Adam Kok na vaakandhawu va Griqua eka xitiyanhlana xa vona, vutiyimiseri na nkondzelelo wa vona eka ku sihalala ku tekeriwa ndhawu hi vakoloni.

src: Cabinet calls on the public to celebrate their unity in diversity as we work together to build a country where all its people care for and respect one another.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku tlangela vun'we bya vona eka ku hambanahambana tanihiloko hi tirhisana ku aka tiko laha vanhu va rona hinkwavo va hlayisanaka na ku xiximana.

src: United Nations General Assembly (UNGA).
tgt: Huvo yo Angarhela ya Nhlangano wa Matiko (UNGA).

src: In contributing towards the centenary of former President Nelson Mandela, the UNGA will on 24 September 2018 hold a high-level plenary meeting on global peace known as the Nelson Mandela Peace Summit, in honour of the centenary of the birth of Madiba.
tgt: Eka ku hoxa xandla eka malembexidzana ya khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela, UNGA hi siku ra 24 Ndzati 2018 yi ta khoma nhlengeletano ya swirho hinkwaswo ya levhele ya le henhlahenhla eka ku rhula ka misava hinkwayo leyi tivekaka tanihi Samiti ya ku Rhula ya Nelson Mandela, hi ku xixima malembexidzana ya ku velekiwa ka Madiba.

src: The plenary is scheduled to adopt a political declaration negotiated by UNGA Member States.
tgt: Nhlengeletano leya swirho hinkwaswo yi kunguhatiwile ku amukela ntwanano wa xipolitiki lowu ku kanerisaniweke hawona hi Matiko lama nga Swirho swa UNGLeswi swi ta endzhaku ka mipfumelelano hi Vayimeri va Nkarhi Hinkwawo va Afrika-Dzonga na Ireland, lava tirhaka tanihi vafambisikulobye, na mifumo eka vundzeni bya ntwanano lowu.

src: President Ramaphosa is also expected to participate in the UN High-Level Meeting on TB on 26 September 2018.
tgt: Phuresidente Ramaphosa u tlhela a languteriwa ku teka xiave eka Nhlengeletano ya Levhele ya le Henhlahenhla ya UN eka TB hi siku ra 26 Ndzati 2018.

src: TB is a major disease in Africa and some of the world’s high TB burden countries are on the continent.
tgt: TB i vuvabyi lebyikulu eAfrika naswona man'wana ya matiko lama nga na ndzhwalo wa TB ya le henhla ya misava ya kumeka eka tikokulu leri.

src: Messages.
tgt: Swihungwana.

src: CondolencesCabinet sends its condolences to the families that lost their loved ones in a bus crash that occurred on the N1-25 near Tobias in the Waterberg Municipality District in Limpopo.
tgt: MichaveleloKhabinete yi rhumela michavelelo ya yona eka mindyangu leyi lahlekeriweke hi varhandziwa va yona eka ku diba ka bazi loku humeleleke eka N1-25 ekusuhi na Tobias eka Xifundza xa Masipala wa Waterberg eLimpopo.

src: Cabinet also wishes those injured a speedy recovery.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi navelela lava vavisekeke ku hola hi ku hatlisa.

src: CongratulationsCabinet congratulates the Minister of Small Business Development, Ms Lindiwe Zulu, for being admitted to the highest level of the Order of Rio Branco (Ordem de Rio Branco), and the Grand Cross from the Government of Brazil.
tgt: VuhoyozeriKhabinete yi hoyozela Holobye wa Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo, Mnn Lindiwe Zulu, ku va a amukeriwile eka levhele ya le henhlahenhla ya Risiva ra Rio Branco (Ordem de Rio Branco), and the Grand Cross kusuka eka Mfumo wa Brazil.

src: This is in recognition for the Minister’s continuous efforts to enhance bilateral relations between Brazil and South Africa.
tgt: Leswi i ku tekela enhlokweni matshalatshala lama yaka emahlweni ya Holobye ku tiyisa vuxaka bya matiko lamambirhi exikarhi ka Brazil na Afrika-Dzonga.

src: This honorific order of Brazil is granted to those who have distinguished themselves in acts of meritorious service and civic virtues.
tgt: Risima lero xixima ra Brazil ri nyikiwa lavaya va tihlawulekiseke hi swendlo swa vukorhokeri bya kahle swinene na vunene bya vaaki.

src: Minister Zulu was the South African Ambassador to Brazil between 2004 and 2008.AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Holobye Zulu a ri Muyimeri wa Tiko wa Afrika-Dzonga eka Brazil exikarhi ka 2004 na 2008.Lava thoriwekeLava thoriweke hinkwavo va fanele ku landzelela vutiyisisi bya mithwaso na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.

src: Board of Rand Water:a. Adv Faith Matshidiso Hashatse (Chairperson)b. Ms Massacha Khulekelwe Glynnis Mbonambi (Deputy Chairperson)c. Mr LL Makibinyaned.
tgt: Huvo ya Rand Water:a. Adv Faith Matshidiso Hashatse (Mutshamaxitulu)b.

src: Ms Phindile Sweetness Mbanjwae.
tgt: Man Massacha Khulekelwe Glynnis Mbonambi (Xandla xa Mutshamaxitulu)c. Tat LL Makibinyaned.

src: Mr Ahmed Mohammed Pandorf.
tgt: Tat Ahmed Mohammed Pandorf.

src: Ms Mahlatse Martha Kabig.
tgt: Tat Mahlatse Martha Kabig.

src: Ms Mankone Ntsabah.
tgt: Tat Mankone Ntsabah.

src: Ms Nomsa Georgina Mbilenii.
tgt: Tat Nomsa Georgina Mbilenii.

src: Mr Protas Thamsanqa Philij.
tgt: Tat Protas Thamsanqa Philij.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 10 October 2018 at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, ti 10 Nhlangula 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Issues in the environment.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.

src: Economy and investment drive.
tgt: Ikhonomi na pfhumba ra vuvekisi.

src: Cabinet welcomes the practical interventions such as the commitment to buy local products, a more aggressive approach to increasing exports, interventions in agricultural value chains and support for small and medium enterprises.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku nghenelela loku tirhisekaka ko fana na ku tiyimisela ku xava swimakiwa leswi endliweke endzeni ka tiko, endlelo ro tika swinene ro tlakusa ku rhumela nhundzu ematikweni mambe, ku nghenelela eka migingiriko yo yisa swimakiwa swa vurimi eka vaxavi na nseketelo wa mabindzu lamatsongo na ya le xikarhi.

src: These announcements came out of the recent two-day Job Summit, which was convened under the National Economic Development and Labour Council.2 The outcome of the Job Summit follows the announcement of the Economic Stimulus and Recovery Plan, which seeks to restore economic growth and create much-needed jobs.
tgt: Switiviso leswi swi hume eka Samiti ya Mitirho ya masiku mambirhi leya ha ku vaka kona, leyi a yi khomeriwe ehansi ka Huvo ya Vatirhi na Nhluvukiso wa swa Ikhonomi ya Rixaka.

src: The new Mining Charter – which was finalised in consultation with the mining industry, labour, affected communities and other stakeholders – clarifies the imperatives of growth, sustainability and transformation.
tgt: Mbuyelo wa Samiti ya Mitirho wu ta endzhaku ka ku tivisiwa ka Kungu ro Vuyisela na Nhlohlotelo wa swa Ikhonomi, leri lavaka ku tlherisela ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxa mitirho leyi lavekaka swinene.

src: Cabinet calls on all stakeholders to engage with the Mining Charter so as to finalise and create stability in the mining sector.
tgt: Tsalwa ra milawu ya swa Migodi lerintshwa leri nga fikisiwa emakumu hi ku tihlanganisa na indhasitiri ya swa migodi, vatirhi, miganga leyi khumbekaka na vanhu lava nga na xiave van’wana – ri swi veka erivaleni nkoka wa ku kula, ku yisa emahlweni nkarhi wo leha na ncico.

src: Kokstad Home Affairs office and handover of title deeds.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba vanhu hinkwavo lava nga na xiave ku hlayisisa Tsalwa ra Milawu ya swa Migodi ku endlela leswaku ku fikisiwa emakumu na ku endla leswaku ku va na ntshamiseko eka sekitara ya swa migodi.

src: Cabinet joins President Cyril Ramaphosa in commending the Department of Home Affairs for successfully opening its Kokstad office in KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Hofisi ya Timhaka ta Xikaya ya le Kokstad na ku nyikiwa ka mapapila ya vun’wini bya tindlu.

src: The President opened the Home Affairs office as part of government’s programme to expand the footprint of Home Affairs service-delivery points to meet citizens’ demands for Smart ID cards and other documents.
tgt: Khabinete yi tikatsa na Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa eku ndhundhuzeleni Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya ku va yi pfule hi ku humelela hofisi ya yona ya le Kokstad eKwaZulu-Natal.

src: This is part of the restoration programme to ensure beneficiaries experience the full benefits of owning a house and are able to access the formal property market.
tgt: Phuresidente u pfule hofisi ya Timhaka ta Xikaya tanihi xiphemu xa nongonoko wa mfumo wo ndlandlamuxa tindhawu to nyika vukorhokeri ta Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya ku fikelela swilaveko swa vaaki swa mapasi ya makhadi na matsalwa man’wana.

src: Cabinet also takes this opportunity to strongly encourage citizens to collect their IDs as soon as they receive a notification of collection.
tgt: Ku tatisela kwalaho, Phuresidente Ramaphosa u nyike ku tlula 443 wa mapapila ya vun’wini bya tindlu eka vavuyeriwa va Phurojeke ya swa Tindlu ya Franklin.

src: Settlement agreement on spectrum.
tgt: Ntwanano lowu fikeleriweke hi mayelana na swihondzo.

src: Cabinet welcomes the settlement agreement reached in the matter involving the Invitation to Apply for the allocation of high-demand spectrum.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ntwanano lowu fikeleriweke eka mhaka leyi khumbaka Xirhambo xo Endla Xikombelo xa maavelo ya swihondzo leswi laviwaka swinene.

src: This provides policy certainty in the information and communications technology (ICT) sector.
tgt: Leswi swi nyika ku tshemba eka pholisi eka sekitara ya vuhlanganisi bya thekinoloji na mahungu (ICT).

src: The settlement agreement is in line with President Ramaphosa’s call to initiate the process for the allocation of high-demand radio spectrum licensing.
tgt: Ntwanano lowu fikeleriweke wu fambisana na xirhambo xa Phuresidente Ramaphosa xo ta na phurosese ya maavelo ya tilayisense ta swihondzo swa rhadiyo leti laviwaka swinene.

src: In further contributing to the implementation of the National Integrated ICT Policy White Paper, interested parties have until 8 November 2018 to provide written inputs on the proposed policy and policy direction to the authority.
tgt: Loko ku tlhela ku hoxiwa xandla eka matirhiselo ya Pholisi ya Mpfapfarhuto wa tirhele ya ICT leyi Pfanganisiweke ya Rixaka, mavandla lama nga na ku tsakela ya na ku fikela ti 8 Hukuri 2018 ku nyika mavonelo lama tsariweke hi mayelana na pholisi leyi ringanyetiweke na tlhelo leri pholisi yi ri tekaka eka mfumo.

src: South Africa’s first small-scale fisheries cooperatives.
tgt: Mabindzu lamatsongo ya vunjoveri yo sungula ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Cabinet welcomes South Africa’s first small-scale cooperatives in the fishing sector, namely the Port Nolloth and Hondeklipbaai cooperatives in the Northern Cape, which were launched by the Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Mr Senzeni Zokwana.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela mabindzu lamatsongo yo sungula ya Afrika-Dzonga eka sekitara ya vunjoveri lama ku nga mabindzu ya le Port Nolloth na Hondeklipbaai eKapa-N’walungu, lama simekiweke hi Holobye wa Vurimi, Swihlahla na Vunjoveri, Tat Senzeni Zokwana.

src: The launch marks the implementation of the small-scale fisheries policy.
tgt: Ku simekiwa ku fungha matirhiselo ya pholisi ya vunjoveri lebyitsongo.

src: The fishing rights give dignity to local fishermen, who have been fishing illegally, in that they are now protected for the first time.3 The two small-scale fishing communities who will be benefiting from this policy have received basic training on cooperatives and have been assisted to register cooperatives for the purpose of applying for 15-year fishing rights.
tgt: Timfanelo to njovela ti nyika xindzhuti eka vanjoveri va tinhlampfi va laha ndzeni ka tiko, lava a va njovela swi nga ri enawini, laha sweswi va sirheleriweke ro sungula.

src: Cabinet commends the close to three million taxpayers who have filed their tax returns, of which over half were submitted through eFiling.
tgt: Khabinete yi bumabumela kwalomu ka timiliyoni tinharhu ta vahakeri va swibalo lava tlheriseke swibalo swa vona laha ku tlula hafu ya vona va tlheriseke hi ku tirhisa Inthanete.

src: On 31 October, the 2018 tax season closes for non-provisional taxpayers and for those provisional taxpayers who opt to file at a South African Revenue Service branch.
tgt: Hi ti 31 Nhlangula, nguva ya xibalo ya 2018 ya pfala eka vahakeri va swibalo lava holaka miholo lava hakelaka xibalo kan’we hi lembe na le ka vahakeri va xibalo lava handle ka miholo, va endlaka mali hi tindlela tin’wana lava hakelaka kambirhi hi lembe lava hlawulaka ku ya tlherisa xibalo eka rhavi ra Vukorhokeri bya Swibalo swa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Provisional taxpayers who opt to file their returns through eFiling have until 31 January 2019 to do so.
tgt: Vahakeri va swibalo lava handle ka miholo, va endlaka mali hi tindlela tin’wana lava hakelaka kambirhi hi lembe lava hlawulaka ku tlherisa swibalo swa vona hi ku tirhisa Inthanete va nyikiwa kufikela ti 31 Sunguti 2019 ku endla tano.

src: Proper and efficient revenue collection ensures fiscal sovereignty, and timeous and accurate submissions ensure compliant taxpayers.
tgt: Ku hlengeletiwa ka xibalo hi ndlela ya kahle na vuswikoti swi tiyisisa leswaku ku va na ku yima kahle ka nkwama wa tiko, naswona ku tlherisiwa ka xibalo hi nkarhi na hi nkahoxeko swi tiyisisa leswaku vahakeri va xibalo va landzelelaka.

src: Tax revenue helps government to fund the country’s service-delivery projects and other socio-economic development programmes.
tgt: Mali leyi hlengeletiweke hi swibalo yi pfuna mfumo ku pfuna tiphurojeke ta mphakelo wa vukorhokeri ta tiko hi swa timali na minongonoko yin’wana ya nhluvukiso ikhonomi ya vanhu.

src: Social-grant payments.
tgt: Ku hakeriwa ka midende ya vaakatiko.

src: Cabinet was brief by the Inter-Ministerial Committee: Social Grants, chaired by Minister Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwe hi Komiti ya Vaholobye: Midende ya Vaakatiko leyi fambisiwaka hi Holobye Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.

src: As of the 1st October 2018, more than 10 million beneficiaries were paid using either of these platforms - the South African Post Office (SAPO)/Postbank Grinrod Bank as well as merchants such as Boxer, Shoprite, and Pick ’n Pay.
tgt: Kusukela hi ti1 Nhlangula 2018, ku tlula 10 wa timiliyoni ta vahori va midende va hakeriwile hi ku tirhisa yin’wana na yin’wana ya tipulatifomo leti – Poso ya Afrika-Dzonga (SAPO)/Postbank Bangi ya Grindrod xikan’we na mavhengele yo xavisa yo fana na Boxer, Shoprite na Pick n Pay.

src: Government has successfully migrated social-grant payments from Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) as instructed by the Constitutional Court Judgement.
tgt: Mfumo wu swi kotile ku rhurhisela ku hakeriwa ka midende ya vaakatiko ku suka eka Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) tanihilaha swi lerisiweke hakona hi Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa.

src: All cash beneficiaries effected by CPS have been migrated and CPS has been notified of the termination of the contract as of 30 September 2018.
tgt: Vavuyeriwa va mali ya midende hinkwavo lavaa va hakeriwaka hi CPS va rhurhisiwile naswona CPS yi tivisiwile hi ku herisiwa ka kontiraka ya yona hi ti 30 Ndzati 2018.

src: Cabinet extends its appreciation to the diligent oversight work led by the Inter-Ministerial Committee supported by the Technical Task Team of Directors General.
tgt: Khabinete yi tata ku khensa ka yona eka ntirho wo langutela lowu tirhiweke kahle lowu a wu rhangeriwile hi Komiti ya Vaholobye lowu seketeriweke hi Ntlawa wa Ntirho wa Xithekiniki Vafambisijenerali.

src: It further extends its appreciation to the work of the officials from SAPO, South African Social Security Agency and, the departments of Social Development Telecommunications and Postal Services Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation National Treasury South African Police Service and GCICabinet thanks all the social-grant beneficiaries for their cooperation during this transition.
tgt: Yi tlhela yi tata ku khensa ka yona eka ntirho wa vatirhi vo huma eka SAPO, Ejensi ya swa Midende ya Vaakatiko ya Afrika-Dzonga (Sassa) na, tindzawulo ta Nhluvukiso wa Vaaki Vukorhokeri bya Tiposo na Vuhlanganisi bya Tinqingho, Nkunguhato, Nandzeleriso na Nhlahluvo Vutameri bya Nkwama wa Tiko Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga na GCIKhabinete yi khensa vavuyeriwa va midende hinkwavo eka ntirhisano wa vona hi nkarhi wa ku cinca loku.

src: Albertina Sisulu Centenary.
tgt: Ku tlangeriwa ka dzana ra malembe ya Albertina Sisulu.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the preparations for the centenary celebration of Mama Albertina Sisulu that will take place during her birth month, October.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi malunghiselo yo tlangela lembexidzana ra Manana Albertina Sisulu loku nga ta va kona hi n’hweti ya ku velekiwa ka yena, nhlangula.

src: Mama Sisulu was born on 21 October 1918 and the Chairperson of the IMC on Centenary Celebrations, Minister Jeff Radebe, is here to outline upcoming activities related to the centenary celebration.
tgt: Manana Sisulu u velekiwe hi ti 21 Nhlangula 1918, naswona Mutshamaxitulu wa IMC wa Ku Tlangela Lembexidzana, Holobye Jeff Radebe u kona laha ku andlala migingiriko leyi taka leyi fambelanaka na ku tlangeriwa ka lembexidzana.

src: Sentencing of Springs father.
tgt: Ku gweviwa ka tatana wa le Springs.

src: Cabinet welcomes the sentencing of the abusive man, commonly referred to as the Springs Monster.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku gweviwa ka wanuna wa muxanisi loyi a tiviwa swinene tanihi Xihovori xa le Springs.

src: He was sentenced to 35 years in jail for the attempted murder of his son, child abuse and neglect, as well as using and dealing in drugs.
tgt: U gweviwe kufikela eka malembe ya 35 ekhotsweni eka ku ringeta ku dlaya n’wana wa yena wa jaha, ku xanisa n’wana na ku tsan’wa, xikan’we na ku tirhisa na ku xavisa swidzidziharisi.

src: Gender-based violence remains a serious challenge in our society, as demonstrated by the recent rape of a minor at a Dros restaurant in Silverton.
tgt: Madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu ma ha ri ntlhontlho lowukulu emigangeni ya hina,tanihilaha swi tikombeke hakona hi mpfinyo lowu wa ha ku vaka kona wa n’wana lontsongo evhengeleni ro xavisa swakudya leswi swekiweke na ku dyela ra Dros eSilverton.

src: Cabinet reiterates calls on law-enforcement authorities to leave no stone unturned in prosecuting perpetrators of these heinous crimes.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshikelela xirhambo xa minhlangano ya nsindziso wa nawu ku tirha hi matimba swinene eka ku gweva vaendlamilandzu va vugevenga lebyi byo chavisa.

src: It further calls on all of us to work together in stopping the violation of the rights of children and the most vulnerable members of our society.
tgt: Yi tlhela yi rhamba hinkwerhu ka hina ku tirhisana eka ku herisa ku tluriwa ka timfanelo ta vana na swirho leswi nga sirhelelekangiki swinene swa vaakatiko va hina.

src: Westbury protest.
tgt: Ku kombisa ku vilela ka le Westbury.

src: Cabinet welcomes the intervention in Westbury by Police Minister Bheki Cele, which is part of the broader strategy to fight the scourge of drugs and gang-related violence in the area.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku nghenelela ka Holobye wa Maphorisa Bheki Cele eWestbury, loku nga xiphemu xa qhinga ro angarhela ro lwisana na ntungu wa swidzidziharisi na madzolonga lama fambelanaka na mitlawa ya vugevenga eka ndhawu yoleyo.

src: The intervention includes the deployment of the Tactical Response Team and a greater visible policing presence.
tgt: Ku nghenelela ku katsa ku rhumeriwa ka Ntlawa wa Qhinga ro Angula (Tactical Response Team, va tlhela va tiveka tanihi Mabereta) na vukona bya maphorisa lebyi vonakaka swinene.

src: Importantly, there will also be an investigation into allegations of corruption at the Westbury Police Station.
tgt: Xa nkoka swinene, hi leswaku ku ta tlhela ku va na vulavisisi bya swihehlo swa vukungundzwana eka Xitichi xa Maphorisa xa le Westbury.

src: Cabinet calls on the Westbury community and all communities to work with the police in ensuring that we root out acts of criminality, drugs and gangsters in their respective areas.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba vaakatiko va le Westbury na vaaki hinkwavo ku tirhisana na maphorisa ku vona leswaku hi herisa migingiriko ya vugevenga, swidzidziharisi na mitlawa ya swigevenga eka tindhawu ta vona to hambanahambana.

src: Crime.
tgt: Vugevenga.

src: Cabinet commends the law-enforcement agencies in carrying out an intensive multi-disciplinary investigation relating to incidents at shopping malls, retail stores and mosques which has resulted in the arrest of nineteen suspects.
tgt: Khabinete yi bumabumela tiejensi to sindzisa ku landzeleriwa ka nawu eka ku endla vulavisisi bya xiyimo xa le henhla lebyi fambelanaka na timhangu ta le timolo, mavhengele yo xavisa na tikereke ta MaIslam lebyi nga endla leswaku ku khomiwa vaehleketeriwa va khumekaye.

src: It involved the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster.
tgt: A byi katsa Ntlawa wa Vululami, Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Vusirheleri.

src: Three of the suspects were arrested in relation to incendiary devices in the Durban area, including the Verulam Mosque.
tgt: Vaehleketeleriwa vanharhu va khomiwile hi mayelana na swibuluki eka ndhawu ya le Durban, ku katsa na Kereke ya MaIslam ya le Verulam.

src: All the suspects are expected to face charges including murder and attempted murder and contravening the Explosives Act.
tgt: Vaehleketeleriwa hinkwavo va languteriwa ku langutana na swihehlo leswi katsaka ku dlaya na ku ringeta ku dlaya na tlula Nawu wa Swibuluki.

src: Cabinet reassures South Africans that fighting crime is a top priority and that government will continue to take necessary steps to ensure a safe and secure environment for all inhabitants of South Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshembisa MaAfrika-Dzonga leswaku ku lwisana na vugevenga i xirhangana xa le henhla na leswaku mfumo wu ta ya emahlweni wu teka magoza lama faneleke ku vona leswaku ku na mbangu lowu hlayisekeke na ku sirheleleka eka vatshami hinkwavo va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Name changes: Makhanda.
tgt: Ku cinciwa ka vito: Makhanda.

src: Cabinet welcomes the name change of Grahamstown, in the Eastern Cape, to Makhanda, in honour of Xhosa prophet, philosopher and military man who fought against colonialism.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku cinciwa ka vito ra Grahamstown ri va Makhanda eKapa-Vuxa, hi ku xixima muphurofeta, mufilosofa na nhenha ya nyimpi ya Muqhoza leyi nga lwa na xikoloni.

src: The change is an important part of our democratic journey and will help to foster greater social cohesion and build a deeper appreciation of our shared history.
tgt: Ku cinca i xiphemu xa nkoka xa rendzo ra hina ra xidemokirasi naswona ku ta pfuneta ku tlakusa vun’we bya vaaki hi lakukulu na ku aka ku tlangela ko enta ka ku avelana ka matimu ya hinaSwiboho swa KhabineteKhabinete yi pasise modlolo wo korhokela lowu pfuxetiweke eka nsimeko wa Phurojeke ya Ndzhurho wa Vuhaxi byi ya eka Dijitali.

src: The model adopts a market/retail-driven approach through collaboration and partnerships with the private sector and industry.
tgt: Modlolo lowu wu amukela endlelo leri fambisiwaka hi makete/vuxavisi hi ku tirhisana swin’we na vutirhisani na sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo na indhasitiri.

src: With this approach, government will no longer be involved in the procurement of set-top-boxes, warehousing, transportation and installation of devices.
tgt: Hi endlelo leri, mfumo wu nge he khumbeki eka nkumo wa Xibokisana xa Vuhaxi bya Mahungu vuhlayiselanhundzu, ku tleketliwa na ku nghenisiwa ka switirhisiwa.

src: This provides South Africa with headway towards the completion of the project in a manner that is inclusive, affordable and efficient, and that reduces risk to government.
tgt: Leswi swi nyika Afrika-Dzonga nhluvukiso wo ya emakumu ka phurojeke hi ndlela leyi nghenisaka hinkwavo, yo kala yi nga durhi na ku koteka, naswona sweswo swi hungutaka nxungeto eka mfumo.

src: This will push digital viewership migration to the 85% threshold and beyond, towards switching off all analogue broadcasts.
tgt: Leswi swi ta susumeta ndzhurhiso wa ku vona ka dijitali ku ya eka 85% ya masungulo na ku yisa emahlweni, ku ya eka ku timiwa ka vuhaxi hinkwabyo bya analogo.

src: Cabinet approved South Africa’s Common Core Document, which will be deposited with the United Nations (UN).
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise Tsalwa ra Nkoka wa Swo Fana swa Afrika-Dzonga leri nga ta yisiwa eka Nhlangano wa Matiko (UN).

src: The document provides progress which contains information of a general, factual and statistical nature on South Africa’s adherence to the obligations attached to the signed nine UN treaties.
tgt: Tsalwa ri nyika nhluvukiso lowu nga na mahungu ya ntolovelo, ya ntiyiso na ku va ya muxaka wa tinhlayo eka ku landzelela ka Afrika-Dzonga eka mfanelo leyi fambisanaka na ku sayiniwa na mitwanano ya kaye ya UN.

src: Upcoming eventsMedium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTBPS)Finance Minister Tito Mboweni will deliver the Medium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTBPS) on Wednesday, 24 October 2018, which will reveal adjustments to the national budget to ensure fiscal sustainability.
tgt: Swiendleko leswi takaXitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi (MTBPS)Holobye wa Timali Tito Mboweni u ta andlala Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi (MTBPS) hi Ravunharhu, 24 Nhlangula 2018, lexi nga ta humesela erivaleni cincacinco eka mpimanyeto wa rixaka ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na ntshamiseko wa swa timali ta tiko.

src: Transport MonthThis year’s Transport Month programme will emphasise the importance of transport infrastructure, such as the maritime, aviation, rail and road sectors as enablers of economic growth.
tgt: N’hweti ya swa VutleketliNongonoko wa lembe leri wa N’hweti ya Vutleketli wu ta tshikelela nkoka wa switirhisiwankulu swa vutleketli swo fana na tisekitara ta swa malwandle, vuhahisi, swiporo na magondzo tanihi swipfuneti swa ku kula ka ikhonomi.

src: Cabinet calls on the public to use public transport and actively implement road safety initiatives throughout the year.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba vaaki ku tirhisa vutleketli bya mani na mani na ku tirhisa hi nkhinkhi mapfhumba ya vuhlayiseki bya le magondzweni lembe hinkwaro.

src: Let us use the month to celebrate and restore the culture of lift clubs when travelling to work to reduce congestion in our roads.
tgt: A hi tirhiseni n’hweti leyi ku tlangela na ku vuyisa ntolovelo wo famba swin’we emimovheni loko hi ya entirhweni ku hunguta ntlimbano wa mimovha emagondzweni ya hina.

src: Road safety on our roads remains a challenge, and drivers and pedestrians should use public roads responsibly.
tgt: Vuhlayiseki bya gondzo emagondzweni ya hina byi tshama bya ha ri ntlhontlho, naswona vachayeri na van’wamilenge va fanele va tirhisa magondzo ya mani na mani hi vutihlamuleri.

src: MessagesCongratulationsSouth Africa’s radio telescope, MeerKAT, will be joining Breakthrough Listen, an international initiative that is seeking signs of intelligent life in the universe.
tgt: SwihungwanaVuhoyozeriThelesikopu ya rhadiyo ya Afrika-Dzonga, MeerKat yi ta joyina Breakthrough Listen, pfhumba ra matiko ya misava leri lavaka mikombeto ya vutomi bya vutlhari emisaveni.

src: It demonstrates our internationally recognised expertise and infrastructure.
tgt: Leswi swi kombisa vutivi na switirhisiwankulu swa hina leswi tekeriwaka enhlokweni hi matiko ya misava.

src: South Africa’s 64-dish MeerKAT radio telescope, inaugurated in July this year, is the most sensitive telescope of its kind in the world.
tgt: Thelesikopu ya rhadiyo ya MeerKat ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi nga na 64 wa tidishi, leyi simekiweke hi Mawuwana lembe leri, i thelesikopu yo nyenyela swinene ya muxaka wa yona yi ri yoxe emisaveni.

src: Cabinet congratulates the team of researchers from Wits University who performed a historic and successful liver transplant from a HIV-positive mother to her HIV-negative child.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela ntlawa wa valavisisi vo huma eYunivhesiti ya Wits lava nga endla hundziso wa xivindzi wa matimu na ku humelela ku suka eka manana loyi a nga na HIV ku ya eka n’wana wa yena loyi a nga hava HINtlawa wa vadokodela lowu a wu katsa Phurofesa Jean Botha, Dok Francesca Conradie, Dok Harriet Etheredge, Dok June Fabian na Phurofesa Caroline Tiemessen.

src: Cabinet congratulates the people of Equatorial Guinea on their 50th independence celebration.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela vanhu va le Equatorial Guinea eka ku tlangela ka vona ka malembe ya 50 ya ntshuxeko.

src: South Africa has enjoyed full diplomatic relations with the Republic of Equatorial Guinea since 5 May 1993.CondolencesCabinet extends its condolences to the family, friends and colleagues of the late Environmental Affairs Minister Boma Edna Molewa.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi ve na vuxaka bya xidipulomatiki byo hetiseka na Rhiphabliki ra Equatorial Guinea kusukela hi ti 5 Mudyaxihi 1993.Michavelelo Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela ka yona eka ndyangu, vanghana na vatirhikulobye va Holobye wa Timhaka ta Mbangu Boma Edna Molewa.

src: Minister Molewa distinguished herself in many capacities and causes, from her contribution to our liberation to fighting for the equality of women in our society.
tgt: Holobye Molewa u tihumelerise erivaleni hi tindlela to tala ta vuswikoti na swivangelo swo karhi, kusuka eka ku hoxa xandla ka yena ku lwela ntshuxeko wa hina na ku lwela ndzingano wa vamanana eka rixaka ra hina.

src: She was also a national and global champion for the environmental integrity of a sustainable planet which can be shared and enjoyed by all.
tgt: U tlhele a va nghwazi ya rixaka na ya matiko ya misava eka ku xiximeka eka swa mbangu ka pulanete leyi nga ta va kona nkarhi wo leha leyi ku nga ta avelaniwa hayona na ku rhandziwa vanhu hinkwavo.

src: Cabinet sends its condolences to the government and people of Indonesia.
tgt: Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela ka yona eka mfumo na vanhu va le Indonesia.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 24 October 2018 at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlangane hi Ravunharhu, 24 Nhlangula 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Issues in the environment.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.

src: Cabinet welcomes the maiden MTBPS by Finance Minister Tito Mboweni, which is based on the strong conviction that South Africa can be renewed.
tgt: Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa le Xikarhi ka Theme (MTBPS)1.1 Khabinete yi amukela MTBPS yo sungulasungula hi Holobye wa Timali Tito Mboweni, leyi simekiweke ehenhla ka nkholwo wo tiya leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi nga pfuxiwa hi vuntshwa.2 MTBPS ya 2018 yi kombisa swihlawuriwa swo tika swa ikhonomi na nkwama wa timali wa mfumo leswi langutaneke na mfumo eka malembe manharhu lama landzelaka.

src: The 2018 MTBPS highlights the difficult economic and fiscal choices confronting government over the next three years.
tgt: Ku kula ka ikhonomi ka 2018 ku pfuxetiwile kuya ehansi kusuka eka 1.5% kufika eka 0.7%, naswona mbangu wa misava hinkwayo wu ta tama wa ha ri na mitlhontlho eka tiikhonomi ta timakete leta ha tumbulukaka.

src: Economic growth for 2018 has been revised down from 1.5% to 0.7%, and the global environment remains challenging for emerging market economies.
tgt: MTBPS 2018 yi humelerisa xihlohloteri xa ku kula ka ikhonomi xa Phuresidente na pulani ya ku hlukela, leswi swi nga ta seketeriwa hi ntshamiseko wa nkwama wa timali wa mfumo na wa timali.3 Mfumo wu tama wa ha tibohile eka ku yiseka emahlweni ka swa nkwama wa timali wa mfumo, kambe ku vile na ku rheta kusukela loko ku andlariwile Mpimanyeto wa 2018 nan’waka.

src: The 2018 MTBPS gives effect to the President’s growth economic stimulus and recovery plan, which will be underpinned by fiscal and monetary stability.
tgt: Mfumo wu tama wa ha tibohile ku tshamisekisa na ku hunguta xikweleti.

src: Government remains committed to fiscal sustainability, but there has been slippage since the tabling of the 2018 Budget in February this year.
tgt: Ehenhla ka xiyimo xa mbangu wo tika wa ikhonomi na nkwama wa timali wa mfumo, ku aviwa loku ringanyetiwaka ka xibalo ku ya emahlweni ku rhangise minongonoko yo tirhisa mali leyi seketelaka dyondzo ya masungulo, rihanyu, ku hanya kahle ka vaaki, mati, nkululo na vukorhokeri bya gezi.

src: Against the backdrop of a difficult economic and fiscal environment, the proposed division of revenue continues to prioritise large social spending programmes that support basic education, health, social welfare, water, sanitation and electricity services.
tgt: Mpfuxeto wa misava.1 Khabinete yi amukela ntirho lowu fananaka wa minongonoko ya mpfuxeto wa misava na ntlheriso wa timfanelo lowu lulamisaka nkavululami wa karhi lowu nga hundza na ku pfuna ku kurisa ikhonomi.2 Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa u rhangele ntirho wa ntlheriso wa timfanelo ta misava, laha kutlula 4 586 wa tihekitara ta misava ti nyikiweke muganga wa KwaMkhwanazi eEmpangeni, KwaZulu-Natal.3 Muganga wa KwaMkhwanazi wu ta tlhela wu kuma mipako ya le ndzhaku ka ku tshamisekisiwa na nseketelo lowu nga ta va pfuna ku fikisa eka mpimo wa le henhla rifuwo leri nga kotekaka ra misava leyi.

src: Cabinet welcomes the consistent implementation of land reform and restitution programmes that redresses the past injustices and help to grow the economy.
tgt: Ku onheteriwa kwaloko ku tirha ku pfumata lava sweleke vukorhokeri lebyi dingiwaka swonghasi.2 Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku rhiya tihlo na ku tirhisana na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ku endla leswaku lavaya va nga na vutihlamuleri va tihlamulela.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa led a land restitution ceremony, where over 4 586 hectares of land were handed to the community of KwaMkhwanazi in Empangeni, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Endlelo ra ku thoriwa ka Mulawuri wa Vuchuchisi bya Mfumo wa Vaaki (NDPP)5.1 Khabinete yi amukele endlelo lerintshwa ra ku thoriwa ka NDPPhuresidente Ramaphosa u thole Phanele yo Tsundzuxa ku kuma na ku endla tiinthavhiyu na vanhu lava nga na nkoka wa ku tekeriwa enhlokweni ku teka xiyimo xa Nhloko ya Vulawuri byo Chuchisa bya Rixaka.

src: The KwaMkhwanazi community will also receive post-settlement packages and support that will assist them to maximise the potential wealth of the land.
tgt: Phanele leyi yi hlengeletane ro sungula vhiki reri naswona yi languteriwa ku rhumela mavito ya lava nghenisiweke eka nxaxamelo wo koma eka Phuresidente ku nga si hundza siku ra 7 N’wendzamhala Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa.1 Khabinete yi burisanile hi Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa hi ku tirhisiwa, ku rimiwa na ku va na mbangi hi ntswatsi eka ku yi tirhisela swa le xihundleni swa yena n’wini na nhlohlotelo wa yona.

src: This shifts communities from subsistence to commercial participants and owners of businesses across the value chains of the assets on their land.
tgt: Vaaki va komberiwa ku endla va tiva hi vuahluri lebyi tanihileswi ntirhiso wa mbangi endhawini ya mani na mani wu tshimbisiweke.

src: Government is committed to supporting the sustainability of emerging agricultural enterprises, which includes 262 land reform-related projects to benefit youth and women across all provinces.
tgt: Ku ya emahlweni, vuahluri lebyi a byi susangi vugevenga bya ku xavisa mbangi.2 Khabinete yi amukela vuahluri lebyi nga kona eka mbangu wa milawu yin’wana leyi yi nga ha tirhisiwaka eka ntirho, ku va na mbangi na ku rima mbangi.

src: Cabinet welcomed the new approach of appointing the NDPPresident Ramaphosa appointed the Advisory Panel to identify and conduct interviews with individuals worthy of consideration to occupy the position of the Head of the National Prosecuting Authority.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku tivisiwa ka Tindhawu leyi Sirheleriweke (tiMPA) ta 20 tanihi Oparexini Phakisa: Netiweke ya Vayimeri va tiMPA ta Ikhonomi ya swa Lwandle.

src: This follows incidents of violence at some schools, including the tragic death of the 24-year-old teacher, Mr Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate, who was fatally stabbed by a learner at the Ramotshere Secondary School in Zeerust, North West.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi ta angula eka Vuahluri bya Khoto ya le Henhla ya Gauteng N’walungu bya Hukuri 2017, laha eka byona Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu yi leriseke ku lulamisiwa na ku tivisiwa ka mihundzuluxo leyi faneleke ya Nawu wa Vana, 2005, (Nawu wa 38 wa 2005) hi mayelana na xitshunxo xa xinawu eka malawulelo ya sisiteme ya nhlayiso na vuwundli.

src: The benefit of the additional designation will, amongst others, allow for further development of the ecotourism and promotion of access to sustainably managed resources for small-scale fisheries.
tgt: Samiti ya Vuvekisi ya G20 yi ta tisa endhawini yin’we mabindzu ya Jarimani na Matiko ya CwA ku valanga swivandlanene swa vuvekisi ehansi ka rimba ra Xinakulobye xa Vavekisi va Jarimani va ta nyika tiphurojeke ta nkoka swinene leti nga ku endlekeni eka nkarhi wa sweswi eka Matiko ya CwA na ku valanga swivandlanene ku yisa emahlweni eka tikokulu.

src: Cabinet approved South Africa’s Revised and Aligned Second National Action Programme (NAP) to Combat Desertification, Land Degradation and Mitigate the Effects of Drought (2018-2030).
tgt: Phuresidente u ta ya eka samiti a ri eka xiyimo xa Mutshamaxitulukulobye wa Ntlawa wo Tsundzuxa wa Afrika wa G. Khomferense ya G20 eka CwA yi ta kongomisa eka tindlela leti G20, matiko ya Afrika na mihlangano ya nhluvukiso swi nga tirhisanaka hatona ku kondletela vuvekisi lebyi nga riki bya mfumo na vutekaxiave bya ikhonomi eka mifumo ya Afrika.

src: The NAP seeks to contribute towards the conservation and sustainable use of our land and other natural resources.
tgt: Nhlengeletano leyi yi ta tlhela yi endla ntirho wo lulamisela eka xiyenge xa Samiti ya G20 eBuenos Aires, Argentina.

src: South African International Investment ConferencePresident Ramaphosa will on Friday, 26 October 2018, preside over South Africa’s inaugural Investment Conference at the Sandton Convention Centre in Johannesburg.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku rhanga emahlweni ka filimi ya laha tikweni leyi thyiweke Nommer 37 hi muendli wa tifilimi Joshua Bradley eUnited States hi siku ra 2 Hukuri 2018.

src: Group of Twenty (G20) SummitPresident Ramaphosa has been invited by the Federal Chancellor of Germany, Dr Angela Merkel, to participate in the G20 Investment Summit – German Business and the Compact with Africa (CwA) Countries, and a Business Roundtable, both of which will be held in Berlin, Germany on 30 October 2018.The G20 Investment Summit will bring together German business and CwA Countries to explore investment opportunities under the framework of the G20 Partnership with Africa.
tgt: Xitsakisi xa vugevenga leyi endleriweke eCape Flats yi nyikiwile timali hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki hi ku tirhisa xikimi xa yona xa Swihlohloteri swa Vaendli va Tifilimi va Vantima lava ha Tumbulukaka va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: German investors will present flagship projects currently undertaken in the CwA Countries and explore further opportunities on the continent.
tgt: Leswi swi ta hoxa xandla eka ku koka vuvekisi byo kongoma bya matiko mambe eka indasitiri ya tifilimi ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The two weeks of activism takes place against the backdrop of celebrations of the centenaries of Struggle icons Mama Albertina Sisulu and Tata Nelson Mandela, both of whom epitomised the value of regular consultation and interaction with the communities they served.
tgt: Ntirho wa nkosi wu ta sungula hi 08:00 eOur Lady of Cedars Catholic Church eWoodmead, Joni.3 eka ku lova ka nghwazi ya Nyimpi yo Lwela Ntshunxeko tlhelo muamukeri wa Risiva ra Rixaka ra Mendi eka Xitiyanhlana xa Silivhere, Ttn Eric “Stalin” Mtshali.4 eka ku lova ka nghwazi ya ANC Moss Chikane.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 7 November 2018 at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlengeletane hi Ravunharhu, 7 Hukuri 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Issues in the Environment.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.

src: Presidential Gender-Based Violence and Femicide Summit Cabinet welcomes the successful deliberations of the Presidential Gender Based Violence and Femicide Summit held on 01 and 02 November.
tgt: Samiti ya swa Timhaka ta Madzolonga lama Simekiweke eka Rimbewu na ku Dlayiwa ka Vavasati leyi rhangeriweke hi Phuresidente.

src: The Summit has confirmed the urgency of forging consensus on dealing with the crisis of gender-based violence, discrimination against women and gender disparities.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku jekanekisana loku nga va na ku humelela ka Samiti ya swa Timhaka ta Madzolonga lama Simekiweke ekaRimbewu na ku Dlayiwa ka Vavasati leyi rhangeriweke hi Phuresidente leyi a yi khomiwe hi siku ra 01 na 02 Hukuri.

src: Government has agreed to conduct a review of national plans to end gender-based violence and the development of a National Action Plan on gender-based violence.
tgt: Samiti leyi yi tiyisisile xihatla xa ku fikeleriwa ka ntwanano wa ku tirhana na xiphiqo xa madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu, xihlawuhlawu ehenhla ka vaxisati na ku nga ringani ka rimbewu.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to work together to fundamentally change attitudes, practices and institutions to end violence against women.
tgt: Mfumo wu twananile ku endla nkambisiso wa makungu ya rixaka ku herisa madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu na nhluvukiso wa Kungu ra Matirhelo ra Rixaka hi mayelana na madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu.

src: Investment.
tgt: Vuvekisi.

src: Cabinet welcomes the successful Investment Conference that took place in October in Sandton, Johannesburg.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela Khomferense ya swa Vuvekisi leyi nga va na ku humelela leyi veke kona hi Nhlangula eSandton, eJoni.

src: The Investment Conference enabled South Africa to garner in access of R290 billion in investment commitments across different sectors of the economy.
tgt: Khomferense ya swa Vuvekisi yi olovisele Afrika-Dzonga ku hlengeleta kutlula R290 wa tibiliyoni ta ku tiboha ku vekisa loku humaka eka tisekitara to hambana ta ikhonomi.

src: This adds to the pledges of over R400 billion that were received during the investment drive by the special envoys and from various countries during state visits.
tgt: Leswi swi tatisa eka ku tshembisa loku tlulaka R400 wa tibiliyoni loku amukeriweke hi nkarhi wa pfhumba ro vekisa leri a ri huma eka vurhumiwa byo hlawuleka na lebyi humaka eka matiko yo hambana hi nkarhi wa tendzo ta mfumo.

src: The Conference was attended by more than 1 000 delegates, drawn from more than 35 countries.
tgt: Khomferense a yi endzeriwile hi kutlula 1000 wa varhumiwa, lava a va huma eka matiko yo tlula Moya wa yona a wu nyanyula swinene, naswona tiko ra ka hina ri kombise swivandlanene swa vuvekisi na mapfhumba ya tipholisi lawa ma pfunaka ku tumbuluxa mbangu wa vuvekisi lowu nga na xinghana.

src: Cabinet congratulates the team that worked on the Conference and looks forward to receiving regular update reports on implementation of the commitments made.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela xipanu lexi tirheke eka Khomferense, naswona yi langutela ku amukela swiviko swa vuxokoxoko lebyintshwa swa nkarhi na nkarhi hi mayelana na matirhisele ya vutiboheleri lebyi endliweke.

src: As South Africa and the rest of Africa continues to move on a higher trajectory towards growing the economy of the continent, Cabinet also welcomes the inaugural Africa Investment Forum, currently taking place up until the 9th November, in Johannesburg.
tgt: Loko Afrika-Dzonga na Afrika hinkwayo yi ya emahlweni no kurisa ikhonomi ya tikokulu, Khabinete yi tlhela yi amukela Foramu ya swa Vuvekisi ya Afrika yo sungula leyi sweswi yi nga eku humeleleni kufikela hi siku ra vu9 Hukuri, eJoni.

src: The Africa Investment Forum was convened by the African Development Bank.
tgt: Foramu ya swa Vuvekisi ya Afrika a yi rhambiwile hi Bangi ya Nhluvukiso ya Afrika.

src: It aims to build on current successes by bringing together public and private sector investors to chart a new growth path for the entire African Continent.
tgt: Yi kongomise ku aka ehenhla ka ku humelela loku nga kona sweswi hi ku hlanganisa vavekisi lava humaka eka mfumo na lava humaka eka mihlangano leyi nga riki ya mfumo ku pfula gondzo rintshwa eka Tikonklu ra Afrika hinkwaro.

src: The recently held G20 Africa Conference further boosts our growth prospects through the various commitments that promote private investment and economic participation in African states as part of the Compact with Africa Initiative.
tgt: Khomferense ya G20 ya Afrika leyi ya ha ku khomiwaka yi tlhela yi hlohlotela ku kula ka swivandlanene swa hina hi ku tirhisa ku vutiboheleri byo hambanahambana lebyi tlakusaka vuvekisi lebyi nga riki bya mfumo na ku nghenelela eka swa ikhonomi ka mifumo ya Afrika tanihi xiphemu xa Ntwanano hi Pfhumba ra Afrika.

src: The Compact with Africa Initiative is co-chaired by South Africa and Germany through the Africa Advisory Group.
tgt: Ntwanano hi Pfhumba ra Afrika wu fambisiwa xikan’we hi Afrika-Dzonga na Jarimani hi ku tirhisa Ntlawa wo Tsundzuxa wa Afrika.

src: Cabinet also welcomed the recently launched R50 million Phuthaditjhaba Industrial Park in the Free State which will promote industrialization and increase local job creation and growth in that province.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi amukela Phaka ya Tifeme ya Phuthaditjhaba ya R50 wa timiliyoni leya ha ku simekiwaka eFree State leyi nga ta tlakusa ku tumbuluxiwa ka tifeme no tlakusa ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na ku kula emigangeni eka xifundzakulu lexiya.

src: Cabinet remains convinced that these interventions will ultimately begin to reduce the unemployment challenges facing the country, by igniting a renewed spirit of hope and optimism.
tgt: Khabinete ya ha tshemba leswaku ku nghenelela loku ekuheteleleni ku ta sungula ku hunguta mitlhontlho ya ku pfumaleka ka mitirho leyi nga langutana na tiko, hi ku tisa moya wo tshemba na ntshembo.

src: Job Creation.
tgt: Ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho.

src: Government is stepping up efforts to create more jobs for young people and South Africans as a whole, focused on township and rural economies, and enterprises of women and youth who often bear the brunt of challenging economic realities.
tgt: Mfumo wu tlakusa matshalatshala yo tumbuluxela vantshwa na MaAfrika-Dzonga hi ku angarhela mitirho yo tala, lama kongomiseke eka tiikhonomi ta le malokixini na le matikoxikaya, na mabindzu ya vavasati na vantshwa lava va talaka ku rhwala mpingu wa mitiyiso ya ikhonomi leyi tlhontlhaka.

src: Cabinet is confident that the package of recovery measures, which will inject R50 billion into key sectors such as agriculture, public infrastructure, township and rural economies, will provide the necessary impetus for job creation and sustained economic recovery.
tgt: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku mpako wa magoza yo pfuxeta ikhonomi, lawa ma nga ta nghenisa R50 wa timiliyoni eka tisekitara ta nkoka to fana na ta swa vurimi, swimakiwakulu swa vaaki, tiikhonomi ta le malokixini na le matikoxikaya, wu ta nyika nhlohlotelo lowu faneleke wa ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na mpfuxeto wa ikhonomi leyi nga hetaka nkarhi wo leha.

src: This adds to the practical outcomes of the Jobs Summit where government, business and labour committed to: buy local products adopt a more aggressive approach to increasing exports interventions in agricultural value chains and support for small and medium enterprises to boost jobs.
tgt: Leswi swi tatisela eka mivuyelo leyi tirhisekaka ya Samiti ya swa Mitirho laha mfumo, mabindzu na vatirhi va tiboheke ku: xava swimakiwa swa laha ndzeni ka tiko ku tirhisa maendlelo yo tikarhata swinene yo tlakusa nxaviselo-vambe ku nghenelela eka ku hangalasiwa ka swimakiwa swa vurimi no seketela mabindzu lamatsongo na ya le xikarhi ku tlakusa mitirho.

src: Cabinet believes that these interventions are critical in addressing the findings from the Quarterly Labour Force Survey for the third quarter of 2018, which showed both a growth in employment and an increase in the number of unemployed persons.
tgt: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku ku nghenelela loku i ka nkoka eka ku ololoxa leswi kumiweke eka Ndzavisiso wa swa Nhlayokulu ya Vatirhi wa Kotara hi Kotara eka kotara ya vunharhu ya 2018, lowu kombiseke leswaku ku kula eka ku thoriwa xikan’we na ku tlakuka ka nhlayo ya vanhu lava nga tirhiki.

src: For the 3-months period, 92 000 additional jobs were created.
tgt: Eka nkarhi wa tin’hweti tinharhu, mitirho ya 92 000 yo tatisela yi tumbuluxiwile.

src: However, because about 131 000 previously ‘discouraged work-seekers’ re-entered the labour market in the quarter, the unemployment rate also rose, by of a percentage point to per cent.
tgt: Hambiswiritano, hikwalaho ka vanhu lava lavaka mintirho va kwalomu ka 131 000 lava a va hele ntamu eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza va tlhele va nghena eka makete wa vatirhi eka kotare leyi, mpimo wa mpfumaleko wa ntirho na wona wu tlakuke hi wa poyinti ya tiphesente wu ya eka wa tiphesente.

src: According to Statistics South Africa employment growth was registered in business services trade and construction, while job losses were occurred in mining, manufacturing, transport and private households.
tgt: Hi ku ya hi Tinhlayonhlayo ta Afrika-Dzonga, ku kula ka ku thoriwa ku ve kona eka vukorhokeri bya swa mabindzu, mabindzu na vuaki, loko ku lahlekeriwa hi mitirho ku ve kona eka swa migodi, vumaki, vutleketli na le mitini.

src: Employment in the formal sector shrunk, whilst jobs in the informal sector grew.
tgt: Ku thoriwa eka sekitara ya ximfumo ku tsongaharile, kasi mitirho eka sekithara leyi nga riki ya mfumo yi kurile.

src: 20th Anniversary of the Competition Act Cabinet notes that the Competition Act reached its 20th year since it was brought into operation in October 1998.
tgt: Anivhesari ya vu20 ya Nawu wa Mphikizano Khabinete yi lemuka leswaku Nawu wa Mphikizano wu fikelele lembe ra vu20 kusukela loko wu sungule ku tirha hi 1998.

src: Over the twenty-year period, the competition authorities have registered significant successes in the fight against cartels, abuse of market dominance and protection of public interest during mergers.
tgt: Eka malembe ya 20 lama nga hundza, vulawuri bya mphikizano byi ve na ku humelela lokukulu swinene eka ku lwisana na ku twanana ku tlakusa minxavo ka vamaki na vaxavisi, matirhiselo yo biha ya ku va lava xaveriwaka ngopfu emakete na ku sirheleriwa ka ku tsakela ka vaaki loko ku va na ku hlangana.

src: The authorities imposed more than R8 billion in penalties on companies for breaches of the Act.
tgt: Mfumo wu nyike kutlula R8 wa tibiliyoni ta mixupulo eka tikhamphani leti tluleke Nawu lowu.

src: The Ministry of Economic Development, through measures in the Competition Act, generated more than R5 billion in special funds to promote small business, local suppliers and the entry of black farmers into the economic mainstream.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya swa Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi, hi ku tirhisa magoza lama nga eka Nawu wa Mphikizano, yi endle ku tlula R5 wa tibiliyoni ta nkwama wo hlawuleka ku tlakusa mabindzu lamatsongo, vahangalasi va swimakiwa na ku nghena ka van’wamapurasi va vantima eka ikhonomikulu.

src: Cabinet congratulates the competition authorities for the work done to open the economy to new players and promote entrepreneurship and competition.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela valawuri va mphikizano eka ntirho lowu va wu tirheke ku pfulela vanhu lavantshwa lava khumbekaka ikhonomi no tlakusa ku endliwa ka mabindzu na mphikizano.

src: 18th Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) Council of Ministers meeting.
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya vu18 ya Khansele ya Vaholobye ya Indian Ocean Rim Association.

src: Cabinet congratulates the Department of International Relations and Cooperation for hosting a successful 18th Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) Meeting of the Council of Ministers (COM) which was held in Durban, KwaZulu Natal on 02 November 2018 under the theme: Uniting the Peoples of Africa, Asia, Australasia and the Middle East through enhanced cooperation for Peace, Stability and Sustainable Development”.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Ndzawulo ya Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava na Ntirhisano ku va yi rhurhele Nhlengeletano ya vu18 ya Khansele ya Vaholobye (COM) ya Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) leyi nga va na ku humelela leyi a yi khomeriwe eDurban, eKwaZulu-Natal hi siku ra 02 Hukuri 2018 ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Ku Vumba Vun’we bya Vanhu va Afrika, Asia, Australasia na Middle East hi ntirhisano lowu antswisiweke kuma ku Rhula, Ntshamiseko na Nhluvukiso lowu Yisekaka Emahlweni”.

src: One of the outcomes of the 18th IORA meeting was a Special Declaration in honour of President Nelson Mandela who is also one of the founders of IORThis led to the establishment of the “IORA Nelson Mandela ‘Be the Legacy’ internship programme” expected to be officially launched in July 2019.
tgt: Wun’wana wa mivuyelo ya nhlengeletano ya IORA ya vu18 a ku ri Xihlambanyo xo Hlawuleka hi ku xixima Phuresidente Nelson Mandela loyi a nga un’wana wa vasunguri va IORLeswi swi endle leswaku ku tumbuluxiwa “nongonoko wa ntirhodyondzo wa ‘Va na Ndzhaka’ wa IORA Nelson Mandela” lowu languteriweke ku simekiwa ximfumo hi Mawuwani 2019.

src: This initiative aims at empowering and capacitating young people of IORA with work experience in their fields of study.
tgt: Pfhumba leri ri kongomise eka ku nyika vantshwa va IORA matimba na vuswikoti bya ntokoto wa ntirho eka swiyenge swa vona swo hambana swa dyondzo.

src: Fighting Crime Cabinet welcomes the recently launched Anti-Gang Unit in Hanover Park, Western Cape, by President Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela Yuniti yo Lwisana na Vugevenga bya Mitlawa leyi ya ha ku simekiwaka eHanover Park eKapa-Vupeladyambu hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: This added intervention by government will go a long way in dealing decisively with the problem of gang and drug related crimes that are plaguing communities.
tgt: Ku nghenelela loku engeteriweke hi mfumo loku ku ta pfuna swinene eka ku tirhana kahle ka ku lwisana na vugevenga bya mitlawa na vugevenga lebyi fambelanaka na swidzidziharisi lebyi hlaselaka vaakitiko.

src: The unit has members who are trained in handling high-risk situations as they come from the tactical response teams, the special task force as well as the national intervention unit.
tgt: Yuniti leyi yi na swirho leswi leteriweke eka ku tirhana na swiyimo swa nxungeto wa le henhla tanihileswi swi humaka eka Tactical Response Team, va tlhela va tiveka tanihi Mabereta, maphorisa lama tirhaka ntirho wo hlawuleka xikan’we na yuniti yo nghenelela ya tiko hinkwaro.

src: In the pursuit of tackling crime, this particularly government-led intervention will be rolled out nationally.
tgt: Eka ku lava ku lwisana na vugevenga, ku nghenelela loku rhangeriweke hi mfumo ngopfungopfu ku yise ku nghenelela loku nga ta yisiwa etikweni hinkwaro.

src: Cabinet calls on communities to work with law enforcement agencies to maintain safety and security which is critical for any community to develop.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela vaakitiko ku tirhisana na tiejensi to sindzisa nawu ku hlayisa vuhlayiseki na nsirhelelo leswi nga swa nkoka eka ku hluvukisa muganga wun’wana na wun’wana.

src: It remains committed in ensuring that communities are safe and feel safe in their respective areas.
tgt: Ya ha tiyimisele eka ku vona leswaku vaakatiko va hlayisekile no titwa va hlayisekile eka tindhawu leti va tshamaka eka tona.

src: Tax Season Cabinet thanks all taxpayers for promptly submitting their annual tax returns for the 2017/18 tax season, which closed on 31 October 2018.
tgt: Khabinete yi khensa vabari eka ku va va yise tifomo ta vona ta xibalo ta lembe na lembe hi xihatla eka nguva ya xibalo ya 2017/18 leyi nga pfala hi siku ra 31 Nhlangula 2018.

src: Revenue generated through taxes remains the main source of funds that ensures government can deliver services to the public.
tgt: Mali ya tiko leyi hlengeletiweke hi swibalo yi tshama ya ha ri xihlovokulu xa timali lexi xi endlaka leswaku mfumo wu nyika vaakitiko vukorhokeri.

src: National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).
tgt: Xikimi xa Mpfuneto wa Swichudeni hi swa Timali xa Rixaka (NSFAS).

src: Cabinet reminds all learners wanting to apply to the National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) for financial aid in 2019 that online applications close on 30 November 2018.
tgt: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa vadyondzi hinkwavo lava lavaka ku endla swikombelo eka Xikimu xa Mpfuneto wa Swichudeni hi swa Timali xa Rixaka (NSFAS) ku kuma mpfuneto wa swa timali hi 2019 leswaku ku endliwa ka swikombelo hi ku tirhisa inthanete swi pfala hi siku ra 30 Hukuri 2018.

src: On 01 September 2018, applications opened to eligible students wishing to further their studies in 2019 on an approved course at any public university or Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) college in South Africa.
tgt: Hi siku ra 01 Ndzati 2018, swikombelo swi pfuleriwile eka swichudeni leswi fikelelaka leswi navelaka ku yisa tidyondzo ta swona emahlweni hi 2019 eka khoso leyi pfumeleriweke eka yunivhesiti ya mani na mani kumbe kholichi ya Dyondzo na Vuleteri ya swa Vuthekiniki na Mitirho ya Mavoko (TVET) yihi kumbe yihi eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Students are strongly encouraged to submit online applications or visit their nearest National Youth Development Agency (NYDA) centre before the closing date.
tgt: Swichudeni swi hlohloteriwa swinene ku yisa swikombelo hi ku tirhisa inthanete kumbe swi endzela senthara ya Ejensi ya Nhluvukiso wa Vantshwa ya Rixaka (NYDA) ku nga se fika siku ro pfala.

src: Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Swiboho swa Khabinete.

src: Cabinet approved the Strategy Framework for the pursuit of South Africa’s strategic economic interests globally as it relates to trade, investment and industrialisation.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise Rimba ra Maqhinga ro landzelerisiwa ka mitsakelo ya ikhonomi ya xiqhinga ematikweni ya misava ra Afrika-Dzonga tanihiloko ri fambelana na mabindzu, vuvekisi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka tifeme.

src: The strategy aims to ensure that international engagements serve the country’s domestic policy imperatives such as poverty alleviation, unemployment and inequality.
tgt: Qhinga leri ri kongomise ku vona leswaku ku tirhisana ka matiko ya misava ku tirhela swilaveko swa pholisi ya laha ndzeni ka tiko ku fana no herisa vusweti, ku pfumaleka ka mitirho na ku pfumala ku ringanana.

src: The strategy advocates that South Africa pursue development integration in the rest of Africa supported by an investment led strategy and build strategic alliances to advance its agenda.
tgt: Qhinga leri ri seketela leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi landzelerisa ku hlanganisiwa ka nhluvuko eAfrika hinkwayo loku seketeriwaka hi vuvekisi lebyi rhangeriweke hi qhinga no aka vuxaka bya xiqhinga ku yisa ajenda ya yona emahlweni.

src: It also consolidates its trade and investment relations with developed countries and pursues inward investments, skills and technology transfer and value –added exports.
tgt: Ri tlhela ri hlanganisa vuxaka bya yona bya mabindzu na na vuvekisi na matiko lama hluvukeke naswona ri landzelerisa vuvekisi bya le ndzeni, ku hundzisiwa ka swikili na thekinoloji na nxaviselavambe lowu nga na nkoka.

src: Cabinet approved the cost-of-living annual salary adjustment for members of the South African Human Rights Commission.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku cinciwanyana ka muholo wa lembe na lembe wa ku durha ka swilo eka swirho swa Khomixini ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The South African Human Rights Commission Act, 2013 provides that remuneration, allowances and other terms and conditions of office be determined by the President in consultation with Cabinet and the Minister of Finance.
tgt: Nawu wa Khomixini ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ya Afrika-Dzonga wa 2013 wu vula leswaku muholo, mali ya swipfuno na swipimelo swa le ntirhweni swin’wana swi fanele swi bohiwa hi Phuresidente hi ku tirhisana na Khabinete na Holobye wa swa Timali.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Swiendleko leswa ha taka.

src: International Labour OrganisationThe International Labour Organisation’s (ILO) High-Level Global Commission on the Future of Work will hold its final session from the 15 to 17 November 2018 The Commission is is co-chaired by President Cyril Ramaphosa and his Swedish counterpart Stefan Löfven.
tgt: Nhlangano wa swa Timhaka ta Vatirhi wa Matiko ya MisavaKhomixini ya Matiko ya Misava ya Levhele ya le Henhla ya swa Timhaka ta Vumundzuku bya Ntirho ya Nhlangano wa Vatirhi wa Matiko ya Misava (ILO) yi ta khoma nhlengeletano ya yona yo hetelela kusukela hi 15 kufikela hi 17 Hukuri 2018.

src: The High-Level Global commission, set up by the ILO in 2017, is tasked with assessing the rapid transformations taking place in the world of work,identifying the key challenges and what must be done to make the future of work better and fairer.
tgt: Khomixini ya Matiko ya Misava ya Levhele ya le Henhla, leyi tumbuluxiweke hi ILO hi 2017, yi nyikiwe ntirho wo kambela ku cinca ka xihatla emitirhweni, ku kuma mitlhontlho ya nkoka na leswi swi faneleke ku endliwa ku endla vumundzuku bya ntirho byi va lebyinene no antswa.

src: The work of the Global Commission aligns with government's focus on the creation of decent and sustainable jobs, and efforts to ensure young South Africans have the skills necessary to thrive in the changing workplace.
tgt: Ntirho wa Khomixini ya Matiko ya Misava wu fambelanisa nkongomiso wa mfumo eka ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho ya kahle no va kona nkarhi wo leha na matshalatshala yo vona leswaku vantshwa va MaAfrika-Dzonga va na swikili leswi faneleke ku endlela ku humelela emitirhweni leyi cincacincaka.

src: China International Import Expo (CIIE)Cabinet welcomes the participation of South Africa as a country guest of honour in the China International Import Expo (CIIE) in Shanghai.
tgt: Nkombiso wa swixaviwa leswi humaka ematikweni ya misava wa le China (CIIE)Khabinete yi amukela ku nghenelela ka Afrika-Dzonga tanihi tiko leri nga muyeni wo xiximeka eka Nkombiso wa Swixaviwa leswi Humaka Ematikweni Mambe wa Matiko ya Misava wa le China (CIIE) eShanghai.

src: Trade and Industry Minister Rob Davies, is leading a delegation of 27 South African organisations.
tgt: Holobye wa Mabindzu na Vumaki, Rob Davies, u rhangela vurhumiwa bya mihlangano ya 27 ya le Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The delegation is being funded by the Department of Trade and Industry through the Export Marketing and Investment Assistance (EMIA) Scheme.
tgt: Vurhumiwa byi pfuniwa hi swa timali hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki hi ku tirhisa Xikimi xa Vumaketi bya Swixavisela-vambe na Mpfuneto wa swa Vuvekisi (EMIA).Ku nghenelela ka Afrika-Dzonga ku pfuneta tiko hi ndlela yo antswa ku tlakusa vuswikoti bya rona eka swa bindzu na vuvekisi, naswona hi langutele vakombisi lava nga ta nghenelela vo huma eka tisekitara leti katsaka ku phurosesiwa ka swa vurimi, tintangu na dzovo, vuinjiniyere, tikhemikali to endla petirolo, swiphemu swa switimela, swa vusirheleri xikan’we na thekinoloji ya swa vuxokoxoko na vuhlanganisi laha va nga vuya ekaya tioda to xava.

src: On the margins of the Expo, South Africa also hosted an investment seminar focusing on opportunities in the manufacturing sector.
tgt: Eka mhaka ya Nkombiso, Afrika-Dzonga yi rhurhele nhlengeletano ya swa vuvekisi leyi a yi kongomise eka swivandlanene leswi nga kona eka sekitara ya swa vuendli.

src: Imbizo Focus WeekThe upcoming two weeks of activism by government will mark the 9th National Imbizo Focus Week, which is being coordinated by the Government Communication and Information System (GCIS).
tgt: Vhiki ra Nkongomiso wa ImbizoMavhiki mambirhi lama nga ta landzela ya ku gingirika ka mfumo ma ta fungha Vhiki ra Nkongomisa wa Imbizo ya Rixaka ya vu9, leyi kondleteriwaka hi Sisiteme ya swa Vuhlanganisi na Mahungu ya Mfumo (GCIS).

src: Members of the National Executive as well as provincial and local government leaders will undertake community meetings and Izimbizo countrywide.
tgt: Swirho swa Vurhangerinkulu bya Rixaka xikan’we na varhangeri mifumo ya swifundzankulu na mifumo ya miganga va ta ya eka tinhlengeletano ta vaakitiko na Imbizo etikweni hinkwaro.

src: A programme will be posted on WEBTOKEN for the period 12 to 25 November 2018.South Africans are encouraged to utilise this platform to engage with principals on service delivery issues to ensure that we work together in developing our communities.
tgt: Nongonoko wu ta eka WEBTOKEN eka nkarhi wo sukela hi siku ra 12 kufikela 25 Hukuri 2018.

src: Cabinet expresses its condolences to the families and loved ones of all those who lost their lives during a series of fires on the Garden Route and surrounding areas, as well as in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela eka mindyangu na varhandziwa va vanhu hinkwavo lava nga hundza emisaveni hi nkarhi wa nandzelelano wa mindzilo eka Garden Route na tindhawu leti nga ekusuhi xikan’we na le Kapa-Vuxa.

src: The fire claimed the life of Nico Heyns, who was a pilot for “Working on Fire”.
tgt: Ndzilo wu koxe vutomi bya Nico Heyns loyi a ri muhahisi wa xihahampfhukaphatsa wa “Working on Fire”.

src: It also resulted in the death of nine other people and the displacement of approximately 2000.
tgt: Leswi swi tlhele swi vanga rifu ra vanhu va kaye van’wana na ku rhurhisiwa ka kwalomu ka 2000 wa vona.

src: A number of properties and large areas of vegetation were also destroyed.
tgt: Tindlu to hlaya na tindhawu letikulukumba ta swimila na tona ti tshwile.

src: Cabinet commends the swift response of fire fighters and disaster management officials, together with the SA Air Force and “Working on Fire” who worked tirelessly to save lives and bring the fire under control.
tgt: Khabinete yi ndhundhuzela ku tekiwa goza ra xihatla ka vatimeri va ndzilo na vatirhi van’wana vo lawula timhangu hi ku tirhisana na Masocha ya le Moyeni ya Afrika-Dzonga na “Working on Fire” lava tirheke hi nkhinkhi ku ponisa vutomi bya vanhu no lawula ndzilo.

src: Cabinet expresses its condolences to the Government and the people of Indonesia following the plane crash that killed 189 people after takeoff from the Indonesian capital, Jakarta.
tgt: Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela eka mfumo na vanhu va le Indonesia endzhaku ka ku wa ka xihahampfhuka lexi xi koxeke vutomi bya vanhu va 189 endzhaku ko va xi suke entsindza wa Indonesia, Jakarta.

src: Cabinet congratulates South Africa for being elected with responding support to serve on the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Council on Monday, 05 November 2018 during the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference in Dubai.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela ku hlawuriwa ka Afrika-Dzonga hi nseketelo lowukulu ku tirha eka Khansele ya Nhlangano wa Vuhlanganisi bya Tiqingho ya Matiko ya Misava (ITU) hi Musumbunuku, 05 Hukuri 2018 eka Khomferense ya Vayimelatiko ya ITU eDubai.

src: Cabinet also congratulates Mr Mandla Mchunu of ICASA who has been elected to serve on the Radio Regulations Board of the ITU as well as Ms Doreen Bogdan-Martin on her election as the Director of the Telecommunication Development Bureau, and as the first woman to be part of the senior management of the ITU since it was established in 1865.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela Nkulukumba Mandla Mchunu wa Vulawuri bya Vuhlanganisi lebyi Tiyimelaka bya Afrika-Dzonga (Icasa) loyi a hlawuriweke ku tirha eka Bodo ya Swinawana swa Rhadiyo eka ITU xikan’we na Manana Doreen Bogdan-Martin eka ku hlawuriwa ka yena tanihi Mufambisi wa Byuro ya Nhluvukiso wa Vuhlanganisi bya Tinqingho no va waxisati wo sungula ku va xiphemu xa vufambisinkulu bya ITU k sukela loko yi tumbuluxiwile hi 1865.Afrika-Dzonga ya tinyungubyisa hi ku tshemba loku yi nyikiwaka kona hi matiko man’wana ku tirha eka mihlangano ya le henhla ya ITU eka malembe ya mune lama landzelaka.

src: South Africa is humbled by the confidence bestowed by other nation states to serve in these high structures of the ITU for the next four years.
tgt: Hi ta tirhisa swiyimo leswi ku yisa ajenda ya hina ya nhluvukiso na ku va na rixaka leri pfulekeke mahlo leri katsaka vanhu hinkwavo eka nkarhi wa xidjitali.

src: We will use these positions to push the developmental agenda and for an inclusive information society in the digital age.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela Rhiphabuliki yXidemokirasi xa Federali ya Ethiopia eka ku va yi hlawule phuresidente wa wansati wo sungula, Muchaviseki Sahle-Work Zewde loyi sweswi a nga phuresidente wa wansati a ri yexe eka tikokulu ra Afrika.

src: Cabinet also congratulated the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia for electing its first woman president, Her Excellency Sahle-Work Zewde, who is the only current woman president on the African continent.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi ya emahlweni yi tiyisisa vuxaka bya yona bya matiko lamambirhi na Ethiopia eka swiyenge swo hambana leswi katsaka vuxaka bya swa mabindzu, swa tipolitiki na swa ikhonomi.

src: Cabinet sends congratulations to Cameroon’s President Paul Biya, who was inaugurated for his seventh term in office.
tgt: Khabinete yi yisa ku hoyozela ka yona eka Phuresidente wa Cameroon, Paul Biya, loyi a nga vekiwa ximfumo eka nkarhi wo tirha ra vunkombo.

src: Cabinet calls on all people of Cameroon to work together towards a peaceful solution through an inclusive dialogue process.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela vanhu hinkwavo va le Cameroon ku tirhisana leswaku va ta fikelela xitshunxo lexi nga na ku rhula hi ku tirhisa phurosese yo vulavurisana leyi katsaka vanhu hinkwavo.

src: Cabinet looks forward to the deepening of bilateral political, economic and trade relations between South Africa with Cameroon.
tgt: Khabinete yi langutele ku tiyisisa vuxaka bya matiko lamambirhi bya swa tipolitiki, swa ikhonomi na swa mabindzu exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Cameroon.

src: Cabinet also congratulates the people of Brazil for holding a successful election which sees President-elect of the Federative Republic of Brazil, H. Jair Bolsonaro as the next Brazilian President.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela vanhu va Brazil eka ku va va ve na nhlawulo lowu nga na ku humelela lowu nga endla muyimelakulangwa wa Phuresidente ya Federative Republic of Brazil, H. Jair Bolsonaro a va Phuresidente wa Brazil loyi a landzelaka.

src: Cabinet extends good wishes to all the Hindu communities in South Africa who are celebrating Diwali or Deepavali.
tgt: Khabinete yi navelela miganga va Mahindu hinkwayo eAfrika-Dzonga leyi tlangelaka Diwali kumbe Deepavali.

src: This is a religious occasion that celebrates the victory of good over evil, knowledge and wisdom over ignorance as well as the triumph of light over darkness.
tgt: Lexi i xiendleko xa vukhongeri lexi xi tlangelaka ku hlula ka vunene eka vubihi, vutivi na vutlhari eka nkalavutivi xikan’we na ku hlula ka ku vonakala eka munyama.
