src: Let the divine light bless South Africa with peace, prosperity, happiness, success and fulfilment, as we all do our part to cement harmony and unity in our country’s cultural and religious diversityAppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Ku vonakala ko kwetsima a ku katekise Afrika-Dzonga hi ku rhula, ntsako, ku humelela na ku hetiseka loko hi endla ntirho wa hina wo tiyisisa ku hanyisana na vun’we eka ku hambana ka tiko ra ka hina hi swa mfuwo na vukhongeri.

src: Re-appointment of Ms Nomfundo Maseti as Full-time Regulator Member, responsible for Piped-Gas regulation, to serve on the NERSA Board.
tgt: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa hinkwako ku ta fanela ku landzelela vutiyisisi bya mithwaso na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.

src: The following persons have been appointed to the Council for the Built Environment:a. Absalom Mosabeni Molobe (Chairperson)b. Ms Maphefo K Mogodi (Deputy Chairperson)c. Ms Zandile Yvonne Mathed.
tgt: Ku thoriwa nakambe ka Manana Nomfundo Maseti tanihi Xirho xa Mulawuri xa Nkarhi Hinkwawo lexi nga na vutihlamuleri byo lawula Gasi leyi Fambisiwaka hi Tipompo, ku tirha eka Bodo ya NERSVanhu lava landzelaka va thoriwile eka Khansele ya Mbangu lowu Akiweke:a. Absalom Mosabeni Molobe (Mutshamaxitulu)b. Manana Maphefo K Mogodi (Xandla xa Mutshamaxitulu)c. Manana Zandile Yvonne Mathed.

src: Dr Jenitha Badule.
tgt: Dokodela Jenitha Badule.

src: Ngwako Edward Hutamof.
tgt: Ngwako Edward Hutamof.

src: Gert Hendrik Meyerh.
tgt: Gert Hendrik Meyerh.

src: Jerry Leigh Magoliusi.
tgt: Jerry Leigh Magoliusi.

src: Hendrik Ndlovuj.
tgt: Hendrik Ndlovuj.

src: Dr Keith Ivor Jacobsk.
tgt: Dokodela Keith Ivor Jacobsk.

src: Adv Boitumelo Tlhakungl.
tgt: Adv Boitumelo Tlhakungl.

src: Inge Maree Vieiram.
tgt: Inge Maree Vieiram.

src: Sinenhlanhla Thuleleni Mthembun.
tgt: Sinenhlanhla Thuleleni Mthembun.

src: Dr Prittish Dalao.
tgt: Dokodela Prittish Dalao.

src: Ulandi Exnerp.
tgt: Ulandi Exnerp.

src: Ms Florence Rabadaq.
tgt: Manana Florence Rabadaq.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 21 November 2018 at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlangane hi Ravunharhu, 21 Hukuri 2018, eTuynhuys, Kapa.

src: Issues in the Environment.
tgt: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.

src: Investment.
tgt: Vuvekisi.

src: Cabinet welcomes the successful inaugural Africa Investment Forum held from 7 to 9 November 2018 at the Sandton Convention Centre in Gauteng.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela Foramu ya Vuvekisi ya Afrika leyi simekiweke yi famba kahle leyi khomiweke kusuka hi siku ra 7 kufika 9 Hukuri 2018 eSandton Convention Centre eGauteng.

src: African governments and businesses, international financial institutions and other development partners focused on making Africa the next global frontier in investment.
tgt: Mifumo ya Afrika na mabindzu, mihlangano ya swa timali ya matiko ya misava na vatirhisani va nhluvukiso van'wana va kongomise eka ku endla Afrika yi va rirhangu ra matiko ya misava leri landzelaka eka vuvekisi.

src: At the close of the conference 45 deals, worth US$32 billion, were concluded to benefit the continent.
tgt: Eku pfaleni ka khomferense 45 wa mitwanano, leyi nga na nkoka wa US$32 wa tibiliyoni, ku ngheniwile eka yona ku vuyerisa tikokulu.

src: Of that, South Africa will benefit from US$6.8 billion in investment.
tgt: Eka sweswo, Afrika-Dzonga yi ta vuyeriwa kusuka eka US$6.8 wa tibiliyoni eka vuvekisi.

src: African Union (AU) Summit.
tgt: Samiti ya Yuniyoni ya Afrika (AU).

src: Cabinet is encouraged by deliberations at the AU Summit held in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on 17 and 18 November 2018, where President Cyril Ramaphosa participated.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaziwa hi mikanerisano eka Samiti ya AU leyi khomeriweke eAddis Ababa, Ethiopia hi siku ra 17 na 18 Hukuri 2018, laha Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa a tekeke xiave.

src: The Extraordinary Session deliberated on the ongoing reform processes which are intended to establish an effective, efficient and re-energized AU that is capable of achieving continental priorities and goals set out in Agenda 2063, which is a strategic framework for the socio-economic transformation of Africa over the next 50 years.
tgt: Nhlengeletano leyo ka yi nga Tolovelakangi eka tiphurosese ta mpfuxeto leti yaka emahlweni leti a ti kunguhateriwile ku tumbuluxa AU leyi tirhaka kahle, leyi nga tlangisiki swipfuno na ku va leyi nyikiweke matimba hi vuntshwa leyi kotaka ku fikelela swirhangana swa tikokulu na swikongomelokulu leswi hlamuseriweke eka Ajenda 2063, leswi swi nga rimba ra maqhinga eka ncinco wa vaaki na ikhonomi wa Afrika eka 50 wa malembe lama taka.

src: The reform of the AU is an ongoing process, with some of its recommendations already implemented, particularly in relation to the commitment to have member states of the AU assume greater ownership of financing the organisation.
tgt: Mpfuxeto wa AU i phurosese leyi yaka emahlweni, laha swin'wana swa swibumabumelo swa yona se swi tirhisiweke, ngopfungopfu hi ku fambelana na vutiboheleri bya ku va na mifumo leyi nga swirho swa AU yi byarha vun'wini lebyikulu bya ku nyika timali eka nhlangano lowu.

src: More countries continue to sign the African Continental Free Trade Agreement to ensure the Continent realises the continent-wide free-trade agreement.
tgt: Matiko yo tala ya ya emahlweni ya sayina Ntwanano wa Mabindzu ya Nkaswipimelo ya Tikokulu ra Afrika ku tiyisisa leswaku Tikokulu ri humelerisa ntwanano wa mabindzu ya nkaswipimelo ya tikokulu hinkwaro.

src: Strategic Partnership with the European Union (EU).
tgt: Vutirhisani bya Xiqhinga na Yniyoni ya Yuropa (EU).

src: Cabinet is pleased with the positive outcome of the 7th South Africa – EU Summit held on 15 November in Belgium.
tgt: Khabinete ya tsaka hi mbuyelo lowunene wa Samiti ya Afrika-Dzonga – EU ya vu7 leyi khomiweke hi siku ra 15 Hukuri eBelgiu.

src: The outcomes and commitments made at the summit build on our unprecedented drive to place economic growth and job creation at the centre of South Africa’s national agenda.
tgt: m Mivuyelo na vutiboheleri lebyi endliweke eka samiti ku aka ehenhla ka pfhumba leri nga si tshama ri vakona ku veka ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho exikarhi ka ajenda ya rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: South Africa is the only African country and one of the 10 countries globally that has a Strategic Partnership with the EThe EU is South Africa’s largest trading partner and largest foreign investor as a bloc, representing 73.7% of total Foreign Direct Investment stocks in the country.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga i tiko ra Afrika ri ri roxe naswona hi rin'wana ra matiko ya 10 emisaveni hinkwayo leri nga na Xinakulobye xa Xiqhinga na EEU i mutirhisani wo bindzurisa lonkulu wa Afrika-Dzonga naswona i muvekisi wa matiko mambe lonkulu tanihi biloko, leyi yimelaka 73.7% ta switoko hikwaswo swa Vuvekisi byo Kongoma bya Matiko Mambe etikweni.

src: President Ramaphosa this week hosted the President of the Federal Republic of Germany, Mr Frank-Walter Steinmeier, on a State Visit to South Africa.
tgt: Phuresidente Ramaphosa vhiki reri u rhurhele Phuresidente xa Rhiphabuliki ya Xifederali ya Jarimani, Ttn Frank-Walter Steinmeier, eka Vuendzeri bya Mfumo eka Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Germany is one of the largest foreign investors in South Africa, with more than 600 German companies having subsidiaries or production in the country, sustaining about 100 000 jobs.
tgt: Jarimani hi yin'wana ya vavekisi va matiko mambe lavakulu eAfrika-Dzonga, leyi nga na kutlula 6000 wa tikhamphani ta Jarimani leti nga na marhavu kumbe vuhumesi etikweni, yi hlayisa kwalomu ka 100 000 wa mitirho.

src: This State Visit resulted in the signing of trade and investment agreements between the two countries, and afforded both leaders an opportunity to discuss multilateral issues and cooperate closely as non-permanent members of the United Nations (UN) Security Council for a two-year term from 2019 to Land reform.
tgt: Vuendzeri lebya Mfumo byi vange ku sayiniwa ka mitwanano ya mabindzu na vuvekisi exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi, naswona byi kotise varhangeri havambirhi ku kanela hi swiphiqo swa matikonyingi na ku tirhisana swinene tanihi swirho leswi nga riki swa nkarhi hinkwawo swa Khansele ya Nsirhelelo ya Vun'we bya Tinxaka (UN) ku ringana theme ya malembe mambirhi kusuka hi 2019 kufika hi Mpfuxeto wa misava.

src: Cabinet noted that Parliament’s Joint Constitutional Review Committee adopted its report that is in favour of amending Section 25 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Khabinete yi lemuke leswaku Komiti ya Nkambisiso wa Vumbiwa ya Nhlanganelo ya Palamende yi amukele xiviko xa yona lexi xi seketelaka ku hundzuluxiwa ka Xiyenge xa 25 xa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ya Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.

src: The amendment will make it possible for the State to expropriate land without compensation in the public interest.
tgt: Hundzuluxo lowu wu ta endla swi koteka eka Mfumo ku teka vun'wini bya misava ku ri hava ndziriso ku vuyerisa vaaki.

src: The committee’s report is expected to be tabled in the National Assembly for debate.
tgt: Xiviko xa komiti xi languteriwa ku andlariwa eka Huvo ya Rixaka eka njhekajekisano.

src: A public consultation process saw numerous organisations making submissions on the Bill and public hearings were held in all nine provinces.
tgt: Phurosese yo tinhlanganisa na vaaki yi endle mihlangano yo tala yi rhumela swibumabumelo eka Nawumbisi lowu naswona tinhlengeletano to twa miehleketo ya vaaki ti khomiwile eka swifundzakulu swa hinkwaswo.

src: The Constitution has so far been amended 17 times through a consultative and inclusive process.
tgt: Vumbiwa kufika sweswi ri hundzuluxiwile ka 17 hi phurosese yo tihlanganisa na ku katsa vanhu hinkwavo.

src: Government remains committed to a responsible land reform approach that is in the best interests of everyone.
tgt: Mfumo wu tshama wa ha tibohe eka endlelo ra mpfuxeto wa misava lowu nga na vutihlamuleri leri nga ta vuyerisa munhu un'wana na un'wana.

src: Cabinet affirms that government respects the rule of law and will, at all times, act in accordance with the Constitution.
tgt: Khabinete ya tiyisisa leswaku mfumo wu xixima mfumo wa nawu naswona, hi mikarhi hinkwayo, wu ta endla hi ku fambisana na Vumbiwa.

src: Constitutional Court judgement.
tgt: Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa.

src: Cabinet welcomes the Constitutional Court judgment which ruled that the Minerals and Petroleum Resources Development Act, 2002 (Act 28 of 2002) which governs the awarding of mining rights, must be read concurrently with the Interim Protection of Informal Land Rights Act, 1996 (Act 31 of 1996), which protects vulnerable land rights.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa leyi boheke leswaku Nawu wa Swicelwa na Nhluvukiso wa Swipfuno swa Oyilimbisi, 2020 (Nawu wa 28 wa 2002) lowu wu fumaka ku nyikiwa ka timfanelo ta vucelamigodi, wu fanele ku hlayiwa swin'we na Nawu wa Nsirhelelo wa Timfanelo ta Misava leti nga riki ta Ximfumo, 1996 (Nawu wa 31 wa 1996), lowu wu sirhelelaka timfanelo ta misava leti nga sirhelelekangiki.

src: The victory of the Lesetlheng community in North West signals a start to the recognition of land rights of which South Africa’s historically oppressed people had been deprived for generations.
tgt: Vuhluri bya muganga wa Lesetlheng eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu wu komba masungulo ya timfanelo ta misava leti vanhu lava a va tshikeleriwile emikarhini leyi nga hundza va Afrika-Dzonga a va pfumatiwile tona eka tinxaka to hlaya.

src: Where mining impacts on settlements, families and communities, people directly affected by mining must consent to any changes affecting their land rights.
tgt: Laha vucelamigodi byi hlohlotela eka matshamelo, mindyangu na miganga, vanhu lava khumbekaka hi ku kongoma hi vucelamigodi va fanele ku pfumela ku cinca kwihi kumbe kwihi loku khumbaka timfanelo ta vona ta misava.

src: Audit outcomes.
tgt: Mivuyelo ya oditi.

src: Cabinet welcomes and congratulates the government departments and entities that continues to consistently receive clean- audit outcomes.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela na ku hoyozela tindzawulo na mavandla ya mfumo lama yaka emahlweni hindlela yo fanana ya ku kuma mivuyelo ya oditi yo basa.

src: This comes after the release by the Auditor General (AG) Kimi Makwetu of the Public Finance Management Audit Report of the 2017/18 financial year.
tgt: Leswi swi ta endzhaku ka ku humesiwa hi Oditara-Jenerala (AG) Kimi Makwetu ka Xiviko xa Oditi ya Malawulelo ya Timali ta Mfumo xa lembeximali ra 2017/18.

src: Cabinet is however concerned with the report that shows an overall deterioration in the audit results of some national and provincial government departments and their entities.
tgt: Hambisiwiritano Khabinete yi vilerisiwa hi xiviko lexi xi kombaka ku ya ehansi ko angarhela eka mivuyelo ya oditi ya tindzawulo tin'wana ta mfumo wa rixaka na wa swifundzakulu na mavandla ya tona.

src: The signing into law of the Public Audit Amendment Bill by President Ramaphosa, which will strengthen the work of the Office of the AG, will assist in holding accountable those that continue to have disregard for the governance framework.
tgt: Ku sayiniwa ku va nawu ka Nawumbisi wo Hundzuluxa wa Oditi ya Mfumo hi Phuresidente Ramaphosa, leswi swi nga ta tiyisa ntirho wa Hofisi ya AG, swi ta pfuna ku endla va tihlamulela lava va yaka emahlweni na ku tsan'wa rimba ra mfumo.

src: Cabinet encourages all departments and entities to work on remedial interventions on all the issues flagged by the AG and to monitor progress regularly to address issues before the next audit cycle.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaza tindzawulo na mavandla hinkwawo ku tirha hi miphalalo yo lulamisa eka swiphiqo hinkwaswo leswi funghiweke hi AG na ku veka ndzima tihlo nkarhi na nkarhi ku tirhana na swiphiqo ku nga si fika ndzhendzeleko wa oditi ya nkarhi lowu taka.

src: Safety and Security.
tgt: Vuhlayiseki na Nsirhelelo.

src: Cabinet pledges support to the National Safer Festive Season Campaign that was launched by Police Minister Bheki Cele under the theme “Operation Quiet Storm”.
tgt: Khabinete ya tiboha ku seketela Pfhumba ra Nguva ya Makhisimusi yo Hlayiseka ya Rixaka leyi simekiweke hi Holobye wa Maphorisa Bheki Cele ehansi ka nkongomelo wa “Operation Quiet Storm”.

src: The campaign aims to make South Africa a safer place as we approach the year-end holiday season.
tgt: Pfhumba leri ri kongomisa eka ku endla Afrika-Dzonga yi va ndhawu yo hlayiseka tanihiloko hi tshinelela nguva ya tiholideyi ta ku hela ka lembe.

src: The South African Police Service will conduct nationwide operations in every town, village and township until the end of January 2019.They will focus on visible policing, whilst conducting special crime awareness and prevention operations.
tgt: Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa bya Afrika-Dzonga byi ta endla mitirho etikweni hinkwaro edorobeni rin'wana na rin'wana, emugangeni na le lokixini kufikela ku hela ka Sunguti 2019.

src: Cabinet appeals to all people in South Africa to continue cooperating with the police in keeping our communities safe.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela vanhu hinkwavo eAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni va tirhisana na maphorisa eka ku endla miganga yi tshama yi hlayisekile.

src: Parents and guardians are also advised to be extra vigilant in caring for their children during the upcoming festive season.
tgt: Vatswari na vahlayisi va xinawu na vona va tsundzuxiwa ku va xa xalamuka swinene eka ku hlayisa vana va vona hi nkarhi wa nguva ya makhisimusi leyi nga eku teni.

src: Cabinet also pledges support to the 2018 Festive Season Road Safety campaign, launched by the Minister of Transport, Dr Blade Nzimande, in Limpopo at the weekend.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete ya tiboha ku seketela pfhumba ra Vuhlayiseki bya le Magondzweni bya Nguva ya Makhisimusi, leri simekiweke hi Holobye wa Vutleketli, Dkd Blade Nzimande, eLimpopo hi ku hela ka vhiki.

src: The launch coincided with the annual two-day Road Safety Summit and the UN’s World Day of Remembrance for victims of road crashes.
tgt: Nsimeko lowu wu kotlana na Samiti ya Vuhlayiseki bya le Magondzweni ya masiku mambirhi ya lembe na lembe na Siku ra ku Tsundzuka ra Misava ra UN ra lava weriweke hi khombo ra mitlumbano ya le magondzweni.

src: It is in the best interests of our well-being that we all play a part in ensuring a safer festive season by driving responsibly and obeying the rules of the road.
tgt: Swi ta vuyerisa ku hanya kahle ka hina leswaku hinkwerhu hi tirha xiphemu eka ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na nguva ya makhisimusi leyi hlayisekeke hi ku chayela hindlela ya vutihlamuleri na ku landzelela milawu ya gondzo.

src: Maputo-Catembe Bridge.
tgt: Biloho ra Maputo-Catembe.

src: Cabinet congratulates the South African engineers involved in the historic development of the longest suspension bridge in Africa.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela vainjhiniyara va Afrika-Dzonga lava khumbekeke eka nhluvukiso lowu nga wa nkoka eka matimu wa biloho ro cinkinya ro leha kutlula hinkwawo eAfrika.

src: The Maputo-Catembe Bridge was built by the China Road and Bridge Corporation and connects Maputo in Mozambique and KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Biloho ra Maputo-Catembe ri akiwile hi Khamphanikulu ya Magondzo na Mabiloho ya Chayina naswona ri khomanisa Maputo eMozambique na KwaZulu-Natal.

src: President of Mozambique, Mr Filipe Nyusi, inaugurated the three-kilometre-long Maputo-Catembe Bridge, which was built over four years at a cost of US$785 million.
tgt: Phuresidente wa Mozambique, Ttn Filipe Nyusi, u pfule ximfumo Biloho ra Maputo-Catembe ro leha tikhilomitara tinharhu, leri ri akiweke hi mune wa malembe hi ndhurho wa US$785 wa timiliyoni.

src: This development will stimulate trade and tourism between Mozambique and South Africa with travel time between Maputo to Kosi Bay in KwaZulu-Natal’s East Coast border post drastically reduced from six hours to 90 minutes.
tgt: Nhluvukiso lowu wu ta hlohlotela mabindzu na vupfhumba exikarhi ka Mozambique na Afrika-Dzonga hi nkarhi wa ku tekiwa ka rendzo exikarhi ka Maputo kuya eka Hlaluko wa Kosi endzilakanini wa Ribuwu ra le Vuhumadyambu ra KwaZulu-Natal lowu hunguteke hindlela ya xiyimo xa le henhla kusuka eka tsevu wa tiawara kufika eka 90 wa timinete.

src: Programme of Action Briefing Week.
tgt: Nongonoko wa Vhiki ro Nyika Vuxokoxoko bya Matirhelo.

src: Cabinet was apprised on the progress reports on the priority outcomes for the period starting 1 April 2018 to 30 September 2018.
tgt: Khabinete yi nyike vuxokoxoko eka swiviko swa tindzima eka mivuyelo ya swirhangana eka nkarhi lowu sungulaka hi 1 Dzivamisoko 2018 kufika hi 30 Ndzati 2018.

src: Departments working within the clusters to implement the 14 priority outcomes continue to achieve their respective deliverables.
tgt: Tindzawulo leti tirhaka exikarhi ka swikatsa leswi ku simeka 14 wa mivuyelo leya swirhangana ti ya emahlweni ti fikelela swiphakeriwa swa tona vini.

src: These outcomes are derived from the 2014-2019 Medium Term Strategic Framework and from the National Development Plan’s Vision 2030.
tgt: Mivuyelo leyi yi huma eka Rimba ra Maqhinga ra le Xikarhi ka Theme na kusuka eka Xivono xa 2030 xa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso ra Rixaka.

src: Cabinet has approved the action required to deal with the challenges affecting implementation.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xa goza leri lavekaka ku tirhana na mitlhontlho leyi khumbaka nsimeko.

src: The reports are published on the DPME website (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Swiviko leswi swi kandziyisiwle eka webusayiti ya DPME (WEBTOKEN).

src: Automotive Production and Development Programme (APDP).
tgt: Nongonoko wa Vuhumesi na Nhluvukiso wa Swipandzamananga (APDP).

src: Cabinet approved the extension of the APDP from 2021 to 2035 with amendments to support the South African Automotive Masterplan (SAAM).
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku engeteriwa ka APDP kusuka hi 2021 kufika hi 2035 hi mihundzuluxo ku seketela Kungukulu ra Swipandzamananga ra Afrika-Dzonga (SAAM).

src: The SAAM focuses on six areas: Local market optimisation Regional market development Localisation Infrastructure development Industry transformation, and Technology and associated skills development.
tgt: SAAM yi kongomisa eka swiyenge swa tsevu: Ku tirhisiwa hindlela leyi vuyerisaka makete wa le tikweni Nhluvukiso wa makete wa Xifundza Nhluvukiso wa swimakiwakulu ncinco wa vumaki, na nhluvukiso wa thekinoloji na swikili leswi fambelanaka.

src: The amendments seek amongst others to encourage higher levels of local value addition to create more opportunities for additional employment.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi exikarhi ka swin'wana yi lava ku hlohlotela tilevhele ta le henhla ta ku engeteriwa ka nkoka wa laha tikweni ku tumbuluxa swivandlanene swa mitirho yo engetela.

src: Monitoring and evaluation of the programme and related industry trends are further enhanced to ensure progress towards the SAAM vision and objectives.
tgt: Vulanguteri na nkambelo wa nongonoko lowu na swiendleko swa vumaki leswi fambelanaka swa antswisiwa ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na ndzima eka xivono na swikongomelo swa SAAHolobye wa Mabindzu na Vumaki, Dkd Rob Davies, u ta nyika vuxokoxoko eka swihangalasamahungu hi mihundzuluxo leyi hi Ravuntlhanu, 23 Hukuri 2018.Milawumbisi.

src: .The Minister of Trade and Industry, Dr Rob Davies, will brief the media on these amendments on Friday, 23 November 2018.Bills.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise Nawumbisi wa Hakelo yo Engetela ya Oditi ya Mfumo wa 2018 (Public Audit Excess Fee Bill of 2018) leswaku wu andlariwa ePalamende.

src: Cabinet approved for the Public Audit Excess Fee Bill of 2018 to be introduced in Parliament.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu lulamisela Oditara-Jenerala ku teka goza ro lulamisa ku tiyisisa leswaku milahleko leyi Mfumo wu hlanganaka na yona, laha swi kotekaka, yi vuyisiwa na ku kongomisa mihambuko yo tivikana leyi ehleketeleriwaka yo karhi eka vulavisisi.

src: The Bill supports changes to the regulation of fees for Auditor General functions in the Public Audit Amendment Act, assented to by the President and promulgated earlier this week.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu ya emahlweni ku lava ku nyika matimba eka AG ku tirha ntirho wa oditi ya matiko ya misava a ku endla tioditi ta matirhelo, na ku fambelanisa milulamiselo ya mafumelo ya AG eka maendlelo lamanene ya nkarhi wa sweswi.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Swiendleko leswi Taka.

src: 100 #WomenOfFortitudeFollowing a period of nominations, the 100 #WomenOfFortitude will be unveiled at the Union Buildings in Pretoria on 22 November 2018.
tgt: 100 #WomenOfFortitudeEndzhaku ka nkarhi wa ku boxiwa ka mavito, 100 #WomenOfFortitude yi ta pfuriwa eUnion Buildings ePitori hi siku ra 22 Hukuri 2018.

src: The Inter-Ministerial Committee on the Nelson Mandela Centenary and Centenary of AlbertinaSisulu announced on the 11 October 2018 the #WomenOfFortitude campaign as one of the Mama Sisulu Centenary activities.
tgt: Komiti ya le Xikarhi ka Tindzawulo eka Malembexidzana ya Nelson Mandela na Malembexidzana ya Albertina Sisulu yi tivise hi siku ra 11 Nhlangula 2018 pfhumba ra #WomenOfFortitude tanihi un'wana wa migingiriko ya Malembexidzana ya Manana Sisulu.

src: The #WomenOfFortitude campaign is a movement of 100 women to drive the conversation of how women today can sustain the legacy of Mama Sisulu.
tgt: Pfhumba ra #WomenOfFortitude i nhlangano wa 100 ra vavasati ra ku hlohlotela mbulavurisano wa hilaha vavasati namuntlha va nga yisaka emahlweni ndzhaka ya Manana Sisulu.

src: 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence (GBV)The Department of Women is coordinating and consolidating government's calendar of events for the 16 Days of Activism against GBV Campaign from 25 November to 10 December 2018.
tgt: 16 wa Masiku ya ku Lwisana na Madzolonga yo ya hi Rimbewu (GBV)Ndzawulo ya Vamanana yi le ku kondleteleni na ku katsakanya khalendara ya swiendleko ya mfumo eka Pfhumba ra 16 wa Masiku ya ku Lwisana na GBV kusuka hi siku ra 25 Hukuri kufika 10 N'wendzamhala 2018.

src: Members of the National Executive as well as provincial and local government leaders will undertake portfolio/sector-specific events throughout the country through community-engagement initiatives.
tgt: Swirho swa Vurhangerinkulu bya Rixaka xikan'we na varhangeri va swifundzakulu na va miganga va ta endla swiendleko swo kongomana na photifoliyo/sekitara etikweni hinkwaro hi mapfhumba ya ku vulavurisana na miganga.

src: Detailed government programmes can be accessed from WEBTOKEN Cabinet urges all South Africans to use this platform and participate in a government event nearest to them.
tgt: Minongonoko ya mfumo leyi koxometiweke yi nga hlahluviwa kusuka eka from WEBTOKEN Khabinete yi hlohlotela maAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku tirhisa pulatifomo leyi na ku teka xiave eka xiendleko xa mfumo lexi nga ekusuhi na vona.

src: Civil society and other women's organisations are encouraged to populate their calendars of events for the period.
tgt: Vaakatiko lava nga na ku tsakela kun'we na mihlangano ya vavasati yin'wana yi khutaziwa ku tata tikhalendera ta yona hi swiendleko swa nkarhi lowu.

src: All South Africans are urged to work together to heed the call to #HearMeToo, by listening to the plight of women, and taking action to end the scourge of all forms of violence against women.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo va khutaziwa ku tirhisana ku tekela enhlokweni xirhambo eka #HearMeToo, hi ku yingisela mpingu wa vavasati, kutani va teka goza ku herisa maxangu ya mixaka hinkayo ya madzolonga ehenhla ka vavasati.

src: Cabinet congratulates all local sporting heroes who are flying the South African flag high.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela tinghwazi ta mitlangu hinkwato leti endlaka Afrika-Dzonga yi tinyungubyisa.

src: The achievements of those who excelled in their respective sporting fields, was acknowledged at the recent 2018 Sports Award ceremony.
tgt: Mifikelelo ya lavaya va tirheke kahle swinene etimbaleni ta vona ta mitlangu, yi amukeriwile eka nkhuvu wa Masagwati ya mitlangu wa 2018 lowu wa ha ku vaka kona ku nga ri khale.

src: South Africa’s Caster Semenya bagged double gold by winning the coveted Sports Star of the Year award along with the Sportswoman of the Year Award.
tgt: Caster Semenya wa Afrika-Dzonga u amukele misuku yimbirhi hi ku wina sagwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Lembe leri rhandziwaka ngopfu swin'we na Sagwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Xisati wa Lembe.

src: South African swimming sensation Chad le Clos won the Sportsman of the Year Award.
tgt: Muhlamberi wa xiyimo xa le henhla wa Afrika-Dzonga Chad le Clos u wine Sagwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Xinuna wa Lembe.

src: Ndodomzi Ntutu won the Sportsman of the Year with Disability Award.
tgt: Ndodomzi Ntutu u wine Sagwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Xinuna wa Lembe loyi a nga na Vutsoniwa.

src: Anrune Liebenberg won the Sportswoman of the Year with Disability Award.
tgt: Anrune Liebenberg u wine Sgwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Xisati wa Lembe loyi a nga na Vutsoniwa.

src: Banyana Banyana won the prestigious Team of the Year Award.
tgt: Banyana Banyana u wine Sagwati ra Xipanu xa Lembe ra xiyimo xa le henhla.

src: Banyana Banyana won their match against Nigeria at the 2018 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON).
tgt: Banyana Banyana yi wine meche wa yona wo sungula na Nigeria eka Khapi ya Tinxaka ya Vavasati ya 2018 (AFCON).

src: Bafana Bafana drew 1-1 in the AFCON qualifier match with Nigeria.
tgt: Bafana Bafana yi tlange ku ringana hi 1-1 eka meche wo hundzela emahlweni wa AFCON na Nigeria.

src: The South African Rugby team is commended for their performances and we wish them well for their upcoming match against Wales on 24 November 2018.Cabinet calls on South Africans to continue to rally behind the country’s sports women and men.
tgt: Xipanu xa Rhagabi xa Afrika-Dzonga xa hoyozeriwa eka matirhelo ya xona naswona hi va navelela leswinene eka meche wa xona lowu taka na Wales hi siku ra 24 Hukuri 2018.Khabinete yi kombela maAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni va seketela vatlangi va xinuna na va xisati va tiko.

src: Cabinet also congratulates:.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi hoyozela:.

src: Science and Technology Minister Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, who has been nominated to serve in the World Economic Forum Council on the Fourth Industrial Revolution, which consists of government, civil society and academics.
tgt: Holobye wa Sayense na Thekinoloji Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, loyi vito ra yena ri boxiweke ku tirha eka Khansele ya Forau ya Ikhonomi ya Matiko ya Misava eka Ncinco wa Tifeme wa Vumune, lowu vumbiwaka hi mfumo vaaki lava nga na ku tsakela kun'we na swidyondzeki.

src: This will help countries globally to respond and take advantage of opportunities presented by the Fourth Industrial Revolution.
tgt: Leswi swi ta pfuna matiko emisaveni hinkwayo ku angula na ku tirhisa hindlela leyi vuyerisaka swivandlanene leswi tisiwaka hi Ncinco wa Tifeme wa Vumune.

src: Finance Minister Tito Mboweni on his appointment to the Board of Trustees of the AU Peace Fund, which will finance mediation and preventative diplomacy activities, institutional capacity requirements, and peace support operations in Africa.
tgt: Holobye wa Timali Tito Mboweni eka ku thoriwa ka yena eka Bodo ya Valawulathirasiti ya Nkwama wa ku Rhula wa Misava, lowu wu nga ta nyika timali eka migingiriko ya xidipulomati yo lamula no sivela, swilaveko swa vuswikoti bya mihlangano, na mitirho yo seketela ku rhula eAfrika.

src: As a member of the Board of Trustees, Minister Mboweni will contribute towards the strategic coherence and enhanced governance, financial and administrative oversight of the Peace Fund.
tgt: Tanihi xirho xa Bodo ya Vulawulathirasiti, Holobye Mboweni u ta hoxa xandla eka nkhomano wa xiqhinga na mafumelo lama antswisweke, na vuangameri bya swa timali na mafambiselo bya Nkwama wa ku Rhula.

src: The appointment of the trustees of the AU’s Peace Fund is a key step in the implementation of the financing of the AU’s agenda, which is part of the ongoing institutional reform process.
tgt: Ku thoriwa ka valawulathirasiti va Nkwama wa ku Rhula wa AU i gozakulu eka nsimeko wa ku nyikiwa ka timali ka ajenda ya AU, leswi swi nga xiphemu xa phurosese ya mpfuxeto wa mihlangano leyi yaka emahlweni.

src: Higher Education and Training Minister Naledi Pandor, who will be conferred with the French National Order of the Legion of Honour Award on Friday, 30 November 2018.
tgt: Holobye wa Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri Naledi Pandor, loyi a nga ta tlhomiwa Risiva ra Rixaka ra Furwa ra Sagwati ra Vuthu ra Nxiximo hi Ravuntlhanu, 30 Hukuri 2018.

src: The award is in recognition of her lifelong remarkable achievements and efforts in nurturing and furthering the cooperation between France and South Africa in the field of Science and Technology.
tgt: Sagwati leri ri tekela enhlokweni mifikelelo na mitirho ya yena leyi nga erivaleni ya vutomi hinkwabyo eka ku kondletela na ku yisa emahlweni ntirhisano exikarhi ka Furwa na Afrika-Dzonga eka xiyenge xa Sayense na Thekinoloji.

src: The ceremony will be held in at the residence of the French Ambassador to South Africa in Pretoria.
tgt: Nkhuvu lowu wu ta khomeriwa endhawini ya vutshamo ya Muyimeri wa Furwa eka Afrika-Dzonga ePitori.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Lava thoriwekeLava thoriweke hinkwavo va fanele ku landzelela vutiyisisi bya mithwaso na mbhaso lowu faneleke.

src: Provincial heads of the Directorate for Priority Crime Investigation:.
tgt: Tinhloko ta swifundzakulu ta Ndzawulotsongo xa Vulavisisi bya Vugevenga bya Xirhangana (Hawks):.

src: Free State: Brigadier Kubandran Moodley and.
tgt: Free State: Burigadiya Kubandran Moodley na.

src: North West: Major General Dumisani Patrick Mbotho.
tgt: N'walungu-Vupeladymabu: Meja-Jenerala Dumisani Patrick Mbotho.

src: Reappointment of Adv Makhosini Solomon Msibi as the CEO of the Road Traffic Management Corporation (RTMC).
tgt: Ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa ka Adv Makhosini Solomon Msibi tanihi CEO wa Khamphanikulu ya Malawulelo ya Nkhuluko wa le Magondzweni (RTMC).

src: Reappointment of Mr Thulani Matiki Norman Kgomo as non-executive member of the RTMC Board.
tgt: Ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa ka Ttn Thulani Matiki Norman Kgomo tanihi xirho lexi nga riki xiphemu xa vurhangerinkulu xa Huvo ya RTMKu thoriwa hi vuntshwa ka Mnn Daphline Harridene Charlotte-Ann Ewertse tanihi xirho lexi nga riki xiphemu xa vurhangerinkulu xa Huvo ya RTMKu thoriwa ka Adv Sandile Nogxina tanihi Mulawuri loyi a nga riki Xiphemu xa Vurhangerinkulu tlhelo Mutshamaxitulu wa Huvo ya Khamphani ya Vuhahiselo ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 5 December 2018 at Tuynhuys in Cape TownIssues in the environment.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlangane hi Ravunharhu, 5 N’wendzamhala 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Economic growthCabinet welcomes the 2.2% growth in the South African economy during the third quarter, which is helping move the country out of a technical recession.
tgt: Ku kula ka ikhonomiKhabinete yi amukela ku kula ka 2.2% eka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga eka kotara ya vunharhu, leswi swi pfunaka ku humesa tiko eka ku wa ka ikhonomi ka xithekiniki.

src: The growth figures were driven by increases in the agricultural sector (6.5%), financial sector (2.3%) manufacturing sector (7.5%) and wholesale and retail trade sales (3.2%).
tgt: Tinhlayo leta ku kula ti hlohloteriwile hi mitlakuko eka sekitara ya vurimi (6.5%) sekitara ya swa timali (2.3%) sekitara ya ku endla (7.5%) na mixaviso ya le tiholisele na mabindzu ya mavhengele (3.2).

src: The growth figures signal a rebound in the economy and together with initiatives from the Jobs Summit and South African Investment Conference, will continue to improve.
tgt: Tinhlayo leta ku kula ti komba ku hluka eka ikhonomi na xikan’we na mapfhumba kusuka eka Samiti ya Mitirho na Khomferense ya Vuvekisi ya Afrika-Dzonga, ti ta ya emahlweni yi tlakuka.

src: Cabinet also joins South Africans in welcoming this month’s drop in the fuel price which comes as a relief, especially as we move into a holiday period.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi tikatse na maAfrika-Dzonga eka ku amukela ku ya ehansi ka n’hweti leyi eka nxavo wa mafurha loku ku taka tanihi mphalalo, ngopfungopfu loko hi ri karhi hi ya eka nkarhi wa tiholideyi.

src: All sectors of society are urged to build on the positive momentum during the third quarter to help place the South African economy on a new growth trajectory.
tgt: Tisekitara hinkwato ta rixaka ti hlohloteriwa ku aka nkhinkhi lowunene eka kotara leya vunharhu ku pfuna ku veka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga eka ndlela ya ku kula leyintshwa.

src: National Minimum Wage (NMW)Cabinet also welcomes the signing of the NMW Bill into law by President Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: Muholo wa Mpimohansi wa Rixaka (NMW)Nakambe Khabinete yi amukela ku sayiniwa ka Nawumbisi wa NMW ku va nawu hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: The Bill sets a historic precedent in the protection of low-earning workers and reduction of inequality in society.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu veka xikombiso lexi nga na nkoka eka matimu eka nsirhelelo wa vatirhi lava holaka mali ya le hansi na ku hungutiwa ka nkandzingano erixakeni.

src: The first NMW will raise the earnings of an estimated six million South African low-earning workers.
tgt: NMW leyo sungula yi ta tlakusa miholo ya kwalomu ka tsevu wa timiliyoni ta vatirhi lava holaka mali ya le hansi va le Afrika-Dzonga.

src: There will be a phase-in period for farm workers, forestry workers and domestic workers.
tgt: Ku ta va na nkarhi wo nghenisa hawona eka vatirhi va le mapurasini, vatirhi va le swihlahleni na vatirhi va le mindyangwini.

src: Whilst this NMW will not end income inequality, Cabinet believes it will go a long way to breaking the back of rising inequality and persistent poverty.
tgt: Hambileswi NMW leyi yi ta ka yi nga herisi nkandzingano wa miholo, Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku yi ta pfuna swinene eka ku tshova longo ra nkandzingano lowu tlakukaka na vusweti lebyi phikelelaka.

src: Toyota Wessels Institute for Manufacturing Studies (TWIMS)Cabinet welcomes the launch of the newly established R56-million TWIMThe institute will boost South Africa’s manufacturing sector, develop world-class capabilities and drive African industrialisation.
tgt: Vandla ra Toyota Wessels ra Tidyondzo to Endla (TWIMS)Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka TWIMS ya R56 wa timiliyoni leya ha ku tumbuluxiwaka.

src: It will also accelerate the building of a manufacturing culture that the country needs to drive its domestic demands and create more WEBTOKEN is an independent and not-for-profit initiative established through grant funding from the Toyota South Africa Education Trust.
tgt: Vandla leri ri ta nyika matimba eka sekitara yo endla ya Afrika-Dzonga, yi hluvukisa vuswikoti bya tlilasi ya misava na ku hlohlotela ku tumbuluxiwa ka tifeme ta Afrika.

src: It has been established in partnership with the University of Pretoria’s Gordon Institute of Business Science to deliver a Master of Business Administration degree specialising in manufacturing.
tgt: Nakambe yi ta hatlisisa ku akiwa ka ntolovelo wo endla lowu tiko ri wu dingaka ku hlohlotela swilaviwa swa rona swa laha tikweni na ku tumbuluxa mitirho yo tala.

src: Social EconomyCabinet notes the successful Symposium on the Social Economy held by government in partnership with the International Labour Organisation (ILO) and the Government of Flanders on Friday, 30 November 2018.
tgt: I pfhumba leri tiyimelaka naswona a hi ra mpindzulo leri tumbuluxiweke hi ku tirhisa timali ta nhlayiso wa vaaki ta Thirasiti ya Dyondzo ya Toyota South Africa.

src: The symposium was led by the Economic Development Department and supported by the Department of Small Business Development.
tgt: Ri tumbuluxiwile hi ku tirhisana na Gordon Institute of Business Science ya Yunivhesiti ya Pitori ku phakela digiri ya Masitasi ya Mafambiselo ya Bindzu leyi kongomisaka eka ku endla.

src: The Social Economy comprises enterprises and initiatives directed at achieving social-policy objectives such as creating jobs, mainstreaming excluded groups, and bringing goods and services to rural communities.
tgt: Ikhonomi ya Vaaki yi vumbiwa hi mabindzu na mapfhumba lama kongomisiwaka eka ku fikelela swikongomelo swa tipholisi ta vaaki swo tanihi ku tumbuluxa mitirho, ku khatsiwa ka mitlawa leyi siyiweke ehandle, na ku yisa tinhundzu na vukorhokeri eka miganga ya le tindhawini ta le matikoxikaya.

src: It has the potential of supporting economic inclusion and creating thousands of additional jobs.
tgt: Yi na vuswikoti bya ku seketela ku katsiwa ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxa magidi ya mitirho yo engetela.

src: The symposium brought together social entrepreneurs, policymakers, researchers and non-governmental organisations, and will help in the development of a Green Paper on the Social Economy during Voter registrationIn preparation for the 2019 elections, Cabinet calls on South Africans to exercise their right as responsible citizens by ensuring they have a green bar-coded ID book, smart ID card or temporary identity certificate and are registered to vote in their districts.
tgt: Simphoziyamu leyi yi tise endhawini yin’we van’wamabindzu va vaaki, vaendlapholisi, valavisisi na mihlangano leyi nga riki ya mfumo, naswona yi ta pfuna eka nhluvukiso wa Phepha ra Swibumabumelo swa Vaaki eka Ikhonomi ya Vaaki hi Ntsariso wa ku vhotaHi ku lulamisela mihlawulo ya 2019, Khabinete yi kombela maAfrika-Dzonga ku tirhisa mfanelo ya vona tanihi vaakatiko lava nga na vutihlamuleri hi ku tiyisisa leswaku va kuma mapasi ya rihlaza lama nga na bakhodi, khadi ra pasi leri hlayekaka hi khomphyutara kumbe xitifikheti xa vutitivisi xa nkarhinyana naswona va va va tsarisile ku vhota eka swifundzatsongo swa vona.

src: The Independent Electoral Commission will hold a voter-registration weekend on 26 and 27 January 2019 and South Africans are encouraged to use the opportunity to register to vote or verify their registration status.
tgt: Khomixini ya Nhlawulo leyi Tiyimelaka yi ta khoma ku hela ka ntsariso wo vhota hi siku ra 26 na 27 Sunguti 2019 naswona maAfrika-Dzonga va khutaziwa ku tirhisa xivandlanene lexi ku tsarisela ku vhota kumbe ku kambisisa xiyimo xa vona xa ntsariso.

src: Cabinet appeals to those who have applied for Smart IDs to collect their documents at their respective Department of Home Affairs (DHA) branches.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela lava va endleke swikombelo swa mapasi lama hlayekaka hi tikhomphyutara ku ya teka mapasi ya vona emarhavini ya Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya (DHA) ya le tindhawini ta ka vona.

src: National Director of Public Prosecutions (NDPP)Cabinet applauds President Ramaphosa’s appointment of Advocate Shamila Batohi as the new NDPThis follows the President’s consideration of five nominees shortlisted by an advisory panel.
tgt: Mulawuri wa Rixaka wa Vuchuchisi bya Mfumo (NDPP)Khabinete yi hoyozela ku thola ka Phuresidente Ramaphosa ka Gqwethankulu Shamila Batohi tanihi NDPP leyintshwa.

src: The appointment brings stability to the leadership of the National Prosecuting Authority and emboldens the country’s fight against crime and corruption.
tgt: Leswi swi landzela ku langutisisa ka Phuresidente ka ntlhanu wa valanghiwa lava hlawuriweke eka nxaxamelo wo koma hi phanele yo tsundzuxa.

src: Cabinet extends its appreciation to Energy Minister Jeff Radebe and the panel for their contribution to this historic process of appointment.
tgt: Ku thoriwa loku ku tisa ntshamiseko eka vurhangeri bya Vulawuri byo Chuchisa bya Rixaka naswona swi tiyisa ku lwisana ka tiko na vugevenga na vukungundzwana.

src: Limpopo health professionalsCabinet strongly condemns attacks on doctors in hospitals around Limpopo.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzisa ku khensa ka yona eka Holobye wa Eneji Jeff Radebe na phanele eka vuhoxaxandla bya yona eka phurosese leya nkoka eka matimu ya ku thola.

src: Health professionals and health facilities serve communities, especially vulnerable members who facilities to get assistance.
tgt: Vatirhi va swa rihanyu va LimpopoKhabinete yi sola hi matimba mihlaselo eka madokodela exibedhlele etindhawini ta le Limpopo.

src: Attacking those who are meant to save lives is a criminal offence and will not be tolerated.
tgt: Ku hlasela lavaya va faneleke ku ponisa vutomi i nandzu wa vugevenga naswona a swi nga kondzeleriwi.

src: The Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, is leading a multidisciplinary task team – comprising police intelligence agents, detective services, public order policing, private security authorities and DHA officials – to review the security systems at public healthcare facilities.
tgt: Holobye wa Rihanyu, Dkd Aaron Motsoaledi, u rhangela xipanu xa ntirho xa marhavinyingi – lexi vumbiwaka hi tiejente ta vuhlori ta maphorisa, vukorhokeri bya mafokisi, vuphorisa byo tisa ku rhula eka vaaki, valawuri va vurindzi lebyi nga riki bya mfumo na tiofixiyali ta DHA – ku kambisisa tisisiteme ta nsirhelelo eka miako ya nhlayiso wa swa rihanyu wa vaaki.

src: Cabinet calls on the community to work with law-enforcement agencies to ensure that perpetrators of this heinous crimes are arrested and convicted.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela vaakandhawu ku tirhisana na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ku tiyisisa leswaku vaendli va vugevenga lebya tihanyi va khomiwa na ku voniwa nandzu.

src: Safer holidaysCabinet appeals to all South Africans to keep safe during the December holidays.
tgt: Tiholideyi to Hlayiseka SwineneKhabinete yi kombela maAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku tshama va hlayisekile eka tiholideyi ta N’wendzamhala.

src: Road users are urged to adhere to the traffic rules, and not to drive recklessly and negligently, especially under the influence.
tgt: Vatirhisi va magondzo va hlohloteriwa ku landzelela milawu ya swipandzamananga, na ku nga chayeli hi vusopfa, ngopfungopfu ehansi ka nhlohlotelo wa xihoko.

src: Pedestrians are also urged to remain cautious on the road.
tgt: Van’wamilenge na vona va hlohloteriwa ku va na vukheta emagondzweni.

src: The Justice, Crime Prevention and Security (JCPS) Cluster has intensified anti-crime and safety operations countrywide.
tgt: Xikatsa xa Vululami, Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Nsirhelelo (JCPS) xi tiyisile mitirho ya ku lwisana na vugevenga na mitirho ya vuhlayiseki etikweni hinkwaro.

src: The DHA’s has increased its capacity in ports of entry to ensure it is able to respond to the expected increase of travellers over the festive period.
tgt: DHA yi tlakuse vuswikoti bya yona etindhawini ta ku nghena etikweni ku tiyisisa leswaku yi kota ku angula eka ntlakuko lowu languteriwaka wa vatekarendzo hi nkarhi lowu wa makhisimusi.

src: It also plans to extend operating hours at busy ports of entry, covering pre-festive season movements, the festive season period and the re-opening of schools.
tgt: Nakambe yi kunguhate ku engetela tiawara to tirha etindhawini ta mphensamphensa ta ku nghena etikweni, ku ri karhi ku angarheliwa mifambafambo ya nkarhi lowu rhangelaka nguva ya makhisimusi, nkarhi wa nguva ya makhisimusi na ku pfula ka swikolo.

src: Fifth anniversary of the passing of MadibaCabinet joins South Africans in commemorating the fifth anniversary of the passing of our first democratically elected President Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela, who passed on 5 December 2013.
tgt: Anivhesari ya vuntlhanu ya ku lova ka MadibaKhabinete yi tikatse na maAfrika-Dzonga eka ku tsundzuka anivhesari ya vuntlhanu ya ku lova ka Phuresidente wa hina loyi hlawuriweke hindlela ya xidemokirasi wo sungula Nelson Rolihlaha Mandela, loyi a loveke hi siku ra 5 N’wendzamhala 2013.

src: President Ramaphosa declared 2018 as the Year marking Mandela’s centenary.
tgt: Phuresidente Ramaphosa u tivise 2018 tanihi Lembe ra ku fungha malembexidzana ya Mandela.

src: His legacy has been celebrated throughout the year by South Africans in their various formations, the most recent being the Global Citizens Mandela 100 Festival held over the past weekend.
tgt: Ndzhaka ya yena yi tlangeriwile elembeni hinkwaro hi maAfrika-Dzonga eka mihlangano yo hambanahambana, leya ha ku vaka kona ku nga ri khale ngopfu ku nga Nkhuvu wa Vaakatiko va Misava Hinkwayo wa Mandela 100 lowu khomiweke eka ku hela ka vhiki loku nga hundza.

src: Cabinet calls on all to stay true to Madiba’s ideals, including his unwavering commitment to justice, equality and non-racialism.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela hinkwavo ku tshama va ri karhi va ri na ntiyiso eka mianakanyo ya Mandela, ku katsa na vutiboheleri bya yena lebyi nga tsekatsekiki eka vululami, ndzingano na ku nga hlawuli ku ya hi nghohe.

src: Global Citizen Festival Mandela 100Cabinet thanks all participants of the Global Citizen Festival Mandela 100 held in Johannesburg on Sunday, 2 December 2018.
tgt: Nkhuvu wa Vaakatiko va Misava Hinkwayo wa Mandela 100Khabinete yi khensa vatekaxiave hinkwavo va Nkhuvu wa Vaakatiko va Misava Hinkwayo wa Mandela 100 lowu khomiweke eJoni hi Sonto, 2 N’wendzamhala 2018.

src: The festival formed part of the national commemorative events to celebrate the centenary of Tata Nelson Mandela and was transmitted in over 180 countries.
tgt: Nkhuvu lowu wu vumbe xiphemu xa swiendleko swo tsundzuka swa rixaka ku tlangela malembexidzana ya Tatana Nelson Mandela naswona wu hundziseriwile eka kutlula 180 wa matiko.

src: It brought together thousands of global citizens, activists, world leaders, musicians and influencers to advance the Sustainable Development Goals of the United Nations (UN) in honour of Mandela’s memory.
tgt: Wu tise endhawini yin’we magidi ya vaakatiko va misava hinkwayo, vagingirikeli, varhangeri va misava hinkwayo, swiyimbeleri na vahlohloteri ku antswisa Swikongomelokulu swa Nhluvukiso lowu Yisekaka Emahlweni wa Vun’we bya Tinxaka (UN) hi ku xixima nkhumbulo wa Mandela.

src: Cabinet extends its sympathy to all those who were violated by criminal elements that preyed on them whilst leaving the stadium.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzise nchavelelo wa yona eka hinkwavo lava va onheriweke hi swiyenge swa vugevenga leswi swi va bvanyangeteke loko va ri karhi va huma erivaleni ra mitlangu.

src: It strongly condemns these criminal acts and calls on law-enforcement agencies to bring offenders to book.
tgt: Yi sola hi matimba swiendlo leswa vugevenga naswona yi kombela tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ku endla leswaku vaonhi va khomiwa na ku tengisiwa.

src: World AIDS DaySouth Africa marked World AIDS Day on 1 December under the theme: “Cheka Impilo.
tgt: Siku ra AIDS ra MisavaAfrika-Dzonga yi funghe Siku ra AIDS ra Misava hi siku ra 1 N’wendzamhala ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Cheka Impilo.

src: Know Your Status.” Cabinet appreciates government’s multidimensional HIV and AIDS programme that has taken decisive steps to bring an end to the epidemic.
tgt: Know Your Status.” Khabinete yi amukela nongonoko wa HIV na AIDS wa mahlangutinyingi lowu wu tekeke magoza yo tivikana ku herisa ntungu lowu.

src: The programme has realised an additional uptake of two million people to the antiretroviral treatment programme.
tgt: Nongonoko lowu wu humelerisile ku khatsiwa ko engetela ka vanhu va timiliyoni timbirhi eka nongonoko wa vutshunguri bya antirhithirovhayirali.

src: South Africa has more than 4,2 million people on treatment, making it one of the world’s biggest treatment programmes.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi na kutlula 4,2 wa timiliyoni ta vanhu lava kumaka vutshunguri, leswi swi yi endlaka yin’wana ya minongonoko ya vutshunguri leyikulu ya misava.

src: The HIV and AIDS campaign continues to make inroads towards changing behaviour, medical treatment and social de-stigmatisation.
tgt: Pfhumba ra HIV na AIDS ri ya emahlweni ri va na nhlohlotelo eka ku cinca mahanyelo, vutshunguri bya xidokodela na ku herisa nhlekulo eka vaaki.

src: Cabinet is steadfast in its call on South Africans to get tested so they can know their HIV status, which will help them make informed decisions on preventative measures, treatment, care and support.
tgt: Khabinete ya phikelela eka xikombelo xa yona eka maAfrika-Dzonga ku va va kamberiwa ku endlela leswaku va ta tiva xiyimo xa vona xa HIV, leswi swi nga ta va pfuna ku teka swiboho va ri na vutivi hi magoza ya sivelo, vutshunguri, nhlayiso na nseketelo.

src: UN International Day of Persons with DisabilitiesSouth Africa joined the global community in observing the annual UN International Day of Persons with Disabilities on Monday, 3 December.
tgt: Siku ra Vanhu lava nga na Vutsoniwa ra Matiko ya Misava ra UNAfrika-Dzonga yi tikatse na miganga ya misava hinkwayo eka ku xixima Siku ra Vanhu lava nga na Vutsoniwa ra Matiko ya Misava ra UN ra lembe na lembe hi Musumbunuku, 3 N’wendzamhala.

src: Government remains committed to the inclusion and protection of persons with disabilities through dedicated programmes and interventions to ensure access to equal opportunities, as enshrined in the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshama ya ha tibohile eka ku khatsiwa na nsirhelelo wa vanhu lava nga na vutsoniwa hi ku tirhisa nongonoko na miphalalo ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na mfikelelo wa swivandlanene swo ringana, tanihilaha swi hlayisiweke hakona eka Vumbiwa r Rhiphabuliki ya Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.Swiboho swa Khabinete.

src: Nkomazi Special Economic Zone (SEZ)Cabinet ratified a decision of the Minister of Trade and Industry, Dr Rob Davies, to designate the SEZ and to grant a SEZ Licence to the Mpumalanga Provincial Government’s Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
tgt: Zoni ya Ikhonomi yo Hlawuleka ya Nkomazi (SEZ) Khabinete yi amukele xiboho xa Holobye wa Mabindzu na Vumaki, Dkd Rob Davies, ku hlawula SEZ leyi na ku nyika Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu na Vupfhumba ya Mfumo wa Xifundza xa Mpumalanga Layisense ya SEZ.

src: The Nkomazi SEZ will be positioned as an “Agro-Processing Hub” using green energy.
tgt: SEZ ya Nkomazi yi ta vekiwa eka xiyimo tanihi “Habu yo Phurosesa swa Vurimi” hi ku tirhisa eneji ya rihlaza.

src: It will be supported by mixed services such as warehousing and logistics.
tgt: Yi ta seketeriwa hi vukorhokeri lebyi pfanganisiweke byo tanihi guxeta na vutleketli.

src: This forms part of is the Maputo Development Corridor project, which is a major trade corridor which connects Gauteng, Limpopo and Mpumalanga with Maputo in Mozambique.
tgt: Leswi swi vumba xiphemu xa phurojeke ya Ndlela ya Nhluvukiso ya Maputo, leyi nga ndlelakulu ya mabindzu leyi khomanisaka Gauteng, Limpopo na Mpumalanga na Maputo eMozambique.

src: It comprises, among other things, roads, ports and WEBTOKEN will contribute towards accelerating growth, attract foreign and domestic direct investment, expand the manufacturing sector and create employment in the region.
tgt: Yi ta hoxa xandla eka ku hatlisisa ku kula, ku koka rinoko ra vuvekisi bya le matikweni mambe, na bya laha tikweni na byo kongoma, ku ndlandlamukisa sekitara yo endla na ku tumbuluxa mitirho exifundzeni.

src: Cabinet has approved the signing of the rollover Economic Partnership Agreement (EPA) with the United Kingdom (UK) once the last outstanding technical issues are resolved and the internal administrative issues are finalised.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku sayiniwa ka Ntwanano wa Ntirhisano wa Ikhonomi leyi hundziseriwaka na United Kingdom (UK) xikan’wekan’we loko timhaka ta xithekiniki leta ha saleleke endzhaku to hetelela ti ololoxiwile naswona timhaka ta mafambiselo ti hetisisiwile.

src: Cabinet also approved the submission in Parliament for ratification, the Agreement establishing the EPA between Southern African Customs Union and Mozambique and the UCabinet approved the publication of the streamlined White Paper on Home Affairs for public comment.
tgt: Nakambe Khabinete yi pasise ku rhumeriwa ePalamende ku ya amukeriwa, Ntwanano wa lowu tumbuluxaka EPA exikarhi Yuniyoni ya Vabarisi va Tinhundzu leti Tundziwaka kusuka eka Matiko Mambe ya le Dzongeni wa Afrika na Mozambique na UKhabinete yi pasise ku kandziyisiwa ka Phepha ra Swibumabumelo swa Mfumo eka Timhaka ta Xikaya leri antswisiweke leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.

src: The White Paper argues that for South Africa to fully realise the potential of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, the DHA must play a critical enabling role in citizen empowerment, inclusive development, efficient government and national security.
tgt: Phepha lera Swibumabumelo swa Mfumo ri vula leswaku ku va Afrika-Dzonga yi humelerisa vuswikoti bya Ntumbuluxo wa Tifeme wa Vumune, DHA yi fanele ku tirha xiave xa nkoka eka havaxerisamatimba wa vaaki, nhluvukiso lowu katsaka hinkwavo, mfumo lowu nga tlangisiki swipfuno na nsirhelelo wa rixaka.

src: It is also based on the DHA having sole mandate for the management of official identity and status, international migration, and asylum seekers and refugees.
tgt: Ri tlhela ri ya hi leswi DHA yi nga na xilerisoximfumo xa malawulelo ya vutitivisi na xiyimo, ndzhurho wa matiko ya misava, na valavi va nsirhelelo na vutumbelo.

src: The White Paper proposes measures to reduce the fraudulent bank transactions and realise savings due to increased inefficiencies.
tgt: Phepha lera Swibumabumelo swa Mfumo ri ringanyeta magoza ya ku hunguta mixaviselano yo banga ya vumbabva na ku humelerisa mihlayiso ya timali hikwalaho matirhelo lama nga riki kahle lama tlakukeke.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the World Intellectual Property Organisation (WIPO) Copyright Treaty (WCT) of 1996 to Parliament for accession.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku rhumeriwa ka Ntwanano wa Mfaneloxinawu (WCT) wa Nhlangano wa Nhundzu ya Vutumbuluxi wa Misava (WIPO) wa 1996 ePalamende ku ya pfumeleriwa.

src: This is a multilateral agreement and a special agreement under the Berne Convention that deals with the protection of the work and rights of their authors in the digital environment.
tgt: Lowu i ntwanano wa matikonyingi na ntwanano wo hlawuleka ehansi ka Ntwanano wa Berne lowu wu tirhanaka na nsirhelelo wa ntirho na timfanelo ta vatsari eka mbangu wa xidijitali.

src: Acceding to the WCT also benefits the South African creative industry, specifically authors of literary and artistic works.
tgt: Ku pfumeriwa ka WCT swi tlhela swi vuyerisa indasitiri yo tumbuluxa ya Afrika-Dzonga, ngopfungopfu vatsari va mitirho yo hlaya na ya vutshila.

src: The WCT is in the best interest of South Africa as it ensures that the country’s copyright law will keep pace with technological change.
tgt: WCT yi vuyerisa Afrika-Dzonga tanihileswi yi tiyisisaka leswaku nawu wa mfaneloxinawu ya mutumbuluxi yi ta fambisana na ncinco wa thekinoloji.

src: This will afford important protection against piracy for rights holders in the areas of computer programmes and databases.
tgt: Leswi swi ta kotisa nsirhelelo wa nkoka ehenhla ka ku yiveriwa ka vakhomamfanelo eka swiyenge swa tiphurogireme ta khomphyutara na tidatabeyisi.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the WIPO Performances and Phonograms Treaty of 1996, to Parliament for accession.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku rhumeriwa ka Ntwanano wa ku Endla na Mipfumawulorito wa WIPO wa 1996, ePalamende ku ya pfumeleriwa.

src: This is a multilateral agreement which deals with the rights of performers and producers of phonograms, specifically in the digital environment.
tgt: Lowu i ntwanano wa matikonyingi lowu wu tirhanaka na timfanelo ta vaendli na vahumesi va mipfumawulorito, ngopfungopfu eka mbangu wa xidijitali.

src: This treaty will protect people or organisations that add substantial creative, technical or organisational skill in the process of bringing work to the public and enhance revenue to benefit them.
tgt: Ntwanano lowu wu ta sirhelela vanhu kumbe mihlangano leyi engetelaka xikili xo lulamisa kumbe xa xithekiniki, xo tumbuluxa hindlela yo tivikana eka phurosese ya ku tisa ntirho eka vaaki na ku antswisa mali leyi hlengeletiwaka ku va vuyerisa.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Beijing Treaty to Parliament for accession.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku rhumeriwa ka Ntwanano wa Beijing ePalamende ku ya pfumeleriwa.

src: This is a multilateral agreement, which regulates copyright for audio-visual performances and expands the audio-visual performers’ rights.
tgt: Lowu i ntwanano wa matikonyingi, lowu lawulaka mfaneloxinawu ya mutumbuluxi eka ku endliwa ka swo yingiseriwa no voniwa na ku ndlandlamukisa timfanelo ta vaendli va swo yingiseriwa no voniwa.

src: It recognises audio-visual performers’ intellectual property right in their audio-visual work and creates economic benefit for them.
tgt: Wu tekela enhlokweni mfanelo ya nhundzu ya vutumbuluxi ya vaendli va swo yingiseriwa no voniwa eka ntirho wa vona wa swo yingiseriwa no voniwa na ku tumbuluxa mbuyelo wa ikhonomi eka vona.

src: It also provides audio-visual performers with moral rights in respect of their work and recognises audio-visual performers’ rights in the digital environment.
tgt: Nakambe yi nyika vaendli va swo yingiseriwa no voniwa timfanelo ta vumunhu hi mayelana na ntirho wa vona naswona wu tekela enhlokweni timfanelo ta swo yingiseriwa no voniwa eka mbangu wa xidijitali.

src: Cabinet approved for the establishment of an Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) to lead the African Peer Review Mechanism (APRM) second generation periodic review.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku tumbuluxiwa ka Komiti ya le Xikarhi ka Tindzawulo (IMC) ku rhangela nkambisiso wa nkarhi wa wo endla wa vumbirhi wa Endlelo ra Nkambisiso wa Vutangha ra Afrika (APRM).

src: It will be conducted after the 2019 General Elections.
tgt: Wu ta endliwa endzhaku ka Mihlawulo ya Mani na Mani ya 2019.

src: This APRM review process provides member states a space for national dialogue on governance and socio-economic indicators and an opportunity to build consensus on the way forward.
tgt: IMC yi seketeriwa hi ntumbuluxo lowu pasisiweke wa Huvo yo Fuma ya Rixaka ya APRPhurosese ya nkambisiso ya APRM yi nyika mifumo leyi nga swirho xivandla xa n’wangulano wa rixaka eka mafumelo na swikombo swa vaaki na ikhonomi na xivandlanene xa ku aka mpfumelelano eka ndlela yo yisa emahlweni.

src: Cabinet approved for South Africa to sign the Convention to establish, under international law, an intergovernmental organisation called the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) Observatory, which will be responsible for the construction and operational phases of the global SKA radio telescope project, to be located in South Africa and Australia.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku va Afrika-Dzonga yi sayina Ntwanano wa ku tumbuluxa, ehansi ka nawu wa matiko ya misava, nhlangano wa le xikarhi ka mifumo lowu vuriwaka Square Kilometre Array (SKA) Observatory, lowu wu nga na vutihlamuleri bya vuaki na swiyenge swo tirha swa phurojeke ya thelesikopu ya tirhadiyo ya SKA ya misava hinkwayo, ku va yi vekiwa eAfrika-Dzonga na Australia.

src: The signing of the convention will be crucial in providing the global partnership with the appropriate governance mechanisms, which will ensure successful delivery of the project.
tgt: Ku sayiniwa ka ntwanano lowu swi ta va swa nkoka eka ku nyika ntirhisano wa misava hinkwayo maendlelo ya mafumelo lama faneleke, leswi swi ta tiyisisa leswaku ku va na mphakelo lowu fambaka kahle wa phurojeke leyi.

src: South Africa will also be able to leverage foreign inward investment, as well as skills and infrastructure development benefits associated with the SKA project.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi ta tlhela yi kota ku tlakusa vuvekisi bya le ndzeni bya matiko mambe, xikan’we na mivuyelo ya nhluvukiso wa swikili na swimakiwakulu leyi fambelanisiwaka ka phurojeke leya SKKhabinete yi pasise Rimba ra Tixaka ra Ndhawu yo Kambela ya Ndzilekana leyi nga na Hinkwaswo ku va ri simekiwa.

src: Cabinet approved the One-Stop Border Post (OSBP) National Framework for implementation.
tgt: Leswi swi ta nyika ndzetelo eka ntumbuluxo wa xihatla wa tiOSBP exikarhi Afrika-Dzonga na matikoakelana ya yona.

src: The OSBP will enhance trade facilitation without compromising national security or revenue collection through the efficient movement of goods, persons and services between South Africa and the adjoining states of Botswana, Lesotho, Namibia, Mozambique and Zimbabwe.
tgt: OSBP yi ta tiyisa vuhumelerisi bya bindzu ku ri hava ku debyisa nsirhelelo wa rixaka kumbe nhlengeleto wa xibalo hikwalaho ka mfambafambo wa tinhundzu, vanhu na vukorhokeri exikarhi Afrika-Dzonga na matiko lama khomaneke na yona ya Botswana, Lesotho, Namibia, Mozambique na Zimbabwe.

src: It will also result in the region realising a faster border clearance and limited duplication of border agency interventions, which in turn improves trade competitiveness and movement of person by cutting down on cost and time.
tgt: Ri ta tlhela ri vanga exifundzeni ku humelerisiwa ka mbhasiso wa le ndzilekanini ka xihatla na mivuyelelo leyitsongo ya miphalalo ya tiejensi ta le ndzilekanini, leswi swi nga ta tlhela swi antswisa vuphikizani bya mabindzu na mfambafambo wa vanhu hi ku hunguta eka ndhurho na nkarhi.

src: Cabinet approved that the National Treasury and Financial Intelligence Centre (FIC) will coordinate South Africa’s preparation for the national risk assessment and upcoming mutual evaluation process which commences in mid-April 2019.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise leswaku Nkwama wa Timali wa Rixaka na Senthara ya Vuhlori bya Timali (FIC) swi ta fambisa ku lulamisiwa ka nhlahluvo wa mixungeto wa rixaka na phurosese ya nkambelo wa matlhelo hinkwawo lowu taka lowu wu sungulaka exikarhi ka Dzivamisoko 2019.

src: The mutual evaluation is a peer-review process conducted by international experts from other member countries of the intergovernmental body, the Financial Action Task Force, to assess the effectiveness of the anti-money laundering (AML) and combating of terrorist financing (CFT) system in South Africa.
tgt: Nkambelo wa matlhelo hinkwawo i phurosese ya nkambisiso leyi endliwaka hi vativinkulu va matiko ya misava vo huma eka matiko lama nga swirho ya nhlangano wa le xikarhi ka mifumo, Vuthu ra Xipanu xa Matirhelo ya Timali, ku hlahluva vukahle byo lwisana na ku tumbeta swihlovo swa mali (AML) na ku herisiwa ka sisiteme ya ku nyika matherorisi timali (CFT) eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: The outcomes of the process will assist in strengthening the integrity of the South African financial system by identifying steps to be taken to address any weaknesses in our AML/CFT system.
tgt: Mivuyelo ya phurosese leyi yi ta pfuna ku tiyisa vutengi bya sisiteme ya timali ya Afrika-Dzonga hi ku tiva magoza lama faneleke ku tekiwa ku tirhana na mitsano yihi kumbe yihi eka sisiteme ya hina ya AML/CFKhabinete yi pasise swibumabumelo leswi andlariweke eka Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya Masungulo hi Ndzawulo ya Nkunguhato, Vulanguteri na Nkambelo.

src: The recommendations flow from the Impact evaluation of the Early Grade Reading Study after two years of interventions.
tgt: Swibumabumelo leswi swi khuluka kusuka eka Nkambelo wa Nhlohlotelo wa Dyondzo ya ku Hlaya ya Tigiredi ta le Masungulweni endzhaku ka malembe mambirhi ya mphalalo.

src: The DBE initiated the Early Grade Reading Study in collaboration with various universities.
tgt: DBE yi tumbuluxe Dyondzo ya ku Hlaya ya le ka Tigiredi ta le Masungulweni hi ku tirhisana na tiyunivhesiti to hambanahambana.

src: This is a large-scale educational impact evaluation which aims to build evidence about what works to improve the teaching and learning of early grade reading in African languages in the country.
tgt: Lowu i nkambelo wa nhlohlotelo wa dyondzo ya xikalu lexikulu lowu wu nga na xikongomelo xa ku aka vumbhoni hi mayelana na leswi swi tirhaka ku antswisa madyondziselo na madyondzelo ya ku hlaya eka tigiredi ta le masungulweni hi tindzimi ta Xintima etikweni.

src: The Report will be posted on the DPME website.
tgt: Xiviko lexi xi ta posiwa eka webusayiti ya DPMKhabinete yi pasise Rimba ra Pholisi eka Miyuziyamu ya Rixaka.

src: The aim is to transform the management and operations of museums in terms of access, redress, equity, nation-building and social cohesion.
tgt: Xikongomelo i ku cinca mafambiselo na matirhelo ya miyuziyamu hi ku landza mfikelelo, ndzulamiso, ndzingano, ku akiwa ka rixaka na nkhomano wa vaaki.

src: The policy proposes the clustering of museums into new management structures to achieve economies of scale by reducing the number of WEBTOKEN also provides for the grading of all the museums according to qualities, scope and significance to enable equitable funding allocations.
tgt: Pholisi leyi yi ringanyeta ku katsiwa endhawini yin’we ka miyuziyamu ku va swivumbeko swa mafambiselo lamantshwa ku fikelela tiikhonomi ta xikalu hi ku hunguta nhlayo ya tikhansele.

src: Cabinet approved the National Guide for the Appointment of Persons to Boards and Chief Executive Officers (CEOs) of State-owned and State-controlled Institutions.
tgt: Nakambe ri lulamisela ku siyanisiwa ka miyuziyamu hinkwayo hi ku ya hi swihlawulekisi, vuanami na vutivikani ku kotisa leswaku ku va na miavelo ya timali yo ringana.

src: The guide provides national principles and good-practice guidelines to promote uniformity in the appointment of persons.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise Xiletelo xa Rixaka xa Matholelo ya Vanhu eka Tihuvo na Vaofisirinkulu va Vurhangerinkulu (tiCEO) ta Mihlangano leyi nga Ehansi ka Vun’wini bya Mfumo na leyi Lawuriwaka hi Mfumo.

src: It responds to the Presidential Review Committee on State-owned Entities to promote transparency, accountability and good governance practices in all organs of state.
tgt: Xiletelo lexi xi nyika misinya ya rixaka na swiletelo swa maendlelo lamanene ku kondletela mfanano eka matholelo ya vanhu.

src: Cabinet approved the 6th progress report by the Inter-Ministerial Task Team on North West.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise xiviko xa ndzima xa vu6 hi Xipanu xa Ntirho xa le Xikarhi ka Tindzawulo eka N’walungu-Vupeladyambu.

src: Cabinet is pleased that visible progress has been made in stabilising the provincial departments in North West and the provision of basic services has been prioritised.
tgt: Khabinete ya tsaka leswi ndzima yo tivikana yi khatsiweke eka ku tshamisekisa tindzawulo ta xifundzakulu eN’walungu-Vupeladyambu naswona ku nyikiwa ka vukorhokeri bya masungulo byi rhangisiwe emahlweni.

src: The intervention has cleared over 90% of the accruals to suppliers enabling the improved supply of medicine and equipment.
tgt: Mphalalo lowu wu basisile kutlula 90% ta timalimpfelelo eka vaphakeri va tinhundzu na vukorhokeri leti kotisaka mphakelo lowu antswisiweke wa mirhi na switirhisiwa.

src: Four of the five operating theatres at Mafikeng hospital have been returned to functionality.
tgt: Mune ehenhla ka ntlhanu wa tithiyetara leti tirhaka exibedhlele xa Mafikeng ti vuyiseriwile eka xiyimo xo tirha.

src: A number of the funded vacant posts in the respective departments have been filled.
tgt: Swivandla swa mitirho leswi nyikiwaka timali eka tindzawulo to hambanahambana swi pfariwile.

src: A process to address the backlog infrastructure maintenance has been put in place and the law enforcement agencies continue to make progress in bringing those who were involved in corruption to account.
tgt: Phurosese ya ku tirhana na nhlayiso wa swimakiwakulu lowu saleleke endzhaku yi simekile naswona tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ti ya emahlweni ti khatsa ndzima ku tisa lavaya va khumbekaka eka vukungundzwana ku ta tihlamulela.

src: Working with the North West leadership the appointed Administrators continue to make progress in setting in place good governance processes.
tgt: Ku ri karhi ku tirhisaniwa na vurhangeri bya N’walungu-Vupeladyambu Valawuri lava thoriweke va ya emahlweni va khatsa ndzima eka ku simeka tiphurosese ta mafumelo lamanene.

src: The NCOP visited the North West in October and have tabled their report endorsing the National government intervention in the Province.
tgt: NCOP yi endzele N’walungu-Vupeladyambu hi Nhlangula naswona yi andlala xiviko xa yona lexi amukela mphalalo wa mfumo wa Rixaka eka Xifundzakulu lexi.

src: Cabinet approved the hosting of the following events:The Fourth Annual Meetings of the New Development Bank (NDB), during the first quarter of 2019.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku rhurheriwa ka swiendleko leswi landzelaka: Tinhlengeletano ta Lembe na Lembe ta Vumune ta Bangi ya Nhluvukiso Leyintshwa (NDB), eka kotara leyo sungula ya 2019.

src: The NDB was established by the Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) bloc to mobilise resources to support infrastructure and sustainable development projects in BRICS countries, and other emerging markets and developing countries.
tgt: NDB yi tumbuluxiwile hi biloko ya Brazil, Russia, India, China na Afrika-Dzonga ku hlengeleta swipfuno ku seketela swimakiwakulu na tiphurojeke ta nhluvukiso lowu yisekaka emahlweni ematikweni ya BRICS, na timakete leta ha tumbulukaka tin’wana na matiko lama ha hluvukaka.

src: The 17th Ordinary Session of the African Ministerial Conference on the Environment (AMCEN) in June/July 2019.
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya Ntolovelo ya vu17 ya Khomferense ya Vaholobye va Afrika eka Mbangu (AMCEN) hi Khotavuxika/Mawuwani 2019.

src: AMCEN is a permanent forum where African Ministers of the Environment deliberate and decide on environmental issues of relevance to the Continent.
tgt: AMCEN i foramu ya nkarhi hinkwawo laha Vaholobye va Afrika va Mbangu va kanerisanaka na ku teka swiboho eka timhaka ta mbangu leswi fambelanaka na Tikokulu.

src: South Africa assumes its chairship from 2019 to 2021.Bills.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi sungula vutshamaxitulu bya yona kusuka hi 2019 kufika hi 2021.

src: Cabinet approved publication of the Revised Expropriation Bill for public comment.
tgt: MilawumbisiKhabinete yi pasise ku kandziyisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa ku Tekiwa ka Vun’wini lowu Pfuxetiweke leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.

src: The revised bill adds a section that provides explicit circumstances under which land expropriation in the public interest may be without compensation.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu pfuxetiweke wu engetela xiyenge lexi nyikaka swiyimo leswi nga erivaleni leswi ehansi ka swona ku tekiwa ka vun’wini bya misava hindlela leyi nga ta vuyerisa vaaki ku nga ta va xiswona ku ri hava ndziriso.

src: The section strengthen the earlier Expropriation Bill that was withdrawn from the parliament process.
tgt: Xiyenge lexi xi tiyisa Nawumbisi wa ku Tekiwa ka Vun’wini wa le masungulweni lowu wu humesiweke endzhaku eka phurosese ya palamende.

src: The Bill will assist in accelerating the land reform programme whilst within the framework of the constitutional principles.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu ta pfuna ku hatlisisa nongonoko wa mpfuxeto wa misava loko hi tlhelo wu ri endzeni ka rimba ra misinya ya vumbiwa.

src: Cabinet approved for the publication of the Conduct of Financial Institutions Bill of 2018 for public comment.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku kandziyisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Matikhomelo ya Mihlangano ya Timali wa 2018 leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.

src: This forms part of government’s reform of the financial sector regulation towards a Twin Peaks model and follows the enactment of the Financial Sector Regulation Act, 2017 (Act 9 of 2017) which, amongst others, aims to ensure better market conduct and the treatment of customers in the financial sector.
tgt: Leswi swi vumba xiphemu xa mpfuxeto wa mfumo wa malawulelo ya sekitara ya timali eka modlolo wa Twin Peaks naswona wu landzelela ku pasisiwa ka Nawu wa Malawulelo ya Sekitara ya Timali, 2017 (Nawu wa 9 wa 2017) lowu, exikarhi ka swin’wana, wu nga na xikongomelo xa ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na matikhomelo ya timakete yo antswa na makhomelo ya tikhasimende yo antswa eka sekitara ya timali.

src: Market conduct regulation aims to prevent and manage when prevention is not successful, the poor outcomes that arise from financial institutions conducting their business in ways that are unfair to customers or undermines the integrity of financial markets and confidence in the financial system.
tgt: Malawulelo ya matikhomelo ya timakete ya na xikongomelo xa ku sivela na ku lawula loko nsivelo wu nga fambi kahle, mivuyelo ya xiyimo xa le hansi leyi tumbulukaka kusuka eka mihlangano ya timali leyi endlaka bindzu hi tindlela leti nga riki letinene eka tikhasimende kumbe ti tekelaka ehansi vutengi bya timakete na ntshembo eka sisiteme ya timali.

src: The Bill will strengthen customer protection by putting in place a single comprehensive market conduct law.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu ta tiyisa nsirhelelo wa tikhasimende hi ku simeka nawu wa matikhomelo ya timakete wo katsakanya wun’we.

src: This will result in the consistent application of customer-protection principles across the financial sector.
tgt: Leswi swi ta vanga matirhiselo yo fanana ya misinya ya nsirhelelo wa tikhasimende eka sekitara ya timali hinkwayo.

src: It provides for a single, activity-based approach to licensing all financial institutions, and ensuring full regulatory coverage and supervision.
tgt: Wu lulamisela endlelo leri simekiweke eka migingiriko, rin’we eka ku nyika mihlangano ya timali hinkwayo tilayisense, na ku tiyisisa leswaku ku na angarhelo na vulanguteri byo lawula hi vutalo.

src: This will allow the newly established Financial Sector Conduct Authority to better meet its mandate of protecting financial customers by ensuring fair treatment.
tgt: Leswi swi ta pfumelela Vulawuri bya Matikhomelo ya Sekitara ya Timali leya ha ku tumbuluxiwaka ku fikelela ku antswa xilerisoximfumo xa ku sirhelela tikhasimende ta timali hi ku tiyisisa leswaku ku na makhomelo lamanene.

src: The Bill, which will apply to all financial institutions, also supports transformation of the financial sector through implementation of the Financial Sector Code issued under the Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act, 2003 (Act 53 of 2003) by requiring that policies be introduced to comply with the code and also supervising implementation of those policies.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu, lowu wu nga ta tirha eka mihlangano ya timali hinkwawo, wu tlhela wu seketela ncinco eka sekitara ya timali hi ku tirhisiwa ka Xikatsa xa Milawu ya Sekitara ya Timali lexi nyikiweke ehansi ka Nawu wa Havexerisamatimba wa Ikhonomi ya Vantima yo Angarhela, 2003 (Nawu wa 53 wa 2003) hi ku koxa leswaku tipholisi ti sungula ku tirhisiwa ku landzelela xikatsa lexa milawu na ku tlhela ku vekiwa tihlo eka ku tirhisiwa ka tipholisi toleto.

src: Cabinet approved for the introduction of the Financial Matters Amendment Bill of 2018 in Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise ku andlariwa ka Nawumbisi wo Hundzuluxa wa Timhaka ta Timali wa 2018 ePalamende.

src: The amendments relate to the:a) Insolvency Act of 1963, to strengthen the regulation of over-the-counter derivative market, in line with G20 commitmentsb) Military Pensions Act of 1976, to address discriminatory provisionsc) Banks Act of 1990, to allow for qualifying state-owned companies to apply for banking licencesd) Government Employment Pension Law of 1996, to change the clean break principle in the case of divorce, ensuring that members’ pension pay outs to former spouses on divorce are not converted to a debt obligation ande) Auditing Profssion Act of 2005, to address challenges and limitations that the Independent Regulatory Board for Auditors faces in discharging its regulatory and oversight responsibilities.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi fambelana na:Nawu wa Nchono wa 1963, ku tiyisa malawulelo ya makete lowu humaka eka nxavisonkandzawulelo, hi ku fambisana na vutiboheleri bya G20Nawu wa Tiphenceni ta Masocha wa 1976, ku tirhana na milulamiselo ya xihlawuhlawuNawu wa Tibangi wa 1990, ku pfumelela tikhamphani leti nga ehansi ka vun’wini bya mfumo leti fikelelaka ku endla xikombelo xa tilayisense ta ku bangaNawu wa Phenceni wa Vutirhelamfumo wa 1996, ku cinca nsinya wa avelo wa xiphemu xa phenceni eka xiyimo xa ku dlaya vukati, lowu wu tiyisisaka leswaku tihakelo ta phenceni eka khale ka muringani hi nkarhi wa ku dlaya vukati a ti hundzuluxeriwi eka mbhoheko wa xikweleti naNawu wa Phurofexini yo Odita wa 2005, ku tirhana na mitlhontlho na switsandzekisi leswi Huvo yo Lawula leyi Tiyimelaka ya Vaoditara yi hlanganaka na swona eka ku tirha mitirho ya yona yo lawula na yo angamela.

src: National Minimum Wage (NMW) announcementPresident Ramaphosa will announce the NMW at an event to be held at Kliptown in Soweto on Friday, 7 December 2018.
tgt: Swiendleko leswi Taka Xitiviso xa Muholo wa Mpimohansi wa Rixaka (NMW) Phuresidente Ramaphosa u ta tivisa NMW eka xiendleko lexi xi nga ta khomiwa eKliptown eSoweto hi Ravuntlhanu, 7 N’wendzamhala 2018.

src: The NMW will immediately benefit more than six million workers and help address the level of inequality and poverty in South Africa.
tgt: NMW yi ta vuyerisa xikan’wekan’we kutlula tsevu wa timiliyoni ta vatirhi na ku pfuna ku tirhana na levhele ya nkandzingano na vusweti eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: This landmark proclamation will extend our social net to the most vulnerable people.
tgt: Xitiviso lexa nkoka swinene xi ta engetela ritavala ra hina ra vaaki kufika eka vanhu lava nga sirhelelekangiki.

src: International Anti-Corruption DayIn commemoration of the UN’s International Anti-Corruption Day on Sunday, 9 December 2018, Cabinet reaffirms the country’s fight against corruption in both the private and public sectors.
tgt: Siku ra ku Lwisana na Vukungundzwana ra Matiko ya MisavaHi ku tsundzukiwa ka Siku ro Lwisana na Vukungundzwana ra Matiko ya Misava ra UN hi Sonto, 9 N’wendzamhala, Khabinete yi tiyisisa ku lwisana na vukungundzwana ka tiko eka havumbirhi bya tisekitara leti nga riki ta mfumo na ta mfumo.

src: The JCPS Cluster has prioritised the fight against this scourge in line with government’s zero-tolerance stance towards corruption.
tgt: Xikatsa xa JCPS xi rhangise emahlweni ku lwisana na xirilo lexi hi ku fambisana na xiyimo xa nkankondzelelo eka vukungundzwana xa mfumo.
