tgt: Akhademi leyi yi ta korhokela swirho swa SIU, na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu na to lwisana na vukungundzwana tin'wana leti ti kumekaka eka matiko lama nga swirho ya Muganga wa Nhluvukiso wa Dzongeni wa Afrika, matiko lama a ma ri ehansi ka Britain na lama a ma nga ri ehansi ka Britain.

src: This new capacity will also deepen the country’s ability to respond to matters arising from the State of Capture Commission.
tgt: Vuswikoti lebyintshwa byi ta tlhela byi tiyisa vuswikoti bya tiko ku angula eka timhaka leti tumbulukaka ku suka eka ka Khomixini ya ku Tekiwa ka Vulawuri hi Swiyenge swa le Tlhelo.

src: Joint Working Visit by Prime Ministers of the Netherlands and Denmark.
tgt: Rendzo ro Tirha ra Nhlanganelo hi Vaholobyenkulu va Netherlands na Denmark.

src: Cabinet welcomed the engagements between President Ramaphosa, Prime Minister Mark Rutte of the Netherlands and Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen of Denmark, during the joint working visit in Pretoria this week.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukele mivulavurisano exikarhi Phuresidente Ramaphosa, Holobyenkulu Mark Rutte wa Netherlands na Holobyenkulu Mette Frederiksen wa Denmark, hi nkarhi wa rendzo ra ntirho ra nhlanganelo ePitori vhiki reri.

src: The joint working visit was a first of its kind in our country.
tgt: Rendzo lero tirha ra nhlanganelo a ri ri ro sungula ra muxaka wa rona etikweni ra ka hina.

src: The economic relations between the three countries are a present-day manifestation of longstanding relations between South Africa and two European Union countries that offered significant support to South Africa’s liberation movements and the fight against apartheid.
tgt: Vuxaka bya xiikhonomi exikarhi ka matiko lamanharhu i nkombiso wa siku ra namuntlha wa vuxaka leyi ku nga kahle byi ri kona exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na matiko ya Yuniyoni ya Yuropa lamambirhi lama ma nyikeke nseketelo wo tivikana eka mihlangano ya ntshunxeko ya Afrika-Dzonga na nyimpi ehenhla ka mafumeloxihlawuhlawu.

src: During this working visit, South Africa signed Memoranda of Understanding on cooperation in the field of green hydrogen and energy partnerships with the two countries.
tgt: Hi nkarhi wa rendzo lero tirha, Afrika-Dzonga yi sayine Memorandamu ya Ntwanano hi mayelana na ntirhisano eka ndzima ya swinakulobye hayidirojeni na eneji swa rihlaza.

src: Companies and institutions from the three countries made investment and partnership announcements, including a one billion United States Dollar commitment for the establishment of the SA-H2 Fund to mobilise green hydrogen investments.
tgt: Tikhamphani na mihlangano kusuka eka matiko lamanharhu swi endle switiviso swa vuvekisi na swinakulobye, ku katsa na vutiboheleri bya biliyoni yin'we ya Dolara ya United States eka ku tumbuluxiwa ka Nkwama wa SA-H2 ku hlengeleta vuvekisi bya hayidirojeni ya rihlaza.

src: The Public Infrastructure Fund for Water and Energy: Invest International intends to establish a concessional financing package fund for 300 million Euros and grants of 100 million Euros that will assist South Africa in the delivery of water and energy infrastructure.
tgt: Nkwama wa Switirhisiwakulu swa Mfumo swa Mati na Eneji: Invest International yi kunguhata ku tumbuluxa nkwama wa mpako wa ku nyikiwa ka timali lowu twananiweke wa 300 ya timiliyoni ta Tiyuro na malimpfuneto ya 1000 ra timiliyoni ta Tiyuro leti ti nga ta pfuneta Afrika-Dzonga eka mphakelo wa switirhisiwakulu swa mati na eneji.

src: African Peace Mission Cabinet welcomed a briefing by President Ramaphosa on the recent African Peace Mission to Ukraine and the Russian Federation in which the President participated alongside leaders and representatives of the governments of Senegal, Comoros, Zambia, Egypt, Congo-Brazzaville, and Uganda.
tgt: Mixini wa ku Rhula wa Afrika Khabinete yi amukele ku nyikiwa vuxokoxoko hi Phuresidente Ramaphosa hi mayelana na Mixini wa ku Rhula wa Afrika wo ya eUkraine na Federexini ya Russia lowu eka wona Phuresidente a tekeke xiaveswin'we na varhangeri na vayimeri va mifumo ya Senegal, Comoros, Zambia, Egypt, Congo-Brazzaville, na Uganda.

src: The Mission underscored South Africa’s principled position of non-alignment and the country’s commitment to the peaceful resolution of the conflict.
tgt: Mixini wu tiyise xiyimo lexi nga na milawu xa Afrika-Dzonga xa ku teki rihlanguti na vutiboheleri bya tiko eka xitshunxo xa ku rhula xa ntlimbo lowu.

src: Cabinet noted that President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine and President Vladimir Putin of the Russian Federation had welcomed the African peace initiative and committed to further engagements with African leaders on matters raised towards a peaceful resolution of the conflict.
tgt: Khabinete yi lemuke leswaku Phuresidente Volodymyr Zelensky wa Ukraine na Phuresidente Vladimir Putin wa Federexini ya Russia va amukele pfhumba ra ku rhula ra Afrika naswona va tibohe eka ku vulavurisana ku yisa emahlweni na varhangeri va le Afrika hi mayelana na timhaka leti boxiweke eka xitshunxo xa ku rhula xa ntlimbo.

src: The Mission emphasised the need for a de-escalation of the conflict to allow negotiations to commence with urgency, the return of children taken from Ukraine, the release of prisoners of war and creation of corridors to facilitate for greater humanitarian assistance.
tgt: Mixini lowu wu tshikelele xidingo xa ku hungutiwa ka ntlimbo ku pfumelela mikanerisano ku sungula hi xihatla, ku vuyisiwa ka vana lava tekiweke eUkraine, ku humesiwa ka vabohiwa va nyimpi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka tindlela ku olovisa mpfuneto wa vanhu swinene.

src: Cabinet welcomed the appreciation expressed by global leaders of the value of this African Leaders’ Peace Initiative towards finding a peaceful resolution of the conflict as expressed by the Prime Ministers of Denmark and the Netherlands, as well as the Foreign Minister of France, amongst others.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukele ku khensa loku hundzisiweke hi varhangeri va misava hinkwayo ka nkoka wa Pfhumba ra ku Rhula ra Varhangeri va le Afrika eka ku kuma xitshunxo xa ntlimbo lowu tanihilaha ku paluxiweke hakona hi Vaholobyenkulu va Denmark na Netherlands, xikan'we na Holobye wa Matiko Mambe wa Furwa, exikarhi ka van'wana.

src: Following the peace mission, South Africa will participate in the African Union-Russia Summit in Moscow in July, on the sidelines of which, our government will also take the opportunity to further engage Russia on matters the two Presidents undertook to give their consideration.
tgt: Endzhaku ka mixini wa ku rhula, Afrika-Dzonga yi ta teka xiave eka Samiti ya Yuniyoni ya Afrika-Russia eMoscow hi Mawuwana, laha matlhelo ya yona, mfumo wa hina wu nga ta tlhela wu teka xivandlanene lexi ku vulavurisana ku ya emahlweni na Russia hi mayelana na timhaka leti Tiphuresidente letimbirhi ti tiboheke ku ti tekela enhlokweni.

src: President Ramaphosa’s National Security Advisor, ProfFholisani Sydney Mufamadi, will attend a Peace Summit, convened by President Zelenksy, that will take place in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August.
tgt: Mutsundzuxi wa Nsirhelelo wa Rixaka wa Phuresidente Ramaphosa, yena Phrf Fholisani Sydney Mufamadi, u ta ya eka Samiti ya ku Rhula, leyi rhambiweke hi Phuresidente Zelenksy, leyi yi nga ta va kona eCopenhagen, Denmark, hi Mhawuri.

src: With regard to the flight that transported South African presidential security personnel and media representatives to Poland en route to Ukraine and Russia, Cabinet noted the unfortunate events that unfolded when this flight landed in Warsaw, Poland.
tgt: Hi mayelana na xihahampfhuka lexi tleketleke vatirhi va nsirhelelo wa phuresidente va le Afrika-Dzonga na vayimeri va swihangalasamahungu ku ya ePoland endleleni ya vona yo kongoma eUkraine na Russia, Khabinete yi lemuke swiendleko leswi a swi fanele ku va swi nga humelelangi leswi swi humeleleke loko xihahampfhuka lexi xi phatsama eWarsaw, Poland.

src: Cabinet noted that the Department of International Relations and Cooperation will pursue discussion on this matter through the appropriate diplomatic mechanisms and channels.
tgt: Khabinete yi lemuke leswaku Ndzawulo ya Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava na Ntirhisano yi ta khoma nkanelo hi mayelana na mhaka leyi hi ku tirhisa maendlelo na tindlela swa xidipulomati leswi faneleke.

src: Trade matters.
tgt: Timhaka ta mabindzu.

src: Cabinet noted the latest trade figures as presented by the Department of Trade, Industry and Competition showed that South Africa’s exports to China reached US$33 billion in 2022, more than twice the level of our next largest trading partner, Germany.
tgt: Khabinete yi lemuke tinhlayo ta mabindzu ta sweswinyana tanihilaha ti andlariweke hakona hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu, vumaki na Mphikizano leti kombeke leswaku tinhundzu ta Afrika-Dzonga leti rhumeriwaka eChina ti fike eka US$33 wa tibiliyoni hi 2022, hi kambirhi kutlula levhele ya mutirhisani wo bindzurisa lonkulu kutlula hinkwavo, Jarimani.

src: Overall, South Africa-China trade increased by 30% from US$44 billion in 2018 to US$57 billion by the end of 2022.
tgt: Hi ku angarhela, mabindzu ya Afrika-Dzonga-China ya tlakuke hi 30% kusuka eka US$44 wa tibiliyoni hi 2018 kufika eka US$57wa tibiliyoni hi kuhela ka 2022.

src: From 2018 to 2022, average annual growth rates of 10% (exports) and 4.5% (imports) were recorded.
tgt: Kusukela 2018 kufikela 2022, mipimo ya ku kula ya lembe na lembe ya nhlayoxikarhi ya 10% (tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe) na 4.5% (tinhundzu leti xaviweke ematikweni) yi tsarisiwile.

src: South Africa maintained a large trade surplus over those five years.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi hlayisa misalo ya mabindzu leyikulu eka ntlhanu wa malembe.

src: Energy.
tgt: Eneji.

src: Cabinet welcomed the agreement that will see Mozambique supply South Africa with 100 megawatts (MW) of electricity within the next three (3) months upon the signing of the Power Purchase Agreement.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukele ntwanano lowu wu nga ta endla leswaku Mozambique yi amukela Afrika-Dzonga hi 100 wa timegawati (MW) ta gezi endzeni ka tin'hweti tinharhu (3) leti landzelaka xikan'wekan'we loko ku sayiniwa Ntwanano wa ku Xaviwa ka Gezi.

src: The next three to 12 months will see South Africa importing up to 1 000 MW of electricity from Mozambique.
tgt: Tin'hweti tinharhu kufika eka 12 leti landzelaka ti ta endla leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi xava kusuka eka matiko mambe kufika eka 1 000 MW ta gezi kusuka eMozambique.

src: Cabinet further welcomed continuous improvement in the Eskom’s generation capacity that has ensured the utility registers over 60% Energy Availability Factor.
tgt: Khabinete yi yile emahlweni yi amukela antswiso lowu yaka emahlweni eka ntalo wa ku endliwa ka gezi Eskom lowu wu tiyisiseke leswaku nhlangano wo phakela miganga gezi wu tsarisa 60% ta Xiphemu xa Vukona bya Eneji.

src: Cabinet extends its appreciation to South Africans for your contribution in lowering the demand for electricity, which has contributed to Eskom being able to maintain lower stages of load-shedding.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzise ku khensa ka yona eka vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga eka vuhoxaxandla bya n'wina eka ku hunguta ku laviwa ka gezi, leswi swi hoxekeke xandla eka Eskom ku va yi kota ku hlayisa switeji swa le hansi swa ku tirhisiwa ka gezi hi ku siyerisana.

src: Saving electricity is a shared responsibility and an action from which all of us benefits.
tgt: Ku hlayisa gezi i vutihlamuleri lebyi avelaniwaka naswona i goza leri hinkwerhu ka hina hi vuyeriwaka kusuka eka rona.

src: Cabinet expressed appreciation for a donation to South Africa by the People’s Republic of China of emergency and small-scale generation equipment valued at R167 million.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzise ku khensa eka munyikelo eAfrika-Dzonga hi Rhiphabuliki ya Vanhu ya China ya xilamulelamhangu na switirhisiwa swo endla gezi swa mpimo lowutsongo leswi nga na nkoka R167 wa timiliyoni.

src: A deployment plan is being developed to ensure the donated equipment is installed in public facilities which will, as a result, be isolated from load-shedding.
tgt: Kungu ra ku rhumeriwa ka vatirhi ri le ku hluvukisiwa ku tiyisisa leswaku ku na switirhisiwa leswi nyikeriweke swa vekeriwa eka switirhisiwa swa mfumo leyi ekuheteleleni hi yi nga ta humesiwa eka ku tirhisiwa ka gezi hi ku siyerisana.

src: A formal handover ceremony will take place as soon as the goods are cleared by South African customs authorities.
tgt: Ntirho wa ku hundzisiwa ka ximfumo wu ta va kona xikan'wekan'we loko tinhundzu ti pasisiwile hi vulawuri va xibalo va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Water Cabinet received an overview of responses by the Department of Water and Sanitation to water and sanitation challenges in the country.
tgt: Mati Khabinete yi kume nkatsakanyo wa miangulo hi Ndzawulo ya Mati na Nkululo ya mitlhontlho ya mati ya nkululo etikweni.

src: The overview highlighted the acceleration of surface water resource projects that had previously experienced such as:7.
tgt: Nkatsakanyo lowu wu kombisile ku hatlisisiwa ka tiphurojeke swipfuno swa mati ya le henhla leti eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza ti tokotiweke tanihi:7.

src: Construction of the R40 billion Phase 2 of the Lesotho Highlands Water Project which will serve Gauteng and surrounding provinces.
tgt: Vuaki bya Xiyimo xa 2 xa R40 wa tibiliyoni xa Phurojeke ya mati ya Lesotho Highlands leyi yi nga ta tirhela Gauteng na swifundzakulu leswi rhendzeleke.

src: Work will be completed in The R4 billion Phase 2A of the Mokolo Crocodile Water Augmentation Project in North West and Limpopo.
tgt: Ntirho wu ta hetiwa hi Xiyimo xa 2A xa R4 wa tibiliyoni xa Phurojeke yo Engetela Mati ya Mokolo Crocodile eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu eLimpopo.

src: Funding is being raised for another phase on which construction will start in May 2024, with completion planned for In a partnership between government and the mining sector, construction is underway on the R24 billion Olifants River Water Resource Development project in Limpopo, with completion expected in In a similar partnership with mines in the Northern Cape, construction will start later this year on the R10 billion Vaal Gamagara project where completion is also expected around Construction started this month, June 2023, on the R500 million Groot Letaba Water Augmentation Project in Limpopo, which entails the raising of the Tzaneen Dam.
tgt: Mali yi le ku hlengeletiweni eka xiyimo xin'wana lexi vuaki byi nga ta sunguriwa hi Mudyaxihi 2024, ku ri na ku hetisiwa loku kunguhateriweke ku va hi Eka xinakulobye exikarhi ka mfumo na sekitara ya vucelamigodi, vuaki byi le ku endlekeni eka phurojeke ya Nhluvukiso wa Swipfuno swa Mati swa Nambu wa Olifants ya R24 wa tibiliyoni eLimpopo, ku ri na ku hetiwa loku languteriwaka hi Eka xinakulobye xo fana hi migodi leyi nga eKapa-N'walungu, vuaki byi ta sungula endzhakunyana ka lembe leri eka phurojeke ya Vaal Gamagara ya R10 ra tibiliyoni laha ku hetiwa na kona ku languteriwaka kwalomuya ka Vuaki byi sungule n'hweti yaleyi, Khotavuxika 2023, eka Phurojeke yo Engetela Mati ya Groot Letaba eLimpopo, leyi yi khumbaka ku tlakusiwa ka Damu Tzaneen.

src: Work on this project will be completed in In the Western Cape, construction will begin in 2024 on the R1,2 billion Voëlvlei Augmentation Scheme, where completion is expected in 2026.
tgt: Ntirho eka phurojeke leyi wu ta hetiwa hi EKapa-Vupeladyambu, vuaki byi ta sungula hi 2024 eka Xikimi xo Engetela xa Voëlvlei xa R1,2 wa tibiliyoni, laha ku hetiwa ku languteriwa hi 2026.

src: These projects are securing the supply of water to the nation and in this process thousands of people will be employed, businesses around the construction sites will benefit from the consumption of workers and contractors, and the improved infrastructure will benefit local economies.
tgt: Tiphurojeke leti ti hlayisa mphakelo wa mati eka rixaka naswona eka phurosese leyi magidi ya vanhu ya ta thoriwa, mabindzu lama rhendzeleke tindhawu ta vuaki ti ta vuyeriwa hi ku tekiwa ka vatirhi na van'watikontiraka , naswona switirhisiwakulu leswi antswisiweke swi ta vuyerisa tiikhonomi ta le tindhawini letiya.

src: Launch of South African Isotope Facility (SAIF).
tgt: Nsimeko wa Xitirhisiwa xa Ayisothopi xa Afrika-Dzonga (SAIF).

src: Cabinet welcomed the partnership between the Department of Science and Innovation and IThemba LABS, which saw the opening of the SAIF, a world-class facility that responds to the growing challenge of cancer as one of the leading causes of death.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukele xinakulobye exikarhi ka Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Vutumbuluxi na IThemba LABS, leyi nga endla leswaku ku pfuriwa SAIF, xitirhisiwa xa xiyimo xa misava lexi xi angulaka eka ntlhontlho lowu kulaka wa mfukuzana tanihi xin'wana xa swivangelo swa rifu.

src: The facility will conduct advanced research and training as well as increase the production capacity for radioisotopes.
tgt: Xitirhisiwa lexi xi ta endla ndzavisiso na vuleteri leswi antswisiweke xikan'we na engetelo wa vuswikoti bya tirhadiyoayisothopi.

src: Radioisotope therapy targets cancerous cells with minimal damage to surrounding healthy cells.
tgt: Therapi ya rhadiyoayisothopi yi pakanisa tisele ta mfukuzana leti vavisekeke switsongo eka tisele leti rhendzeleke leti nga hanya kahle.

src: Currently about 5 000 South African patients a year benefit from the supply, and it is expected that these numbers could increase by a factor of five to seven, with the increase in production capacity through the SAIF and the availability of a new cohort of isotopes.
tgt: Eka nkarhi wa sweswi kwalomu ka 5 000 wa vavabyi va le Afrika-Dzonga hi lembe va vuyeriwa kusuka eka mphakelo lowu, naswona swi languteriwile leswaku tinhlayo leti ti nga tlakukaka hi xiphemu xa ntlhanu kufika eka nkombo, ku ri na ntlakuko eka vuswikoti bya vuhumesi hi SAIF na vukona bya ntlawa wuntshwa wa tiayisothopi.

src: Passing of the Postbank Limited Amendment Bill Cabinet welcomed the passing of the Postbank Limited Amendment Bill by Parliament (both the National Assembly and National Council of Provinces), which paves a way for the licensing of the state bank.
tgt: Ku pasisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo Bangi ya Poso leyi nga na Vutihlamuleri Khabinete yi amukele ku pasisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wa Bangi ya Poso leyi nga na Vutihlamuleri hi Palamende (havumbirhi bya Huvo ya Rixaka na Huvo ya Rixaka ya Swifundzakulu), leswi pfulaka ndlela ya ku nyikiwa ka layisense ya bangi ya mfumo.

src: The Bill addresses the risks currently associated with the current structure of the Postbank, by amending the ownership and reporting structure to establish a new holding company for the Postbank.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu tirhana na mixungeto leyi eka nkarhi wa sweswi yi fambelanisiwaka na xivumbeko xa nkarhi wa sweswi xa Bangi ya Poso, hi ku hundzuluxa vun'wini na xivumbeko xo vika ku tumbuluxa khamphani yo lawula yintshwa ya Bangi ya Poso.

src: Cabinet will await the President to sign the into law which will allow the registration of the Postbank as a Bank Controlling Company.
tgt: Khabinete yi ta rindzela Phuresidente ku sayina tanihi nawu lowu wu nga ta pfumelela ntsariso wa Bangi ya Poso tanihi Khamphani yo Lawula Bangi.

src: Youth Empowerment.
tgt: Havexeriso wa Vantshwa.

src: Cabinet thanked all South Africans for joining in the country’s Youth Day celebrations on 16 June 2023 under the theme: “Accelerating youth economic emancipation for a sustainable future”.
tgt: Khabinete yi khense yi khense vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga eka ku tikatsa eka mitlangelo ya Siku ra Vantshwa ya tiko hi siku ra 16 Khotavuxika 2023 ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Ku hatlisisiwa ka ntshunxeko wa ikhonomi ya vantshwa eka vumundzuku lebyi yisekaka emahlweni”.

src: Cabinet welcomed the launch of state-of-the-art Public Employment Mobile Bus by the Departments of Basic Education, Higher Education, Science and Innovation, and Employment and Labour, in collaboration with the European Union's Education for Employability programme.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukele nsimeko wa Bazi ro Fambafamba na Miganga ra Mitirho ya Mfumo ra ximanguvalawa hi Tindzawulo ta Dyondzo ya Masungulo, Dyondzo ya le Henhla, Sayense na Vutumbuluxi, na Mitirho na Vatirhi, eka ku tirhisana na nongoloko wa Dyondzo ya Vutholeki ya Yuniyoni ya Yuropa.

src: These opportunity buses travel to far-flung areas to help learners and work-seekers on their employment path by matching individuals’ strengths and capabilities to potential careers and job opportunities.
tgt: Mabazi lama swivandlanene ma ta teka tendzo eka tindhawu leti tshameleke ekule ku pfuna vadyondzi na valavi va mitirho hi ndlela ya vona ku thoriwa hi mitamu na vuswikoti bya munhu lebyi pananaka eka mitirhovutomi leyi nga tshukaka yi va kona na swivandlanene swa mitirho.

src: Cabinet further welcomed the initiatives by the Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development to support youth to participate in the agricultural sector in their revitalisation of communal areas such as the Marapyane-Bakgatla primary cooperative.
tgt: Khabinete yi yile emahlweni yi amukela mapfhumba hi Ndzawulo hi Vurimi, Antswiso wa Misava na Nhluvukiso wa Matikoxikaya ku seketela vantshwa ku teka xiave eka sekitara ya vurimi eka mpfuxeto wa tindhawu ta nhlanganelo wa vaakandhawu to tanihi bindzu ra nhlanganelo ra le xikolweni xa le hansi xa Marapyane-Bakgatla.

src: This cooperative has created more than 100 jobs in their villages and these youth are primarily grain and sunflower farmers.
tgt: Ntirhisano lowu wu tumbuluxile kutlula 100 wa mitirho emigangeni ya ka vona naswona vantshwa i varimi va mavele na swiluva swa dyambu ngopfungopfu.

src: Working on Fire Programme Cabinet salutes the 400 South African firefighters deployed to Canada to assist in saving lives, homes, businesses and vegetation in the Canadian Province of Alberta.
tgt: Ku Tirha eka Nongoloko wa Ndzilo Khabinete yi losa 400 ya vatimelandzilo va le Afrika-Dzonga lava rhumeriweke eCanada ku pfuneta ku ponisa vutomi, makaya, mabindzu na nhova eka Xifundzakulu xa Alberta xa Canada.

src: The 2023 deployment is in response to an urgent request from the Canadian Inter-agency Forest Fire Centre.
tgt: Ku rhumeriwa ka vatirhi ka 2023 i angulo eka xikombelo xa xihatla ku suka eka Senthara ya Ndzilo wa Swihlahla ya le Xikarhi ka Tiejensi ya Canada.

src: This fifth collaboration between South Africa and Canada is evidence of the strong relations between our two countries and South Africa’s contribution to preserving our physical environment, regardless of which part of the world is affected by environmental threats.
tgt: Ntirhisano lowa vuntlhanu exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Canada i vumbhoni bya vuxaka lebyo tiya exikarhi ka matiko ma ka hina lamambirhi naswona vuhoxaxandla bya Afrika-Dzonga ku hoxa xandla eka ku hlayisa mbangu wa xiviri, swi nga ri na mhaka leswaku i xiphemu xihi xa misava lexi hlaseriwaka hi mixungeto ya mbangu.

src: Special Olympics World Summer Games Team South Africa continues to fly the flag at the 2023 Special Olympics World Summer Games in Berlin, Germany, from 17 to 25 June 2023.
tgt: Mitlangu ya Ximumu ya Misava ya Tiolimpiki yo Hlawuleka Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga xi ya emahlweni xi endla tiko ri tinyungubyisa eka Mitlangu ya Ximumu ya Misava ya Tiolimpiki yo Hlawuleka ya 2023 eBerlin, Jarimani, kusuka 17 kufika 25 Khotavuxika 2023.

src: Team SA comprises 64 athletes and 21 coaches who are competing against 7 000 athletes from across 180 countries.
tgt: Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga xi vumbiwa hi 64 wa switsutsumi na 21 wa vadzaberi lava va phikizanaka na 7 000 ya switsutsumi kusuka eka 180 wa matiko.

src: They represent the best of our nation and are proof of the power of the human spirit.
tgt: Va yimela lava nga na vuswikoti swinene va rixaka ra ka hina naswona i vumbhoni bya matimba ya moya wa vumunhu.

src: Cabinet decisions South Africa’s Ratification of the Luxembourg Protocol to the Convention of International Interests in Mobile Equipment on Matters Specific to Railway Rolling Stock Cabinet approved the submission of the Luxembourg Rail Protocol to Parliament for ratification.
tgt: Swiboho swa Khabinete Ku Amukeriwa ka Afrika-Dzonga ka Milawu ya Luxembourg ya Ntwanano wa Mitsakelo ya Matiko ya Misava eka Switirhisiwa swo Fambafamba hi mayelana na Timhaka leti Kongomanaka na Matorokisi Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa Milawu ya Swiporo swa Luxembourg ePalamende leswaku xi amukeriwa.

src: The Luxembourg Rail Protocol fosters economic growth by enhancing private sector financing in the rail industry.
tgt: Milawu ya Swiporo ya Luxembourg yi kondletela ku kula ka ikhonomi hi ku tiyisa sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo leyi nyikaka timali eka indasitiri ya swiporo.

src: The Luxembourg Rail Protocol is a result of the success of the Cape Town Convention on International Interests in Mobile Equipment that was held in 2007.
tgt: Milawu ya Swiporo ya Luxembourg i mbuyelo wa ku humelela ka Ntwanano wa Kapa hi mayelana na Mitsakelo ya Matiko ya Misava eka Switirhisiwa swo Fambafamba leyi khomiweke hi 2007.

src: South Africa signed the protocol in 2022, as an indication of how serious the country is about rail reform.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi sayine milawu leyi hi 2022, tanihi xikombo xa hilaha tiko ri tiyimiseleke hakona hi mayelana na antswiso wa swiporo.

src: Appointments All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.
tgt: Ku thoriwa Ku thoriwa hinkwako ku fanele ku landzelela vutiyisisi bya mithwaso na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.

src: Mr Evert Potgieter as Chief Financial Officer of the Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority.
tgt: Ttn Evert Potgieter tanihi Muofisirinkulu wa Timali wa Vulawuri byo Lawula Vatirhi va Tindlu.

src: Mr Sandile Psychology Mkhize as Chief Executive Officer of Magalies Water (extension of contract).
tgt: Ttn Sandile Psychology Mkhize tanihi Muofisirinkulu wa Vurhangerinkulu wa Magalies Water (ku engeteriwa ka kontiraka).

src: Dr Mlungisi Bhekizizwe Gabriel Cele as Head: National Advisory Council on Innovation at the Department of Science and Innovation.
tgt: Swirho swa Khansele ya Ndzavisiso wa Vurimi: Mhn Joyene Isaacs (ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa) Dkd Poncho Mokaila (ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa) Dkd Jonty Tshipa Ttn Neo Harrison Masithela Mhn Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson Dkd Hilke Maartens Ttnr Goodman Gcaba (ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa) Dkd Troy Govender

src: Members of the Agricultural Research Council: Ms Joyene Isaacs (reappointment) Dr Poncho Mokaila (reappointment) Dr Jonty Tshipa Mr Neo Harrison Masithela Ms Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson Dr Hilke Maartens Mr Goodman Gcaba (reappointment) Dr Troy Govender
tgt: Dkd Konanani Liphadzi (ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa) Dkd Pieter Naude Malan (ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa) na Dkd Owen Horwood.

src: Dr Konanani Liphadzi (reappointment) Dr Pieter Naude Malan (reappointment) and Dr Owen Horwood.
tgt: Ku pfariwa ka swivandla leswi nga eka Ejensi ya Vutleketli bya le Magondzweni exikarhi ka Mindzilekana: Mhn Bukeka Mahlutshana na Ttn Leroy Nsibande.

src: Filling of vacancies on the Board of the South African Civil Aviation Authority:
tgt: Ku pfariwa ka swivandla eka Bodo ya Vulawuri bya Vuhahisi bya Vaaki bya Afrika-Dzonga:

src: Mr Tshepo Peege.
tgt: Ttn Tshepo Peege.

src: Bills.
tgt: Milawumbisi.

src: Draft Marriage Bill of 2022 Cabinet approved the publication of the Draft Marriage Bill of 2022 for public comment.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Vukati wa Mpfapfarhuto wa 2022 Khabinete yi pasise ku kandziyisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Vukati wa Mpfapfarhuto wa 2022 leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.

src: The Bill gives effect to the White Paper on Marriages in South Africa, which was approved by Cabinet in March 2022.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu humelerisa Phepha ra Swibumabumelo swa Mfumo hi mayelana na Vukati eAfrika-Dzonga, leri ri pasisiweke hi Khabinete hi Nyenyakulu 2022.

src: The Bill empowers the Department of Home Affairs to develop a single Marriage Act for the country.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu havexerisa Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya ku hluvukisa Nawu wa Vukati wun'we wa tiko leri.

src: The Bill seeks to ensure that all marriages are concluded in accordance with the principles of equality, non-discrimination and human dignity as provided for in the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu lava ku tiyisisa leswaku vukati hinkwabyo bya hetisisiwa hi ku fambisana na milawu ya ndzingano, nkaxihlawuhlawu na xindzhuti xa ximunhu tanihilaha swi lulamiseriweke hakona eka Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ya Afrika-Dzonga ya 1996.

src: The draft Bill allows South Africans and residents in the country of all sexual orientations, as well as religious and cultural persuasions, to conclude legal unions in line with the constitutional principles.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowa mpfapfarhuto wu pfumelela vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga na vatshami etikweni va rimbewuvutixaxameti, xikan'we na swikhorwiwa swa vukhongeri na swa mfumo, ku hetisisa vukati bya xinawu hi ku fambisana na milawu ya le ka vumbiwa.

src: The Bill outlines measure to prevent unions such as child marriages and those done in the absence of the other party.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu katsaka goza ro sivela vukati byo tanihi vukati bya vana na lebyi byi endliwaka ku ri hava vandla lerin'wana.

src: National Water Resource Infrastructure Agency (NWRIA) Bill of 2022.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Ejensi ya Switirhisiwakulu swa Swipfuno swa Mati ya Rixaka (NWRIA) wa 2022.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the draft NWRIA Bill to Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa Nawumbisi wa NWRIA wa mpfapfarhuto ePalamende.

src: The Bill proposes the setting up of an NWRIA to be responsible for the planning, financing and development of the water infrastructure for the country.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu ringanyeta ku simekiwa ka NWRIA leswaku yi va na vutihlamuleri bya nkunguhato, ku nyika timali na nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwakulu swa mati swa tiko leri.

src: It will also be responsible for the maintenance of the current water resource infrastructure.
tgt: Yi ta tlhela yi va na vutihlamuleri bya nhlayiso wa switirhisiwakulu swa swipfuno swa mati leswi nga kona eka nkarhi wa sweswi.

src: The agency is to ensure a sustainable, equitable and reliable supply of water in line with constitutional obligations of access to water and a secure healthy environment.
tgt: Ejensi leyi yi fanele ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na mphakelo wo yiseka emahlweni, wo ringanana na ku va wo tshembeka wa mati hi ku fambisana na miboheko leyi nga eka vumbiwa ya mfikelelo wa mati na ku sirhelela mbangu lowu nga na rihanyo.

src: It will be set up as a Public Entity under the Schedule 2 of the Public Finance Management Act, 1999 (Act 1 of 1999).
tgt: Yi ta simekiwa tanihi Vandla ra Mfumo ehansi ka Xedulu ya 2 ya Nawu wa Malawulelo ya Timali ta Mfumo, 1999 (Nawu wa 1999).

src: The agency will take on the functions that are currently performed by the Trans-Caledon Tunnel Authority.
tgt: Ejensi leyi yi ta byarha mitirho leyi eka nkarhi wa sweswi yi tirhiwa hi Trans-Caledon Tunnel Authority.

src: Divorce Amendment Bill of 2023 Cabinet approved the submission of the draft Divorce Amendment Bill of 2023 to Parliament.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wo Dlaya Vukati 2023 Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wo Dlaya Vukati wa mpfapfarhuto wa 2023 ePalamende.

src: The Bill amends the Divorce Act, 1979 (Act 70 of 1979) so as to provide for mechanisms to safeguard the welfare of minor or dependent children born of Muslim marriages.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu hundzuluxa Nawu wo Dlaya Vukati, 1979 (Nawu wa 70 wa 1979) ku endlela ku lulamisela tindlela ta ku sirhelela nhlayiseko wa swihlangi kumbe va na lava hlayisiwaka va tswariweke eka vukati bya Ximuzilamu.

src: The amendments also aim to provide for the redistribution of assets on the dissolution of a Muslim marriage to provide for the forfeiture of patrimonial benefits of a Muslim marriage.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi tlhela yi lulamisela ku phakeriwa hi vuntshwa ka rifuwo loko ku n'okisiwa vukati bya Ximuzilamu ku lulamisela ku tekeriwa mivuyelo ya ndzhaka ya vukati bya Ximuzilamu.

src: In June 2022, the Constitutional Court had found that the Divorce Act in its current form to be inconsistent with the Constitution as it excludes Muslim marriages.
tgt: Hi Khotavuxika 2022, Khoto ya Vumbiwa yi kumile leswaku Nawu wo Dlaya Vukati eka xivumbeko xa wona xa nkarhi wa sweswi a wu fambisani na Vumbiwa tanihileswi wu nga katsiki vukati bya Ximuzilamu.

src: The court found that a section of the Divorce Act is unconstitutional in that it unfairly discriminates against children of married parents and those of unmarried parents.
tgt: Khoto yi kume leswaku xiyenge xa Nawu wo Dlaya Vukati wu hambana na vumbiwa hi mhaka ya leswaku wu endla xihlawuhlawu lexi nga riki lexinene ehenhla ka vana va vatswari lava tekaneke na vatswari lava nga tekanangiki.

src: The African Renaissance and International Cooperation Fund (ARF) Amendment Bill Cabinet approved the submission of the publication of the ARF draft amendment Bill for public comment.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wa Nkwama wa Mpfuxeto wa Afrika na Ntirhisano wa Matiko ya Misava (ARF) Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa nkandziyiso wa Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wa mpfapfarhuto wa ARF leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.

src: The purpose of the Bill is to amend the ARF Act (Act 51 of 2000).
tgt: Xikongomelo xa Nawumbisi lowu i ku hundzuluxa Nawu wa ARF (Nawu wa 51 wa 2000).

src: The amendments will also mean that the ARF will now be called the South African Development Partnership Agency.
tgt: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi ta tlhela yi vula leswaku ARF sweswi yi ta vitani Ejensi ya Swinakulobye bya Nhluvukiso wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The agency will serve as a tool to manage, support and facilitate South Africa’s outgoing development cooperation and assistance.
tgt: Ejensi leyi yi ta tirha tanihi xitirho ku lawula, ku seketela na ku humelerisa ntirhisano na mpfuneto wa nhluvukiso lowu fikaka emakumu wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The ARF is critical to promoting South Africa’s national interests and values, the African Renaissance and the creation of a better world for all.
tgt: ARF i ya nkoka swonghasi eka ku kondletela mitsakelo ya rixaka na mikhuvanene swa Afrika-Dzonga, Mpfuxeto wa Afrika na ku tumbuluxiwa ka misava yo antswa ya hinkwavo.

src: The ARF is also important for South Africa as it enhances cooperation between our country and other countries, in particular African countries, through the promotion of democracy, good governance, the prevention and resolution of conflict, socio-economic development and integration, humanitarian assistance and human resource development.
tgt: ARF yi tlhela yi va na nkoka eka Afrika-Dzonga tanihileswi yi antswisaka ntirhisano exikarhi ka tiko ra ka hina na matiko man'wana, ngopfungopfu matiko ma le Afrika, hikwalaho ka nkondletelo wa xidemokirasi, mafumelo lamanene, nsivelo na xitshunxo xa ntlimbo, nhluvukiso na mpfanganiso wa vanhu na ikhonomi mpfuneto wa vanhu na nhluvukiso wa swipfuno swa ximunhu.

src: Update in South Africa’s Re-election to serve as a Member of the Council of the International Civil Aviation Organisation Cabinet noted the re-election of South Africa to serve as a Member of the Council of the International Civil Aviation Organisation Upcoming events1 Mandela Month.1 South Africa and the world will, in July, commemorate Mandela Month under the theme “Climate, Food and Solidarity” During the month, South Africans celebrate former President Nelson Mandela’s life, his legacy and take action to help change our communities for the better, integrating efforts contributing towards the fight against poverty and inequality.2 Cabinet urges all South Africans to use the month to do something that will make a difference in their communities and ensure that we build the South Africa envisioned by our founding father.
tgt: Ku nyika vuxokoxoko byintshwa hi mayelana na ku Hlawuriwa hi Vuntshwa ka Afrika-Dzonga ku tirha tanihi Xirho xa Khansele ya Nhlangano wa Vuhahisi bya Vaaki wa Matiko ya Misava Khabinete yi lemuke ku hlawuriwa hi vuntshwa ka Afrika-Dzonga ku tirha tanihi Xirho xa Khansele ya Nhlangano wa Vuhahisi bya Vaaki wa Matiko ya Misava Swiendleko leswi Taka1 N'hweti ya Mandela.1 Afrika-Dzonga na misava hinkwayo, hi Mawuwana, va ta tsundzuka N'hweti ya Mandela ehansi ka nkongomelo wa “Maxelo, Swakudya na Nkhomano”.

src: 2 Summit for a new Global Financing Pact.1 President Ramaphosa will, on 22 and 23 June 2023, participate in the summit for a new global financing pact in France.
tgt: Hi n'hweti leyi, vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga va tlangela vutomi bya khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela, ndzhaka ya yena naswona va teka goza ku pfuna ku cinca vaakandhawu va ka hina leswaku va antswa, va pfanganisa matshalatshala ku hoxa xandla eka ku lwisana na vusweti na nkandzingano.2 Khabinete yi hlohlotela vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku tirhisa n'hweti leyi ku endla swin'wana leswi swi nga ta endla ku hambana emigangeni ya ka vona na ku tiyisisa leswaku hi aka Afrika-Dzonga leyi voniweke hi tatana wa hina wo simeka.

src: South Africa will address key issues such as the reform of multilateral development financial institutions, debt crisis, innovative financing, international taxes and special withdrawing rights.3 Representative Council of Learners (RCL) Conference.1 The RCL Conference will be convened on the 29 and 30 June 2023 at the University of Pretoria with an aim of building and strengthening the role of RCLs in schools.2 This year’s conference will focus on empowering learners, the identification of learners’ needs and improving the functioning of RCLs.
tgt: 2 Samiti ya Ntwanano wo Nyika Timali wa Misava Hinkwayo wuntshwa.1 Phuresidente Ramaphosa hi siku ra 22 na 23 Khotavuxika 2023, u ta teka xiave eka samiti ya ntwanano a ku nyika timali wa misava hinkwayo eFurwa.

src: This is an important platform for developing future leadership of the country.4 2023 Netball World Cup Tournament.1 With 36 Days to go to the Netball World Cup 2023 which will take place at the Cape Town International Convention Centre from 28 July to 6 August 2023, Cabinet thanked all South Africans for the warm Ubuntu welcome to the entourage on a countrywide World Cup Trophy tour.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi ta tirhana na timhakakulu to tanihi antswiso wa mihlangano ya timali ta nhluvukiso ya matikonyingi, xirilo xa swikweleti, ku nyika timali ka vutumbuluxi, swibalo swa matiko ya misava ma timfanelo to tihumesa to hlawuleka.3 Khomferense ya Khansele ya Vuyimeri ya Vadyondzi (RCL)3.1 Khomferense ya RCL yi ta rhambiwa hi siku ra 29 na 30 Khotavuxika 2023 eYunivhesiti ya Pitori hi xikongomelo xa ku aka na ku tiyisa xiave xa tiRCL eswikolweni.2 Khomferense ya nan'waka yi ta kongomisa eka ku havexerisa vadyondzi, ku kumiwa ka swidingo swa vadyondzi na ku antswisa matirhelo ya tiRCLeyi i pulatifomo ya nkoka ya ku hluvukisa vurhangeri bya nkarhi lowu taka bya tiko leri.4 2023 Thonamente ya Khapi ya Misava ya Netibolo.1 Kha ri na 36 wa Masiku ku ya eka Khapi ya Misava ya Netibolo ya 2023 leyi yi nga ta va kona eCape Town International Convention Centre kusuka 28 Mawuwana kufika 6 Mhawuri 2023, Khabinete yi khense vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga hinkwavo eka ku amukela ka Vumunhu ka malwandla eka vanhu lava endzeke eka rendzo ra Thirofi ya Khapi ya Misava etikweni hinkwaro.

src: The trophy tour forms part of the build-up to the opening game.
tgt: Rendzo lera thirofi ri vumba xiphemu xa migingiriko yo yisa eka ntlangu wo pfula.

src: The trophy tour kicked off in KwaZulu-Natal and will make its way to Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Limpopo, North West, Free State, Northern Cape and the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Rendzo lera thirofi ri sungule eKwaZulu-Natal naswona ri ta nghena hi le Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Limpopo, N'walungu-Vupeladyambu, Free State, Kapa-N'walungu na Kapa Vupeladyambu.

src: The tour will culminate in the Western Cape as the host province, before the start of the tournament on 28 July 2023.5 Banyana Banyana depart for Women’s FIFA World Cup.1 On behalf of the nation, Cabinet extends its best wishes to the national women’s football team, Banyana Banyana, as they prepare to depart on Friday, 23 June 2023, for the Women’s FIFA World Cup which will be staged in Australia and New Zealand in July.2 The team’s performances in various tournaments have brought global attention to the development of the women’s game in South Africa, as part of the broader self-empowerment and societal empowerment of women in the country.
tgt: Rendzo leri ri ta gimeta eKapa-Vupeladyambu tanihi xifundza lexi rhurhelaka, ku nga si sungula thonamente leyi hi siku ra 28 Mawuwana 2023.5 Banyana Banyana va suka ku ya eka Khapi ya Misava ya FIFA ya Vavasati.1 Hi ku yimela rixaka, Khabinete yi navelele leswinene eka xipano xa bolo ya milenge ya vavasati ya rixaka, Banyana Banyana, tanihiloko xi ri eku lulamiseleni ku suka hi Ravuntlhanu 23 Khotavuxika 2023, kuya eka Khapi ya Misava ya FIFA ya Vavasati leyi yi nga ta khomeriwa eAustralia na le New Zealand hi Mawuwana.2 Matirhelo ya xipano eka tithonamente to hambanahambana ma tisile nkongomiso wa miehleketo wa misava hinkwayo eka nhluvukiso wa ntlangu wa vavasati eAfrika-Dzonga, tanihi xiphemu xa vutihavexerisi byo angarhela havexeriso wa rixaka wa vavasati etikweni.

src: Messages.
tgt: Mahungu.

src: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to: South African wheelchair tennis players Donald Ramphadi and Kgothatso Montjane who emerged as Grand Slam champions in their respective divisions at the prestigious Roland Garros tournament in France.
tgt: VuhoyozeriKhabinete yi hundzise vuhoyozeri bya yona na ku navelela leswinene eka: Vatlangi va thenisi va tiwhilichere va le Afrika-Dzonga Donald Ramphadi na Kgothatso Montjane lava va humeleleke tanihi tinghwazi ta Grand Slam eka swiavo swo vona hi ku hambana eka thonamente ya Roland Garros yo xiximeka eFurwa.

src: All the winners of the 2023 Comrade Marathon and runners who participated in the ultramarathon down run from Pietermaritzburg to Durban.
tgt: Vahluri hinkwavo va Matsambu ya Comrade ya 2023 na switsutsumi leswi swi teke xiave eka matsambukulu yo rhelela kusuka ePietermaritzburg kufika Durban.

src: We congratulate Tete Dijana and Gerda Steyn for not only winning the men’s and women’s races respectively, but also for breaking the down-run records for both the men and women races.
tgt: Hi hoyozela Tete Dijana na Gerda Steyn kungari eka ku hlula ntsena misayano ya vavanuna na ya vavasati hi ku hambana ka vona, kambe na ku tlhela va tshova tirhekodo to rhelela eka havumbirhi bya misiyano ya vavanuna na ya vavasati.

src: A special mention is also reserved for Limpopo resident Ntate Johannes Mosehla who, at the age of 81, became the oldest person to complete the Comrades.
tgt: Ku vuriwa ko hlawuleka ku tlhela ku hlayiseriwa mutshami wa le Limpopo Tatana Johannes Mosehla loyi, eka malembe ya 81 hi vukhale, a veke munhu wa khale kutlula hinkwavo ku heta Comrades.

src: In Youth Month, South Africans of all ages can learn the value and benefit of a healthy lifestyle from this very senior citizen.
tgt: Hi N'hweti ya Vantshwa, vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga va malembe hinkwawo hi vukhale va nga dyondza nkoka na ku vuyeriwa hi hanyelo leri nga na rihanyo kusuka eka mudyuhari lonkulu swonghasi.

src: Cabinet also commends Nomhle Ngwenya for becoming the youngest and first black woman to obtain a PhD from the science faculty at Wits at just 25 years old.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela Nomhle Ngwenya ku va a ri wansati wa wantima lotsongo eka hinkwavo ku va wo sungula ku kuma PhD ku suka eka fakhalithi ya sayense ya Wits a ri na 25 wa malembe ntsena hi vukhale.

src: Ms P Khoza who was elected the President of the 42st ICAO Assembly that took place from 27 September to 7 October 2022 in Montreal, Canada Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Member of Parliament, Ms Tina Joemat-Pettersson, who was the Chairperson of the National Assembly Portfolio Committee on Police, and previously served as Minister of Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries and Minister of Energy.
tgt: Mhn P Khoza loyi a hlawuriweke tanihi Phuresidente wa Huvo ya ICAO ya 42 leyi yi veke kona kusuka 27 Ndzati ku fika 7 Nhlangula eMontreal, Canada Michavelelo Khabinete yi hundzise michavelelo ya yona eka ndyangu na vanghana va: Xirho xa Palamende, Mhn Tina Joemat-Pettersson, loyi a ri Mutshamaxitulu wa Komiti ya Photifoliyo ya Huvo ya Rixaka hi mayelana na Maphorisa, naswona loyi eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza a tirha tanihi Holobye wa Vurimi, Swihlahla, na Tinhlampfi na Holobye wa Eneji.

src: She also served as an MEC for Education in the Northern Cape.
tgt: U tlhele a tirha tanihi MEC wa Dyondzo eKapa-N'walungu.

src: She was also a member of the National Executive Committee of the African National Congress (ANC) and ANC Women’s League.
tgt: U tlhele a va xirho xa Komiti ya Vurhangerinkulu ya Rixaka ya African National Congress (ANC) na Ligi ya Vavasati ya ANMugingirikeli wo lwela ntshunxeko wa United Democratic Front.

src: Cabinet welcomed the improvement in Eskom’s Energy Availability Factor, which is now closer to 70%.
tgt: IMiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni Ezamandla IKhabhinethi iyamkele inkqubela yoMba wokuFumaneka koMbane kwa-Eskom, ngoku isondele kuma-70%.

src: About 400 megawatts (MW) have been added to the grid and planned maintenance has improved in a short space of time.
tgt: Malunga neemegawathi ezingama-400 (i-MW) zongezwe kuthungelwano lombane kwaye ugcino olucwangcisiweyo luye lwaphucuka ngethutyana elifutshane.

src: Cabinet also noted the decision by the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment’s National Air Quality Officer to grant Eskom a postponement to meet the Minimum Emission Standards at the Kusile Power Station in Mpumalanga, subject to certain strict conditions.
tgt: Kwakhona iKhabhinethi yaqaphela ukuba isigqibo seGosa leSizwe elijonge ukuCoceka koMoya leSebe lezaMahlathi, ezokuLoba kunye nokusiNgqongileyo sokunika u-Eskom elinye ithuba lokuhlangabezana neMithetho yokuKhutshelwa kweGesi eMoyeni kwiSikhululo soMbane iKusile eMpumalanga, ngokulawulwa yimiqathango engqongqo ethile.

src: The postponement will allow Eskom to carry out repairs on the stack that was damaged on 23 October 2022.
tgt: Oku kuhlehliswa kuza kuvumela u-Eskom ukuba aqhube nokulungisa isakhelo esonakele ngomhla wama-23 kweyeDwarha 2022.

src: The power utility will also construct three temporary stacks that are expected to return 2 100 MW of power to the national grid and reduce load-shedding by two levels.
tgt: Iziko lombane liza kwakha kwakhona izakhelo zexeshana ezintathu ekulindeleke ukuba zibuyisele i-2 100 MW yombane kuthungelwano lombane lwesizwe kunye nokunciphisa ukucinywa kombane ngamanqanaba amabini.

src: Cabinet reiterated that government is committed to the Just Energy Transition (JET) and determined to mitigate the impact of climate change.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yagxininisa ukuba urhulumente uzibophelele kwiNguqu yezaMandla (i-JET) kwaye uzimisele ukuthomalalisa ifuthe lokutshintsha kwemozulu.

src: The JET, which was established in 2020, aims to achieve “Net Zero” carbon emissions by 2050.
tgt: I-JET, eyasekwa ngonyaka wama-2020, ijolise ekuphumezeni ukukhutshwa kwekhabhoni "ye-Net Zero" ngonyaka wama-2050.

src: Cabinet thanked South Africans who continue to use electricity sparingly, especially during peak times.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela abemi boMzantsi Afrika abaqhubekayo nokusebenzisa umbane ngononophelo, ngakumbi ngamaxesha aphezulu.

src: Our combined energy efforts have helped bring about lower stages of load-shedding.
tgt: Iinzame zethu zamandla ezidityanisiweyo ziye zanceda ukuzisa amanqanaba asezantsi okucinywa kombane.

src: Cabinet further welcomed the commitments made at the New Global Financing Pact Summit held in Paris, France from 22 to 23 June 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi kwakhona yamkela ukuzibophelela okwenziwe kwiNgqungquthela yesiVumelwano esiTsha seMali yeHlabathi eyayibanjelwe e-Paris, eFransi ukususela kumhla wama-22 ukuya kowama-23 kweyeSilimela 2023.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa attended the summit, which aimed to build a new contract between the North and the South to help address issues of climate change, development and debt.
tgt: UMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa wayizimasa lo ngqungquthela, eyayijolise ekwakheni ikontraki entsha phakathi koMntla kunye noMzantsi ukunceda ukushukuxa imiba yokutshintsha kwemozulu, uphuhliso kunye netyala.

src: Severe weather conditions.
tgt: Iimeko ezimandla zemozulu.

src: Cabinet expressed appreciation to Provincial Disaster Management teams for their quick response in assisting communities affected by the recent floods in KwaZulu-Natal and Northern Cape.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise umbulelo kumaqela oLawulo lweNtlekele kwiPhondo ngokukhawulezisa ekuncedeni uluntu oluchatshazelwe zizikhukula kutsha nje KwaZulu-Natala naseMntla Koloni.

src: We are all deeply saddened by the loss of lives in KwaZulu-Natal, and express our condolences to the families and friends of those who lost their lives.
tgt: Sonke sibuhlungu ngokusweleka kwabantu KwaZulu-Natala, kwaye sivakalisa uvelwano kwiintsapho nezihlobo zabo bathe baphulukana nobomi babo.

src: The road infrastructure, electricity supply, sewer systems and houses in affected areas in KwaZulu-Natal have been extensively damaged while roads in some parts of the Northern Cape have suffered structural damage.
tgt: Iziseko ezingundoqo zeendlela, unikezelo lombane, iinkqubo zogutyulo lwelindle kunye nezindlu kwiindawo ezichaphazelekayo KwaZulu-Natala zonakaliswe kakhulu ngelixa iindlela kwezinye iindawo zoMntla Koloni ziye zonakala.

src: Government and humanitarian organisations continue to provide immediate relief supplies to the affected communities in KwaZulu-Natal, including food parcels, blankets, plastic sheeting and emergency boxes.
tgt: Urhulumente kunye nemibutho yoncedo iyaqhubeka nokubonelela ngoncedo olukhawulezileyo kuluntu oluchaphazelekileyo KwaZulu-Natala, kuquka iipasile zokutya, iingubo zokulala, iingubo zeplasitiki kunye neebhokisi zikaxakeka.

src: Eskom and municipal electrical departments have also been activated to restore power to affected areas.
tgt: U-Eskom kunye namasebe ombane kamasipala nawo avuliwe ukuze kubuyiselwe umbane kwiindawo ezichaphazelekayo.

src: Joint Working Visit to the Netherlands and Denmark.
tgt: Utyelelo lokuSebenza ebeliQhutywe ngokuBambisana yi-Netherlands ne-Denmark IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uTyelelo lokuSebenza ngokuManyeneyo olube yimpumelelo phakathi kweNkulumbuso yase-Netherlands, uMnu Mark Rutte kunye neNkulumbuso yase-Denmark, uNks Mette Frederiksen oluqinise ubudlelwane boMzantsi Afrika nala mazwe mabini kwimiba yehaydrojini engenabungozi kokusingqongileyo, amandla ahlaziyekayo kunye ne-JEUtyelelo kwakhona lwazisa iqela labatyali-mali eMzantsi Afrika ukuqinisa amanqanaba aphezulu entsebenziswano kunye nobudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwelizwe kunye namaqabane amabini abalulekileyo aseYurophu.

src: Cabinet welcomed the successful Joint Working Visit between the Prime Minister of the Netherlands, Mr Mark Rutte and Prime Minister of Denmark, Ms Mette Frederiksen that solidified South Africa’s relationship with the two countries in the areas of green hydrogen, renewable energy and the JEThe visit also brought a group of investors to South Africa to reinforce the high levels of cooperation and good relations between the country and the two important European partners.
tgt: Ngexesha leengxoxo ezisemthethweni ezidibeneyo, isiVumelwano sokuSebenzisana kuMmandla weHaydrojini Engenabungozi kokusiNgqongileyo satyikitywa phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Netherlands, ngelixa isivumelwano phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Denmark malunga neNtsebenziswano yoPhuhliso enxulumene neNkqubo yeNtsebenziswano yezaMandla yonyaka wama-2017 salungiswa.

src: During the joint official talks, a Memorandum of Understanding in the Field of Green Hydrogen was signed between South Africa and the Netherlands, while an agreement between South Africa and Denmark regarding Development Cooperation concerning the Energy Partnership Programme of 2017 was amended.
tgt: Imbizo kaMongameli yeNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweZithili yaKwaZulu-Natala (i-DDM) UMongameli Ramaphosa, edibene neenkokheli eziphuma kuwo omathathu amanqanaba oburhulumente (kuzwelonke, kwiphondo nakwingingqi), bathabathe iMbizo kaMongameli yesiXhenxe ye-DDM yoLawulo lweSithandathu ngoLwesihlanu, umhla wama-30 kweyeSilimela 2023 kuMasipala weSithili uThukela KwaZulu-Natala.

src: Government leaders used this opportunity to interact with residents on service-delivery challenges and plans for the development of the district.
tgt: Iinkokheli zikarhulumente zisebenzise eli thuba ukunxibelelana nabahlali ngemingeni yonikezelo lweenkonzo kunye nezicwangciso zophuhliso lwesithili.

src: Cabinet called on residents to play an active role in determining the future of their communities by participating in the DDM Presidential Imbizo programme.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icele abahlali ukuba badlale indima ebonakalayo ekumiseleni ikamva loluntu lwabo ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo ye-DDM yeeMbizo zikaMongameli.

src: All citizens are urged to play a role in the development of their communities by being active citizens.
tgt: Bonke abemi bayabongozwa ukuba badlale indima kuphuhliso loluntu lwabo ngokuba ngabemi abakhutheleyo.

src: By working together, we can identify issues of concern and unblock impediments to integrated service delivery.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisana, sinokubona imiba exhalabisayo kwaye sivule imiqobo ekunikezelweni kweenkonzo okuhlangeneyo.

src: Cabinet reflected on the latest Quarterly Employment Statistics released by Statistics South Africa (Stats SA) that showed a decrease in employment in various sectors and gains in others.
tgt: Uqoqosho IKhabhinethi icinge ngeeNkcukacha-manani zeKota zamva nje ezikhutshwe liZiko leeNkcukacha-manani loMzantsi Afrika (i-Stats SA) ezibonise ukuhla kwengqesho kumacandelo ahlukeneyo kunye neenzuzo kwamanye.

src: Although growth remains subdued, our resilient economy continues to create jobs, even though not at the preferred pace.
tgt: Nangona ukukhula kuhleli kuthotyiwe, uqoqosho lwethu oluzinzileyo luyaqhubeka nokudala imisebenzi, nangona lungekho ngesantya esisifunayo.

src: Interventions such as the Presidential Employment Stimulus programme are helping to turn the tide.
tgt: Ungenelelo olufana nenkqubo kaMongameli yoVuselelo lweNgqesho luyanceda ukuguqula imeko.

src: Cabinet is encouraged that by March 2023, more than 1, 2 million people had directly benefited from the programme since its inception in 2020.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthazekile ukuba kwinyanga yoKwindla 2023, bangaphezu kwesigidi esi-1.2 abantu abathe baxhamla ngokuthe ngqo kule nkqubo ukususela oko yathi yasekwa ngonyaka wama-2020.

src: So far, about 800 000 short-term jobs, mostly for young people, have been created in the critical areas of education, early childhood development and community safety.
tgt: Ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, malunga nama-800 000 emisebenzi yexeshana elifutshane, ingakumbi elungiselelwe ulutsha, edalwe kwimimandla ebalulekileyo, kwezemfundo, uphuhliso lwabantwana abaselula nokhuseleko loluntu.

src: The programme has ensured that many vulnerable South Africans participate in meaningful work and receive a stable income.
tgt: Le nkqubo iqinisekise ukuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika abaninzi abasesichengeni bathatha inxaxheba kumsebenzi onentsingiselo kwaye bafumana umvuzo ozinzileyo.

src: It has helped ease the economic hardships of thousands of families.
tgt: Iye yanceda ekuthomalaliseni ubunzima bezoqoqosho kumawakawaka eentsapho.

src: Cabinet further welcomed a joint declaration of intent to establish the South African-German Hydrogen Task Force, which was signed by the Minister in The Presidency responsible for Electricity, Dr Kgosientsho Ramokgopa and German Vice Chancellor Robert Habeck.
tgt: IHaydrojini Engenabungozi kokusiNgqongileyo IKhabhinethi iphinde yasamkela isibhengezo esihlangeneyo senjongo yokuseka uMbutho waBasebenzi beHaydrojini eMzantsi Afrika naseJamani, esatyikitywa nguMphathiswa okwi-Ofisi kaMongameli ojongene noMbane, uGq Kgosientsho Ramokgopa kunye noSekela-Tshansela waseJamani u-Robert Habeck.

src: The task force will look at how the green hydrogen market will be created and developed, as well as create business-to-business opportunities between the two countries.
tgt: Umbutho wabasebenzi uza kujonga indlela imakhethi yehaydrojini engenabungozi kokusingqongileyo eya kwenziwa ngayo kwaye iphuhliswe, kunye nokudala amathuba oshishino ukuya kumashishini phakathi kwamazwe amabini.

src: Green hydrogen is generated by renewable energy and it has significantly lower carbon emissions than traditional hydrogen.
tgt: Ihaydrojini engenabungozi kokusingqongileyo iveliswa ngamandla ahlaziyekayo kwaye inokukhutshwa kwekhabhoni esezantsi kakhulu kunehaydrojini yemveli.

src: Government has already created plans for a Hydrogen Valley, which is expected to run from Limpopo, through Johannesburg, to Durban.
tgt: Urhulumente sele equlunqe izicwangciso zenkqubo ye-Hydrogen Valley, ekulindeleke ukuba iqale eLimpopo, inqumle eRhawutini, iye kutsho eThekwini.

src: The valley will establish opportunities for projects that will kick-start hydrogen initiatives in hubs with the aim of boosting economic growth and job creation.
tgt: Le nkqubo iza kuseka amathuba eeprojekthi eziya kuqalisa amaphulo ehaydrojini kwiindawo zokuhlala ngenjongo yokukhulisa uqoqosho nokudalwa kwemisebenzi.

src: Southern African Customs Union (SACU) Heads of State and Government Summit.
tgt: INgqungquthela yeeNtloko zeMibuso noRhulumente woMbutho woRhwebo e-Afrika eseMazantsi (i-SACU).

src: Cabinet noted President Ramaphosa’s Working Visit to the 8th SACU Heads of State and Government Summit held in the Kingdom of Eswatini on Thursday, 29 June 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluqaphele uTyelelo loMsebenzi lukaMongameli u-Ramaphosa oluya kwiNgqungquthela yeSibhozo yeeNtloko zeMibuso nooRhulumente ye-SACU ebibanjelwe eBukhosini baseSwatini ngoLwesine, umhla wama-29 kweyeSilimela 2023.

src: Founded in 1910, SACU is the oldest Customs Union in the world.
tgt: I-SACU eyasekwa ngo-1910, yeyona Manyano yezoRhwebo endala ehlabathini.

src: The summit deliberated and provided updates on the status of the implementation of the SACU Strategic Plan 2022 – 2027.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela yaxoxa yaza yanikezela ngohlaziyo ngobume bokuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga se-SACU sonyaka wama-2022 ukuya kowama-2027.

src: The SACU Strategic Plan was adopted in June 2022 as a roadmap to deepen regional integration in the Customs Union and forge stronger ties among the five member states as well as take advantage of opportunities presented by the African Continental Free Trade Area.
tgt: IsiCwangciso-qhinga se-SACU samkelwa ngenyanga yeSilimela ngonyaka wama-2022 njengomgaqo wokwenza nzulu ukudityaniswa kommandla kuManyano yezoRhwebo kunye nokwakha ubudlelwane obuluqilima phakathi kwamazwe amahlanu angamalungu kwakunye nokusebenzisa amathuba aveliswe ngukuRhwebelana koMmandla we-Afrika okungaHlawulisi iRhafu.

src: Cabinet is concerned about the practice of illegal mining and government is taking measures to end it through the National Coordination and Strategic Management Team (NCSMT).
tgt: Ukwembiwa kwemigodi IKhabhinethi inenkxalabo ngomkhwa wokwembiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kwaye urhulumente uthatha amanyathelo okuwuphelisa esebenzisa i-National Coordination and Strategic Management Team (i-NCSMT).

src: The NCSMT seeks to coordinate government’s efforts to combat illegal mining and the trafficking of precious metals.
tgt: I-NCSMT ijonge ukulungelelanisa iinzame zikarhulumente zokulwa nokwembiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kunye nokurhweba ngezimbiwa zexabiso.

src: Illegal mining and trafficking of precious metals are harming our economy, and have a negative impact on the safety and health of surrounding communities.
tgt: Ukwembiwa kwesinyithi kunye nokurhweba ngokungekho mthethweni kuyalonakalisa uqoqosho lwethu, kwaye kunempembelelo embi kukhuseleko nempilo yoluntu.

src: Cabinet reiterated that violence is not a solution to community problems and called on communities to use existing channels to address their concerns.
tgt: Uqhankqalazo loluntu IKhabhinethi iphinde yathi ubundlobongela ayisosisombululo kwiingxaki zoluntu kwaye icela uluntu ukuba lusebenzise imijelo esele ikhona ukusombulula iingxaki zalo.

src: A Ministerial Task Team has been deployed to Diepsloot in Gauteng to work with community leaders to address their issues of concern.
tgt: IGqiza laBaphathiswa eliSebenzayo lithe latyalwa e-Diepsloot e- Gauteng ukuze lisebenze neenkokheli zabahlali ukulungisa imiba ebaxhalabisayo.

src: Cabinet called on the community of Diepsloot and other areas to work with government, local councillors and the police to resolve issues such as crime.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icele abahlali base-Diepsloot kunye nezinye iindawo ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente, ooceba basekuhlaleni kunye namapolisa ukusombulula imiba efana nolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Draft Country Investment Strategy (CIS) Cabinet has approved South Africa’s draft CIS for implementation.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi UYilo lwesiCwangciso soTyalo-mali seLizwe (i-CIS) IKhabhinethi iluvumile uyilo loMzantsi Afrika lwe-CIS ukuba luphunyezwe.

src: The CIS, which was published for public comments in 2022, seeks to position the country as a key African investment destination of choice by leveraging quality foreign and domestic direct investments.
tgt: I-CIS, eyapapashwa ngonyaka wama-2022 ukuze uluntu luhlomle ngalo, ifuna ukubeka eli lizwe njengendawo ephambili ekhethwayo yotyalo-mali e-Afrika ngokunyusa umgangatho wotyalo-mali oluthe ngqo lwangaphandle nolwasekhaya.

src: The strategy is anchored on the country’s priority investment and economic development goals such as increasing employment, decreasing poverty, and supporting a just transition to a low carbon economy and energy security.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sisekelwe kutyalo-mali oluphambili lwelizwe kunye neenjongo zophuhliso loqoqosho ezifana nokwanda kwengqesho, ukunciphisa intlupheko, kunye nokuxhasa utshintsho olunobulungisa kuqoqosho lwekhabhoni ephantsi kunye nokhuseleko lwamandla.

src: It provides investment mechanisms to attract small, medium and micro enterprises into the pursuit of economic growth, especially the green economy.
tgt: Sibonelela ngeendlela zotyalo-mali ukutsala amashishini amancinci, aphakathi kunye nasakhasayo kwiphulo lohlumo loqoqosho, ngakumbi ukutshintshela kuqoqosho olungenabungozi kokusingqongileyo.

src: The strategy also taps into a number of multilateral, regional and bilateral agreements signed by South Africa.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sikwachaphazela inani lezivumelwano zamazwe ngamazwe, zommandla kunye namazwe amabini atyikitywe nguMzantsi Afrika.

src: The strategy is aligned to the goals of the National Development Plan on economic transformation and the recently adopted National Infrastructure Plan 2050.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso silungelelaniswe neenjongo zesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe malunga nenguqu kwezoqoqosho kunye nesiCwangciso seZiseko ezinguNdoqo seSizwe sonyaka wama-2050 esamkelwe kutshanje.

src: The country’s provinces and their metropolitan municipalities will be central in driving the strategy, which will be constantly adapted to the changing economic environment.
tgt: Amaphondo esizwe kunye noomasipala bawo abambaxa aza kuba sembindini ekuqhubeni esi sicwangciso, esiya kuthi rhoqo silungelelaniswe kwimeko yezoqoqosho eguqukayo.

src: Third periodic country report under International Convention against Torture and other Cruel and, Inhuman or Degrading Treatments or Punishment (CAT).
tgt: Ingxelo yelizwe yesithathu phantsi kwesiVumelwano seZizwe ngezizwe esichasene neNtuthumbo kunye nezinye iiNkohlakalo kunye neMpatho engenabuntu okanye iSohlwayo (i-CAT).

src: Cabinet has approved the submission of South Africa’s third CAT periodic report to the United Nations (UN) Secretary-General.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa kwengxelo yesithathu ye-CAT yoMzantsi Afrika kuNobhala-Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN).

src: The report outlines the measures that South Africa is taking to prevent the torture and ill-treatment of citizens.
tgt: Ingxelo ichaza amanyathelo athathwa nguMzantsi Afrika ukuthintela ukungcungcuthekiswa kunye nokuphathwa kakubi kwabemi.

src: South Africa signed the Convention in 2000 and ratified it in 2008.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika utyikitye isiVumelwano ngonyaka wama-2000 waza ngonyaka wama-2008 wasiqinisekisa.

src: In accordance with Article 17 of the Optional Protocol to the CAT, one of the obligations imposed on State Parties is to establish domestic mechanisms for the prevention of torture known as the National Preventive Mechanism.
tgt: Ngokuhambelana neNqaku le-17 loMthetho wokuZiphatha ongaNyanzelisiyo (i-Optional Protocol) kwi-CAT, enye yezibophelelo ezinyanzeliswe kumaQela kaRhulumente kukuseka iindlela zasekhaya zokuthintela intuthumbo eyaziwa ngokuba yiNkqubo yoThintelo yeSizwe.

src: Over the past 29 years, the democratic government in South Africa has removed old apartheid laws and institutions, built new democratic institutions, and initiated laws based on constitutional rights and freedoms.
tgt: Kule minyaka ingama-29 idlulileyo, urhulumente wentando yesininzi eMzantsi Afrika uye wayisusa imithetho namaziko amadala ocalu-calulo, wakha amaziko amatsha entando yesininzi, waza wasungula imithetho esekelwe kumalungelo omgaqo-siseko kunye nenkululeko.

src: Members of the public are able to report allegations of torture and ill-treatment to the Independent Police Investigative Directorate directly for investigation.
tgt: Uluntu luyakwazi ukuxela izityholo zokungcungcuthekiswa kunye nempatho-mbi kwiCandelo loPhando lwaMapolisa eliZimeleyo ukuze ziphandwe.

src: South Africa also has a well-functioning Human Rights Commission, a national institution established to support constitutional democracy.
tgt: Kwakhona uMzantsi Afrika ukwaneKomishoni yamaLungelo oLuntu esebenza kakuhle, iziko lesizwe elimiselwe ukuxhasa intando yesininzi yomgaqo-siseko.

src: Appointments All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearances.
tgt: Izikhundla Zonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Ms Ntomboxolo Mbengashe as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Post Bank South Africa for a period of five years.
tgt: UNks Ntomboxolo Mbengashe njengeGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba (i-CEO) yeBhanki yePosi yoMzantsi Afrika ixesha leminyaka emihlanu.

src: Mr Sibusiso Bukhosini as CEO of Isimangaliso Wetland Park Authority (reappointment).
tgt: UMnu Sibusiso Bukhosini njengeGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba ye-Isimangaliso Wetland Park Authority (uqeshiwe kwakhona).UNks Tamlyn Bouwer njengeGosa eliPhethe i-Ofisi yeMali yeBhunga leSizwe lokuBhalisa abaKhi bezindlu.

src: Ms Tamlyn Bouwer as Chief Financial Officer of the National Home Builders Registration Council.
tgt: UMnu Morongwa Calvin Molongoana njengoSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele (u-DDG): kwicandelo le-Statistics Support and Informatics kwiZiko leeNkcukacha-manani loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Mr Morongwa Calvin Molongoana as Deputy Director-General (DDG): Statistical Support and Informatics at Stats SMs Daphne Yandiswa Morudu as DDG: South African National Statistics System at Stats SMr Rory Gallocher as Chief Operations Officer in The Presidency.
tgt: UNks Daphne Yandiswa Morudu njengo-DDG: INkqubo yeeNkcukacha-manani yeSizwe yaseMzantsi Afrika kwiZiko leeNkcukacha-manani loMzantsi Afrika UMnu Rory Gallocher njengeGosa eliPhezulu leMisebenzi kuBongameli.

src: Draft Companies Amendment Bill of 2023 Cabinet approved the submission of the draft Companies Amendment Bill of 2023 to Parliament for processing.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo wonyaka wama-2023 weeNkampani IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weeNkampani wonyaka wama-2023 ukuze uqwalaselwe.

src: The proposals in the Bill aim to reduce regulatory and administrative burdens to business owners and will enhance South Africa’s attractiveness to potential investors.
tgt: Izindululo ezikulo Mthetho uYilwayo zijolise ekunciphiseni umthwalo wommiselo nowolawulo kubanini bamashishini kwaye ziza kukhulisa umtsalane woMzantsi Afrika kwabo banokuba ngabatyali-zimali.

src: Most of the amendments were technical in nature, and were concerned with streamlining and clarifying administrative issues.
tgt: Uninzi lwezihlomelo bezinobugcisa ngokwendalo, kwaye bezijongene nohlenga-hlengiso kunye nokucacisa imiba yolawulo.

src: One of the key priorities of this democratic government is job creation and this cannot be achieved if the ease of doing business in South Africa is not addressed.
tgt: Enye yezinto ezingundoqo eziphambili kulo rhulumente wentando yesininzi kukudala imisebenzi kwaye oku akunakufezekiswa ukuba ukukhululeka kokwenza ushishino eMzantsi Afrika akushukuxwa.

src: The amendments also provide more clarity on a number of clauses in the Bill, which seek to reduce the regulatory regime on businesses tighten anti-money laundering gaps strengthen the disclosure requirements and enhance the shareholder powers in a company.
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo zikwanika ingcaciso ethe kratya kwinani lamagatya akulo Mthetho uYilwayo, zifuna ukunciphisa inkqubo yommiselo kumashishini ziqinisa izikhewu ezichasene nokuthutyeleziswa kwemali ukomeleza iimfuno zokubhengeza kunye nokwandisa amagunya abanini-zabelo kwinkampani.

src: Excessive remuneration, particularly at the highest levels of a company, is a matter of great concern internationally and in South Africa.
tgt: Umvuzo ogqithisileyo, ngakumbi kumanqanaba aphezulu enkampani, ngumcimbi oxhalabisa kakhulu kumazwe ngamazwe kunye nalapha eMzantsi Afrika.

src: The amendments in the Bill will promote transparency and clarify responsibilities between directors and senior management on the one hand, and shareholders on the other, as well as address public concerns regarding high levels of inequalities in society.
tgt: zihlomelo ezikulo Mthetho uYilwayo ziza kukhuthaza ukwenziwa kwezinto elubala kwaye zicacise uxanduva phakathi kwabalawuli nabaphathi abaphezulu kwelinye icala, nabanini-zabelo kwelinye, kunye nokulungisa iinkxalabo zoluntu malunga namazinga aphezulu okungalingani eluntwini.

src: Intergovernmental Monitoring, Support and Interventions (IMSI) Bill of 2022 Cabinet approved the publication of the draft IMSI Bill of 2022 for public comments.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo wonyaka wama-2022 wokuBeka esweni, iNkxaso kunye namaNgenelelo kuRhulumente (i-IMSI) IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koyilo loMthetho oYilwayo we-IMSI wonyaka wama-2022 ukuze uluntu luveze izimvo zalo.

src: The Bill will be used as a remedy to many challenges experienced when government invokes sections 100 and 139 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 when compelled to do so due to failures in some spheres of government.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kusetyenziswa njengesisombululo kwimingeni emininzi efunyenwe xa urhulumente ebesebenzisa icandelo le-100 nele-139 loMgaqo-siseko weRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika yonyaka we-1996 xa kunyanzeleke ukuba enze njalo ngenxa yokusilela kwamanye amacandelo karhulumente.

src: Section 100 empowers government to intervene if a province fails to meet its administrative and service-delivery obligations while Section 139 empowers the provincial executive to intervene if a municipality does not fulfil an obligation in terms of the Constitution or legislation.
tgt: ICandelo le-100 lixhobisa urhulumente ukuba angenelele ukuba iphondo liyasilela ukuhlangabezana nezibophelelo zalo zolawulo nonikezelo lweenkonzo ngelixa iCandelo le-139 lixhobisa isigqeba sephondo esinolawulo oluphezulu ukuba singenelele ukuba umasipala akalufezi uxanduva ngokoMgaqo-siseko okanye ngokomthetho.

src: The IMSI Bill is introduced as the regulatory instrument to address challenges on enforcing Section 139, monitoring and evaluation, and the impact of interventions.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo we-IMSI waziswa njengesixhobo sokulawula ukujongana nemingeni ekunyanzeliseni iCandelo le-139, ukubeka iliso novavanyo, kunye nefuthe longenelelo.

src: The Bill will regulate the implementation of Section 139 of the Constitution, including the relevant processes.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uya kulawula ukuphunyezwa kweCandelo le-139 loMgaqo-siseko, kuquka neenkqubo ezifanelekileyo.

src: It will provide for targeted support to municipalities in need of assistance, and also provide for the monitoring of municipalities to fulfil their executive obligations in terms of the Constitution or legislation.
tgt: Uza kubonelela ngenkxaso ekujoliswe kuyo koomasipala abafuna uncedo, kwaye ukwabonelela ngokubeka iliso koomasipala ukuze bafezekise izibophelelo zabo zolawulo ngokoMgaqo-siseko okanye ngokomthetho.

src: Cabinet reminds everyone that the 2023 tax filing season will open on Friday, 7 July 2023 and run until 23 October 2023.
tgt: Imisitho Ezayo Ixesha leRhafu IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza wonke umntu ukuba ixesha lokufakwa kwerhafu lonyaka wama-2023 liza kuvulwa ngoLwesihlanu, umhla wesi-7 kweyeKhala 2023 liqhube kude kube ngumhla wama-23 kweyeDwarha 2023.

src: Taxpayers are encouraged to file their returns on eFiling or on the South African Revenue Service (SARS) MobiApp.
tgt: Abahlawuli berhafu bayakhuthazwa ukuba bafake iingxelo zabo kwi-eFiling okanye kwi-MobiApp yeNkonzo yeRhafu yoMzantsi Afrika (u-SARS).

src: The tax-filing process is now even simpler and SARS will continue with auto-assessments this year.
tgt: Inkqubo yokufakwa kwerhafu ngoku ilula ngakumbi kwaye u-SARS uza kuqhubeka novavanyo oluzenzekelayo kulo nyaka.

src: Between 1 and 7 July 2023, taxpayers are being notified by SMS or email if they had been selected to receive an auto-assessment.
tgt: Phakathi komhla woku-1 kunye nowe-7 kweyeKhala 2023, abahlawuli berhafu baza kwaziswa nge-SMS okan nge-imeyile ukuba bakhethelwe ukufumana uvavanyo oluzenzekelayo.

src: Should you receive the SMS, the next step for you would be to review the auto-assessment on the SARS MobiApp or eFiling.
tgt: Ukuba uthe wayifumana i-SMS, inyathelo elilandelayo lakho liya kuba kukuhlola uvavanyo oluzenzekelayo kwi-MobiApp yakwa-SARS okanye kwi-eFiling.

src: If you agree with the auto-assessment, you do not have to do anything.

src: Transforming MENtalities Summit 2023.
tgt: Transforming MENtalities Summit 2023.

src: The recently concluded Transforming MENtalities Summit has left an indelible mark on 1500 attendees, with its powerful engagement and insightful discussions poised to pave the way for transformation needs for men and boy behavior.
tgt: The recently concluded Transforming MENtalities Summit has left an indelible mark on 1500 attendees, with its powerful engagement and insightful discussions poised to pave the way for transformation needs for men and boy behavior.

src: Held at the Birchwood Hotel and OR Tambo Conference Centre, the summit brought together University Vice-Chancellors, Deans, Principals and Council Chairpersons of TVET Colleges, Student Support Structures and Leadership, CEOs of SETAs, entities of the Departments of Higher Education and Science and Innovation, policymakers, survivors, peer educators, and change-makers, all unified by a shared commitment to addressing Gender-Based Violence (GBV) within the Post-School Education and Training (PSET) sector.
tgt: Held at the Birchwood Hotel and OR Tambo Conference Centre, the summit brought together University Vice-Chancellors, Deans, Principals and Council Chairpersons of TVET Colleges, Student Support Structures and Leadership, CEOs of SETAs, entities of the Departments of Higher Education and Science and Innovation, policymakers, survivors, peer educators, and change-makers, all unified by a shared commitment to addressing Gender-Based Violence (GBV) within the Post-School Education and Training (PSET) sector.

src: The Summit was hosted by HIGHER HEALTH and the Human Science Research Council (HSRC) on behalf of the Department of Higher Education and Training and the Department of Science and Innovation.
tgt: The Summit was hosted by HIGHER HEALTH and the Human Science Research Council (HSRC) on behalf of the Department of Higher Education and Training and the Department of Science and Innovation.

src: The aim was to engage the sector leadership, on transforming mentalities and address the root causes of GBEvidence and data suggest that men behavior has been one of the root causes of GBV and the Summit called for action for men and boys towards being part of the solution.

src: The summit asked for the development of more peer educators and champions across all our campuses, to work as change agents towards transforming MENtalities, more men dialogues across all institutions, incorporating gender studies including GBV, gender equality, gender diversity and transforming MENtalities as co-curriculum alongside the main curriculum in the Post-School Education and Training (PSET) sector.

src: Western Cape Provincial Powers Bill.1 Cabinet was briefed about the unconstitutional draft Western Cape Provincial Powers Bill.2 The Draft Bill violates the provisions of Schedules 4 and 5 of the Constitution that set out powers and functions including concurrent powers of both the provincial and National executives.

src: Cabinet has noted that this draft Bill is an attempt to revert back to the Democratic Party’s (forerunner to the Democratic Alliance) preferred federal approach that seeks to undermine a United and inclusive South Africa.4 It is noteworthy that WC draft Bill ignores the exclusion from access to services of the large black communities of Khayelitsha, Gugulethu, Nyanga, Langa, the Cape Flats, Delft, Central Line, amongst others Cabinet has mandated the Ministers of Justice and COGTA to enter into discussions with the Western Cape provincial government in line with the relevant dispute resolution mechanisms as provided for in section 146 of the Constitution and the applicable intergovernmental framework.
