src: United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) Cabinet welcomed the address by President Cyril Ramaphosa at the 78th UNGA held in New York, United States of America from 18 to 26 September 2023.
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya Nhlangano wa Tinxaka wa Mani na mani (UNGA) Khabinete yi amukerile mbulavulo wa Presidente Cyril Ramaphosa eka UNGA ya vu 78 leyi a yi khomeriwe eNew York, United States of America ku sukela ti 18 ku fikela 26 Ndzati 2023.

src: The President’s widely welcomed address reaffirmed South Africa’s position in championing the interests, and equal and meaningful participation, of the African continent and the Global South in general at the UN and other multilateral forums.
tgt: Mbulavulo wa Presidente lowu amukeriweke hi vanhu votala wu tiyisisile xiyimo xa Afrika-Dzonga eka ku rhangela mitsakelo, ku nghenelela hi ku ringana no twisiseka ka tikonkulu ra Afrika na Global South (Matiko ya swifundza swa Afrika, Latin American na Caribbean) hi ku angarhela eka UN na tiforamu tin’wana ta matikonyingi.

src: The address also reaffirmed South Africa’s resoluteness in the mobilisation of support for:
tgt: Mbulavulo wu tlhele wu tiyisisa ku tiyimisela ka Afrika-Dzonga ko kuma nseketelo wa:

src: renewed commitment to multilateralism, based on clear rules and supported by effective institutions.
tgt: Ku tiyimisela loku pfuxetiweke ka vuhlanganisi bya matikonyingi, loku simekiweke eka milawu leyi nga erivaleni naswona yi seketeriwa hi mavandla lama tirhaka.

src: the reform of the UN Security Council (UNSC), to give meaning to the principle of the sovereign equality of nations and to enable the UNSC to respond more effectively to current geopolitical realities.
tgt: ku pfuxetiwa ka Huvo ya Vusirheleri ya UN (UNSC), ku nyika nhlamuselo eka nsinya wa nawu wa ku ringana ka vulawuri lebyi tiyimeleke bya tinxaka na ku endla leswaku UNSC yi kota ku hlamula hi ndlela leyinene eka ntiyiso wa nkarhi wa sweswi wa tipolitiki ta matiko ya misava.

src: wealthy nations to increase financial support to both implement the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and achieve their climate-change goals in a comprehensive and integrated manner, including the need to urgently operationalise the Loss and Damage Fund for vulnerable countries hit hard by climate disasters, as agreed at the 27th Session of the Conference of the Parties held in Egypt in November 2022.
tgt: Ku va matiko lama nga fuma ma engetela nseketelo wa timali eka haswimbirhi ku tirhisa Agenda ya Nhluvukiso lowu Tiyiselaka wa 2030 na ku fikelela swikongomelo swa wona swa ku cinca ka maxelo hi ndlela leyi twisisekaka no hlanganeriwa, ku katsa na xilaveko xo tirhisa Nkwama wa ku Lahlekeriwa na ku Onhaka hi xihatla eka matiko lama nga sirhelelekangiki lama hlaseriweke swinene hi timhangu ta maxelo, tanihilaha swi pfumelelaniweke hakona eka Sexini ya vu 27 ya Nhlengeletano ya Mavandla leyi khomeriweke eEgypt hi Hukuri 2022.

src: President Ramaphosa reaffirmed South Africa’s commitment to continue addressing climate change and positioning the country as a leader in renewable energy, green hydrogen and sustainable industrialisation.
tgt: Presidente Ramaphosa u tiyisisile ku tinyiketela ka Afrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni no lulamisa ku cinca ka maxelo na ku veka tiko tanihi murhangeri eka eneji leyi pfuxetiwaka, hayidirojeni ya rihlaza na vumaki bya tiindasitiri leti tiyiselaka.

src: President Ramaphosa also addressed the Advancing Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness and Response Summit, in his capacity as the African Union Champion for the Coronavirus Disease (COVID-19) Response.
tgt: President Ramaphosa u tlhele a vulavula na Samiti yo ya emahlweni na Nsivelo wa Ntungu, ku Tilulamisela na ku Hlamula, hi xiyimo xa yena tanihi Nghwazi ya Nhlangano wa Afrika wo Hlamula eka Mavabyi ya Xitsongwatsongwana xa Khorona (COVID-19).

src: South Africa’s bilateral programme on the sidelines of the 78th UNGA On the sidelines of the 78th UNGA, President Ramaphosa led a government delegation which held several bilateral meetings aimed at strengthening strategic, political, diplomatic and trade relations.
tgt: Nongonoko wa matiko mambirhi wa Afrika-Dzonga wa le tlhelo eka UNGA ya vu Etlhelo ka UNGA ya vu 78, Presidente Ramaphosa u rhangele vurhumiwa bya mfumo lebyi nga khoma tinhlengeletano to hlaya ta matiko mambirhi leti a ti kongomisiwe eka ku tiyisisa vuxaka bya maqhinga, tipolitiki, vudiplomati na mabindzu.

src: The President met with his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky to discuss progress being made on the African Peace Initiative-led confidence-building measures and other developments.

tgt: Presidente Emmerson Mnangagwa wa Rhiphabliki ra Zimbabwe, eka migingiriko ya mfumo wa Zimbabwe yo hlanganisa ku akiwa hi vuntshwa ka tiko leriya endzhaku ka nhlawulo lowa ha ku vaka kona lowu ku pfumelelaniweke hawona.4 President Ramaphosa u tlhele a nghenelela eka Nhlangeletano yo Tshama va Vulavula hi Bindzu ra Mabindzu na Vuvekisi ya United States (US)-Afrika-Dzonga, lowu a wu katsa varhangeri va Bindzu va Afrika-Dzonga na Amerika.

src: President Ramaphosa also participated in the United States (US)-South Africa Trade and Investment Business Roundtable, which included South African and American business leaders.
tgt: Laha ku nga na ku tlula 600 wa tikhamphani ta le US leti tirhaka eAfrika-Dzonga, ku nghenelela loku a ku ri ka nkoka swinene eka ku tiyisisiwa loku yaka emahlweni ka vuxaka exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na US.5 Hi nkarhi wa kona, ku nyikiwile xitiviso xa ximfumo xa leswaku Foramu ya Ntirhisano wa Mabindzu na Ikhonomi ya US na Matiko ya Afrika ya le Dzongeni wa Sahara ya vu 20, (Foramu ya AGOA) yi ta va kona eJoni ku sukela hi ti 2 ku fikela hi ti 4 Hukuri 2023.

src: With more than 600 US companies operating from South Africa, this engagement was critical in the ongoing strengthening of relations between South Africa and the UDuring the period, a formal announcement was made that the 20th US-Sub-Saharan Africa Trade and Economic Cooperation Forum, (AGOA Forum) will take place in Johannesburg from 2 to 4 November 2023.
tgt: Foramu yi ta tlhela yi va na ‘Nkombiso wa swi Endliwile eAfrika’ lowu nga ta kombisa nkoka lowu endliwaka hi xifundza eka tikonkulu.6 President Ramaphosa u tlhele a vona ku tivisiwa ka ntirhisano exikarhi ka Novo Nordisk na Aspen.

src: The forum will also feature the ‘Made in Africa Exhibition’ that will showcase regional value chains on the continent.
tgt: Ntirhisano wu ta vona vuhumelerisi bya insulin eka switirhisiwa swa Aspen’s eGqeberha, Eastern Cape.

src: The collaboration aims to supply over 16 million doses of insulin in 2024, which will be up scaled by 2026.
tgt: Ntirhisano lowu wu kongomisa eka ku phakela ku tlula 16 wa timiliyoni ta tidoseji ta insulin hi 2024, leyi nga ta tlakusiwa hi 2026.

src: This will significantly enhance access to insulin treatment not just in South Africa, but also across the continent.
tgt: Leswi swi ta ndlandlamuxa swinene ku fikeleriwa ka vutshunguri bya insulin ku nga ri eAfrika-Dzonga ntsena, kambe na le ka tikonkulu hinkwaro.

src: Energy.
tgt: Eneji.

src: Cabinet welcomed the National Energy Regulator of South Africa’s granting of trading and import/export license applications to the National Transmission Company of South Africa, paving the way for procurement of power from across the region.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku va Mulawuri wa Eneji wa Afrika-Dzonga wa Rixaka a pfumelerile swikombelo swa layisense ya mabindzu na ku xava ematikweni ya le handle/ku xavisela matiko ya le handle swa Khamphani yo Fambisa ya Afrika-Dzonga ya Rixaka, leswi nga pfula ndlela yo xava gezi ku suka eka xifundza hinkwaxo.

src: The return to service of the Kusile Power Station’s Unit 4 from planned maintenance has brought back 800 megawatts to our power grid.
tgt: Ku vuyela eku tirheni ka Yuniti ya 4 ya Xitichi xa Gezi xa Kusile ku suka eka ku lulamisa ka nhlayiso lowu kunguhatiweke swi vuyisile 800 wa ti megawati eka giridi ya hina ya gezi.

src: This milestone is central to improving generation capacity for the national grid and addressing the frequency of load-shedding.
tgt: Ndzima leyi yo hlawuleka i ya nkoka eka ku antswisa vuswikoti bya giridi ya rixaka byo endla gezii na ku lulamisa ku vuyelela ka ku timiwa ka gezi hi ku siyerisana.

src: Cabinet was further briefed about progress to return Units 1, 2 and 3 of the Kusile Power Station ahead of schedule.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi tivisiwa hi leswi fikeleriweke mayelana na ku tlherisela Tiyuniti ta 1, 2 na 3 ta Xitichi xa Gezi xa Kusile ku nga se fika nkarhi lowu a wu vekiwile.

src: Cabinet welcomed Eskom’s stable rating by Moody’s Investors Service, which will improve the power utility’s credit worthiness and enable it to plan ahead in implementing planned maintenance on its generation fleet.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukerile ku pimiwa ku va Eskom yi ri eka xiyimo lexi nga tshamiseka hi Vukorhokeri bya Vavekisi bya Moody’s, lexi nga ta antswisa ku fikelela ka vukorhokeri bya gezi eka mali ya xikeweleti leswaku byi kota ku endla makungu ya nkarhi lowutaka yo tirhisa vuhlayisi lebyi kunguhatiweke eka swo famba swa byona leswi tirhisiwaka eka ku endla gezi.

src: Water security.
tgt: Nsirhelelo wa mati.

src: Cabinet was briefed about efforts to address water challenges affecting a number of areas across the country.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi matshalatshala yo lulamisa mitlhontlho ya mati leyi khumbaka tindhawu to hlaya etikweni hinkwaro.

src: The Minister of Water and Sanitation, Mr Senzo Mchunu and executive mayors of some of the cities in Gauteng will provide an update on ongoing interventions to stabilise water supply in the province.
tgt: Holobye wa mati na Mbhasiso, Tatana Senzo Mchunu na vameyarankulu va madoroba man’wana eGauteng va ta nyika hungu leri pfuxetiweke ra ku nghenelela loku yaka emahlweni ku tiyisisa mphakelo wa mati eka xifundzankulu.

src: Cabinet wishes to remind everyone that South Africa is a water-scarce country.
tgt: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa munhu un’wana na un’wana leswaku Afrika-Dzonga i tiko leri kayivelaka mati.

src: All South Africans and everyone in this country must save and use water sparingly.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo na munhu un’wana na un’wana loyi a nga laha tikweni leri u fanele ku hlayisa na ku tirhisa mati hi vukheta.

src: Trade matters.
tgt: Timhaka ta mabindzu.

src: The South Africa-Lesotho Binational Commission (BNC) and Ministerial Cluster Meeting.
tgt: Khomixini ya Matiko Mambirhi ya Afrika-Dzonga na Lesotho (BNC) na Nhlengeletano ya Ntlawa wa Vaholobye.

src: The South Africa-Lesotho BNC and Ministerial Cluster Meeting held from 25 to 28 September 2023 is focussing on economic cooperation, cross-border issues, and the free movement of people, goods and services between the two countries.
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya BNC ya Afrika-Dzonga na Lesotho na Ntlawa wa Vaholobye leyi khomiweke ku sukela hi ti 25 ku fikela hi ti 28 Ndzati 2023 yi kongomisa eka ntirhisano wa ikhonomi, timhaka to tsemakanya mindzilekano, na ku fambafamba ka vanhu hi ku ntshunxeka, nhundzu na vukorhokeri exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi.

src: President Ramaphosa and Prime Minister Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane will co-chair the Inaugural Session of the BNC between South Africa and Lesotho on Thursday, 28 September 2023.
tgt: Presidente Ramaphosa na Holobyenkulu Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane va ta va vatshamaxitulu va Sexini yo Sungula ya BNC exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Lesotho hi Ravumune, 28 Ndzati 2023.

src: The BNC will cover diplomatic relations, defence and security, water, transport, electricity and trade.
tgt: BNC yi ta katsa vuxaka bya vudiplomati, vusirheleri na ku sirhelela, mati, vutleketli, gezi na mabindzu.1 Vulavisisi bya Makete wa Pulatifomo ya Vuhlanganisi bya le ka Inthanete.1 Khabinete yi amukerile xiviko ku suka eka Khomixini ya Mphikizano xa leswi kumiweke na magoza yo lulamisa eka Vulavisisi bya Makete wa Pulatifomo ya Vuhlanganisi bya le ka Inthanete.

src: Cabinet commended the work of the commission in addressing monopoly concerns in digital intermediation platforms, including ecommerce, online travel agencies, food delivery, app stores, classifieds providers and search engines.
tgt: Khabinete yi bumabumerile ntirho wa khomixini wo lulamisa swivilelo swa vulawuri bya vun’we eka tipulatifomo ta vuhlanganisi bya dijitali, ku katsa khomese, tiejensi ta marendzo ta le ka inthanete, ku phakeriwa ka swakudya, switolo swa ti-app, vanyiki va swilo leswi hlawuriweke na tindhawu to secha mahungu.2 Khabinete yi lerisile Vaholobye va tindzawulo ta mfumo leti faneleke ku ya emahlweni va hlangana va ta na switsundzuxo swo antswisa, ku langutisisa switandzhaku swa pholisi na ku endla ku cinca ka pholisi loku lavekaka loku nga ta olovisa ku nghenelela loku twisisekaka ka MaAfrika-Dzonga na mabindzu lamatsongo, ya le xikarhi na lamatsongo swinene eka bindzu ra le ka inthanete leri kulaka.6 Mukhuhlwana wa Swinyenyana.1 Khabinete yi lemukile mitungu ya nkarhi wa sweswi ya chachalaza leyi vangaka mavabyi swinene (HPAI) H5 na H7 eka indhasitiri ya tihuku eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Cabinet has directed Ministers of relevant government departments to further engage with the recommendations for improvement, consider the policy implications and undertake necessary policy reforms that will facilitate meaningful participation of South Africans and small, medium and micro enterprises on the growing online business.
tgt: KapaVupeladyambu na KwaZulu-Natal swi vile na mitungu ya HPAI H5 kasi HPAI H7 yi vikiwile eka swifundzankulu swa Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga na North West.

src: The Western Cape and KwaZulu-Natal experienced outbreaks of HPAI H5 while HPAI H7 has been reported in the provinces of Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga and North West.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Vurimi, Mpfuxeto wa Misava na Nhluvukiso wa le Matikoxikaya, Huvo ya Vulawuri bya Swikumiwa swa Rihanyo swa Afrika-Dzonga na indasitiri va le ku lavisiseni ka swikombelo swa ntsariso wa misawutiso leyi nga kotekaka, laha magoza yo landzelerisa lama fambelanaka na vuhlayiseki, ku tirha kahle na nkoka swi langutisisiwaka swinene eka ntsariso wa misawutiso yoleyo.7 Ku lwisana na vugevenga loku hlanganisiweke Khabinete yi amukerile hungu leri pfuxetiweke ra ku lwisana na vugevenga, leri nga tlhela ri nyikiwa rixaka hi Holobye wa Maphorisa, Jenerala Bheki Cele, na nhlangano wa Nhlanganelo wa Matirhelo na Vuhlori bya Rixaka.2 Ntirho wa swiyenge swo hambanahambana hi mayelana na ku ceriwa ka migodi swi nga ri enawini na vuhlapfa eKapaN’walungu wu endle leswaku ku khomiwa vanhu va 867, vo tala va huma eLesotho, Zimbabwe, Mozambique na MaAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Control measures to manage the spread of the outbreaks are in place and farmers are encouraged to observe prescribed biosecurity measures.
tgt: Khabinete yi vuyelerile matitwelo ya tiejensi to hlayisa nawu ya leswaku MaAfrika-Dzonga lava hlayisaka swigevenga leswi khumbekaka eka migingiriko ya ku ceriwa ka migodi swi nga ri enawini va ta langutana na matimba hinkwawo ya nawu.8 Maxelo yo biha swinene.1 Ku landzelelana ka maxelo yo biha laha tikweni swi yisa ehansi nkucetelo lowu ku cinca ka maxelo ku nga na wona eka vutomi bya hina na xilaveko xa magoza lama tiyiselaka nkarhi wo leha yo susa khaboni eka ikhonomi ya hina loko hi ri karhi hi landzelela nhluvukiso lowu tiyiselaka nkarhi wo leha.

src: The outbreaks pose food security risks and trade measures in the form of imports to manage availability of fertile eggs, table eggs and poultry meat may be implemented.
tgt: Khabinete yi tshama yi ri karhi yi tivisiwa hi ku onhaka loku vangiwaka hi swidzedze leswikulu na ndhambi eKapaVuxa, KapaVupeladyambu na Gauteng, ku ri na swikombiso swa leswaku leswi swi nga endleka swi hangalaka na swifundzha leswin’wana.3 Khabinete yi kombela miganga ku tshama yi vambe ngoma eka switsundzuxo swin’wana swa maxelo yo biha, leswi nga tisaka ku onhaka kun’wana etikweni hinkwaro.4 Mfumo wu ya emahlweni wu seketela vukorhokeri bya xihatla na tisenthara ta vulawuri bya timhangu eka matirho yo ponisa na ku nyika nseketelo wo phalala eka swiyimo swa xihatla.9 Winnie Mandela Avenue.1 Khabinete yi lemukile ku cinciwa ka vito ra William Nicol Drive eSandton ku va Winnie Mandela Avenue tanihi goza ra nkoka ro tsala matimu ya Afrika-Dzonga hi vuntshwa ku kombisa ku hoxa xandla ka lava nga lwela ntshunxeko wa hina.2 Ntirho lowu wu kotlanile na siku leri a ri ta va ri ri ra ku velekiwa ka Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ra vu 87 hi ti 26 ndzati 2023.

src: The Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development, South African Health Products Regulatory Authority and the industry are exploring applications for the registration of possible vaccines, with compliance measures relating to safety, efficacy and quality being paramount for registration of such vaccines.
tgt: Qhinga ra Nyama ya Swiharhi swa nhova leri Pfuxetiweke ra Afrika-Dzonga.1 Khabinete yi pasisile ku tirhisiwa ka Qhingha ra Nyama ya Swiharhi swa nhova leri Pfuxetiweke ra Afrika-Dzonga, leri lavaka ku cinca indhasitiri ya nyama ya swiharhi swa nhova na ku endla leswaku yi va ya ximfumo.2 Xikongomelo xa qhinga i ku tiyisisa sekitara ya nyama ya swiharhi swa nhova tanihi muphakeri wa nsirhelelo wa swakudya na sekitara ya ku kula ka ikhonomi leswi nga pfunaka ku tumbuluxa mitirho.3 Afrika-Dzonga yi vekiwa eka xiyimo xo sungula eka tikonkulu ra Afrika xa ku kumiwa ka nyama ya swiharhi swa nhova.

src: Integrated fight against crime Cabinet welcomed the update on the fight against crime, which was also provided to the nation by the Minister of Police, General Bheki Cele, and the National Joint Operational and Intelligence Structure.
tgt: Qhinga ri lava ku tiyisisa ku tumbuluxiwa ka 202 666 wa mitirho leyi nga ta va kona nkarhi wo leha eka indasitiri ya nyama ya swiharhi swa nhova hi 20.4 Qhinga leri ri ta hangalasiwa eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Swihlahla, Tinhlampfi na Mbango: WEBTOKEKungu Lerikulu ra Sekitara ya Vupfhumba.

src: The multidisciplinary operation on illegal mining and immigration in the Northern Cape led to the arrest of 867 people, many from Lesotho, Zimbabwe, Mozambique and some South Africans.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku yelanisiwa ka Kungu ro Vuyelerisa Sekitara ya Vupfhumba na Kungu Lerikulu ra Vupfhumba lerintshwa.

src: Cabinet echoed the sentiments of law-enforcement agencies that South Africans who harbour criminals involved in illegal mining activities will face the full might of the law.
tgt: Xiphemu xa nkoka xa Kungu Lerikulu i ku hunguta switandzhaku swa ntungu wa COVID-19 eka sekitara ya vupfhumba.

src: The country’s extreme weather patterns underscore the impact climate change is having in our lives and the need for sustained action to decarbonise our economy while pursuing sustainable development.
tgt: Loko Kungu ro Vuyelerisa Sekitara ya Vupfhumba ri tumbuluxiwile ku olovisa ku vuyiseriwa ka sekitara, ku hlayisa mitirho na ku sirhelela tindlela to tihanyisa, Kungu Lerikulu ri ta yisa ntirho lowu eka xiyimo xin’wana na ku fambisa swivandlanene leswintshwa eka sekitara.

src: Cabinet is being kept abreast on the devastation caused by severe storms and flooding in the Eastern Cape, Western Cape and Gauteng, with indications that this will likely spread to other provinces.
tgt: Kungu ri ringanyeta maqhinga ya nkombo yo nghenelela ku tiyisisa leswaku sekitara ya vupfhumba yi tlhelela eka masiku ya yona ya matirhelo ya xiyimo xa le henhla, na leswaku yi va exivindzini xa ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na vubindzurisi.

src: Cabinet calls on communities to remain on high alert for further extreme weather warnings, which could bring further devastation across the country.
tgt: Indhasitiri ya vupfhumba i muhoxa xandla wa nkoka eka ikhonomi naswona a yi seketerile 725 000 wa mitirho loko ku nga se va ntungu wa COVID-19.Milawumbisi.

src: Cabinet decisions Revised Game Meat Strategy for South Africa Cabinet approved for implementation of the Revised Game Meat Strategy for South Africa, which seeks to formalise and transform the game meat industry.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu ya emahlweni wu ringanyeta ku cinca eka modele wa mpfuneto wa timali wa SABC na sisiteme ya tilayisense ta TMpfapfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wo Cinca Vukorhokeri bya Mati.

src: The strategy aims to strengthen the game meat sector as both a provider of food security and an economic growth sector that can help create jobs.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Nawumbisi wo Cinca Vukorhokeri bya Mati ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: South Africa is ranked number one on the African continent for game-meat production.
tgt: Swikongomelonkulu swa Nawumbisi i ku tiyisisa vutihlamuleri eka vanyiki va vukorhokeri bya mati na ku tisa mhaka yo va erivaleni.

src: The strategy seeks to ensure the creation of 202 666 sustainable jobs in the game meat industry by 2030.
tgt: Ku cinciwa ka Nawu wa Vukorhokeri bya Mati, 1997 (Nawu wa 108 wa 1997) ku ta tiyisisa leswaku vanyiki va vukorhokeri bya mati va phakela mati ya xiyimo xa le henhla tanihi xiphemu xa swiyimo swa vona swa tilayisense.

src: An important component of the Master Plan is to mitigate the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on the tourism sector.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka mpfampfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wo Cinca Mati wa Rixaka ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: Issues in the environment 2023 Rugby World Cup Champions Cabinet congratulated the Springboks on their 2023 Rugby World Cup victory that made South Africa the only country to win the Rugby World Cup four (4) times and second to win the title back-to-back.
tgt: Timhaka leti nga eka Mbango Tinghwazi ta Khapu ya Misava ya Rugby ya 2023 Khabinete yi hoyozerile tiSpringboks eka ku hlula ka vona eka Khapu ya Misava ya Rugby 2023 loku endleke Afrika-Dzonga tiko ri ri roxe ri nga hlula Khapu ya Misava ya Rugby ku ringana ka mune (4) no va ra vumbiri ku wina xidlodlo hi ku landzelelana.

src: In the history of rugby in South Africa, this Springboks team is the most diverse in terms of the demographics representation of South Africa.
tgt: Eka matimu ya Rugby eAfrika-Dzonga, xipano xa tiSpringboks hi xona lexi nga na vanhu vo hambanahambana hikuya hi nhlayo ya vaaki va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The composition of such a diverse team was not an act of coincidence, but a deliberate effort by the management and coaching staff of the Springboks to select an inclusive team.
tgt: Ku vumbiwa ka xipano xa tano lowu nga na vanhu vo hambanahambana a ku nga ri mhaka ya xiwelo, kambe i matshalatshala lama endliweke hi vufambisi na valeteri va tiSpringboks ku hlawula xipano lexi katsaka hinkwavo.

src: That bold decision by then coach Rassie Erasmus and his team continues to demonstrate to South Africans and the rest of the world, that everyone with skill, if given a chance and support, can become great – an affirmation that we are Stronger Together.
tgt: Xiboho xelexo xa vurhena lexi tekiweke hi nkarhi wolowo hi muleteri Rassie Erasmus na ntlawa wa yena va ya emahlweni va kombisa maAfrika-Dzonga na misava hinkwayo, leswaku un’wana na un’wana la nga na vuswikoti, loko a nyikiwa nkarhi na nseketelo, a nga va lonkulu - i ku tiyisisa leswaku hi na matimba loko hi ri swin’we.

src: Most importantly, the resilience and determination of the Springboks in the field of play is an embodiment of a true essence of being South African, that which makes this great nation rise against all odds and adversities to emerge victorious.
tgt: Xa nkoka swinene, ku tiyisela na ku tiyimisela ka tiSpringbok eka xivandla xa ntlangu i xikombiso xa xiviri xa ntiyiso xo va muAfrika-Dzonga, leswi endlaka leswaku tiko leri lerikulu ri lwisana na mintshikilelo hinkwayo ni maxangu leswaku ri va ni vun’we ri hlula.

src: Some of the best players of this Springboks team have had to overcome personal adversities on their path to greatness.
tgt: Van’wana va vatlangi lavanene va xipano xa tiSpringbok va boheke ku hlula swiphiqo swa vona vini loko va karhi va lwela ku va ni ndhuma.

src: Cabinet expressed its congratulations to Siyamtanda “Siya” Kolisi, the Springboks double World Cup-winning captain for leading the team to the Greatest of All Time (GOAT) status and the celebrations must go-on.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozerile Siyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, mukaputeni wa tiSpringboks loyi a hluleke Khapu ya Misava kambirhi ku va a rhangele xipano ku ya fika eka xiyimo xa (Greatest of All Time) Vukulu bya Minkarhi Hinkwayo (GOAT) naswona ku tlangela ku fanele ku ya emahlweni.

src: AGOA Forum Cabinet had welcomed the confirmation by both the United States administration and congress on the intention to extend AGOA, which brings certainty to the investment community in the AGOA-eligible countries.
tgt: Nhlangano wa AGOA Khabinete yi amukerile ku tiyisisiwa hi mfumo wa United States na nhlangano eka xikongomelo xo ndlandlamuxa AGOA, leswi nyikaka vutitshembi eka vuvekisi eka matiko ya AGOA lama pfumeleriweke.

src: Cabinet had also welcomed the hosting of the 2023 AGOA Forum in Johannesburg from the 2nd – 4th November 2023 with participants from 32 Africa countries from government, Business, civil society and organised labour for the first time and representatives of the United States government.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi amukela ku rhurheriwa ka nhlangano wa AGOA 2023 eJoni ku suka hi ti 2 ku fika hi ti 4 ta Hukuri 2023 na vatlangi vo suka eka matiko ya 32 ya Afrika ku suka eka mfumo, Mabindzu, vandla ra vaaki na nhlangano wa vatirhi ro sungula ni vayimeri va mfumo wa United States.

src: Cabinet has always asserted that AGOA provides an opportunity for the United States of America to strengthen its economic relationship with Africa and thus it must be extended for a meaningful period, enhanced to make it impactful and attractive.
tgt: Khabinete khale na khale yi vula leswaku AGOA yi nyika nkarhi ku va United States of America ku tiyisa vuxaka bya yona bya swa ikhonomi na Afrika naswona byi fanele byi ndlandlamuxiwa nkarhi wo leha, byi antswisiwa leswaku byi va na nkucetelo na ku koka rinoko.

src: BRICS Tourism Ministers’ Meeting Cabinet welcomed the successful conclusion of the 2023 BRICS Tourism Ministers’ Meeting held in Cape Town, which committed member nations to deeper cooperation and to promote intra-BRICS tourism, develop routes for better tourism mobility and connectivity among the member countries.
tgt: Nhlengeletano ya Vaholobye va Vupfhumba va BRICS Khabinete yi amukerile makumu lama humelelaka ya Nhlengeletano ya Vaholobye va Vapfhumba va BRICS 2023 lowu khomeriweke eCape Town, lowu tinyiketeleke swirho swa matiko eka ntirhisano lowu dzhikeke no tlakusa vupfhumba bya le ndzeni ka BRICS, ku hluvukisa tindlela ta ku fambafamba ko antswa ka vupfhumba na vuhlanganisi exikarhi ka matiko lama nga swirho.

src: This will further strengthen South Africa’s tourism sector which is already showing signs of recovery.
tgt: Leswi swi ta ya emahlweni swi tiyisa sekithara ya vupfhumba bya Afrika-Dzonga lebyi nga le ku kombiseni swikombiso swa ku antswa.

src: For the first 8 months of 2023, the country saw million arrivals which represented a 63.4% increase from the same period in 2022.
tgt: Eka tin’hweti to sungula ta nhungu ta 2023, tiko ri vonile wa timiliyoni ta vanhu lava fikeke leswi yimelaka ku tlakuka ka 63.4% ku suka eka nkarhi lowu fanaka hi 2022.

src: Voter Registration The IEC has announced the 18th and 19th of November 2023 as a first voter registration weekend for the 2024 General Elections.
tgt: Ku tsarisiwa ka Vavhoti Va IEC va tivisile leswaku hi ti 18 na ti 19 ta Hukuri 2023 tanihi hi mahelo ya vhiki yo sungula ya ku titsarisela ku vhota eka Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wa 2024.. Khabinete yi rhamba vanhu hinkwavo lava nga na mfanelo yo vhota ku titsarisela ku vhota eka Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wa 2024 eka xitichi xa wena xa le kusuhi xo vhota.

src: Cabinet is calling on all eligible voters to register to vote for the 2024 General Elections at your nearest voting stations.
tgt: Ku tsarisa ka vavhoti hi ku tirhisa inthanete ku pfuriwile ku suka hi Nyenyenyana 2023 naswona vaakatiko va komberiwa ku tirhisa xitirhisiwa ku tsarisa kumbe ku pfuxeta vuxokoxoko bya vona.

src: South Africans who have applied for their IDs are encouraged to visit their local Home Affairs office to collect them.
tgt: MaAfrika-Dzonga lava nga apulayela ti ID ta vona va khutaziwa ku endzela hofisi ya vona ya kwala tikweni ya Timhaka ta Xikaya ku ti landza.

src: There are more than 500 000 smart ID cards still to be collected atHome Affairs offices across the country.
tgt: Ku na makhadi ya ID yo hundza 500 000 lama ya ha lavaka ku tekiwa etihofisi ta Timhaka ta Xikaya etikweni hinkwaro.

src: Electricity The Minister in the Presidency responsible for Electricity has provided a comprehensive briefing on electricity situation in the country.
tgt: Gezi Holobye eka Hofisi ya Vuphuresidente loyi a nga na vutihlamuleri bya Gezi u nyikile rungula leri heleleke eka xiyimo xa gezi etikweni.

src: Cabinet applauded efforts by the Gauteng Provincial Government working with Eskom to restore electricity to areas in Gauteng that have been hit by black-outs due to the theft or damage to transformers.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlangerile matshalatshala ya Mfumo wa Xifundzankulu xa Gauteng lowu tirhaka na Eskom ku lunghisa gezi eka tindhawu ta Gauteng leti nga hlaseriwa hi ku tima ka gezi hikokwalaho ka ku yiviwa kumbe ku onhiwa ka switirhisiwa swo hunguta kumbe ku engetela vholiteji ya gezi.

src: Last night, six new electrical transformers were switched in Kagiso, in the West Rand area after communities were left without power for more than 3 years.
tgt: Vusiku bya tolo, switirhisiwa swo hunguta kumbe ku engetela vholiteji ya gezi swa ntsevu swintshwa swi layitiwile eKagiso, endhawini ya West Rand endzhaku ka loko miganga yi siyiwile yi nga ri na gezi ku hundza malembe manharhu.

src: Cabinet calls on these communities to protect the critical infrastructure from theft, vandalism and damage that is caused by illegal connections.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba miganga leyi ku sirhelela switirhisiwa swa nkoka ku suka eka vukhamba, ku onhiwa ka swilo na ku onhaka loku vangiwaka hi vuhlanganisi lebyi nga riki enawini.

src: Food Poisoning Cabinet is concerned by the spate of food poisoning of children from eating expired and contaminated foodstuff from spaza shops and street vendors.
tgt: Ku Cheriwa ka Chefu Swakudyeni Khabinete ya vilela hi nhlayo ya le henhla ya ku cheriwa ka chefu swakudyeni eka vana ku suka ka ku va vadya swakudya leswi nga hundzeriwa hi nkarhi no thyaka ku suka eka mavhengele ya swiphaza na vaxavisi va le switarateni.

src: Cabinet is encouraged by the law enforcement efforts to enforce food safety compliance.
tgt: Khabinete yi khutaziwile hi matshalatshala ya ku tirhisa nawu ku sindzisa ku landzeleriwa ka vuhlayiseki bya swakudya.

src: International Migration Workshop with Mayors and Traditional leaders Cabinet was briefed about the international migration workshop hosted by the Department of Home Affairs with the participation of the DSBD, COGTA, Human Settlements and traditional leaders and mayors from metro and district municipalities that focused on curbing effects of illegal immigration, including the operations of spaza shops.
tgt: Nhlengeletano wa ku Rhurha ka Matiko ya Misava na Timeyara na Varhangeri va Ndhavuko Khabinete yi tivisiwile hi nhlengeletano wa ku rhurha ka matiko ya misava lowu khomiweke hi Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya hi ku nghenelela ka DSBD, COGTA, Vutshamo bya Vanhu na varhangeri va ndhavuko na timeyara ku suka eka timasipala ta metro na timasipala ta muganga lava a va langutane no hunguta mbuyelo wa ku rhurha ka vanhu va nga ri enawini, ku katsa na matirhelo ya mavhengele ya swiphaza.

src: Key outcomes include the introduction of omnibus by-laws to address challenges relating to the enforcement of business by-laws by municipalities and traditional authorities.
tgt: Mimbuyelo ya nkoka yi katsa ku sunguriwa ka swinawana—nawana swa mani na mani ku vulavula hi mintlhontlho leyi fambelanaka na ku sindzisiwa ka milawu ya bindzu hi timasipala na valawuri va ndhavuko.

src: There will be immediate joint inspections of businesses, in particular spaza shops by the departments of labour, health, small business development and the Home Affairs immigration inspectorate teams, to enforce compliance with applicable laws An audit of spaza shops in villages and townships, and mechanisms to register them by both traditional leaders and municipalities will be undertaken.
tgt: Ku ta va na vukamberi bya le kusuhi bya mabindzu, ngopfungopfu mavhengele ya swiphaza hi tindzawulo ta mintirho, rihanyo, nhluvukiso wa mabindzu lamatsongo na mintlawa ya vukamberi bya ku rhurha eka Timhaka ta Xikaya, ku sindzisa ku landzeleriwa ka milawu leyi faneleke Nkambisiso wa mavhengele ya swiphaza ematiko xikaya na swidorobanini, na tindlela to va tsarisa hi varhangeri va ndhavuko havambirhi na timasipala ti ta endliwa.

src: There are also efforts to support traditional authorities to keep a record of foreign nationals in their communities.
tgt: Ku tlhela ku va na matshalatshala yo seketela valawuri va ndhavuko ku hlayisa rhekhodo ya vahlampfa emigangeni ya vona.

src: Business licencing legislation is being amended to support all those who wish to trade in the informal sector.
tgt: Milawu ya tilayisense ta bindzu yi karhi ya cinciwa ku seketela hinkwavo lava lavaka ku xavisa eka sekithara leyi nga riki ya ximfumo.

src: Integrated Crime Fighting Cabinet commends the SAPS for dealing a massive blow to international drug syndicates following the discovery of cocaine valued at R80 million which were seized on 20 October 2023 at a warehouse at the Dube Trade Port within the King Shaka International Airport.
tgt: Ku Lwisana na Vugevenga loku Hlanganisiweke Khabinete yi bumabumela va SAPS ku va va hlaserile mintlawa ya misava hinkwayo ya swidzidziharisi endzhaku ko kumiwa ka khokheyini ya ntsengo wa R80 miliyoni swi kumiwile hi ti 20 ta Hlangula 2023 eka ndhawu yo hlayisela eDube Trade Port endzeni ka Rivala ra Swihahampfhuka ra Matiko ya Misava ra King Shaka.

src: Two days prior the seizure, another R70 million worth of cocaine was also seized from a container at the Durban Harbour.
tgt: Masiku mambirhi ku nga si kumiwa mali, khokheyini ya ntsengo wo ringana R70 miliyoni yi kumiwile eka khontheyina eka nhlaluko wa Durban.

src: Cabinet applauds the SAPS for their work in disrupting and dismantling transnational organised crime that poses a significant threat to our communities and the nation.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlangela va SAPS eka ntirho wa vona eku kavanyeteni na ku herisa vugevenga lebyi hleriweke bya matiko hinkwawo lebyi xungetaka swinene vaaki va hina na tiko.

src: Operation Safer Festive Season is already yielding results with police arresting over 140 suspects, including an alleged illegal mining kingpin, and seizing unlicensed firearms.
tgt: Operation Safer Festive Season yi le ku humeseni mimbuyelo na maphorisa ma khomile vaehleketeleriwa vo hundza 140, ku katsa murhangeri wa vatirhi va le mugodini lava nga riki enawini, naswona va kumile swibamu leswi nga riki na mpfumelelo.

src: Presidential Oversight Visit Cabinet welcomed the Presidential Oversight Visit to the Emfuleni Municipality, which followed-up on engagements with the community during the District Development Model visit of 2022.
tgt: Riendzo ra Vulanguteri bya Murhangeri Khabinete yi amukerile Riendzo ra Vulanguteri bya Murhangeri eka Masipala wa Emfuleni, lowu landzeleke eka ku tihlanganisa na muganga hi nkarhi wa riendzo ra Xikombiso xa Nhluvukiso wa Xifundza ra 2022.

src: The 2022 visit to Emfuleni identified issues of poor infrastructure maintenance by the municipality Through the intervention of the Department of Water and Sanitation, there has been notable progress in addressing water and sanitation infrastructure challenges that had resulted in the collapse of the Vaal Waste Water system.
tgt: Riendzo ra 2022 ro ya Emfuleni ri kumile timhaka ta ku hlayisiwa ka switirhisiwa hi xiyimo xa le hansi hi masipala Hi ku nghenelela ka Ndzawulo ya Mati na Nkululo, ku vile na nhluvuko lowu xiyekaka eku tiviseni mintlhontlho ya switirhisiwa swa mati na nkululo leswi nga vanga ku wa ka sisiteme ya Vaal ya Mati ya Thyaka.

src: Work has been undertaken to improve water supply, the proper functioning of the waste water infrastructure and thus eliminating the problem of the sewer effluent that run running on the streets and people’s yards.
tgt: Ntirho wu endliwile ku antswisa mphakelo wa mati, ku tirha kahle ka xitirhisiwa xa mati ya thyaka naswona hi ndlela leyi swi herisa xiphiqo xa nkululo lowu khulukaka eswitarateni na le majarateni ya vanhu.

src: Noted progress during the visit include improvements in critical bulk pipelines and water pump stations, resurfacing and resealing of roads, and a massive rollout of streetlights to improve lighting and safety.
tgt: Nhluvuko lowu xiyekaka hi nkarhi wa riendzo wu katsa ku antswisiwa ka tiphayiphi to rhwala nhundzu yo tala na switichi swo pompa mati, ku pfuxetiwa na ku pfariwa ka magondzo, na ku tirhisiwa ka timboni ta le switarateni hi xitalo leswaku ku antswisiwa timboni na vuhlayiseki.

src: Roadmap for the Freight Logistics System in South Africa The Department of Transport has commenced consultations on the Roadmap for the Freight Logistics System in South Africa, as part of measures to address the challenges facing the freight and logistics sector and the strengthening of South Africa’s economic recovery efforts.
tgt: Kungu ra Sisiteme ya Vutleketli bya Nhundzu eAfrika-Dzonga Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli yi sungurile ku burisana hi Kungu ra Sisiteme ya Vutleketli bya Nhundzu eAfrika-Dzonga, tanihi xiphemu xa magoza yo tivisa mintlhontlho leyi langutaneke na sekithara ya vutleketli na nhundzu na ku tiyisa matshalatshala ya ku hlakarhela ka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Infrastructure Development and Maintenance Cabinet welcomed the progress being made with infrastructure development and maintenance with the completion of 36 rural bridges under the Welisizwe Rural Bridges, and the construction underway on 20 projects in human settlements, roads, and water.
tgt: Nhluvukiso wa Switirhisiwa na Vuhlayisi Khabinete yi amukerile nhluvuko lowu endliweke eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa na vuhlayisi hi ku hetisiwa ka mabuloho ya 36 ya le makaya ehansi ka Weliziwe Rural Bridges, na ntirho wo aka lowu yaka emahlweni eka 20 wa tipurojeke eka vutshamo bya vanhu, magondzo, na mati.

src: Relaunch of South African Airways (SAA) international routes Cabinet welcomed the relaunch of SAA international routes with the re-introduction of its intercontinental flight to São Paulo, Brazil, which also marked the return of the long-haul service out of Cape Town and Johannesburg.
tgt: Ku sunguriwa nakambe ka (SAA) tindlela ta matiko ya misava ta Rivala ra Swihahampfhuka Afrika-Dzonga Khabinete yi amukerile ku sunguriwa nakambe ka tindlela ta matiko ya misava SAA hi ku sunguriwa nakambe ka xihahampfhuka xa yona xa le xikarhi ka matiko-nkulu ku ya São Paulo, Brazil, leti nga tlhela ti fungha ku vuya ka vukorhokeli bya mpfhuka wo leha ehandle ka Cape Town na Joni.

src: The return of SAA in the international routes will contribute directly in driving growth in international travel to the country, and growth of the tourism sector after the ravages of the Covid-19 pandemic.
tgt: Ku vuya ka SAA eka tindlela ta matiko ya misava ku ta hoxa xandla hi ku kongoma eka ku fambisa ku kula eka maendzo ya matiko ya misava etikweni, na ku kula ka sekithara ya vupfhumba endzhaku ka timhangu ta ntungu wa Covid-19.

src: South Africa launches the largest drone in Africa Cabinet congratulated the Defence and aerospace company Milkor on their successful launch of the Milkor 380 unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), which places South Africa among the countries that continue to make strides in drone technology.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi simeka xihahampfhuka lexi nga fambiki hi munhu lexikulu eAfrika Khabinete yi hoyozerile khamphani ya vusirheleri na swa swihahampfhuka Milkor eka ku simekiwa loku humeleleke ka xihahampfhuka lexi nga fambiki hi munhu xa Milkor 380 (UAV), leswi vekaka Afrika-Dzonga exikarhi ka matiko lama yaka emahlweni ya hluvuka eka thekinoloji ya sisiteme ya xihahampfhuka lexi nga fambiki hi munhu.

src: The Milkor 380 is the largest drone built in Africa and it will be used by the defence industry for combat, border control, conservation efforts including to combat poaching.
tgt: Milkor 380 i xihahampfhuka lexi nga fambiki hi munhu lexi akiweke eAfrika naswona xi ta tirhisiwa hi vumaki bya vusirheleri ku sivela, vulawuri bya mindzilikano, matshalatshala yo hlayisa ku katsa ku sivela ku hlota swi nga ri enawini.

src: Matric and Year-end schools examinations Cabinet welcomed the smooth start to the 2023 National Senior Certificate (matric) exams, which commenced on 30 October 2023.
tgt: Metiriki na swikambelo swa le ku heleni ka Lembe Khabinete yi amukerile ku sungula ka kahle ka swikambelo swa (National Senior Certificate) Xitifikheti xa le Henhla xa Rixaka ( swa metiriki), leswi sunguleke hi ti 30 ta Hlangula 2023.

src: Parents and guardians are encouraged to continue to support learners during this critical period.
tgt: Vatswari na vahlayisi va vana va khutaziwa ku ya emahlweni va seketela vadyondzi hi nkarhi lowu wa nkoka.

src: Cabinet also sends its well wishes to all the learners who will be sitting for their year-end exams.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi navelela leswinene eka vadyondzi hinkwavo lava nga ta tshama eka swikambelo swa vona swa ku hela ka lembe.

src: Cabinet decisions The Situation in Palestine Cabinet is disappointed by the refusal of the Israeli government to respect international law and its continued undermining of the United Nations resolutions for the implementation of a ceasefire with impunity.
tgt: Swiboho swa Khabinete Xiyimo xa le Palestine Khabinete yi khomiwile hi tingana hi ku va mfumo wa Israel wu arile ku hlonipha milawu ya matiko ya misava no ya emahlweni wu tekela ehansi swiboho swa United States leswaku ku simekiwa ku yimisiwa ka nyimpi handle ko xupuriwa.

src: The humanitarian corridors for the people of Palestine remain closed with dire consequences for children, women and innocent civilians.
tgt: Tiphaseji ta ku pfuna vanhu va Palestine ta ha pfariwile na mbuyelo wo chavisa eka vana, vavasati na vaakatiko lava nga riki na nandzu.

src: The genocidal airstrikes by the government of Israel on the people of Palestine, continue with rising death toll that include women and children.
tgt: Ku hlaseriwa hi swihahampfhuka loku dlayaka rixaka hi mfumo wa Israel eka vanhu va Palestine, ku ya emahlweni ku tlakusa nhlayo ya mafu leyi katsaka vavasati na vana.

src: In the last two days, the world have sat helplessly and watched as intensifying airstrikes on Gaza and the West Bank have destroyed schools, health facilities, ambulances and civilian infrastructure and supposedly safe roads travelling to the South of Gaza.
tgt: Masiku mambirhi lama nga hundza, misava yi tshamile yi nga endli nchumu yi hlalela loko ku hlaseriwa Gaza hi swihahampfhuka na West Bank yi onhile swikolo, switirhisiwa swa rihanyo, ambulense na switirhisiwa swa vaakatiko na magondzo lama ku vuriwaka leswaku ma hlayisekile lama yaka eDzongeni ra Gaza.

src: For these, the Cabinet has decided to recall all South African diplomats from Tel Aviv for consultation.
tgt: Eka leswi, Khabinete yi tekile xiboho xo vitana vayimeri hinkwavo va Afrika-Dzonga ku suka Tel Aviv ku ta burisana.

src: Cabinet has also noted with disquiet the continuing disparaging remarks of the Israeli’s ambassador to South Africa, Mr. Eliav Belotsercovsky, against South Africans, the leadership of South Africa both in and outside government including civil society who are speaking against the holocaust being committed by the Israeli government against the Palestinians.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi lemukile hi ku vilela hi ku ya emahlweni ka ku delela ka vayimeri va Israel eka Afrika-Dzonga, Tat.

src: The disparaging remarks of Ambassador Belotsercovsky are contrasted by the statements of two former Israeli ambassadors to South Africa (Illan Baruch and Dr. Alon Liel) who have been consistent in describing the actions of their government against Palestinians as Apartheid.
tgt: Eliav Belotsercovsky, loyi a lwisanaka na MaAfrika-Dzonga, vurhangeri bya Afrika-Dzonga hinkwabyo endzeni na le handle ka mfumo ku katsa vaaki vo va na xichavo lava vulavulaka hi ku lwisana na ku dlayeteriwa ka vanhu loku endliwaka hi mfumo wa Israel ku lwisana na vanhu va Palestine.

src: The disparaging remarks against those speaking up against the atrocities and the country’s leaders make ambassador Belotsercovsky position more and more untenable.
tgt: Marito yo delela ya Muyimeri Belotsercovsky ya hambanile hi switatimende swa khale ka vayimeri vambirhi va Israel eka Afrika-Dzonga (Illan Baruch na Dok.

src: As such Cabinet has directed the Department of International Relations and Cooperation to convey the South African government displeasure with the ambassador formally through diplomatic channels.
tgt: Alon Liel) lava nga cincangiki loko va hlamusela swiendlo swa vona hi mfumo wa vona ku lwisana na vanhu va Palestine tanihi xihlawuhlawu.

src: Medium Term Budget Policy Statement Cabinet welcomed the 2023 Medium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTBPS), which provided a frank assessment of the current economic climate and demonstrated government’s firm hold on our nation’s finances amid tough revenue constraints.
tgt: Marito yo delela ku kanetana na lava vulavulaka ku lwisana na tihanyi na varhangeri va tiko va endla xiyimo xa muyimeri Belotsercovsky ku va xi nga tiyiseleki.

src: High Speed Rail Development Cabinet approved the High Speed Rail Development Framework and the financial implications for implementation will be discussed between the Ministers of Transport and Finance Cabinet approved the prioritisation of the Johannesburg to Durban corridor for a detailed feasibility study, and the Johannesburg-Polokwane to Musina, and the Johannesburg to Mbombela will be put to the market.
tgt: Hi ndlela yeleyo Khabinete yi lerisile Ndzawulo ya Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava na Ntirhisano ku hundzisela emahlweni mfumo wa Afrika-Dzonga ku ka wu nga yimi na muyimeri hi ximfumo hi tindlela ta swa tipolitiki.

src: Draft White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection Cabinet approved the publication of the White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection for public comments.
tgt: Xitatimende xa Pholisi ya Bajete ya Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi Khabinete yi amukerile Xitatimende xa Pholisi ya Bajete ya Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi xa 2023 (MTBPS) lexi nyikekeke nkambelo lowu nga erivaleni wa xiyimo xa ikhonomi ya sweswi naswona swi kombisile ku tiya ka mfumo eka timali ta tiko ra hina exikarhi ka swipimelo swo tika swa mali leyi nghenaka.

src: The draft Policy aims to provide a framework to guide the granting of residency and citizenship to foreign nationals, as well as the protection of refugees and asylum seekers in South Africa, cognisant of the Republic’s national security interests and in compliance with international agreements and protocols on migration that South Africa is party to.
tgt: Swiboho swa MTBPS swi antswisa rimba ra timali ta swibalo swa hina xi hlohlotela ku kula ka ikhonomi ya hina loko yi karhi yi ringanisela ku tinyiketela ka vanhu va hina lava seketelaka lava nga hlayisekangiki etikweni ra hina.

src: The 6th Annual Progress Report on the implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of People with Disabilities Cabinet has approved for publication in the government gazette the 6th Annual Progress Report on the implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of People with Disabilities.
tgt: Nhluvukiso wa Swiporo swa Rivilo ra le Henhla Khabinete yi pasisile Rimba ra Nhluvukiso wa Swiporo swa Rivilo ra le Henhla na swiringanyeto swa timali ku simeka ku ta kaneriwa exikarhi ka Vaholobye va Vutleketli na Timali Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhangisiwa ka phaseji ya Joni ku ya eDurban ku kuma dyondzo yo enta ya ku koteka, na Joni ku ya Polokwane ku ya eMusina, na Joni ku ya Mbombela yi ta vekiwa emakete.

src: The publication of the progress report will coincide with the international commemoration of the Disability Rights Awareness Month from 3 November to 3 December.
tgt: Mpfampfarhuto wa Xiviko xa Vulawuri eka Vuakatiko, Ku Rhurhela eTikweni Rimbe na Nsirhelelo wa Muhlampfa Khabinete yi pasisile nkandziyiso wa Xiviko xa Vulawuri eka Vaakatiko, Ku Rhurhela eTikweni Rimbe na Nsirhelelo wa Muhlampfa ku va mani na mani a nyika mavonelo ya yena.

src: The progress report also signals an increase of the minimum employment equity target from 2% to 3% for persons with disabilities as from the 2024/2025 financial year, towards a minimum 7% employment equity target for persons with disabilities by 2030.
tgt: Xikongomelo xa mpfampfarhuto wa Pholisi i ku nyika rimba ro letela ku nyikiwa vutshamo na vuakatiko eka vaakatiko va matikomambe, swin’we na nsirhelelo wa vahlampfa na vanhu lava lavaka vuchavelo eAfrika-Dzonga, hi ku tekela enhlokweni swilaveko swa vuhlayiseki bya rixaka ra Rhiphabliki na hi ku landzelela mintwanano ya matiko ya misava na mintwanano hi mayelana na ku rhurha loku Afrika-Dzonga ri nga xirho eka rona.

src: Bills Draft African Renaissance and International Cooperation Fund (ARF) Bill Cabinet approved the submission of the ARF Amendment Bill to Parliament.
tgt: Xiviko xa Nhluvuko xa Lembe na Lembe xa vu 6 eka ku simekiwa ka Xiviko xa Vulawuri eka Timfanelo ta Vanhu Lava Hanyaka na Vutsoniwa Khabinete yi pasisile ku kandziyisiwa ka phepha-hungu ra mfumo Xiviko xa Nhluvuko xa Lembe na Lembe xa vu 6 eka ku simekiwa ka Xiviko xa vulawuri eka Timfanelo ta Vanhu Lava Hanyaka na Vutsoniwa .

src: The Bill seeks to amend the ARF Act (Act 51 of 2000) and establish the South African Development Partnership Agency that will serve as a mechanism to support South Africa’s development and cooperation with sister countries through the promotion of democracy, good governance, the prevention and resolution of conflict, socio-economic development and integration.
tgt: Ku kandziyisiwa ka xiviko xa nhluvuko ku ta fambisana na nkhuvo wa xitsundzuxo wa matiko ya misava wa N’hweti ya Vulemukisi bya Timfanelo ta Vutsoniwa ku suka hi ti 3 ta Hukuri ku fika hi ti 3 ta N’wendzamhala.

src: Appointment of Mr Ebrahim Rasool as Chairperson of the Development Bank of Southern Africa.
tgt: Nawumbisi Ku Pfuxetiwa ka Mpfampfarhuto wa Afrika na Nawumbisi wa Nkwama wa Ntirhisano wa Matiko ya Misava (ARF) Khabinete yi pasisile ku nyikiwa ka Nawumbisi wa ku Cinca eka Palamende.

src: Upcoming Events Anti-Corruption Dialogue The Anti-Corruption Dialogue will be held on 8 and 9 November 2023 at Birchwood Hotel in Ekurhuleni to mobilise society in the fight against corruption in line with the country’s National Anti-Corruption Strategy Cabinet, in November 2020, approved the National Anti-Corruption Strategy (NACS 2020-2030).
tgt: Nawumbisi wu lavana na ku cinca Nawu wa ARF (Nawu wa 51 wa 2000) no sungula Nhlangano wa Ntirhisano wa Nhluvukiso wa MaAfrika-Dzonga, lowu nga ta tirha tanihi endlelo ku seketela nhluvuko wa Afrika-Dzonga na ntirhisano na matiko ma rikwerhu hi ku tlakusiwa ka xidemokirasi, mafumelo lamanene, ku sivela na ku lulamisiwa ka nkwetlembetano, nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vaaki na ku hlanganisiwa.

src: 3 14th Policy Dialogue Forum South Africa will co-host the 14th Policy Dialogue Forum in collaboration with the UNESCO International Teacher Task Force for Education (TTF) in January 2024 under the theme “Addressing teacher shortages and making the profession more attractive”.
tgt: Swiendlakalo Leswi Taka Mbulavurisano wo Lwisana na Vukungundzwana Mbulavurisano wo Lwisana na Vukungundzwana wu ta khomiwa hi ti 8 na ti 9 Hukuri 2023 eHotela ya Birchwood eKurhuleni ku hlengeleta vaaki eka ku lwisana na vukungundzwana hi ku fambisana na Kungu ra Rixaka ro Lwisana na Vukungundzwana etikweni Khabinete, hi Hukuri 2020, yi pasisile Kungu ra Rixaka ro Lwisana na Vukungundzwana (NACS 2020-2030).

src: The forum will bring together government officials, NGOs, teachers and education experts to discuss critical issues pertaining to the conditions of service for teachers, issues of teacher autonomy and accountability as well as how to make teaching an attractive profession.
tgt: Kungu ra rixaka leri nga na xikongomelo xo endla muganga lowu pfumalaka vukungundzwana hi tlhelo ri ta va ri karhi ri khutaza vaakatiko ku ka va nga pfumeleri vukungundzwana na ku landzelela nawu.

src: South Africa’s first pro-wheelchair bodybuilder Macethandile Kulati for defending his title at the 2023 International Federation of Body Builders and Fitness World Championship in Slovenia.
tgt: Foramu ya vu 14 ya Pholisi ya Mbulavurisano Afrika-Dzonga yi ta rhurhela Foramu ya vu 14 ya Pholisi ya Mbulavurisano hi ku tirhisana na Ntlawa wa Ntirho wa Vadyondzisi Matiko ya Misava wa UNESCO wa Dyondzo (TTF) hi Sunguti ehansi ka nhlokomhaka “ ku vulavula hi nkayivelo wa vadyondzisi no endla leswaku ntirho lowu wu koka rinoko swinene”.

src: South African Chartered Accountants for earning the top position in the Edelman global professional trust survey.
tgt: Foramu yi ta hlanganisa vatirhela mfumo, tiNGO, vadyondzisi na vativi va dyondzo ku kanela timhaka ta nkoka leti khumbaka swiyimo swa ntirho eka vadyondzisi, timhaka ta ku tifuma ka mudyondzisi na vutihlamuleri xikan’we na ndlela yo endla leswaku ntirho wo dyondzisa wu koka rinoko swinene.

src: Dr Claude Mashego for winning the inaugural Miss World South Africa and she will now represent South Africa at the Miss World in New Delhi, India in December this year.
tgt: Xipano xa Proteas hi ku va xi kumile ndhawu eka (semi-finals) hafu ya xiphemu xo hetelela xa Khapu ya Misava ya ICC 2023 eIndia.

src: Advocate Kholeka Gcaleka following her appointment as the new Public Protector for a term of seven years with effect from 1 November 2023.
tgt: Hambi leswi va nga tlhelela endzhaku eka ntlango wa vona na India tolo, tiko ri tshama ri tiyile endzhaku ka xipano naswona ri na ku tshemba leswaku ri ta ya emahlweni ri aka no hi nyungubyisa.

src: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Paralympic gold medallist Zanele Situ who was the first black South African female athlete to win a gold medal at the Paralympic Games in Sydney in 2000.
tgt: Nhenha ya mphikizano wa Moto GP Brad Binder loyi sweswi a nga na rhekhodo ya phodiyamu ya tlilasi ya xiyimo xa le henhla xa Afrika-Dzonga endzhaku ka ku va a ri eka xiyimo xa vunharhu eka Thailand Grand Prix.

src: Former Bafana-Bafana assistant coach and football legend Phil “Mr Jones” Setshedi.
tgt: Muaki wa miri wo sungula wa xitulu xa swigulana wa Afrika-Dzonga Macethandile Kulati hi ku sirhelela xidlodlo xa yena eka Tinghwazi ta Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava wa Vaaki va Miri na Ntirho wa Vutiolori hi 2023 eSlovenia.

src: Warrant Officer Sthembiso Mazibuko of the National Intervention Unit who was killed during a shootout with criminals in Ntuzuma, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Van’watinkota va MaAfrika-Dzonga va kumile xiyimo xa le henhla eka nkambisiso wa vutshembeki bya xiphurofexinali bya misava hinkwayo wa Edelman.

src: Economic Recovery and Growth Quarterly Labour Force Survey (QLFS) Cabinet welcomes the 2023, 3rd quarter, QLFS results as released by Statistics South Africa that indicated employment figures have surpassed the pre-COVID-19 employment levels.
tgt: Timhaka leti nga eka Mbango Nhlakarhelo no Kula ka Ikhonomi Nkambisiso wa Vatirhi wa Kotara (QLFS) Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo wa QLFS wa 2023, wa kotara ya vunharhu wa ha ku humesiwaka hi Nhlangano wa Tinhlayohlayo wa Afrika-Dzonga lowu kombisaka swiyimo wa mitirho leswaku ya hundzile tilevhele ta mitirho eka masungula ya COVID-19.

src: Cabinet is pleased that all provinces but one have contributed to the 399 000 increase to the number of employed people to a total of 16,7 million people in employment in the 3rd quarter, compared to 16,3 million in the 2nd quarter of 2023.
tgt: Khabinete yi tsakisiwa hi swifundzankulu hinkwaswo kambe ku na xin’we lexi pfuneteke eka 399 000 wa tlakuko wa nomboro ya vanhu lava thoriweke yi ya eka 16,7 million wa vanhu lava thoriweke hi kotara ya vunharhu, loko ku pimanisiwa na 16,3 miliyoni eka kotara ya vumbirhi.

src: The strong contributions to additional jobs of KwaZulu-Natal (up by 152 000), Limpopo (up by 70 000), North West (up by 61 000) and Mpumalanga, indicate the gradual but steady realisation of the goal of the Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan of rebuilding better, stronger and inclusively.
tgt: Nghelenelo wukulu eka ku engetela mitirho eKwazulu Natala (wu tlakukile hi 152 000), Limpopo (wu tlakukile hi 70 000), North West (wu tlakukile hi 61 000) na Mpumalanga, swi kombisa ku nonoka kambe swi humelerisa xivono xo Kungu ra ku Aka hi Vuntshwa na Nhlakarhelo wa Ikhonomi ro aka ku antswa, ku tiya no angarhela.

src: Cabinet appreciates the continued and consistent contribution of the following sectors and industries: The formal sector employment increased by 287 000 whereas informal sector increased by 29 000 jobs Finance (this includes business services) up by 237 000 jobs Community and social services up by 119 000 jobs and agriculture by 61 000 jobs.
tgt: Khabinete yi tsakela ku ya emahlweni no hoxa xandla ko tiya eka tiseketara na tiindasitiri leti landzelaka: Sekitara ya mitirho ya ximfumo yi tlakukile hi 287 000 loko yo ka yi nga ri ya ximfumo yi tlakukile hi 29 000 wa mitirho .2 Ya Timali (leyi katsaka vukorhokeri bya mabindzu) yi tlakukile 237 000 wa mitirho .3 Miganga na vukorhokeri bya vaaki yi tlakuka hi 119 000 wa mitirho na vurimi hi 61 000 wa mitirho.

src: Cabinet also noted the negative impact the electricity and logistics constraints continued to have on the manufacturing, mining, transport and utilities.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi vona vubihi lebyi gezi na nkayivelo wa lojisitiki swi ya ka emahlweni ku va na byona eka vumaki, mayini, swifambo na switirhisiwa.

src: Cabinet is confident that noticeable progress will soon be visible in eradicating both load-shedding, and constraints within the freight and logistics industry.
tgt: Khabinete yi na ntshembo lowu vonakaka wa leswaku phurogirese yi ta vonaka ku nga ri khale eka ku hinguta ku tirhisiwa ka gezi hi ku siyerisana na swiphiqo eka vufambisi bya tinhundzu na indasitiri ya lojisitiki.

src: Cabinet is also pleased that despite remaining challenges, youth unemployment is gradually declining (a decrease of 1.9% from the previous quarter), and a 237 000 increase in the number of employed youth, rising to a total of six (6) million youth in employment.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhele yi tsakisiwa hi leswaku hambi ku ri na swirhalanganyi leswi saleke, mpfumaleko wa mitirho eka vatshwa wu ya ehansi hi switsongotsongo (ku chika hi 1.9% kusuka eka kotara leyi hundzeke), na a 237 000 ka tlakuko eka nomboro ya vantshwa lava lava thoriweke, swi fika eka nhlayo ya 6 miliyoni yo thoriwa ka vantshwa.

src: Investments In the same trajectory of a recovering and growing economy, Cabinet welcomed the additional R5-billion investment by the Ford Motor Company for its new plug-in hybrid electric Ford Ranger that is earmarked for export to Europe, New Zealand and Australia.
tgt: Vuvekisi Loko ka ha kongomiwi ko nhlakarhelisiwa no kurisiwa ikhonomi, Khabinete yi amukerile ku engeteriwa ka R5 biliyoni ya vuvekisi hi Khapani ya Mimovha ya Ford eka movha wa yona lowuntshwa Ford Ranger wo tirhisa gezi lowu nga … ta yisiwa Yuropo, New Zealand na Australia.

src: The company currently employs 5 200 people in South Africa.
tgt: Khapani sweswi yi thorile 5 200 wa vanhu eAfika-Dzonga.

src: Cabinet further welcomed the investment by Procter & Gamble (P&G) in its new state-of-the-art production line of the Pampers Premium Care in Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlherile yi amukela vuvekisi bya Procter & Gamble (P&G) eka ndhawu yo tumbuluxa vutshila ya yona ya Pampers Premium Care, Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.

src: The P&G cumulative investment since totals approximately R900 million since 2018 and currently employed over 4000 direct and indirect jobs throughout its value chain.
tgt: Vuvekisi bya P&G kusukela byi kwalomu ka R900 miliyona kusuka hi 2018 naswona sweswi yi thorile ku tlula 4000 wa mitirho yo kongoma no yo nga yi nga kongomi eka tindhawu ta yona to tirhela.

src: Both The Ford Motor Company and P&G project launches are testament of the valuable contribution of President Cyril Ramaphosa’s investment drive through the South Africa Investment Conference, and a reaffirmation of South Africa as an investment destination of choice.
tgt: Ku simeliwa ka tiphurojeke ta Khapani ya Mimovha ya Ford and P&G i vumbhoni bya nkoka byo nghenisa vuvekisi bya Purisidente Cyril Ramaphosa hi ku endla Tinhlengeletano ta Vuvekisi eAfrika-Dzonga, no tiyisisa Afrika-Dzonga tanihi ndhawu ya vuvekisi byo tihlawulela.

src: South Africa’s red meat access to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Cabinet welcomed the signing of the red meat agreement with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, during the Saudi-African Investment Summit.
tgt: 3 Nyama yo tshwuka ya le Afrika-Dzonga ya kumeka eKingdom ya Saudi Arabia Khabinete yi amukela ku sayiniwa ka ntwanano wa nyma yo tshwuka na Kingdom ya Saudi-Arabia, hi nkarhi wa Samiti ya Vuvekisi ya Saudi-African.

src: This agreement marks a critical step in ensuring that South African red meat products gain access to an important market, and further strengthens the contribution of the agricultural sector in both economic growth and job creation.
tgt: Ntwanano lowu wu kombisa xitepe xa kahle eku tiyisiseni leswaku switirhisiwa swa nyama yo tshwuka ya Afrika-Dzonga yi kota ku nghena eka timakete ta nkoka, no yisa emahlweni ku tiyisa ku hoxa xandla ka sekitara ya vurimi eka ku kurisa no tumbuluxa mitirho.

src: Cabinet congratulated Ministers Thoko Didiza and Ebrahim Patel for the work done to ensure the opening of this market for South African red meat products.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Holobye Thoko Didiza na Ebrahim Patel eka ntirho lowu va wu endlaka ku vona leswaku ku pfuleka makete lowu wa switirhisiwa swa nyama yo tshwuka ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Deliberate distortions of the Agri-Black Economic Empowerment (BEE) requirements for agricultural exports Cabinet condemned deliberate distortions by some sections of the media of the Agri-BEE requirements for agricultural exports to stoke racial tensions, and reminded the media that its freedom equally comes with responsibility.
tgt: 4 Ku cinca hi xikongomelo swilavelo swa ku Nyika matimba ya Ikhonomi eka Vantima (BEE) mafambiswa ya swa vurimi.

src: Cabinet expressed its appreciation to the agricultural industry, in particular the SA Wine and Agricultural Chamber of Business, commonly known as Agbiz, for rejecting attempts to plunge the country and the sector into racial tensions by publicly clarifying the distortions as soon as they were published.
tgt: Khabinete yi alana na ku cinciwa hi xikongomelo ka swin’wana swa swiyenge swa vuhaxi swa swilaveko swa Agri-BEE eka mafambiswa ya swa vurimi ku vanga ku kwatisana hi nhlonge, naswona yi tsundzuxa vuhangalasi bya mahungu leswaku ntshuxeko wa yona wu ta ni vutihlamuleri.

src: Your posture on this matter, demonstrated that indeed you have embraced the spirit canvassed by the Springboks of Stronger Together.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombisile ku tsakela eka indasitiri ya vurimi, ngopfungopfu the SA Wine na Agricultural Chamber of Business, leyi tivekaka hi Agbiz, ku va swi alanile no ringeta ku wisa tiko na sekitara hi xiphiqo xa hlonghe hi ku basisa ku cinca loko hi xihatla ku nga se yisiwa evanhwini.

src: Tourism Cabinet noted the partnership established between the Department of Tourism and Google as a game changer that will assist in promoting South Africa as a prime tourist destination.
tgt: Maendlelo ya n’wina eka leswi, ya komba swinene leswaku mi amukerile moya wo lava mavonelo eka vanhu hi ntshembo wa Springboks wa Nkoka wa Ntirhisano.

src: The partnership aims, amongst others, to facilitate the use of digital tools to enhance tourism experiences and sustainability, including the commitment that Google Maps will use technology to avoid crime hotspots.
tgt: 5 Vupfhumba Khabinete yi vonile vuthirhisano lebyi tumbuluxiweke exikarhi ka Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba na Google byi tisile ku cinca loko ku nga ta pfunete ku tlukusa Afrika-Dzonga tanihi ndhawu yo saseka ya vupfhumba.

src: This deployment affirms government’s commitment to put an end to illegal mining and create conditions for inclusive growth and transformation of the economy.
tgt: Vutirhisano byi kongomisiwa, exikarhi ka swin’wana, ku langutisa ku tirhisiwa switirhisiwa swa dijithali ku tlakusa ntokoto wa vupfhumba no fikelela swilaveko, ku katsa ku tiyimisela ku Mepe wa Gogulu wu ta tirhisa tekinojoji ku papalata tindhawu ta khombo ta vugevenga.

src: National Anti-Corruption Advisory Council’s (NACAC) National Dialogue Cabinet welcomed the successful hosting of the NACAC’s National Dialogue, which deliberated on progress in implementing the National Anti-Corruption Strategy and recommendations of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry into Allegations of State Capture.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku thoriwa ka 3 300 wa timembara ta Vuthu ra Vusirheleri ra Afrika-Dzonga ra Rixaka (SANDF), kusuka 28 2023 ku fika 28 Nhlangula 2023, ku seketela Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika Dzonga (SAPS) na swiyenge swin’wana swa nawu ku tirhana na ku ceriwa ka timayini swi nga ri nawini etikweni.

src: The progress includes eight (8) out of 16 recommended pieces of legislative reforms to address specific recommendations of the State Capture Commission that are now before Parliament.
tgt: Ku thoriwa ku tiyisisa ku tiyimisela ka mfumo ko herisa ku ceriwa ka timayini swi nga ri nawini no endla xiyimo lexi katsaka ku kula no cinca ikhonomi.

src: These Bills cover areas such as public procurement, administrative reform, conduct of public servants, reform of intelligence services, money laundering and electoral reform.
tgt: Vaholobye va Vululani, Lwisana na Vugevenga na Tlilasitara ya Vuhlayiseki va nyikile mayimelo ya ntirho lowu nga ku endliweni ku lwisana na vugevenga, naswona Holobye wa Maporisa vhiki leri hundzeke u nyikile xitiviso eka tinhlayohlayo ta kotara ta vugevenga.

src: The Asset Forfeiture Unit has been granted freezing orders worth R14 billion for state capture related cases and has recouped R.4 billion of the ill-gotten gains.
tgt: 7 Mbhurisano wa Khasele ya Rixaka yo Tsundzuxa ku lwa na Vukungundwana (NACAC) Khabinete yi amukele ku humelela ka ku khomiwa ka Mbhurisano wa Rixaka wa NACAC, lowu a wu langutile hi vurhon’wana phurogirese yo endla Maendlelo ya Rixaka yo lwa na Vukungundwana na Swikoxo swa Khomixini ya Huvo ya maveriveri ya ku Lawuriwa ka Mfumo leyi nga ePalamende sweswi.

src: In addition, the Investigating Directorate has taken 34 state capture and corruption cases to court, involving 205 accused persons.
tgt: Phurogirese yi katsa nhungu (8) eka 16 wa swilaveko swa ku ciciwa ka milawu ku hlamula swikoxo swa Khomixini ya ku Lawuriwa ka Mfumo.

src: Cabinet wishes to remind members of the community about government support programmes such as the Child Support Grant which is aimed at assisting families to meet the basic needs of children.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku tirhisana na mfumo ku hunguta Madzolonga ya ku ya hi Rimbewu loko swiyenge swa nawu swi ya emahlweni no khoma vadyohi vo biha timbilu eka vululami.

src: Infrastructure development Energy The Minister in The Presidency responsible for Electricity has provided a comprehensive public briefing on the status and progress with ensuring electricity security.
tgt: Leswi swi engetela ka Phurogireme leyikulu yo Pfuna Vaaki leyi mfumo wu nyikaka swakudya swa rihanyo eka midyangu leyi sweleke hi Phurogireme ya Rixaka ya Mphakelo wa Swakudya eSwikolweni na Mphakelo wa Swakudya Migangeni na tisentara ta nhluvukiso.

src: Water Security Cabinet is pleased with reports that the disputes that resulted in delays towards implementation of the Mzimvubu Dam project have been resolved and site establishment commenced in early November, whilst consultations with traditional leaders on social issues is underway.
tgt: 10 Ku titsarisela ku vhota Khabinete yi byerile vanhu lava ringaneleke ku vhota leswaku va tsarisa ku vhota eswitichini swa le kusuhi na vona swo vhotela, ku katsa ku nyika vuxokoxoko bya vona byitshwa hi Mahelo ya Vhiki yo Tsarisa ku Vhota ya ti 18 na 19 Hukuri 2023.

src: Cabinet was updated that the raising of the Clanwilliam Dam wall to increase storage capacity to 344 million cubic metres for the benefit of the people of the West Coast District Municipality, Cederberg Local Municipality and Matzikama Local Municipality is underway.
tgt: Ku pfuna vavhoti lava lavaka ku teka mapasi lava ma apulayeleke kumbe ku apulaya Xitifikheti xa Nkarhinyana xa Pasi, Ndzawulo ya Xikaya yi fambelanisile tiawara to tirha na ta IEC hi nkarhi wa vhiki ro titsarisela ku vhota.

src: Cabinet was briefed that the construction of the Tzaneen Dam re- commenced in June 2023, with the estimated completion date of April 2025.
tgt: (WEBTOKEN) leyi nga ku tirherheni kusukela hi Nyenyanyani 2023, ku tsarisa kumbe ku nyika vuxokoxoko bya vona lebyi ciceke.

src: Cabinet was apprised that a joint team of the three metropolitan municipalities (Ekurhuleni, Joburg and Tshwane) and Rand Water continue to meet daily to address root causes of water challenges.
tgt: 12 Nhlayiso wa Mati Khabinete yi tsakiwile hi swiviko swa leswaku swiphiqo leswi endleke ku va na ku nonoka eka ku sungula phurojeke ya Mzimvubu Dam swi lulamisile naswona ndhawu yo tirheka ka yona yi sunguriwile emasunguleni ya Hukuri, loko ku mburisana na tihosi hi leswi khumbaka vaaki swi ya emahlweni.

src: At the centre of Gauteng’s water challenges is water losses caused by old municipal infrastructure and deficiencies in water leakage monitoring and efficient repairs.
tgt: Khabinete yi tivisiwile leswaku ku tlakusiwa ka khumbi ra Damu ra Clanwilliam ku engetela ndahwu yo chela mati ku ya 344 wa timiliyoni ta timitara ku vuyerisa vanhu va le Masipala wa West Coast District, Masipala wa Cederberg na Masipala wa Matzikama Local swi ya emahlweni.

src: SA Connect Phase Two Cabinet received and considered an update report on the implementation of the SA Connect Phase 2 Project.
tgt: Khabinete yi byeriwile leswaku ku akiwa ka Damu ra Tzaneen swi sungurile nakambe hi Khotavuxika 2023, ku ehleketiwa leswaku ri ta hela hi Dzivamusoko 2025.

src: SA Connect is a flagship programme of government that seeks to bridge the digital divide by connecting households and government institutions and provide Wi-Fi access to communities across the country.
tgt: Khabinete yi vurile leswaku nhlangano wa mitlawa ya timasipalakulu (Ekurhuleni, Joburg and Tshwane) na Rand Water swi ya emahlweni no mburisana masiku hinkwawo ku fikelela ku kuma xiphiqo lexi vangaka swirhalanganyi wa mati.

src: On progress with Phase 2 of the project, Cabinet was pleased that 1 000 households were connected with broadband and that 1 000 community Wi-Fi hotspots are planned to be installed by December 2023.
tgt: Leswi endlaka kayivelo wa mati eGauteng i ku halaka ka mati loku vangiwaka hi swimakiwa swa khale swa masipala no pfumaleka ka xopaxopo wa ku pfuta ka mati no lunghisiwa hi nkarhi.

src: In addition, the project has rolled out infrastructure for Internet connectivity that allows households to access the Internet at cheaper rates.
tgt: Phurogireme ya Vutihlanganisi ya Afrika-Dzonga i ya mfumo leyi lavaka ku pfala nkayivelo wa vutihlanganisi bya dijithala hi ku hlanganisa mindyangu na tindzawulo ta mfumo no nyika kumeko wa Wi-Fi emigangeni ya tiko hinkwaro.

src: For R249 per month, a subscribing household has unlimited access to robust internet, with cheaper data costs as low as R5 for one gig per day.
tgt: Hi mafambelo ya Feyisi ya Vumbirhi ya Phurojeke, Khabinete yi tsakisiwile hi 1 000 ya mindyangu yi na Burodibende naswona 1 000 ya tindhawu leti ku nga ta kumekeka Wi-Fi emigangeni ti kunguhatiwile ku vekeriwa hi N'wedzamhala 2023.

src: It is estimated that the project will also contribute to economic participation through the provision of 4 505 semi-skilled and 169 skilled employment opportunities, and will support over 75 small to medium-sized companies.
tgt: Hi ku engetela, phurejeke yi simekile switirhisiwa swa inthanete leswi pfumelelaka mindyangu ku kuma inthanete hi nxavo wa le hansi.

src: In addition, high demand spectrum will be provided to more than 18 000 schools, 943 libraries, 5 731 health facilities and 8 241 tribal authorities over the next months through the social obligations to telecommunications companies.
tgt: Hi R249 hi n’hweti, ndyangu lowu titsariseleke u na inthanete leyi nga pimiwangiki ya matimba, hi nxavo wa data wa le hansi wa R5 ya gigi yin’we hi siku.

src: It is anticipated that the project will deliver connectivity to more than five million households and 32 000 community Wi-Fi hotspots across the country over the next 36 months.
tgt: Swi mpimanyetiwile leswaku phurojeke yi ta tlhela yi hoxa xandla eka ntirhelo ra ikhonomi hi nyika swivandlanene swa mitirho ya 4 505 ya lava ntokoteke switsongo na 169 ya lava ntokoteke swinene, no seketela kwalomu ko tlula 75 tikhaphani letitsongo.

src: Broadcasting Digital Migration Cabinet noted the progress the country is making with the migration from analogue to digital broadcasting.
tgt: 14 Ku Cinca ka Vuhaxi bya dijithala Khabinete yi lemukile endlelo leri tiko ri ri endlaka ro cinca ku suka eka vuhaxi bya analogo ku yiwa eka vuhaxi bya dijithala.

src: As of 23 July 2023, all 123 analogue transmitters above 694 Megahertz were switched off in the remaining four provinces namely the Eastern Cape, KwaZulu-Natal, Western Cape and Gauteng.
tgt: Kusuka 23 Mawuwani 2023, 123 wa tithirasimita ta tianalogo hinkwato ta 694 Megaheze ti timiwile eka swifundzakulu leswi a swi sele swa Kapa-Vuxa, KwaZulu-Natal, Kapa-Vupeladyambu na Gauteng.

src: This will free up the spectrum needed for mobile broadband, and other information and communications technology-related needs.
tgt: Leswi swi ta endla nkumeko lowu lavekeka wa burodibende ya tiqingho, na vuxokoxoko byin’wani na vutihlanganisi bya thekinoloji lebyi yelanaka.

src: Cabinet was briefed that the Minister of Communications and Digital Technologies had determined December 2024 as the final date for the switch-off of all analogue broadcasting services, and that progress is on to meet the set target date.
tgt: Khabinete yi byeriwile leswaku Holobye wa Vutihlanganisi na Thekinoloji ya Dijithala u vekile N’wedzamhala 2024 tani hi siku ro hetelela ro tima vukorhokeri bya vuhaxi bya tianalogo, naswona swilo swi famba kahle ku fikelela siku leri vekiweke.

src: Municipal Cleaning and Greening Programme Cabinet encourages South Africans to join the programme to keep our country clean and free from litter by participating in the municipal cleaning and greening initiatives taking place across the country.
tgt: 15 Phurogireme ya Masipala ya Basiso na Nhlayiso wa Mbango 16 Khabinete yi khutaza MaAfrika-Dzonga ku tinghenisa eka phurogireme ku endlela leswaku tiko ra hina ri tshama ri basile no pfumaleke ku cukumetiwa ka swilo hi ku va xiave xa migingiriko ya masipala ya basiso na nhlayiso wa mbango leyi nga ku humeleni tiko hinkwaro.

src: The programme which has already created more than 37 000 work opportunities is aimed at clearing the 7 251 illegal dumping hotspots in communities across the country.
tgt: Phurogireme leyi nga tumbuluxa ku tlula wa 37 000 swivandlanene swa mitirho yi kongomisiwile eka ku basisa 7 251 wa tindhawu leti ku cukumetiwaka thyaka swi nga ri nawini emigangeni tiko hinkwaro.

src: This involves the daily cleaning of streets, clearing illegal dumping sites, cleaning coastal areas and the revitalisation of parks.
tgt: Leswi swi katsa ku basisa switarata masiku hinkwawo, ku basisa tindhawu leti ku cukumetiwaka thyaka swi nga ri nawini, ku basisa mabiribiri no pfuxeta tiphaka.

src: Capacity of the State Improved National and Provincial Audit Outcomes (2022/23 financial year) Cabinet was briefed by the Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA) non the outcomes of the 2022/23 financial year national and provincial audits.
tgt: Vuswikoti bya Mfumo 17 Ku Antswa ka Mbuyelo wa Oditi ya Rixaka na Swifundzankulu (Lembe ximali ra 2022/23) Khabinete yi byeriwile hi Oditara-Jenerala wa Afrika-Dzonga (AGSA) mayelana na mimbuyelo ya lembe ximali ra 2022/23 ya Rixaka na Swifundzankulu.

src: The AGSA pointed out to encouraging trend of continuous improved performance which indicates overall improvement in accountability, transparency, adequacy and effectiveness of controls.
tgt: AGSA yi kombisile ku khutaza maendlelo lama ya ka emahlweni yo antswisa matirhelo lama kombisaka ku antswa eka vutihlamuleri, ntiyiso, vuswikoti na vulawuri byo ringanela.

src: The departments and institutions that have achieved unqualified audits with no findings (clean audits) have increased from 94 during the 2018/2019 to 147 during the 2022/2023, reporting a year-on-year improvement.
tgt: Tindzawulo na tindhawu ta mfumo leti nga fikelela tioditi to basa ku nga ri na leswi kumiweke (Oditi yo basa) ti tlakukile kusuka ka 94 hi 2018/2019 ku ya ka 147 hi 2022/2023, ku tivisiwa ku antswa ka lembe na lembe.

src: The departments and institutions that have achieved unqualified audits with findings are 162, and this represents 39% of the audited institutions.
tgt: Tindzawulo na tindhawu ta mfumo leti nga fikelela tioditi to basa ku ri na leswi kumiweke i 162, naswona leswi swi vula 39% ya tindhawu leti oditiweke.

src: The institutions and departments with Disclaimed findings have decreased from 25 during 2018/2019 reporting period to 5 during 2022/2023 reporting period and represent only 1% of audited institutions.
tgt: Tindhawu ta mfumo na tindzawulo leti nga na swilaveko swo pfumala vutihlamuleri yi ehlile kusuka ka 25 hi nkarhi wo vika hi 2018/2019 ti ya ka 5 hi nkarhi wo vika hi 2022/2023 naswona leswi swi vula 1% ya tindhawu leti oditiweke.

src: Although the Auditor-General reports an estimated R14 billion in financial losses, measures to address material irregularities also show an improvement.
tgt: Hambiswiritano, Oditara-Jenerala u vikile mpimanyeto wa R14 biliyoni lowu lahlekeke, swipimelo leswi langutaka matirhiselo yo biha swi komba ku antswa.

src: Although challenges still remain, the outcomes of the 2022/23 national and provincial governments audits dispel claims that State capacity is in total collapse, with independent and objective assessment by institutions such as the AGSA indicating a very strong and continuous improvement trajectory.
tgt: Hambiswiritano swirhalanganyi swa ha ri kona, mimbuyelo ya 2022/23 ya tioditi ta mfumo wa rixaka na swifundzankulu yi bakanya swikoxo swa leswaku vuswikoti bya mfumo byi le kuweni hi ku hetiseka, …… yo fana na AGSA yi kombisaka ku tiya swinene no ya mahlweni no antswa hi ndlela.

src: International Relations – State Visit to Qatar Last week, President Cyril Ramaphosa concluded a State Visit to Qatar at the invitation of His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, Amir of the State of Qatar.
tgt: 18 Vuxaka bya Matiko– Vuendzi bya Ximfumo eQatar Vhiki leri hundzeke, Puresidente Cyril Ramaphosa u gimetile riendzo ra ximfumo eQatar eka ku rhambiwa hi His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, Amir wa mfumo wa Qatar.

src: The visit underscored three decades of diplomatic relations.
tgt: Riendzo ri tiyisisa vukaka bya matiko bya 30 wa malembe.
